reviews.author: Lucky Rana
reviews.title: Was a Loyal Returning Guest — Wasim from the Front Desk Staff & Poor Service Ended That Forever
reviews.text:
Our family has stayed at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa several times over the years, and until now we had always considered it one of our favorite properties. We have previously left 5-star reviews and recommended it to friends and family. That is why our stay on June 18–19, 2026 (Room 4006) was particularly disappointing.

The first issue occurred during check-in. I arrived at 12:30 PM and was informed that my room would be ready within 30 minutes. Instead, I waited until 2:00 PM. During that time, I watched several guests who arrived after me receive their rooms much sooner. What was most disappointing was the complete lack of communication, explanation, or apology.

The restaurant experience was equally frustrating. Staff appeared focused almost entirely on large groups while individual tables received very little attention. Our food took approximately one hour to arrive, and after the initial order, nobody returned to take any additional requests. We had to actively search for staff ourselves.

The most disappointing interaction occurred at checkout with Wasim from the Front Desk Staff. When I provided honest feedback regarding the stay, there was no acknowledgment, concern, or attempt to understand the issues. Immediately afterward, I was informed that a glass water bottle from the room would incur a ₹500 charge. While I understand that hotel property may be chargeable, the fact that this was raised only after I voiced criticism created a very poor impression and made the interaction feel unnecessarily confrontational.

As a returning guest, I expected better service recovery, better communication, and greater professionalism. The property itself remains beautiful, but hospitality is defined by people, and unfortunately this stay fell far below the standards we had experienced in the past.

For verification purposes, I have attached my booking confirmation with this review.

reviews.author: Sunshine44237212705
reviews.title: How Was This Room Ever Cleared for Check-In?
reviews.text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but this experience deserves to be highlighted.

We stayed at Khyber Resort, Gulmarg for two nights in March, expecting the standards one would associate with a luxury property. Unfortunately, our stay ended with a discovery that completely overshadowed the experience.

During checkout, we found a used condom underneath our bed. It clearly belonged to a previous guest and certainly not to us. The fact that it remained there throughout our stay indicates that the room had either not been properly cleaned or not properly inspected before being allocated to new guests.

This is not a minor housekeeping lapse. It is a serious hygiene failure that should never occur at any hotel, let alone one that positions itself as one of the finest luxury resorts in the region.

What is even more disappointing is the lack of accountability. We reported the matter, documented it with photographs, and expected at the very least an explanation or acknowledgement from the management. To date, no meaningful communication has been received regarding how such an incident could have occurred.

Luxury hospitality is built on trust. Guests trust that their room has been cleaned thoroughly and prepared to the highest standards. In our case, that trust was broken.

The views of Gulmarg were beautiful, but unfortunately the most memorable part of our stay was discovering something that should never have been present in a guest room in the first place.

reviews.author: pankaj
reviews.title: Great location and view but needs improvement with pricing and customer service
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐ 7/10

We stayed at Khyber Resort & Spa with our family for one night during Eid and had a mixed but generally enjoyable experience.

The highlight of the resort is undoubtedly the accommodation and location. The rooms are exceptionally spacious, beautifully designed, well-lit, and offer spectacular views. The swimming pool is absolutely stunning—temperature-controlled, impeccably maintained, and surrounded by breathtaking scenery. It is easily one of the most memorable features of the property.

However, there are a few areas where the experience fell short of expectations.

The biggest disappointment was the in-room dining. While we expected premium pricing at a luxury resort, the value for money was difficult to justify. We paid approximately ₹2,000 for a pizza and another ₹2,000 for a club sandwich. Unfortunately, the club sandwich that arrived was more like a basic chicken-and-mayonnaise sandwich rather than the classic club sandwich we expected. The pizza was equally underwhelming—flat, ordinary, and more reminiscent of a commercial pizza than a premium resort offering. The food presentation and overall dining experience did not match the pricing.

Room service was also slower than expected and could certainly be more responsive.

As we stayed during Eid and our package included both breakfast and dinner, we were hoping for a special festive dining experience showcasing local Kashmiri cuisine or Eid specialties. Instead, the dinner buffet felt fairly standard and lacked the festive touch we had anticipated.

Another point worth mentioning is the cost of the extra bed. We requested an additional bed for our child and were charged approximately ₹13,000, including breakfast and dinner. While we understand that Khyber is positioned as a luxury resort, this felt excessive when compared with other premium properties we stayed at during the same trip. At Pine & Peak, Pahalgam, we paid around ₹4,500 for an extra bed, and at Taj Dal View, Srinagar, approximately ₹5,000. Khyber’s charge was therefore more than two-and-a-half times higher. Premium pricing is expected, but the differential felt difficult to justify.

What disappointed me most, however, was the handling of guest feedback at checkout. Before leaving, I wanted to share my observations directly with the Front Office or Operations Manager so that the feedback could be used constructively. The receptionist kindly offered to contact the manager, but I was informed that the manager was busy in a meeting and that I should simply post my feedback online instead. For a property of this stature, I found this response disappointing. Guest feedback—whether positive or negative—is valuable, and taking a few moments to acknowledge a departing guest’s concerns would have demonstrated a stronger commitment to customer service and continuous improvement.

To be fair, Khyber is a beautiful luxury property with world-class views, spacious rooms, and excellent facilities. However, the pricing of ancillary services, dining experience, and responsiveness to guest feedback are areas where the resort can improve.

Overall, I would rate the experience 7/10. Had the pricing of add-on services been more reasonable and the service experience more polished, it could easily have been a 9/10 stay.

— Pankaj

reviews.title: Exceptional Stay at The Khyber Hotel, Gulmarg – A True Himalayan Gem!
reviews.text:
We celebrated our 25th marriage anniversary at The Khyber Hotel in Gulmarg, and it was truly magical – the staff made our milestone unforgettable! To top it off, the team surprised us with a beautifully decorated room, a celebratory cake, and a lovely bouquet – pure perfection that made our anniversary day extra special. 

Nestled amid breathtaking snow-capped peaks, the resort offers luxurious rooms with stunning views, impeccable cleanliness, and top-notch amenities like the spa and ski facilities. The property feels like a warm embrace from the Himalayas – cozy fires, gourmet dining, and seamless service throughout.

They went above and beyond for us: the front office stars Nazima and Ishfaq welcomed us with genuine warmth and made check-in a breeze with their efficiency and smiles, while Faizan went the extra mile to swiftly arrange our gondola ride booking to Apharwat Peak!

Dining at Cloves Restaurant was a highlight – Junaid Mir, Tawheed Dar, Mubeena, Firdous, and Sajad delivered outstanding service with flavourful Kashmiri cuisine and personalized attention. Meals felt like home-cooked feasts with a fine-dining twist.

The temperature-controlled swimming pool was an absolute delight in the crisp mountain air, perfectly maintained by Touseef and Tamzila, who ensured a relaxing oasis amid the chill.

The Khyber isn't just a hotel; it's an experience. We'll be back!

5/5 stars

reviews.title: Its a great location.... Some services leave a lot to be desired.....
reviews.text:
We were quite excited about our stay at the Khyber. Especially after everything we had heard about it. And it lived upto the expectations or atleast for the most parts it did.
The good:
1- Location location location --- this is one thing this hotel has going for itself. Its located in the lap of the snow capped mountains. You simpy can not beat the view. From our room (1021) it was unobstructed even sitting on the couch or from the bed --- straight mountain views. I hear room 1017 and 1014 have the best views
2- Saba and Khushbu who work at the restaurants are the sweetest. Absolute angels. So caring -- they really took great care of our old parents and our group overall. 
3- Spa - good spa - good service -- (wish they could take advantage of the views and design the spa room/windows accordingly)
4- Size of the rooms, Bathrooms are incredible. Fantastic.
5- Rashida and Imtiaz (?) in housekeeping were so sweet. 
6- the quality of linen and pillows is awesome. 
7- the musicial play Santoor and Rabad is awesome (perhaps lower the volume on the speaker).

What could be better:
a- Courtesy - I was VERY disappointed with the lack of courtesy from the reception staff and many of the guys at the restaurant. Maybe because we were coming from an amazing service at the ITC in Pehalgam and going to the Taj in Srinagar both with amazing service, the Khyber left a lot to be desired
b- Not to overgeneralize, but my friends who travelled with us had the same unaided view - The MEN that worked the front desk area and at the restaurants, coffeeshop just seemed to have an attitude about something. It was very weird. They would make eye contact but not acknowledge that you needed help. Things as simple as moving a couch so we could sit together as a group, started with a no, they would see you needed water but wouldnt bring it.  I'd highly suggest this crowd either go train at a Taj or let Saba and Khushbu lead this team - they can set the gold standard
c- The corridor can be noisy. We had a hard time sleeping just because how noisy the corridor was.  Maybe because our location was on the way to the pool.. but still....
d- Would love for the conceirge to be more knowledgable about the local surroundings. Especially about the outdoors and the local hikes etc. 
e- The hotel staff gets overwhlemed when large groups check in together. They have been around long enough that they should be able to manage these crowds well

Personally, if Taj or ITC were to open a hotel in Gulmarg with a similar view, I'd definitely stay there for their hospitality.

reviews.author: Charu
reviews.title: Hyped
reviews.text:
During my vacation to Kashmir, many friends told me that Khyber was overhyped. I always disagreed  it was on my bucket list, and I truly believed it would live up to its reputation. But when I finally arrived, I was deeply disappointed.

The rooms are in urgent need of refurbishment. The plumbing clearly requires attention, and the overall condition feels tired. The lift system is confusing  at one point you take one lift, at another level you need to change to a different one. Given that it’s built on a hilly terrain, some structural complexity may be unavoidable, but poor maintenance and lack of clarity are not. Cleanliness was another concern; certain areas felt dingy rather than luxurious.

To their credit, they upgraded us to a suite with a balcony, which was a relief and certainly better than the initial room allotted. The food was good, and the live santoor playing was honestly the biggest highlight of the stay  it added a beautiful Kashmiri touch to the ambiance. The spa experience with therapist Islary was excellent as well. Varun and Abhishek genuinely tried their best to make our stay comfortable, and their effort is appreciated.

However, good staff efforts and cultural touches cannot compensate for the pressing need to invest in upkeep and room maintenance. Unfortunately, I now have to agree with what I once dismissed — this property does feel overhyped.

reviews.author: AK
reviews.title: A Magical and Unforgettable Stay
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa, Gulmarg, and it was certainly the most memorable trip of our lives. We had booked 2 rooms for our family, and we absolutely loved our stay. The hotel truly stands out for its exceptional hospitality, which goes far beyond expectations. The staff are extremely polite, warm, and always ready to help with a genuine smile.

The property itself is breathtakingly beautiful, surrounded by stunning mountain views and lush greenery. Every corner of the hotel reflects luxury, comfort, and attention to detail. The restaurant staff went way beyond to ensure that guests were comfortable and well taken care of. The room service team was also very prompt, polite, and helpful throughout our stay.

The location is perfect, as the hotel is right next to the Gondola point, making it very convenient for guests. There are also multiple taxis available just outside the hotel, which makes commuting easy. The breakfast and dinner spreads were lavish, with a wide variety of delicious options catering to different tastes.

The spa and wellness facilities are excellent, and the overall ambience of the resort is very peaceful and relaxing. The rooms were spacious, warm, and offered spectacular views of the snow-covered mountains, making the experience even more special. The hotel also offers great activities and personalized experiences, which made our family holiday even more enjoyable.

Overall, it was a magical stay, and we would highly recommend The Khyber to anyone visiting Gulmarg. It is truly a perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and warm hospitality.

reviews.title: Great stay- heated pool was the highlight
reviews.text:
We had a good stay at The Khyber, Gulmarg, with several aspects that truly stood out, though we did feel a bit more could have been offered considering the premium price point.

The views from the room were absolutely stunning, overlooking the Himalayan mountain range - easily one of the highlights of our stay. The heated pool was excellent and very welcome in Gulmarg’s cold weather. Food and service at the food table were prompt, well-managed, and consistently very good.

That said, for a hotel of this category, we would have expected a few more comforts such as heated water in the flush and being provided with two key cards by default, which would have made the stay more convenient. At the same time, we do understand that maintaining a large luxury property in a remote, high-altitude town like Gulmarg comes with its own operational challenges, and we do acknowledge the effort that goes into keeping the hotel running smoothly in such conditions.

Special mentions go to Firdous at Cloves for attentive service, Wasim Yusuf, whose Rubab playing added a beautiful and calming cultural touch to the experience, and Owais at the spa/pool, who was very helpful and courteous.

Overall, a pleasant stay with memorable views, great food, and standout staff but with room for improvement to fully match its luxury positioning.

reviews.title: Extremely Misleading Property – Not Worth the Money!!!
reviews.text:
We booked the Luxury Balcony Gulmarg View Room at The Khyber for our 5th anniversary, and the experience was extremely disappointing. The so-called “Gulmarg view” is completely fake and misleading. Instead of the beautiful valley view shown on their website and travel platforms, all you actually get is a hut view. They have conveniently erased or hidden the real images everywhere, which clearly amounts to misrepresentation and cheating customers.

The hospitality is equally poor. The staff and management seem least bothered about guest concerns, offering no proper assistance or care. For a property that claims to be luxury, the service was far below basic expectations.

Another major disappointment is the swimming pool, which they overhype in every advertisement. Shockingly, it is only accessible from 12 pm to 9 pm, and guests are not allowed to use it in the morning. This is the first hotel we’ve ever seen with such pathetic and restrictive rules, making the whole facility pointless.

Overall, this property is not worth the money. Please look for better hotels in Gulmarg—don’t fall for the misleading pictures and promises. We truly regret choosing this place for our special occasion.

Beyond the views, the hospitality and dining are what truly set The Khyber apart. The resort’s restaurants feature a magnificent spread of both Kashmiri and global delicacies.

Chef Khan’s commitment to catering to guest needs, ensuring the authenticity of local Wazwan preparations, and personally engaging with diners transformed our meals from excellent to truly unforgettable. His dedication is a perfect example of The Khyber’s world-class service.

If you seek the ultimate luxury retreat with sublime food and genuinely personalized care, The Khyber is the definitive choice.

If you’re looking for luxury, comfort, and world class hospitality amidst nature’s beauty, The Khyber is the perfect choice. We can’t wait to return in winters..

reviews.author: zeenia c
reviews.title: Impeccable service & Great hospitality

reviews.author: Ray
reviews.title: Comfortable stay for families.
reviews.text: It was beautiful in winters. We booked the Himalayan view, balcony room. Enjoyed every bit of the view, from the room and the bathtub. Few flaws being, our room was ready but wasn't informed, even though we were in front of them throughout. Some parts of the room were dusty, even the bottle on the bedside was dusty on top. Near bathtub also it was dusty. Furnitures are normal, not the extraordinary Kashmiri ones. Service was OK, we wanted to order in-room from 'Brava', they told us on phone that the menu for this restaurant is available in the room QR code. After searching, didn't find, again called, then somebody else says that they don't serve in the room. This wasted a lot of time. Spa was exceptional! A must-try. Pool water was too hot for me, couldn't open eyes and swim. There is a kids playroom also. Overall a lot of things to do. Breakfast spread was good. Heating system is perfect.

reviews.title: Best 5star experience in terms of hospitality and food
reviews.text: The food is absolutely brilliant. We ordered more than we were advised by the staff and finished everything. The Chef Mr Rakesh kumar chose most healthy ingredients with perfect spices making it a truly 5star taste and 5 star hospitality by sabreena, Amirr tral, & ishfan

reviews.author: araustin
reviews.title: The Khyber - Paradise in midst of the Paradise
reviews.text:
Kashmir has been always on our bucket list for years and finally this year in Jan 2025 we managed to fulfill this long overdue holiday wish through Gulmarg. The Khyber Himalayan resort has been certainly one of the most memorable stays we have experienced. Lovely beautiful property midst the snow capped mountains and valley. Great ambience, food, service and comfort. Our 4 year toddler enjoyed the stay, played a lot with the snow and had a blast in the heated indoor pool. 

To top it off, we had Khurshid pick us up and drop us back in Srinagar. A very safe pair of hands, kind and helpful. Despite the snowy conditions Khurshid skilfully drove through the valley. He also had a lot of good suggestions to explore while in Gulmarg. Also played a big hand making this all worthwhile. 

Certainly looking forward to visiting Gulmarg and staying in The Khyber again.

Just, supremely efficient, eager to help and what not !!!!  In restaurant, they work hard to make you happy. Chef Munich and South Indian Chef Vikram are beyond compare. reviews.title: Highly overrated & over priced
reviews.text:

Breakfast spread was one of best but Ala carte is highly over priced 
Can visit once but not value for money

reviews.author: Sagar
reviews.title: Winter family vacation
reviews.text: The thing which impressed us was the lavish interiors. But the resort lacks in terms of some amenities which should be a necessity for a top notch property. As the ambient temperature gets extremely cold in the winter time, there’s no hot water facility in the bidet which is really inconvenient & m really surprised that the celebrities staying in the resort aren’t highlighting this. Also the areas outside the rooms aren’t air proof leading to cold air entering everywhere. The resort food quality is good but very costly ( which has become very common in all five star properties in Kashmir valley for whatever reasons). Mr. Waseem of housekeeping is the brightest star as he is attending to each & everyone’s needs & ensuring that the resort’s high standards are maintained. The heated swimming pool is a good one but there should be a life guard available & there should be time allotted to families & couples as the couples get really cosy in the pool which sometimes becomes inconvenient for the families.

reviews.author: Sowmith r
reviews.title: Khyber should allow booking amendments for medical situations
reviews.text:
Booking Dates
7-11 October 2024

I recently had a disappointing experience with Khyber. While I understand their policies, I felt let down by their lack of flexibility. Due to an unexpected health emergency, we had to request a cancellation or, at the very least, change of dates. But despite explaining the situation and providing all necessary documentation, the hotel refused to accommodate our request.

I am well aware of the non-refundable nature of the booking, but given the large sum of money involved, I had hoped for some level of understanding. Emergencies happen, and it’s unfortunate that in such a situation, the hotel’s response was strictly policy-driven, with no consideration for the circumstances.

It’s disappointing to see that a business prioritizes policy over the genuine difficulties of its guests, especially when significant amounts of money are at stake. I hope Khyber reevaluates how they handle such cases in the future, as a little empathy could go a long way.

We lost about 2.5 lakhs on this booking.

reviews.title: Good Hotel but not worth the hype and money
reviews.text:
We spent three nights here (18th to 21st August) and had the following experience:

Positives:
- The location is great and a 2 min walk from the Gandola (cablecar). The hotel is nice and well maintained and views are beautiful.
- The L'Occitane spa was amazing.

Negatives:
- The hotel does NOT have AC and only has heating. Therefore, if you visit during any season besides Winter, the lack of AC is a problem. The room was hot and still!
- The swimming pool was very underwhelming and the water was torrid! 
- The jacuzzi in both the men and women spa bathrooms were half broken and not working.
- The food was average at best and extremely expensive for what they serve! Expected much better food and was disappointed. The Italian restaurant was still better but the main restaurant was sub-par.
- The housekeeping was not at all of a 5 Star Hotel - everyday they would mess up something or the other. 

Overall, the stay was decent but given how expensive the hotel is, we were fairly disappointed and do not think it was worth the hype! The hotel needs to improve and up their game!

reviews.author: Inspire52831243043
reviews.title: Terrible - Avoid - Rude
reviews.text:
Terrible Experience at Khyber Himalayan Resort

Our stay at Khyber Himalayan Resort in Gulmarg on July 30-31, 2024, was nothing short of a disaster. The Chicken Biryani was excessively oily, overly spicy, and barely edible. The noodles were dry, lacking any vegetables, and equally disappointing. Despite our feedback, the manager dismissed our concerns with an indifferent attitude.

The issues didn’t end there. The resort’s indoor areas were unbearably hot due to the lack of air conditioning, and they refused to let us use the outdoor seating, which was covered despite the sunny weather. The staff's rudeness was palpable.

The situation worsened when my husband used the soaker tub in our room. The water was muddy and yellowish, and after draining, the room was flooded with dirty water. We were informed that the drainage was backing into the tub. Instead of taking responsibility, the staff and manager tried to cover up the issue. They offered us a neighbouring room, but with our original room filled with sewage water, that was the least they could do.

Although the Brava Restaurant provided improved service later in the evening, it felt like a superficial attempt to compensate for the day’s many failures. Overall, the experience was unacceptable, rude, and disappointing. I strongly advise against staying at this resort.

Hotel does not have a Bar, but a lovely Italian resto, great buffet,  our waiter Abdul Kadir, was phenomenal.  We kids had a little upset stomach,  he promptly got us a doctor.  Like in 10 min. reviews.author: Som_Roy
reviews.title: Luxury Amidst Nature - Outdoor activities could improve
reviews.text: Our recent 2-night stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa confirmed its reputation as the pinnacle of luxury in Kashmir. The resort boasts expansive rooms with breathtaking views, impeccable service, and a fantastic heated pool, all of which elevate the guest experience to extraordinary heights. However, while the resort excels in comfort and amenities, it falls short in integrating the natural allure of Gulmarg into its offerings. Visitors looking to engage in outdoor activities such as ATBs, skiing, or the Gondola ride will find themselves needing to arrange these externally, as the hotel does not provide these services. Despite this, the hospitality shown by staff members like Aijaz, Aamir, and Rayees in the restaurant was remarkable. Their professionalism and attentive service greatly enhanced our dining experiences and deserve special recognition. The Khyber is indeed a sanctuary of luxury, though a few more in-house outdoor services could make it truly unparalleled.

reviews.author: JanviShahh
reviews.title: Nature's Luxury Haven: A Majestic Retreat at Khyber in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Our return to Khyber for the second time proved to be just as remarkable as our initial experience. Our first encounter with this exquisite establishment was in December of 2018, where we joyously welcomed the New Year amidst the hotel's splendid arrangements.

This recent visit took us to the snowy landscapes of Srinagar and Gulmarg, where we were blessed with a picturesque snowfall upon our arrival in Gulmarg, transforming the surroundings into a mesmerizing white haven.

Upon returning to the hotel after a delightful snow play, we were greeted by a dedicated room for guests to store their snow gear and change footwear, providing the convenience we needed. The hotel offers comfortable footwear for leisurely strolls, while guests can conveniently leave their rented boots in this designated area.

Cloves, the hotel's primary restaurant, offers a diverse array of cuisines, predominantly North Indian, where we relished in the culinary delights amidst a bustling ambiance, particularly during buffet hours. Our culinary journey extended to Brava, where we delighted in delectable Italian fare accompanied by a scenic view. While the mushroom soup surpassed expectations, the Eggplant Parmigiana fell slightly short, yet the Tiramisu redeemed the dining experience with its delightful taste. The attentive staff provided warm and insightful service throughout our dining experience.

For those seeking lighter fare and evening teas, Chaikash, the hotel's tea lounge, offers an inviting space, while CALABASH caters to enthusiasts of shisha.

One of Khyber's standout features is its temperature-controlled pool, offering a breathtaking view that complements the luxurious experience. The spa services uphold a high standard of professionalism, with knowledgeable therapists ensuring a rejuvenating experience.

Khyber in Gulmarg stands as a testament to the harmonious blend of nature and luxury, offering an indulgent escape for discerning travelers.

reviews.author: Hetal C
reviews.title: Watch out!! Appearance can b very deceptive
reviews.text:
Imagine walking into the only 5* property in Gulmarg & getting a cold welcome!! 

We entered the property wit 2 senior citizens - an infant 6 months old - a child 4.5 yrs old + 3 out of the 4 adults unwell - all of them struggling wit travel sickness, tired as hell Frm the 4 hr road travel Frm Pahalgam only to see a fully busy lobby & no one to even bother about ur presence there 
Versus the other properties where u r so warmly welcomed wit some associate help u settle down while they help u thru the checkin 

Post all the formalities, we were definitely given a table where they served the kawah while they handed over the rooms.. But also, We were just abt 20 mins late for Hi tea - but were outright refused the service. 

The rooms we got were @ ground level called level 5 wit a decent view - but the first thing u would see r the green Bob wires n not the scenic beauty as they r so in ur face . 
Also, u just cannot keep the curtains open to enjoy the views at any point of time as ppl walk around n there is zero privacy!! 
It was just another room wit zero view now. 

The hotel is so overbooked wit limited staff & Resturant space that it feels like a fish market. The tables r so close to each other tht u r literally looking into ur neighbours food & hearing their conversations - the waiters have to come so close to u n take ur order coz they can barely hear u.. 
plus since they r so under equipped to handle this kind of a crowd, beware if u order al-a-cart, the quality of food is just abt edible incase u r lucky!! 
We got unlucky wit undercooked rice & super spicy salad, dal wit barely a tadka flavour & buns that were dry & hard.. 

We also requested for an empty soup bowl to make the infant porridge- but they were so busy taking other orders tht I had to personally go and get the bowl while my child was crying wit hunger. 

The people in Kashmir in general r very sweet & helpful.. All the hotels we stayed in so far whether it was the Lalit in Srinagar or Radisson in Pehalgam, we were really welcomed n well taken care of .. it was like we must make a visit to Kashmir often not just for its beauty but also for its people, love & service.
But unfortunately Khyber can really change ur opinion, 

It’s our first day here n we can’t really wait to get outta this property!! 

I would think better to try another property - this is only over hyped as it’s the only available 5 start here.

Varun was there for breakfast lunch and dinner- winder when he rests. And always personally attending to us add taking care of all our demands. 
Chef Ranjan curated fabulous food varieties and dishes- the Italian and the Indian are to die for. And he too personally met us before and during meals and ensured our individual taste preferences are taken care of. 
They also organised a lovely bonfire especially for us. 
As such everyone was very hospitable- cannot point out any one who was lacking in any way. 
I have to mention about the very well heated pool and the Steam Sauna & Jacuzzi- which gave us the relaxation every evening. 
Last but the most amazing evening was the private theatre which we booked- a Six Seater almost lie-flat seats. We watched a movie and had a superb Indian dinner there only. 
So if possible I would rate Khyber 7 stars.

reviews.author: Timothy M
reviews.title: Don's "pass" on the Khyber Hotel
reviews.text:
I was persuaded to stay at the Khyber by my cousin (who happens to be in the travel industry) a week ago.  I'm so glad he convinced me to stay there.  The hotel itself is a wooden marvel! Having lived in the northern Midwest part of the US, I know what a toll winter takes on outdoor structures, especially wood.  The artistic detail and its maintenance were excellent. Let's lets talk about the staff. From the moment we arrived to the moment we left, the staff was attentive and sincere.  A gentleman at the reception desk named Irfan was a standout amongst standouts. He assisted us with services at the hotel, and out of the hotel (especially arranging for currency exchanges).  The food (and I'm a non-veg) was impressive on an ala-carte  basis. Unsurprisingly, the breakfast buffet was not as impressive, but the service was prime.
If I return to Gulmarg, I definitely will stay at the Khyber!

reviews.author: Ritin R
reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: Luxurious and comfortable property with modern amenities! We stayed as a family and had a nice experience. Gurpreet had been super kind person, very warm and kind, she looked after us very well and always catered to our requests with a smile. Her colleague Tahir also did a great job and made us smile at every touchpoint. Would highly recommend Gurpreet for her professionalism,  ownership, positive attitude and client centricity. She made our stay very comfortable with whatever she could do. She followed up with me and delivered a birthday cake for my wife at 9:30 PM. These things really made us feel great and she was the reason behind those. The restaurants are good - Our overall experience at Clove was good but we had one bad episode where we found that outsiders were also allowed to access the restaurant along with the hotel guests; this caused inconvenience as we encountered not so very courteous group of men sitting next to our table and  creating lot of discomfort for us. However we raised this complaint after changing our table, it was managed by the restaurant manager Shakir and other restaurant person  who advised us to move away from that group of guys creating trouble (which we had already done), we would have appreciated Shakir even more if we would have advised those guys to watch their manners and stop creating nuisance in the dining area! Anyway, sans this experience, everything else was nice. We must mention about Abhishek, who despite being a junior staff member apologized on behalf of the notorious bunch of people who made us move to another table, he looked after us well and his kind gesture impressed us and we really liked his sense of ownership and maturity despite being a junior staff. Shakir endeavoured to improvise our experience the next day and arranged a nice dinner for us at Brava, the Italian fine dine restaurant which we commend and thank him for. At Brava, we met Varun, the restaurant manager, he took our experience to the greater heights that we really adored. He was very caring and kind at all touch points. Extremely sweet and courteous. He made our experience at the restaurant super memorable, his selection of must try dishes was amazing, service attitude was commendable, he went that extra mile to wow us at all times!  He got a birthday balloon for my wife, motivated his staff to sing for the b’day jingle for her. All in all he made a mark and made our stay truly memorable. Overall the hotel is very nice and comfortable and staff members are amazing! Highly recommend the property!

reviews.author: Aditya Pramanik
reviews.title: Stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa Gulmarg, Kashmir
reviews.text:
Stay at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa Gulmarg, Kashmir
We stayed at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa for 02 nights from 2nd to 4th October 2023. It was a family trip. First, we went to Srinagar to attend a friend’s wedding. There were 04 of us and hence reserved 02 double rooms for our stay. Booking was made via the groom who was getting married. The rooms which were reserved for us were the Premier Rooms which got upgraded to Luxury Balcony Gulmarg View. Our arrival had been conveyed by the Revenue Head who conveyed the information to the hotel’s FOM, F&B Director & GM. All 03 mentioned above welcomed us and met us on arrival. We were walked to our rooms and then explained the rooming amenities. The FO Associate (Gurpreet) was very friendly, and calm, and asked us questions about our travel. The view from the rooms was fascinating and felt more luxurious than the hotel’s description. Quality of food prepared & personal attention by staff members starting at Brava (Italian Restaurant) to Calabash (Outlet for sheeshas & small eats) to Chaikash (their waiting lounge at the Lobby), Cloves (Khyber’s signature all-day dining restaurant) were great experiences. Associates and managers to mention are Surley (Housekeeping), Firdaus (F&B) and Sarida, Manzoor (FO), Mr Chhabra (GM), Vaibhav (Director, F&B) & Chef Sushmit Daniels (Executive Chef). We stayed at Khyber during our trip to Kashmir and it’s one of the best stays ever. Post our stay, we all have decided to go to Khyber once again during the winter period. The level of customer care stands out. If you plan to stay at The Khyber, stay there for 02 nights. Another person to mention is the Santoor player, Umar Farooq. His music is amazing once you get to listen to his tunes during the day. It soothes one’s mind. We will be back for another stay very soon. So, looking forward to that.

reviews.title: Khyber resort Gulmarg - A traveller’s paradise
reviews.text: Super luxurious stay amenities and facilities.Personal attention by staff member Mr Iqbal Tantray is really appreciated. The location and proximity to Gulmarg gondola base station is an asset .The ground garden facility is awesome and the heated indoor pool is very promising.

reviews.author: Aditya Kapadia
reviews.title: Great Place and View, Amazing Hospitality.
reviews.text:
We visited here with the family in the month of Sept 2023. The rooms are great and food is on point. Staff is very courteous. Irfan at the main reception was extremely helpful and Chef Ranjan ensured we had the best meals during our stay. Serving staff at the restaurants were extremely helpful and polite.

reviews.author: mehshee
reviews.title: Luxury retreat at Khyber
reviews.text:
We stayed two nights at khyber. While you check in, you can sit at the Chaikash  lounge which has an amazing Himalayan view and you can see the mountains and the beautiful trees.

Rooms - we had premier balcony gulmarg view room, we really liked sitting in the balcony. The rooms are really luxurious and grand and the bathroom is huge

Amenities- The views from the heated swimming pool are amazing. They have water googles if you forget, It's open from 9 to 9 so there's enough time to go visit it. I also used the steam room, which was really nice. I didn't use sauna or the hot tub but they have both of these. The spa looked really good as well but I didn't have time to use it. 

The igloo room, has ping pong and caram and some video games. It's nice but they made it in the basement. For the property this size, It would be nice to have it somewhere upstairs with windows and view. 

Food - For food, there are two restaurants. There's an Italian restaurant where we did not eat and the main restaurant which has breakfast and dinner buffet. I think they serve lunch as well but we didn't do lunch. 
The spread just huge. Fresh fruits and everything you can think of like pancakes, waffles, dosas, uttapams, parathas, all sorts of Indian stuff. South Indian breakfast is just amazing. They make you delicious cappuccinos on demand. What stands out the most is the staff at the restaurant. Firdaus and Rayees really were the good care of us. The dinner buffet is also a huge spread. It's practically impossible to even try everything that they have on the spread. 
The only complaint I have with dinner is their desserts. They have a huge selection but nothing else appealing to me or my family. So I think they can up their dessert game a little bit. But overall, the food was delicious. 

From the hotel you can walk to the gondola. We enjoyed our stay at Khyber and highly recommend to anyone else who would like to stay there. 

The lobby is huge and there are so many different settings sections which where you can sit and enjoy. And there is a musician who plays Santur and he is amazing. The music is so calm and soothing as well as entertaining at the same time. We enjoyed listening to him.

reviews.author: Brijesh V
reviews.title: Unapologetic / Arrogant = Khyber Managers
reviews.text:
Unapologetic / Arrogant = Khyber Managers

We recently stayed at Khyber. We had booked 2 nights at Khyber. But since same category of room wasnt available on MMT. We had to book 2 different room categories for 2 nights. Upon arrival we were told by the check in person (who's name I dont wish to add here) that you guys will be fine and you dont need to change the room tomorrow. We were either ways fine- as we had booked different room category and we didn't care much about it. 

Next day morning we went for Gondola level 1 and 2. Must add location of Khyber is great. So we left early at 9 am after our breakfast. After a long and hectic morning at gondola we returned back to our room to find that our room keys wouldn't work. So we had to walk back to reception to be told by another arrogant staff that they have changed our room. This was shocking and disappointing at same time not because room was changed but because for the first time in history of all travel we have done in indis and abroad, we had a hotel staff who had moved our open luggage to another room including some very important medicines without informing us. Had they had informed is a night in advance that they had made an error and indeed we did need to move room. We would have just kept our stuff packed & would have happily moved. The real issue was managers arrogance / unapologetic behaviour. He was not only arrogant but also pressurised his staff to lie about the fact that the person had indeed informed us that we will not need to change the room.  
Anyways- long story short. Great location, great property. Ofcourse exhobitant rates for same. But do not expect service/ hospitality of a 5 star standards of the likes of Vivanta Dal Lake or ITC at Pahalgam. This is a great hotel with below average managers running it. 

Sir, Umar Tramboo (@utramboo). Request you to look into this mismanagement and make Khyber service great again

reviews.author: Murtuza B
reviews.title: Kashmir and Khyber - Paradise on Earth
reviews.text:
Stayed from 12-16 February.

Jaw dropping view which begins right from the time you are climbing from district tonmerg to gulmarg. Postcard views from all sides but this is just the beginning since you can spend hours just seeing the Himalayas from the resort.  

The pool is again unique and a great spot for photos. Many thanks to Ms. Bilkees for her assistance. She was also kind to bandage a cut that I got while entering the jacuzzi which they need to change. The state of it is very old and it barely works in terms of pressure or heat so I believe this needs to changed.  

Meals are all good considering the remote location. Chefs always come and check on you and offer dishes sometimes outside the menu. Many thanks to Varun for his assistance during breakfast. Saima is also sweet and genuinely good to my kids. 

I have to give a special mention to Junaid from the restaurant who really worked hard to make each meal a special experience. After a point the meals gets repetitive and he made sure to customize each meal as per our preference. He really is an asset to the hotel and I hope he is looked after well.

I also would like to thank Waseem and also irfan Hussain for coming out of his way and assisting us with photos.

My 2 cents of advice to this beautiful hotel. Integrate the concierge to book activities and transportation for the guests. Currently they direct you to vendors and it is difficult to haggle with them sometimes. Fix the shower tap handle. It’s difficult to adjust the temperature and sometimes suddenly you get very hot water and sometimes it’s too cold. I did not enjoy my shower. Change the jacuzzi in the men section. 

We will be back surely whenever we visit Kashmir.

reviews.author: Dhruv Kumar
reviews.title: Highly over-hyped. Very bad experience.
reviews.text:
Surprising that I'm compelled to write such a review for such a highly rated property.

The overall experience, to our surprise, was way below our expectations and way way below the hype.

1. Their famous heated pool is not really 'heated' - It is just lukewarm water.

2. All amenities and F&B in the property are exhorbitantly priced. Even the taste or quantity doesn't make up for that price.

3. Personal experience - we had a Jain family with us and they ended up eating non vegetarian! Yes, only because the hotel kitchen - UNAPOLOGETICALLY - messed up the order. Highly unexpected from such a reputed property. Vegetarians please beware and double-check your meals. For the icing on the cake - All this happened after an incomplete order was sent to the room.

4. Staff isn't really very hospitable and not even well trained. Co-ordination between their teams is also surprisingly very poor - to the extent that while placing an order at the coffee shop when we asked if it could be sent to our room - we were told to call IRD and talk to them and that the coffee shop team would be of no help.

5. Their lounge serves only Hookah and the atmosphere is rather dull with small sittings. So in case you're travelling in a big group it would be difficult to find a place where you can all enjoy together. Not to miss - their premier rooms are just moderately sized without any balconies.

6. Not all the amenities mentioned in their service list are functional at all times - best to call the front desk and check for each and everything. During our visit, their mini-theatre was not operational (without any logical explanation from their team).

7. The location is undoubtedly unlike any you would have seen before. Best time to enjoy the view would be when its time for snow. The interiors of the room are average.

BUT hospitality and service - UNEXPECTEDLY HIGHLY DISAPPOINTING

reviews.author: ShwetaKhokhani
reviews.title: Epitome of Luxury
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a lovely property facing the snow capped Himalays. The views are mesmerising. The rooms of all categories are luxurious and super comfortable. All amenities in all rooms remain the same however the square footage and the views differ. All the rooms do not have the same views of the mountains unfortunately. The gulmarg facing rooms have the most eye catching views of the mountains. The rooms on the other side are facing the forest overlooking a little hutment. 
Senior citizens and people with challenged walking should request for rooms close to the reception as there is a lot of walking in the hotel considering it is built on a mountain. 
The swimming pool complex is state of art and an eye candy. Beautiful heated pool with its hypnotising views is relaxing for the body which has trekked in the morning into the mountains and so calming for the mind. 
People with larger budgets should definitely opt for the gulmarg facing rooms with balconies. 
I would definitely visit this property in the peak winter season with its white blankets in its full beauty.

reviews.author: Vids
reviews.title: Surreal Experience at Meadows of flowers - The Khyber Gulmarg
reviews.text:
After much contemplations we decided to go to Kashmir for our short week long trip. 

We decided on two places to visit in Kashmir.. One was Gulmarg and another Srinagar as we were travelling with our 7 yr old daughter and a 1 yr old toddler... 

When it is Gulmarg then it's Khyber.. No second thoughts.. Though resort is the most expensive one with 40k per nights (off season) peak seasons are mostly sold out... But the experience is worth spending each penny..

The resort has two views - Gulmarg and Himalayan..

The Himalayan view is the highest category rooms when you can even see Gondola phase 1 and phase 2 cable car track. The rooms are equipped with all modern amenities, a big bath tub overlooking the Himalayas (Apar Parvat), the property, lush garden with beautiful flowers and roses, it had heater in the room, separate shower area, toilet area, separate closet with cupboards, a king size bed, sofa, balcony with big sitting area. We were allocated Room no. 2019 which is on the second floor and closer to Gym, swimming pool and spa area. 

There is one restaurant near the reception which is 'Cloves'. The staff is really pleasing and way too friendly and helpful.. In - room dining services is very quick and prompt.. We never faced any issue with our baby food we ordered in room or in the restaurant.. Special thanks to Mr Ashish, Chef Shahabaz and the serving staff Raees (always smiling and helpful).

Few other staff which made our stay more comfortable are Hamida (swimming pool), Omar (guard), Apsara (Spa).

However, I would like to express few low lights of our stay..  

At the time of check in we were informed that The sauna, jacuzzi, steam were out of order. For which Mr Mhd Rafi at the front desk had been very arrogant and his tone of response was completely unapologetic. They claim that they had informed their travel partner 15 days back of our stay ie 28th Aug (though we didn't received such notification) and if even they did it wouldn't have helped us as their non refundable policy gets over before 1.5 month of your stay dates. To which the response was "as if you are going to use this facilities for a whole day' it's just question of 1 hr. Which you would spend using these facilities so what's the big fuss.. You can any which ways use other facilities like swimming pool." Imagine the arrogance, one books such an expensive property  keeping in mind the facilities and amenities offered to the guest.. 

The swimming pool area was dirty and under maintenance with workers working to and fro carrying sacks of cement while you are swimming in the pool... We highlighted this to their management.. We were staying there for 4 days n 3 nights to enjoy the property and hospitality.. Would not have expected such an attitude from a premium property like this. 

After bringing it up time and again their GM Mr. Vinit Chabbra offered body massage at their spa.. That's what they could do to compensate for the inconvenience caused..which again was a reactive response.. However, we do appreciate this gesture from Mr. Chabbra but Mr. MHD Rafi  remained unapologetic. 

To the contrast we had wonderful experience with their restaurant staff at 'Cloves' .Special mention of Raees, Mr Ashish, Chef Shahabaz. 

The breakfast  spread@Cloves was elaborate. With dosas, omlettes, juices, kahwa, deserts /breads, other breakfast items like poha, upma, idli, wada, khakra, fafda (seems like they expect lot of Gujarati tourist). My favourite being cold coffee and Kaali (masala fresh lime soda). They didn't serve lunch and dinner buffet due to low occupancy.. However on our request they did serve dinner buffet on the last day of our stay which was not elaborate however worth trying. 

Overall the stay was very comfortable with great housekeeping and restaurant staff. Amazing surreal views, spacious rooms.. Worth spending time and money at The Khyber.

reviews.author: vmaloo
reviews.title: Serenity
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a property where the hype precedes the visit. A majestic hotel nestled amidst refreshing pine forests, it certainly is a resort beautifully made. While we had booked Premier Rooms, we got this changed to the Luxury Room Himalayan View, the room with the balcony overlooking the forests and the mountains and this decision was something we did not regret. 

The hotel only had one operational restaurant during our stay, the multi cuisine Clove (unsure if it has others) and we were pleasantly surprised by the taste of the food. Generous portions, excellent service and tasty food were a consistent experience there. 

The reason why we wanted to visit Khyber is when we saw pictures of the spa and the swimming pool, both enclosed in glass structures to help enjoy the grand view outside. While the view was true to the pictures and the pool was heated (oh, the relaxing feeling when you enter!), the health club is the area where Khyber’s claim of “there’s absolutely nothing spoilt here besides you” shows signs of cracking. The gym was unmanned every time I visited, while the pool only had one attendant who was usually busy running errands. This single male attendant was responsible for running the whole show, including the female changing areas. This is something that is unacceptable. The steam room produced no steam and the cleanliness in this area was subpar. However, in all honesty, entering the heated pool and looking out of the floor-to-glass ceiling to the untouched Himalayan sight made me forget all of this in a jiffy. 
The spa experience was unexpected, and not in a good way. During the therapy, construction and maintenance work was going on, phones were constantly ringing and people were talking, breaking the expected experience of being transported away in a world with zen-like calm. While the whole property is beautifully build with wood, making the therapy rooms soundproof and adding a carpet to the wooden flooring in the spa would go a long way as we could hear every person walking outside the therapy room. The therapists, while claimed to be highly experienced with special training from L'occitane, never asked for prior injuries and while the therapy was not bad, it was not great either. While all of these were excusable, the coup de grace was about to come. On complaining about these to the spa manager (who I will not name here), she refused to believe us, saying the construction was stopped within 5 minutes and the other noises were due to the cleaning staff when we could see people with hammers entering and exiting the spa. Her final conclusion to this conversation was ‘let me know if you want to do the therapy or not within 5 minutes. What is the point of having this conversation?’

The recreational area had table tennis, carrom, foosball, snooker and a non-functioning air hockey table, all of which we highly enjoyed. It also had a theatre which guests can book and enjoy movies in, available to guests on a chargeable basis, but we never ended up using it. 

The Khyber is an impressive property with views unlike any other. It is beautifully built with well thought-of features and is highly maintained. While some areas still need the polish of a Taj or an Oberoi, this trip made me realise that the people at the hotel can change the experience you have and everyone here at Khyber greet you with smiles and are extremely helpful. While some people can absolutely ruin your experience, others can turn it into an amazing one, and I want to call out some names who helped make this experience such an amazing one: Mr. Ishfaq Bhat at customer relations, Ab Qadir at the restaurant, Rahul, the barista and especially Irfan Hussain at the front desk and Mr. Rafi Bhat, the duty manager, who have time and again helped us to make the stay comfortable. You guys made Khyber live up to its massive hype. A big shout out to them and everyone else at Khyber.

Negative highlights: The housekeeping was below expectation and that ruined our mood. reviews.author: Darshant1975
reviews.title: Stay away and save your money! Worst service at extremely high prices. Ritz Carlton prices & highway motel service.
reviews.text:
Khyber Hotel stays true to the Gulmarg culture or looting and duping. Minimal value for money. Save your money and stay somewhere else! Over all I would say stay in Gulmarg no more than one night anyways. 

- I had confirmed booking with my international credit card in April. One day before my flight in a June, they email me that they cannot process my card and my booking will be cancelled in 12 hours. I had to spend multiple hours calling back and forth to finally get someone to respond and give me a payu link. 
- extremely bad service and they make you feel like you should be thankful for being there.  From checkin to checkout , the staff had a constant air of attitude.  
- Dirty rooms, clogged showers. We had to stand in the clogged showers just to take a bath. 
- the elevator stopped working for 1 day and my old mother who has challenges to go up the stairs has to go through immense pain and suffering just to go to her room and back. 
- there is no AC and their thermostat doesn’t work right. Even their technicians can’t get that working right. As a result, my family slept in extreme heat and had to open up the windows which led mosquitoes inside.  When I shared this with the manager and front desk, they were like “there is thermostat and you don’t know how to work it”. 
- food is sometimes ok and most times extremely bad. The worst Palak paneer in the entire world is found here. And I have eaten Palak paneer from Greece to Toronto to New Delhi to New York and beyond. 
- beware and check your booking twice. I booked through booking.com for triple occupancy and when I reached the hotel, I was told that the booking was only for 2 people and I had to pay 10,000 RS extra.  
- no hotel cars and the taxis they call  will charge you 800 RS just to get to the market and back. 
- Cloves restaurant dinner and breakfast are average. But extremely expensive.  Dinner for 4 was 7000 RS. 

I have stayed at Taj, Hilton, Ritz, Welcome group, Marriott, Westin including cabins in Yosemite/Tahoe and many others but never had this bad service in my entire life. 
The only good thing is the location and the cabin like feel as well as the grounds. 
-

reviews.author: priyankakandoi
reviews.title: Overpriced, overhyped & simply not worth it
reviews.text:
The thing about this infamous resort which is certainly overhyped is that they’ve managed to use the beautiful Gulmarg view of the snow-capped mountains and the pine & fir trees to their advantage. Take that away, and you’re left with any other mountain resort. In fact, I have stayed at better ones. 

During our check-in, we were told that we’d paid only for 2 guests whereas we were 3 adults. I assured them I’d paid for 3 guests and had to search for the email sent by MakeMyTrip to make them believe me. That was just a minor inconvenience and they more than made up for it by giving us a complimentary room upgrade for which we’re very thankful. But it made me wonder what the room I’d actually booked was like for around 30,000 + taxes because even the upgraded one wasn’t really out of the world. They are literally fleecing guests. Trust me, it’s not worth the money. 

If you’ve heard of the great Kashmiri hospitality, be prepared NOT to witness it here because the staff clearly isn’t bothered. During the breakfast buffet, it’s a maddening rush and they simply have no clue how to handle it. 
Suggestion: Assign one or two tables to one waiter. 
We asked around 5 different waiters for masala tea and still didn’t get a single cup for another twenty minutes or so. I saw a few guests quietly thrust a 100 rupee note into one of the waiter’s hands. Oh so maybe that is why we weren’t served properly because after paying a fortune, are we still expected to tip (or rather bribe) the waiters so that we are served well during our stay. The staff has this high and mighty air about themselves which is clearly not appealing at all. The only person worthy of praise is the ‘Big-Man’ as I’d like to call him since I forgot to make a note of his name. He’s the security in charge and extremely nice & friendly. 

The staff in the pool area were behaving quite strange. They didn’t seem too pleased to see us and nor were they very friendly or helpful in any way. All in all, I’d like to tell you that Khyber certainly is not worth the exorbitant amount they charge. Stayed at Khyber with family and friends. The hotel is rated 5 star and charges USD 600 plus plus..for a room..

For the price, we got a room facing the grass fences to start with. The room sizes are quite average and are designed for couples and not families.. 

The food is super expensive and probably the worst I have had in years…on the last day, for example the chef made me a special Kashmiri dish ( I appreciated the gesture because they had already goofed up) and I vomited the entire night. My family are all down with gastro issues as well..

It’s such a large hotel but there is literally nothing for the kids..a heated but dirty swimming pool…

Loud local music and dance till 1030 pm in the lobby area..didn’t understand this at all.. 

The staff are polite and helpful so will commend them for that. For the gastro issues, the staff helped me with the medicine as well. 

Will never go back to Khyber for sure…

reviews.author: shouvanik
reviews.title: Heavenly Khyber
reviews.text:
Staying at Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa- an award winning resort, nestled 8825ft above the sea level in the Pirpanjal range of Himalaya- truly an experience of life time. It will mesmerise anyone once you enter in it- what a interior! A very well maintained star property with exquisite wooden work of authentic Kashmiri craftsmanship, lavishly designed room, very spacious with balcony and all modern amenities… luxury bathroom with bathtub, separate shower, toilet and changing area and A snowy view outside to indulge yourself into the world of true luxury. But the best of this property is it’s location.. what a view of Apharwat Himalaya, snowy slopes and forests of pine and deodar.. specially from the Himalayan view room… it will justify expense( approx 42k per night) which is really very high as per Indian standards. The entire property is centrally heated which will feel you very comfortable even in peak winter with minus temperature outside. The pool is also heated and the pool area has just extraordinary view of outside snowy slopes and mountains. We have stayed three nights in March 2022 and it was just an exceptional experience. The staffs are very courteous and helpful. However I felt few drawbacks too..
1. Very high cost of food and buffet which may make you uncomfortable if you are planning for long stay like three nights.
2. Limited and average breakfast menu.. not justified as per rate. We have stayed many luxury hotels across India like Taj, J W, ITC group etc who are much ahead in terms of variety and cost effectiveness of buffet
3. Loccitane Spa- our first experience of L’Occitane spa was at J W Mussoorie which was just heavenly- with that expectation with took service at Khyber too.. but here our experience was little different.. firstly it is more costly as per the quality of service. Second they provide only male to male and female to female therapists.. so if you are taking couple service, your spouse must feel comfortable to take service in presence of a male therapist in a single room. Thirdly the lounge of spa is a common area for Gym and pool too, and specially in evening it’s over crowded with people of all age group. So if you wish to relax and enjoy some special moments before taking therapy, it’s not possible.( I’ve attached a pics of the chaos too!)
3. They almost never receive any phone calls.. but reply readily on email.

Overall it’s a heavenly resort for a lifetime experience specially in winter months but definitely with a very high expenditure.

reviews.text:
Once you enter the hotel you know it is the best property you will find in all of Kashmir. People come to Kashmir specially to stay at The Khyber and I must say, the hype is real. 

Rooms: we stayed in the Premium category room which is a bit bigger and with a private balcony with a beautiful view. We had a walk-in closet and the rest of the bathroom was quite spacious too. The rooms are luxurious! However, this category of rooms can be a long walk away from the restaurant downstairs. 

Food: no complaints about the quality and quantity here. The spread is lavish and top class. The service however was a letdown. The staff was sometimes not at their best - their communication and speed had become a big problem for our group of 15. It got so bad that we had to take this up with the management. 

Spa & Pool: could describe the spa in one word - overpriced. I got a 60min massage and I wasn't fully satisfied with my masseur but the women's masseuse was pretty good for my wife & mom. They do have steam & sauna services. The pool used to be quite packed due to the amount of guests at the hotel so we didn't spend a lot of time there but the pool area is a vibe - just spend some time here early morning or evening after 7pm.

reviews.author: ashm99
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth !! Simply Outstanding !!
reviews.text:
After reading so many raving reviews on TripAdvisor and avid recommendations by several friends, we decided to plan a stay for 2 nights at Khyber ! We were simply blown away by this beautiful property that would make Taj and Oberois of the world a run for their money !! 

 It was peak winter in Gulmarg with temperatures around -6 degrees with ample snow and daily snowfall. The hotel seemed straight out of a postcard with a wonderful backdrop of stunning Himalayas. 

The pickup from Srinagar was very smooth and reasonably priced at 5k. Highly recommended because if you book your own vehicle, you may have to make a change at Tangmarg, where you need to take a vehicle with snow chains on tyres. 

The check-in was smooth with their signature welcome drink. The room was quite spacious. We chose a room without balcony, as balcony rooms don't make much sense for winter months where you can't step out. The view was amazing !! 

The decor and architecture of the entire hotel has been very tastefully done with walnut wood used in abundance. The pool area, the spa and the garden outside (although covered fully with snow) are simply stunning !! 

The service in the restaurant and the housekeeping both were too notch !! The hotel even organized a small birthday celebration for my daughter, which was very touching. A special thanks to Mr Arindam who was very courteous. Aamir Javed in the restaurant was super efficient. 

Our Guide Bilal 8899261148 was the best guide we ever had ! Very honest and he helped us save a lot of money and gave perfect recommendations. Highly recommended for all travel plans to Gulmarg. 

The only suggestion I would like to give is to organize some live music in the lobby or the restaurant during  weekend evenings. 

Overall a terrific stay !! Must visit atleast once a lifetime.

reviews.author: Chandrika Das
reviews.title: Must visit.
reviews.text:
We booked our stay at the Khyber Himalayan Resort in the last week of December 2021 (27th-30th). Before coming we were a bit sceptical given the remote location of the resort , but we were in for a wonderful suprise seeing the efficacy and passion with which this resort is run. 

The rooms were well appointed and luxurious. The bathrooms were spacious. The housekeeping staff Mr. Gulzar and Mr. Nisaar  always kept our room immaculately clean. They were always just a call away to look after our needs and ensured we had a comfortable stay. (Room Nos. 1009&1011) 

We took all our meals at Clove, where the menu is elaborate and the food excellent! We would always look forward to having a hearty breakfast which was quite expansive. 

We were looked after by Mr. Firdous - who was so warm and welcoming. Firdous ji looked after us with great zeal and affection, making sure we were always well fed and his care and concern was more of the kind one reserves for one's family. We ordered à la carte meals, but Firdous ji would always so generously heap our plates with choicest of desserts, sabzis and whatnot, which were a part of their dinner buffet. He would always give fabulous suggestions with respect to what to order and all his suggestions worked very well for us. He would always try and remember what each one of us liked and made sure that we had something special at every meal. 

I cannot wait to be back here on this property which has the warmest staff who has their attention to every little detail. The minute you enter the property you are engulfed with a certain warmth - which I feel is quintessentially Khyber. 

As I leave today, I know I will miss this place intensely, but I rest easy knowing I have a bit of paradise tucked in my heart forever. 

Thanks once again Firdous ji, Nisaar ji and Gulzar ji. You've created magic which no one can surpass.

reviews.author: Himanshu Das
reviews.title: Beautiful Views, Warm Hospitality.
reviews.text:
Khyber Gulmarg is one of those hotels that one must experience at least once in their lifetime.

The hotel does a fantastic job in every aspect - right from the property upkeep to the room comfort, ambience to views from the room, restaurants to housekeeping Khyber can give even the best hotels of the world a run for their money. 

I would like to thank a few people for making our stay comfortable - Mr Waseem at the front desk for the warm welcome, Mr Gulzar Bhat and Mr Nisar from the housekeeping team for taking care of our smallest of requirements and last but not the least Mr Firdous Parray at the restaurant Cloves who truly exemplifies world class hospitality and efficient service. Thank you once again. 

Overall I will definitely recommend Khyber if you’re planning to come to Gulmarg. Remember you’ll need to make reservations good 6 months in advance as this place is always full.

reviews.author: Nihar Gandhi
reviews.title: The overall experience and tips for to keep in mind and to make the most out of the experience here. Must visit
reviews.text: The hotel has a warm welcome and super quick service from the moment you step in. The swimming pool and spa are superb but the spa is but expensive. The Cloves restaurant is fabulous and serves amazing food at 9000ft. The waiter Aamir is very helpful and serves great. The other services offered are also quite useful. The heating in the rooms is too high so sometimes feels suffocating. However, the overall experience at the Himalayan retreat is worth.

reviews.title: Amazing

reviews.author: Nj
reviews.title: Overrated hotel with rude staff
reviews.text:
We were very excited to stay at the overhyped  The Khyber.
But we were very disappointed with the very basic and unmaintained rooms and the rude staff. The housekeeping staff entered in our room even after we directed them to do up our room after we come back from breakfast. But to our surprise we found 4 technicians along with 1 staff member in our room installing a new telivision and they made us wait outside for 15 mins. When we called the manager to complain rather than apologising he said they have the authority to enter the room sometimes without any prior notice to the guest and they can come in at emergencies ONLY. But is replacing a Television an emergency?? After calling several times all that the GM did was say that he will look into the matter.We are actually questioning are selves if it was worth waiting for the stay in this property where everyone is so disrespectful towards their guests? Is it worth staying in a place where you are spending an exorbitant amount and there is no respect to guest privacy?? Very disappointing stay and not recommended at all.
