reviews.author: Aditya Mehta
reviews.title: Gulmarg- a place to visit for the snow & view
reviews.text:
Pros:

Right from the airport the pick up was very smoothly done by Asif- representative from Khyber at the airport & he helped with the departure to Bombay as well. 

The driver Akram & tour guide Bilal also were really warm,friendly and ensured we had a good time sightseeing or with the gandola activities etc.

We were lucky to probably get the last room available at the hotel. We stayed in a single room cottage and room was very spacious with balcony on both ground and first floor. Except we were 3 people so had to put an additional bed for one of us.

The view from the room balcony and from different parts of the hotel was great and that’s the biggest USP of the hotel I would say. 

Staff was very prompt and they were just a phone call away. Be it room service or housekeeping etc.

Cons:

As for the food,the local kashmiri food was good and rest was pretty average I would say. The hotel was at full capacity but the food could’ve been much better. 

Price wise as well all food was above 1000 Rs which even for 5 star standards is on the expensive side.Also a lot of the food was fried & given which is not something we liked and had to ask them to make the dish again.

Also since except Skiing & all snow activities there was not much to do,we enquired about the cinema they had. The cost was Rs 15,000 + GST regardless of no of people if its 2 or 15 people. We found this very expensive and not even worth considering.

reviews.author: Dr Farzana
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
We stayed here for two nights in the month of octobar. We enjoyed our stay very much. The staff is well trained and the view from rooms is good. Food is good and rooms are neat and clean. 
A must visit property.

reviews.author: akshita186403
reviews.title: Fabulous property, and fabulous staff
reviews.text: Thoroughly enjoyed our visit. Gorgeous property, old world and elegant. Delicious food. The spa was out of the world. But the best thing about the property was the staff - courteous & helpful. Special mention to our server Adil, who went out of the way for us. Definitely a thumbs up, if you're looking for a memorable experience in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: anuradha
reviews.title: Superb service
reviews.text:
Hamida Sohail gave us the best hospitality at the pool. They were very cordial and cooperative. Superb service provided by both of them. 
Room service is also commendable. Staff is very polite and the service is too good. 
The reception staff should work on their language as a staff called Imran is very rude and does not know how to talk to guests.

reviews.author: Deepavali
reviews.title: Khyber gulmarg
reviews.text: Truly one of the high points of Kashmir travels Gulmarg is a very beautiful place and Khyber  has state of the art abilities a warm palatial interiors and very good quality and very good food service was excellent special mention to Jane at the spa Firdous at the breakfast table Javed a duty manager

reviews.author: jainnamu
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel & exemplary staff !
reviews.text:
We have always heard so much about Khyber from friends & family & I knew we had to stay there once we decided we were going to go to Kashmir for a holiday. The hotel no doubt is beautifully built, we stayed in the premier room which unfortunately does not have a sit out, only the Himalayan view rooms have sit outs. The staff at the Clove where we ate brekafast & dinner were nothing short of amazing.A special mention to Aamir,Junaid,shyam,Faizal & firdaus & a very very special mention to Aamir who went out of his way for everything & was extremely warm & hospitable,no request was too much for him.

Unfortunately we couldn’t experience their swimming pool because of the covid guidelines which probably gives us a reason to come back to The Khyber sometime in the near future !

reviews.author: Jack L
reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text:
Words will fall short to describe how awesome this place and hotel is!!

Staff - Amazing! Specifically the pool, jaccuzzi, sauna ! Hamida & Mohsin are very hardworking and kind 😊
They’ve been amazing with my 3 year old

Food - 4 out of 5

Amenities - 5 out of 5

Location - 10 out of 5 😃

reviews.author: Tiara R
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text:
Had heard so much about this place.....so happy to say it was beyond our expectations. The location,the ambience,the hospitality, the staff. Firdaus & Bilal at the restaurant make sure you are treated like a queen/king you name a dish n u get it.Junaid at chaikash spoils u with lovely kawahs and the views.
The only drawback was the extra bed which was very uncomfortable....a place like Khyber with such class n service can definitely do better than this

reviews.author: ramesh
reviews.title: Khyber
reviews.text: It was an amazing experience and the staff was really good. Food was amazing and services were the best. All the amenities were amazing. So far the best property in whole Kashmir.  Thankyou khyber himalayan resort for making our stay very much welcoming.

reviews.author: Riyazpadela
reviews.title: Riyaz Padela
reviews.text:
Great location and view, great breakfast, a bit costly, very co operative staff especially Ms. Hamida & Mr. Mohsin at the steam and sona facility counter, 
Food is quite expensive but taste is good
Not value for money compared to the booking prices

reviews.author: Dhirajjain
reviews.title: The khyber gulmarg
reviews.text: Best hospitality by Mr.manzoor we have ever seen..He is so polite & concerned abt every aspect about customer stay & comfort.I would recommend everyone to visit the khyber gulmarg its just worth it & best managment ever managed by Mr.Manzoor

reviews.author: Kumar K
reviews.title: AMAZING STAY
reviews.text: The property is beautiful and the staff have a very helpful nature special thanks to Shoukat and afshana, and shoukat was very helpful throughout our stay and never refused for anything,his hospitality was just Amazing . Highly recommended. Will surely visit again. The rooms are spacious and have amazing view of the Himalayas. The breakfast buffet is good but would highly recommend the dinner buffet too!

reviews.author: Aditi A
reviews.title: Heaven in Kashmir !!!!
reviews.text:
Khyber is the one of the most amazing properties we have ever visited ! Apart from the amazing views the hotel has to offer their hospitality is top notch  . Here I would like to mention Mr Mohammed Rafi and Mr Irfan who welcomed us very warmly. They pampered is to the bits. Before Khyber, we stayed for 2 nights at Welcome pine n peak by Itc in Pahalgam and didn't have that great an experience. After they came to know that, they gave us an upgrade to the Himalayan Suit as we were with a baby and they wanted our vacation to be awesome !! Khyber is as royal as it can get. It's centrally heated and all the staff is soo warm. Here we experienced true Kashmiriyat. Thanks a lot for giving us such wonderful experience and memories to cherish for a lifetime ! ❤️❤️ HIGHLY RECOMMEND ! 
P.S Open a property in Srinagar and Pahalgam soon 😀

reviews.author: Parthanil
reviews.title: A fantastic property in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
An out of the world property facing Gulmarg Snow capped peaks . The inside of the hotel is luxurious and staffed with friendly employees. We have booked in a Himalaya facing room and we can actually see the peaks from our bed !! The serenity of Gulmarg along with the Khyber resorts will
make your visit a memorable one

reviews.author: Dinesh J
reviews.title: Heaven 💯💯cielo
reviews.text:
We visited khyber Himalayan resorts and Spa in the last month. The staff was great with quality service, the food was equally good. Rooms were clean and comfortable.Will recommend this hotel to all my friends who are traveling to Kashmir.Staff was exceptionally helpful.Hope pool will be open on my next trip which was closed due to covid.
Thank you so much team Khyber for making our trip such wonderful.

reviews.author: Harsh
reviews.title: A good experience
reviews.text:
Mr Gulzar & Ms Shafeeqa, kept the rooms squeaky clean and we came back to a sparkling room everyday.
On the whole the hotel was a great experience 
The restaurant can up it’s standards a little bit.
The swimming pool closure due to covid was a big miss.

reviews.author: Juhee jain
reviews.title: Superb Hospitality
reviews.text:
We stayed in Khyber for two nights . Loved the hospitality of Mr. Aarif Bhatt , Mr.Shyam & Mr. Aizaz. As we entered Mr Aarif was at our service making us extremely comfortable and despite the fact that the hotel was sold out he didn’t seem in a rush to attend other guests . He was calmly and patiently attending to all our questions.
Similarly Both Mr. Shyam and Mr Aizaz(both from food department) were extremely warm  and very prompt at their services.

Food was extremely good .
Had a very good time there.

reviews.author: aditi22
reviews.title: Lovely place
reviews.text: My family and I visited Khyber in the month of September 2021. The check in process was made very smooth by Mr. Waseem. He was very polite and helpful. The rooms were spacious and had a lovely view. Food was good and the staff at the restaurant is very courteous and helpful specially Firdous. Firdous was very attentive, helpful and very prompt at his work. We had a lovely experience overall. Definitely worth it and will visit again !

reviews.author: Shantanuu R
reviews.title: Family trip Khyber
reviews.text:
We stayed at Khyber from 15th Oct to 17th Oct. Stay was awesome.Arif Hussain at the FO really took good care from check in till we checked out. Spa was awosome. Our accommodations was 2 bedroom cottage with view of mountain range. 
Really a good property with excellent staff.

reviews.author: Raghav Dheer
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is absolutely perfect for a family holiday. The staff had been very kind to us.  I would also appreciate the service by Gulzar Bhat and Shafeela from House Keeping department.  They both were brilliant and very humble people.  The services have been great and I definitely recommend this place when you come to gulmarg.

reviews.author: Pushpinder Pal ... K
reviews.title: Kashmir Calling
reviews.text:
We, joint family of 11 had visited Kashmir in the Month of Oct 2021 and stayed at Gulmarg in Khyber. It was a sheer luxury experience. Though, the facility is placed on pricey side but worth the luxury. The rooms have ample space to give a feel of Maharaja, with magnificent view of snow clad Mountains on one side and lush green gardens and pool on other side. The   Property has well maintained roof top snacks bar and Restaurant on Ground Floor.
We really appreciate the helpful staff.
I would like to mention Mr Wasim, who was very cooperative especially with kids.
I would also like to acknowledge Mr Shyam, Assistant Manager, F&B who surprised us with instant celebration for our anniversary, with full fanfare. We all were deeply touched by his sweet gesture.

reviews.author: Souvik S
reviews.title: Beautiful but misses out on customer experience!
reviews.text:
To start with the highs - the upkeep of the hotel is brilliant and luxurious. I loved the corridors and the rooms as well. The property is centrally temperature controlled and hence interiors are very comfortable. Rooms are opulent with all moder luxuries thar one can expect. 

The food is very good, and I will say that the breakfast spread is one of the best I have had in hotels/ resorts of this league. 

Now why would I still rate this place a 3 / 5. That's because of the service, and that too when I compare it with properties of this league. Clearly the speed and care for service towards its guests is far from expected. We had to ask multiple times for water, the water kettle was not clean and getting it exchanged took time !

Frankly, the hotel is definitely worth a stay, but will I go back for more given the level of service? - I am not sure

reviews.author: Priyanka N
reviews.title: Memories for a lifetime
reviews.text:
No place which is no where as close to a visit numerous times is Kashmir. I would like to spend my entire life here, it’s the most BEAUTIFUL place no where it’s rightfully called the Paradise on Earth.
We had the chance to stay at The Khyber Gulmarg and it’s just nestled right in nature’s arms.

And what an amazing hospitality where you can feel what being HUMAN truly means. Humanity is a true reality here. Locals and Hotel personnel go out of their way to make your stay truly comfortable and memorable. A special mention to housekeeping staff Gulzar Bhat and Shafiqa for being on their toes to serve in the best ways.
Arif and everyone from the reception team who will be attend to all your requests and requirements.

Gulmarg is a must visit and it’s truly an enchanting place.

reviews.author: Umesh Ranglani
reviews.title: great location , great food , great service
reviews.text: Idrees from front desk followed up with Indigo for my left bag over 2 days relentlessly… the food was great … taxis available at ur beck and call … a great experience with family … a worthy break after the lockdown

reviews.author: garg
reviews.title: Out of this world
reviews.text: We will cherish the time we have spent on this property whenever we will think of our visit to Kashmir.we were pampered over all.Nice place and location.From housekeeping,we remember showkat and Danish they used to acknowledge all our demands with a smile and makes sure things should be happen as per our wish.

reviews.author: Puneet Jaiin
reviews.title: An Extraordinary Gem 💎

Regards and look forward to visit you soon Sir.

reviews.author: Shubham Jain
reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text: Our stay at The Khyber resort Gulmarg was exceptional. We were not really hoping for the weather to be so good but it was so pleasant. Irfan Hussain at the front desk was really helpful and caring. He didn't let us down on any of our requests.

reviews.author: Ishita
reviews.title: Fantastic experience
reviews.text:
We were visiting Khyber to celebrate my husband’s birthday. We had an excellent stay.  The staff was extremely cordial and helpful. Special mention to Mr. Arif who assisted us throughout and made our stay very comfortable.
Thank you for such a wonderful experience!

reviews.author: AkBkChA
reviews.title: Good stay, hoping for even better next time!
reviews.text:
An impromptu trip to Kashmir made us  book a luxury Himalayan view room for 3 nights at this boutique hotel.

The hotel welcome/check-in was rather lukewarm, though the 'trainee' who completed the formalities was quite courteous and if his badge had a name I would definitely mention here.

We requested the 20 series rooms as they are on the 2nd floor and offer a slightly better view but were told the entire block was occupied by a large group for a long time ahead (the next day there was a new check-in into the same by another family) Honesty would definitely be appreciated, however, I did not bother much as the view from the 10 series room was beautiful too and a slightly shorter distance (staircase) from the lobby/restaurants.

We were celebrating the wife's birthday and our anniversary on the same day and though the cake was placed a little later than expected it was well taken care of by Mr.Muzzamil at the front desk and Mr.Bashar. as they arranged for a subtle decor in the balcony of our room. Unfortunately due to some miscommunication they were unable to offer a more special arrangement for private dining as it was already booked for the night. This was again taken care of by Mr.Bashar who had a lovely table with a view reserved for us in the

reviews.author: Vikas
reviews.title: Leisure holiday
reviews.text:
Had a very pleasant stay at Khyber . Very good service by MR. Irfan Hussain (team leader front office) 

He has instantly solved our concerns and has provided the bestest of the service. !

The view and location of the property is extremely beautiful.

reviews.author: Cathayam
reviews.title: Good Ambiance. Nice Upkeep. Not so great food. The only place to stay if in Gulmarg!
reviews.text:
With amazing rooms and views, khyber has you relaxed from the get go. My check in process was a little haphazard. The food at Khyber was below average. But, Mr Firdous at the restaurant made sure that we got the exact kind of tea we wanted for breakfast every day. He also made sure to provide us with great service day and night. 
I had to get a mattress changed at a very odd hour of the night. Mr Arif Hussain at the reception, made sure that, that happened and we got what we wanted as quickly as possible. 
We had a lot of trouble with the operator, they couldn’t pass on the message properly even once. I wanted some bandages for my hand, and I just didn’t get them, forget about getting them late or something, I just didn’t get them. 
If the problems I faced at Khyber are improved upon, there wouldn’t be any doubt in selecting Khyber if you are in Gulmarg!

Ps: the climb to Khyber from the soots downhill is very steep. It’s not an easy climb if you don’t have a vehicle coming back up.

reviews.author: Shiwam.mohan@gmail.com
reviews.title: 10th month anniversary
reviews.text: Nestled amid the hills of Kashmir, this place has conquered our heart with picturesque view, boutique interiors and unmatched hospitality .The courteous staff had made our stay extremely smooth and memorable.We are extremely Thankful to the entire team of Khyber , specially Mr Ameen (chai kash) and Mr Arif ( front desk ) for impeccable services. We wish to visit again soon .

reviews.author: robin b
reviews.title: Wonderful memories
reviews.text:
We stayed for 3N at khyber and those were the memorable ones.I would like  to mention Mr Arif who received  warmly and took us around the property .he helped us to plan our sight seeing and other arrangements.
I would really visit again during the time of winter .

reviews.author: Arpit
reviews.title: Good Stay!
reviews.text:
Great place with good food. Best property in Gulmarg. 

View was fantastic. However the main attraction of the swimming pool was not accessible thanks to the lockdown restrictions. 

 Service can be better. 

Arif Hussain was of good help.

reviews.author: Architta
reviews.title: Amazing service!
reviews.text: Absolutely loved my stay here, would love to give a shout out to two gentlemen, Nasir shafi and mamzoor ali, from the housekeeping department who were amazing and helped us a lot during our stay! Highly recommend this gem

reviews.author: Nilay
reviews.title: Wonderful stay
reviews.text: Truly mesmerised by the wooden architecture of this quaint resort amidst lush green meadows interspersed by pine trees bordered by green mountains. Service of its staffs was a true delight. Specifically I would like to mention about Aijaz who served us tirelessly in the restaurant.His attention to details, preempting the needs of customers, going extra mile to delight them truly stood him out. Despite the restaurant being very busy whenever we went, he made sure he was there to serve us even when we did not expect him to. We also liked the amicable nature of their duty manager Manzoor and front desk executive Arif. We would definitely like to come back to Khyber during the winter.

reviews.author: Ariba Qureshi
reviews.title: Best stay ever
reviews.text: The hospitality at Khyber is second to none! The warmth and care is unmatched! The staff is very courteous,comforting and goes out of their way to cater to your needs! Especially Muzammil, Aijaz,Waseem,Rayeez and Junaid! They treated us so well that we didn’t miss home at all! The trust and comfort they develop in their guests is inexplicable.  It’s my second time at Khyber and I’m already tempted to visit again ! Highly recommend the hotel! One of the best properties in India! Khyber is an experience in itself!

reviews.author: Sara Q
reviews.title: An impeccable experience
reviews.text: This is an extremely honest review. Really really love this place with all my heart. The crowd, the people, the beautiful scenery, it’s all just so pleasant and beautiful. A very very special mention to the kindest and the most helpful people that assisted us in Khyber. Waseem, for making sure we get the best of everything in Khyber, Junaid, for always being around and offering help at every second of our stay, Aijaz, for making our breakfast and dinner wonderful and also getting me extra chocolate syrup😂 Raees, for giving us the best hookah we’ve ever had and Owais for helping us out. If I could, I would name the entire staff because I’ve never met such kind souls. The people here are the ones that made Khyber special for us. We made family here 🤍 - sara

reviews.author: Mehran Qureshi
reviews.title: Family vacay
reviews.text:
I am out of words for this property . Amazing property , very warm staff , amazing food and sheesha .
Special thanks to Waseem , Aijaaz , Rayeez and Junaid ( most warming and helpful staff I’ve ever encountered , treated like family ) . Highly recommended .. Home away from home .. Must visit !!

reviews.author: Sara Qureshi
reviews.title: Only the best place and people in Kashmir
reviews.text: The stay was absolutely wonderful and very luxurious. Two very sweet and helpful people, Gulzar and Afshana from the department of housekeeping were incredibly helpful and professional. Amazing 100/100

reviews.author: Patel
reviews.title: Housekeeping and overall experience
reviews.text: Housekeeping services were excellent. Suhail and rashid provided great service. Breakfast was great and had a wide spread. The hotel was amazing with  views of the Himalaya and the hotel as a great location. Totally worth it . Must visit

reviews.author: Sanya D
reviews.title: Amazing hospitality
reviews.text: My family and I have had such a fabulous stay at this beautiful property. The service has been impeccable and we’ve had a great experience. Mohammad Rafi and Idris were amazing in attending to all our needs.

reviews.author: Ananya

reviews.text: Had a great stay, extremely hospitable staff . Housekeeping staff afshana and Gulzar were extremely efficient, catered to all our requests and kept the area Spick and span . The maintenance was excellent

reviews.author: Lakshya Dugar
reviews.title: Khyber
reviews.text: Has a great stay at Khyber with my parents, the entire staff the hotel was great, especially Mr. Rafiq. Best property to stay at in Gulmarg, nothing else comes close. Would absolutely recommend to anyone travelling there!

reviews.author: Karan

reviews.text:

reviews.author: Saraah
reviews.title: Feedback
reviews.text: Our stay couldn’t have been better in Khyber. Mr Ameen from the Restaurant who delighted us with Kashmiri delicacies,Mr Ashraf from the Reception who arranged for such an amazing visit, Mr Adil Peer,the smiling man from the coffee lounge were the people we were directly associated with and they left an everlasting happiness. Mr Muzammil from the Reception was also really nice and am sure the rest of the staff would have been as sweet as all. Thank you for such a wonderful experience! We definitely plan on returning to the Warmth of the hotel during the colds of February.

reviews.author: siddhi jain
reviews.title: Khyber - the luxury stay.
reviews.text:
This luxurious resort is situated at an altitude of 14800 ft amidst the himalayan ranges. This resort resonates a palace. 
If you plan a visit here , you would get a complete package of gym , spa , shopping at the souvenir shop .
Leaving apart the costly tariff , this place is worth visiting more than 4 times a year. 

Make sure that when you plan a visit here , you aren't tucked up with adventurous activities .
Enjoying this property to the fullest should be your goal.

reviews.author: VVS

reviews.author: Saurav C
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth - Jannat
reviews.text:
Hi Family Friends Well Wishers and Readers!!!

Here I am to review The Khyber Resort and Spa - Gulmarg.

Let me start with thanking Mr. Abdul ji who was the 1st to meet and greet us at the Srinagar airport. He is humble, well educated and ready with all the answer to all the questions a tourist wishes to know. A very save chauffeur and well behaved.

We were greeted by Mr. Arif Bhat who did our check in formalities and escorted us to out room and explained all about The Khyber Resort.

I would like to thank Mr. Vaibhav, who is the food and beverage manager, who has an excellent well behaved staff. Pardon me if I forget to name a few buy will try and thank all possible who came in contact with us. Let me start with Mr. Junaid -  Excellent Human, Good at heart and serves all Khyber guests with all that one needs. I would like to appreciate the care give to us by Mr. Sajad Mr. Suowket Mr. Navin Mr.  Jaweed Mr.  Ishfaq and Mr.  Aamir to name a few. Our interaction with them were in different times of the day and on our different needs but FnB related. Thanks team.

I will also like to thank Mr. Irfan Hyder @ In Room Dinning.

I would like to thank Mr. Nasir who is a guide and is attached to Khyber and I will recommend all travellers to call him if you are in Gulmarg. He will do all for you. He isn't hungry for money and is very clean at heart. He is fun loving andoves what he does.

Last but not the least I would like to thank Mr. Vinit Chhabra who is the General Manager and in command of the property and guests needs and comfort. Missed meeting with you during our long period of stay. Congratulations on having an excellent set of caring colleagues.

reviews.author: Ektaa S
reviews.title: Winter Wonderland!
reviews.text:
We went for a family vacation amidst the pandemic. It was a much needed break. The location of the hotel is fabulous! Completely surrounded by mountains and long pine trees covered in snow! What more can you ask for? Once the climb to Gulmarg starts, the drive to the property is scenic. It was snowing when we arrived giving us the perfect opportunity to experience snowfall.

The hospitality of the staff is amazing. They are warm, kind and extremely helpful. They took care of all our needs and cravings. From stuffed kulchas and gulab jamun to Quesadillas and French toast everything was super!! On days when we were tired of eating indian food, the chef as well the manager Mr. Shyam took special interest in providing us food of our choice.

The staff was always present for all our needs. Special thanks to Aijaz, Ishfaq, Iqbal, Firdous and Tawheed for taking care of us! (Photo of them attached).

Sadly we missed out on the heated pool and spa which was shut due to the covid pandemic. Definitely coming back when it's completely functional! 

It was an amazing experience! Can't wait to visit again ! Kudos to the Khyber team!

Drawbacks:
The property is situated on a hilltop. Even though it's very close to the gondola, the walk is very steep and can be slippery in the snow (only issue during snowfall). They do not provide any transport to and fro to the gondola where all the other activities are also present. You are left at the mercy of cab/ATV drivers. 
PS: carry proper snow footwear for the walk.

I see'em glow🌸.
.
.
The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa is spread over seven unspoilt, fir-laden acres, with majestic views of the Affarwat Peaks. This 85-room resort is framed at every vantage point by nature at its most spectacular. The world’s highest ski lift, the Gulmarg Gondola – which takes you to Kongdoori Mountain, is only a short walk away. Meadows and forests that have enchanted travellers for centuries wait to be explored by trekking enthusiasts and undying romantics. Clad in locally sourced pine and slate, the resort is built in a style true to the architectural heritage of Kashmir. In every way the indoors mirror the beauty of the outdoors.
.

reviews.author: anjtolani
reviews.title: Hanging in the lap of nature
reviews.text: From the big sized balcony of our suite all we heard during our entire stay at this hotel was the sound of birds and silence of the mighty mountains. The Khyber in Gulmarg is not just the best hotel in that location but also one of the best hotels in all of Kashmir. It's location is breath taking, the staff are always eager to assist and the F&B at this hotel is superlative. They do some fabulous wazwan dishes which for first timers to Kashmir, like us awed us. Our first ever authentic kahwa was served to us at check-in at the hotel and we have become die hard kahwa fans ever since. The Chef was also planning to get an authentic Kashmiri winter breakfast spread organised by us but this being summer wasn't the right time for it we were told. But we still managed to have the nun chai one of the mornings over breakfast. This hotel is situated close to the market and the gondola point, yet isolated enough to allow its guests to destress after a day spent outside. When we stayed at the hotel in May, they had snow in their premises and that was a cause of huge excitement for us. Their temperature control pool with a break taking view of the pine trees and snow capped mountains is an absolute highlight and on our trip we carried a swimsuit just for that one dip in the pool even at those low temperatures that Gulmarg experiences even in May. I can't even imagine how much prettier this hotel would be in winter

reviews.author: reena
reviews.title: Luxury Resort in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The impeccable colour combinations, minimalist aesthetics, and understated furnishings do not detract from the beauty of the place and makes it feel impeccably elegant and timeless. Besides the Kashmir style elements, the place has gilded ceilings and stunning wall artifacts, which are a feast for the eyes.

Blending the tradition of Kashmir heritage with contemporary sophistication, the palatial building of The Khyber Resort has a stylish ambience that creates an ultra-luxurious vibe. 

The spectacular lobby has an impressive reception desk, concierge and a sprawling multi cuisine restaurant that throws open the spectacular scenic view of the now capped mountains.

The lobby definitely makes a great first impression with its cozy interior and impeccable designing that is somewhat similar to the beauty of the paradise land. The staff is extremely friendly & helpful, and will go the extra mile to make your stay as memorable as possible. From the lobby, the plush carpeting takes you up to the luxury guestrooms and plush suites. 

Rooms 

The design in all rooms brilliantly combines contemporary style with local accents. The rooms at Khyber are spacious, luxuriously decorated, and most of them have wide balconies to take in the views.  

During our 2 night visit to the hotel, we stayed in a luxury balcony room, which overlooked the stunning picturesque beauty of the mountains.  It featured a magnificent carpeting, a large walk-in closet, a plush king bed, a wide sofa cum bed, tea and coffee sachets and flat-screen TV. 

The rooms are also really quiet and well insulated. The beds are spacious, and linens are of superior quality. There’s nothing quite like a luxury hotel that not only has great interiors, offers excellent service, and has crisp bed-linen you want to curl up in.

The marble bathroom had a wide mirror, sink, a separate rain shower and a deep-soaking bathtub.  One of the best things about hotel stays are soaking in a tub filled with warm water. The Bathrooms feature luxurious bath amenities.

The big windows with views offering a spectacular view of the mountains make you want to stay in the tub forever.

The Presidential suite @ The Khyber has contemporary furnishings that complement authentic silk wall coverings, chandeliers, wood paneling and ceilings painted in soft hues. Bedrooms are heavenly, temperature controlled and have all the luxury amenities. The suites are also equipped with kitchen, servant’s room and a balcony which offers a nice view of the mountains.

Since Khyber is a luxury and expensive resort, one can get some discounts by using coupons from online travel sites like Goibibo. 

Dining

Khyber has an exquisite multi-cuisine restaurant called Cloves that has authentic Kashmir cuisine and continental dishes that are served with warmth and hospitality. 

The Restaurant offers amazing views that you can soak in while dining. The best thing is that you can also order for room service in your own room as per your own convenience.

The hotel also has a popular lounge called Chaikash at the farthest end that serves the most quintessentially coffee, tea and kahwa. 

This place is one of the most desirable and enjoyable place in the hotel to sit and relax with a cup of hot coffee in your hands. The picturesque lounge opens up to an impressive view of the skyline with the majestic mountains in the background.

Calabash, their sheesha lounge, has fine carpets and seating, designed to invigorate lounging for hours on end and floor-length windows that look out to forests of fir and the Himalayas. This is indeed, a cosy nook, which gives you the much needed warmth after a chilly outing in the snow.

The chefs are diligent and ensure the freshest food is served with a touch of innovation. We specially loved the continental treats like the grilled fish, lobster and crab cakes.

I would highly recommend the salmon to be tried. Also not to missed are their delectable buffet spreads that speak in volumes about the enormous variety and freshness. 

The breakfast buffed spreads are the most amazing ones and comprise of fresh juices, detox shots, salads, yoghurts, dips, variants of breads along with continental breakfast like sausages, hams and eggs. The Southern delicacies include dosas, idlis, vadas and uttapams.

The Indoor heated pool and Gym

The Indoor heated pool, which is surrounded by a phenomenal 360 degree view of the snow capped mountains look amazing and make you feel relaxed while soaking in the warm water of the pool.  Heated to a comfortable temperature, you can take a leisurely dip or do laps to stay in shape. 

The gym is well equipped with the latest machines and helps you in exercising with the assistance of the in-house instructor. The steam, sauna and jacuzzi add to the pampering and should definitely be experienced. 

I had booked for a luxury Aromatherapy massage during my stay at their luxurious L’Occitane Spa. I decided to head down early and take a dip in the pool – which is an experience of being totally immersed in soft lights – and later relax in the Jacuzzi followed by steam and sauna.

reviews.author: prernasinha2000
reviews.title: The Khyber Resort & Spa- Luxurious And The Best Option In Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Rooms
It is a 85-room resort with beautiful views of the valley and the Himalayas. Wooden ceilings, luxurious interiors and spacious rooms are some of the wonderful features of this resort. Our room had a balcony with majestic views of the Himalayas. While the morning and the evenings were chilly, with the temperatures dropping to almost 0 degrees, the days are lovely and we would step out or even sit with a book in the balcony.

Cottages
Apart from the rooms they also have an option of the cottages with a private hideaway.

Fitness centre
They a reasonable size gym with well appointed machines, dumbbells and other accessories. There are separate sauna and steam facilities as well as jacuzzis. Again the views from here make winter workouts interesting.

Swimming Pool
The one feature that is covered in almost all the magazines is their heated indoor swimming overlooking the snow laden coniferous forest. It’s a luxury you understand when you are in a cold, freezing atmosphere.

Kids play area- IGLOO
This was well equipped but at the basement and we tried going there twice but it was deserted so we skipped the same. They also have a games room if you want to catch a quick round of snooker or billiards.

The Den
They have the concept of the Den which is where you can watch movies of your choice but we never got the time to check this one out. Restaurants

Cloves
Most of our meals were eaten here. The breakfast has an amazing lay and for dinner and lunch they have a buffet and an ala carte option. I thought the food was pretty decent.

If you are a non-vegetarian then their Kashmiri thali is a must-try though you might need two people to finish it off.

Nouf
Nouf has to be booked in advance and in our usual hurried trip style we never ended up doing the same but it is supposed to have stunning views from every direction. Freshly grilled meats, cooked just the way you like on traditional coal-fired barbecues. Nouf is ideal for a cozy dinner by the candlelight. Definitely on my list for the next time.

Chaikash
Think of it as their coffee shop. It is just next to their lobby and perfect place to lounge and have tea or Kahwa. Their Kahwa is absolutely delicious and for us it became an evening routine to just sit their with our books and chat and indulge in some couple time here.

Do not forget to create a snowman and indulge in some snow fights while you are surrounded 

OTHER ACTIVITIES
Trekking and Fishing
Treks are closed in winters but if you head here in a slightly bearable weather the the trek to Khilanmarg Valley to see spring flowers is supposed to be enchanting. If you are an adventure seeker then you can trek to the serene Alpather Lake. For fishing enthusiasts  Ningle Nallah and the Ferozepur Nallah are streams famous for trout fishing.

reviews.author: alneebari
reviews.title: Amazing from the top
reviews.text: The hotel is in the top of mountain and have amazing view for all rooms and the the restaurants are very good and all staff is helpful and give a good service and they have a warm pool you can swim with a snow view

reviews.author: karangoenka
reviews.title: Very luxurious!
reviews.text: This is the most high end property in Gulmarg. It's v luxurious. Rooms are very comfortable , spacious and well heated. The bathrooms in the rooms are excellent, the shower is simply too good! The hotel is well staffed , with great service and courteous staff. The swimming pool is very good (although the water could have been more heated). The jacuzzi in the spa was excellent although some of the jacuzzi seats weren't working properly. Definitely would recommend this property to people looking for luxury. The property seemed to be very child and family friendly . Please note that this property does NOT serve alcohol but they are very happy to let you carry your own liquor and serve it to you in their hookah lounge.

reviews.author: Tanvi T
reviews.title: A winter Wonderland
reviews.text:
Best resort in Gulmarg infact Kashmir. Their service, facilities, rooms everything is superb. We stayed for 2 nights in Luxury room. Snow was right upto our balcony so that kids were playing in balcony. Resort is centrally heated when there was -5 to -11 outside. 
Indoor heated pool is the highlight of the stay. We used the pool all 3 days. Kids specially enjoyed it.
Their service staff was extremely helpful be it room, restaurant or pool.
Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Gaz
reviews.title: Snow Paradise
reviews.text:
This is not a 5 star hotel, but an excellent 4 star hotel with value for your money. The hotel staff are excellent and the Kashmiri hospitality is the best in the world, and trust me I’m a regular traveller. 

The L’occitane Spa is outstanding and a definite “must do” during your stay. 

The Indian food is outstanding and Room Service is fantastic. 

If you haven’t skied you must ski ! It’s a fabulous experience! The Gondola ski lifts is less than a 5 min drive from the hotel. 

Get your own personal ski instructor for as little as $35/day and I would recommend Mushtaq with his brother Imran (+91 96226 41899) are an excellent duo and they took incredible care of us throughout our stay.

reviews.author: big_paan
reviews.title: Beautiful stay at the Khyber
reviews.text:
We had a short stay at the Khyber, but long enough to share some insights with you!

The L’Occcitane spa - Boooking the treatments, checking in, and the treatment itself were all absolutely five-star. They pay exquisite attention to detail, excel in customer service, and provide a very clean and professional treatment. The only downside was the sound of kids screaming in the pool, but about 5 minutes into the blissful experience, I could no longer hear anything.

Dining - We ate breakfast and dinner at the main restaurant. The breakfast had a nice selection of food, as to be expected at a breakfast buffet at such a property in India. Dinner was decent, but not at all worth the exorbitant prices if you order one dish per person. Most dishes are big enough to share. The customer service was excellent in the restaurant. My gratitude to Tawheed for taking such good care of us!

Rooms - we were in a pretty standard room. The lack of air conditioning made the night almost unbearable, as the temperature range in our room was 27.5-29.5 degrees Celsius. A fan was provided, but the circulation of hot air can only do so much! Because it’s primarily a winter resort, they only have heating.

I struggle with rating the overall customer service. There were some points that stood out. Pakeeza at check in went above and beyond to ensure a comfortable stay for us, and even arranged a special treat for my mom’s birthday! As mentioned above, restaurant staff were excellent as well, as were the security and front door teams. But there were other points that were a little slow. For example, it took 8 hours and 4 reminders to get a rollaway bed in our room. I honestly would have had no trouble getting the bed myself and making it. Similarly, we had to ask a number of times for more water.

In the end, I would definitely recommend this property. I’d love to see it in full swing in the winter, the way it’s meant to be enjoyed. Maybe I’ll take a break from the Canadian Rockies and ski Gulmarg next year!

Thanks!

(Please note, I wrote this review in June on my iPhone... Just getting around to posting it now as I didn't have WiFi while traveling)

reviews.author: MrinalSinha
reviews.title: Don't expect the reservations staff to share local information
reviews.text:
Called the Kyber to book a stay and inquired about skiing options. The experience was contrary to a lot of the reviews. The reservations person told me that once we are checking into the hotel then they can give us information. 

I requested him again asking for advice and told him I should be able to plan it. His response? Sir, you can google it. 

I am sure the hotel is pretty good - given all the reviews. That being said, the first impression is that the staff can do with some training in hospitality.

reviews.author: Ashita M
reviews.title: Experience worth having!
reviews.text:
positive impression of Khyber started as soon as I made bookings with the reservation counter at Khyber where mr Firdaus accommodated my special demands ( for kids) with no fuss or obligation  . We ( a family of 4) visited Khyber in January first week after much speculation ( because of what you read in paper or listen in news about Srinagar, which is not true- it’s very safe for tourists  ) .We were pleasantly surprised when it started snowing as soon as we landed in Srinagar . In spite of delayed flight, the transport incharge of Khyber was standing waiting for us .The experienced cab driver from Khyber constantly kept a track of the snow fall levels during our 1&1/2 hour journey to the hotel and was very responsible in driving . He knew the in’s and out of driving in snow laden roads and where all traffic will get slow due to snowing and kept us apprised of the same . 
Our next best moment was when we entered Gulmarg which was ,by then , completely blanketed with fresh snowfall which glistened beautifully on the tall fir and pine trees , which is exactly where Khyber is located. We were greeted with smiles by the guards Fiyaz Ahmad, Sunil , Danish, Baburam who all helped us in later days with other things too . 
As we entered Khyber, we were taken aback by the richness  of interiors done in traditional Kashmiri style .. the wooden panelling on wall and luxurious carpeted floors bought much needed warmth to the ambience. Rooms were spacious enough . The view from the room was breathtaking- all snow laden dark green fir and pine trees with not a sound to disturb. Next ,we went for a sumptuous meal in the restaurant (as it was delicious - we ended up ordering two servings of everything- but it was a bad idea for day 1- should have had lighter food ). 
We would especially take a moment to thank Mr Ishfaq( associate trainee F&B), Mr Firdaus ( Sen. Ass.F&B) , mr Irfan ( TL F&B), Gh Quadir ( F&B) , mr Sajaad ( trainee), mr Aiyaz ( supervisor F&B), mr Vikram Singh ( Sn chef ), mr Anil ( chef) , Mr Ishfaq( Incharge -in room dining ) and of course mr Basharat ( manager F&B) - for serving us so well - with kahwa, in room dining preparing special non spicy food for my kids and delicious live counters , quick service with smiles all giving us a memorable experience . 
Most of the staff was from Kashmir itself and they were all so pleasant and down to earth and good natured and it was a delight to have conversations with them . Khyber belongs to a Kashmiri family and they have maintained the true spirit of Kashmir in terms of (royal ) interiors, culture and hospitality . 
Regarding sightseeing, there are hotel associated guides ( but not employees of hotel ) , whom you can find standing at the hotel gate at 9 am sharp every morning. They are very responsible ,be it in terms of arranging for you the right warm outfits , gondola ride , ATV , or bargaining for pashminas- as I was told  ( Although we had prebooked mr Yaseen  through reference of Owners of Mercury Himalayan Explorations who are very well experienced since years and helped me plan everything especially with young kids  ).  
Gulmarg is a place which has its own charm in every season - winter ( snow ), spring and summer ( strawberries and apple orchids and beautiful greenery), autumn ( beautiful red coloured trees) - but it is especially good for skiing enthusiasts who if experienced- can traverse the uninhibited mountain sides with trained guides or if novice -simply learn skiing ( which needs a minimum of 5-6 days for basics)
I cannot end before mentioning my gratitude  to Mr Mohammad Rafi , duty manager Khyber for going an extra step for quickly sending me back my important package which I left in the locker by mistake. He was constantly in touch with me till my package arrived safely. I am grateful. 
All in all , it was a marvellous experience and I am thankful to all the Kashmiri people for their warmth and hospitality. And once again , Gulmarg is safe for tourists. 
Thank you Khyber for this memorable experience .

reviews.author: Sunilponraj
reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: This is good place and the staff of hotel especially arif in front office desk and in live cooking station khrusan chief and the entire team welcome us good and stay was excellent with the team and the managers too our first grade to hotel entire team and the second to hotel room and the view of Himalayan range it was pleasant stay in the hotel

reviews.author: NSB83
reviews.title: Khyber, you beauty!
reviews.text:
We booked a stay at Khyber for 6 days starting December 25th. I'm going to be as specific and succinct as possible.

Room - We took room with the glass window and not the balcony because with Sub zero temperature we weren't sure of the utility. We don't regret that decision. 

Best Parts: 

1. The pool, jacuzzi , steam and sauna - There's really nothing quite like the way they have them all together at Khyber 

2. Food is average but not bad at all and service is fantastic which makes up for it! The Hookah lounge is a great place to kick back and chill in the evening. 

3. Buffet breakfast is a decent Indian spread but when you stay for 6 days you know the pattern :) 

4. Igloo offers a good variety of options to enagage in fun activities with your child. 

5. The airport representative - Asif is absolutely fantastic! We had trouble with our flight and Asif really helped us through all of it. Really appreciate that! 

The not so great now - (1) They forgot we were there on our anniversary trip despite me reminders on the phone and the day we checked in. (2) When a family stays in a hotel for an extended period of time and not the usual day or two we do expect to meet the hotel manager. I didn't see him around at all. Would've definitely added a more personal touch to our long stay. 

I would HIGHLY recommend this hotel and will be back just before 2019 comes to a close.

reviews.author: Muzammil A
reviews.title: Amazing property
reviews.text:
We had stayed for 2 nights 04/Jan-05/Jan we booked two rooms with Himalayan View, we must say people visiting Gulmarg should stay at this property; they have the most beautiful views from the room. Overall the property was just too good. The staff and hospitality is just above the best. The Jacuzzi is awesome. 
Only low points are the pool and food.
Pool was a bit cold, not a big deal though, at such extreme cold conditions any temperature would have felt jittery.
Food here is I felt was only vegetarian, if you are a non veg lover this place is not for you. Buffets hardly have any non veg options.
We wanted to have an A la carte for the dinner but the restaurant manager duped us to go for a buffet by offering 1 pax discounts. We paid 7+ grands just to have Panner and Veg. Not his mistake though, I should have been wise to check the buffet menu before taking a call. For the other night we made a wiser decision to have our food outside and we thoroughly enjoyed.

reviews.author: Raz.Habz
reviews.title: December in Heaven
reviews.text: My recent holiday was absolutely fabulous at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa in Gulmarg..the services were outstanding the staff were most pleasant & food absolutely perfect..our rooms were most comfortable & i would like to thank management for such a eell maintained & high standard resort..i will definately be revisiting as this was one of the most memorable holidays my family & i have enjoyed.

reviews.author: rishabh j
reviews.title: Beautiful getaway
reviews.text: Went over to this property twice. It's about an hour's drive from Srinagar airport. The hotel is just amazing. It's very well located and has some great facilities. The staff is very sweet and helpful and are willing to do whatever it takes to make your stay comfortable. They have an indoor heated pool which just steals the show. It's probably one of the best hotels in India with one of the best restaurant in the area. However, please note that they do not serve alcohol.

reviews.author: vmahajan
reviews.title: A 5 Star Hotel that's gives India it's own slice of Switzerland and more  !!
reviews.text:
I have been attempting to book a room here over the Christmas period for the past 2 years now and I always end up reacting a little late by when all rooms get lapped up. This time not to be outdone I ensured I was miles ahead and had a lovely "Gulmarg View with Balcony room" waiting for me. 

I had high expectations of the hotel and rightly so, it's website and promotional video are one of the finest I have ever seen and being a seasoned traveller was a few percentile sceptical that it might be as one would expect "dressed up" for the promotion material. I went about the hotel with a fine tooth comb looking for reasons to give them a thumbs down and boy was it tough. The pictures of the rooms / bathrooms etc are an exact representation of the hotel and this is a rarity.

On check in we were greeted by the lovely Ms Khalida (who upon reading this will remember I promised to give a fair unbiased review on check out :) There was lovely Cava a hot local beverage that was served to all of us and the check in procedure was flawless. I did arrive at about 4 and probably missed the rush since check in is at 2 and I recommend this during the peak season if your not the wait patiently type.

We had stayed for 3 nights over the Christmas 
period and you can't get more festive than that. They had a Santa Clause prancing around giving out sweets to the kids on demand through the day, a nice little touch I must say. 

The Breakfast buffet had a mix of Indian and continental fare enough for everyone to indulge in as per ones palate. I do recommend as I did with the check in, however the reverse in this case show up early as there is a bit of a wait if you come in late in order to get a table.

Dinner was a buffet as well though I do recommend going over the Ala carte menu for a more robust choice especially if your looking to sample various types of ethnic non vegetarian fare. They do have a few on the buffet but if you want the real kickers be prepared to order from the menu. I have seen a few reviews where people complain that the restaurant is expensive, my answer is Khyber is not exactly a budget property, if you can afford the room rates there should he no reason to penny pinch elsewhere.

There are a host of guides standing outside the foyer and on day 1 I was not sure if they were there to dive deep into my pockets, then again you can negotiate terms but the service is if I may say so as promised. Do not hesitate to use there services even for a few hundred more it's worth it in terms of convenience.

The Spa run by Loccitane as all their Spas was exemplary and the pool the finest I have been to in my life in terms of the over all experience. The Jaccuzi was HOT and had 8 seats, and not a lacklustre mildy warm experience that some hotels have for the sake of saying they offer a Jaccuzi. I have read other reviews where one was complaining about the size of the Sauna well it perhaps could have been slightly larger but I'm considering every time I went there was just 1 or 2 other people it did not matter.

I also did read a review a few days ago of someone who had a terrible experience thats what one would call the joker in the pack, I also did have a slight issue of a chocked shower drain which was intended to immediately. No hotel is without it's imperfections therefore one must in view of the over all situation allow somethings to pass. I have picked holes in the finest properties on earth that being said were all human. 

The housekeeping team deserves special mention especially Muzzamil who tended to every need from extra towels to a turn down service without a word. Every time I walked the passages on cue Every single time irrespective of who the staff member was I was greeted throughout my stay with a smile and a Good morning /, evening, it's these little things that go a long way.

I did travel by my 8 and 5 year old and if any one needs suggestions on the property with children do write in. My children had a BALL at the Igloo which is basically a den in the basement with a lot of entertainment in tow.

I have returned and have recommended the property to my friends and Khyber has already had a few reservations confirmed in view of my excellent experience. I thank everyone at Khyber and will definitely be back dinner than later.

reviews.author: Atul S
reviews.title: Surreal, invigorating and Dreamy getaway, fantastic service too !!
reviews.text: We were there over the new years period with the extended family and the facilities, location, service and can-do approach of staff beats the best in the world. With views from our balconies of the Himalayan View room that took our breath away and snowflakes in our hands-wish we had discovered this earlier than the best resorts of the swiss alps. Mr. Chhabra, the GM leads his team inspiringly and some that stood out during our stay included all the Housekeeping staff (Imran in particular), Mukesh at the coffee shop but above all the superstar who defines the Kashmiri spirit of hospitality was Asif - the airport rep who welcomed us with pride and joyful spirit and managed to pull strings relentlessly when our flights got canceled due to bad weather. Having travelled the world, I recommend this to all with a case of wanderlust-get it on your bucket list !!!

reviews.author: Laksh2009
reviews.title: Beautiful beautiful place!!!
reviews.text:
This review is quite a bit late but the memories are very fresh and that feeling of awe still intact. This place really is paradise! The hotel itself is very tastefully done with rich decor. The rooms are very comfy with a balcony that literally takes you out to the Himalayas. 
The staff deserve a very special mention here. They are such warm people always ready to help. We booked the den for a movie which we enjoyed with yum food served right there. The spa was relaxing after a day of sightseeing. The resort vehicles would be the best way to travel around as it is safe and do ask for Mr Akbar to show you around, a very nice gentleman.

reviews.author: viviangomes2005
reviews.title: Great and cosy getaway

reviews.author: Travel The World With AJ

reviews.text: We stayed at the Khyber to celebrate our parent’s birthday, and the staff went out of their way to make it a memorable one. To experience the true authentic beauty of this part of the world, I wouldn’t recommend staying anywhere else. The views are breathtaking and the location perfect.

reviews.author: Eka L
reviews.title: My family has never been happier
reviews.text: Khyber is not only a resort, it’s an over all experience. We stayed there for three nights to celebrate my parents anniversary, each day was better than the previous. The hospitality, the restaurants, Gym, pool and spa.. all were of the best possible standards. The seesha’s were amazing. Food was so yummy that we overate eatery meal! What was even better for us, was that when we came, it was green, when we slept, it had snowed a little, when we woke up, the whole place was white! Getting to see that transition was amazing. The heated pool, while it snowed outside, the amazing jacuzzi and the steam, sauna room were also really good in standards. My special mention to the staff, specially Sameer, they make up feel so belonged that they won part of me permanently. Can’t wait for my next stay!

reviews.title: As Always Amazing .!!!

I like the Khyber Hotel most in Kashmir bcoz of its location, the most thing is staff very nice friendly. they have maintained well this property. while u eat at The balcony that is breathtaking. reviews.author: Ashmita
reviews.title: Most Perfect Trip
reviews.text:
Khyber is the best 5 star resort I have stayed in so far. Their service is extraordinarily amazing. The staff is so courteous that they will go out of the way to make your stay comfortable and memorable. The food is delicious no matter which cuisine you try.

reviews.author: Rahuls82
reviews.title: Luxury in himalayas !!
reviews.text: Stayed in Khyber in Dec 2018 with my wife and 5 year old son. Property is state of art architecture with spectacular views. Rooms are nice but wifi internet wasnt working smoothly. Even though I complained twice the issue wasnt resolved although technicians visited my room twice.  Some people might find food expensive but its amazing. Amenities are great especially kids will enjoy the swimming pool. I felt that somewhere it lacks personal touch but again with so many guests and considering this is huge property, this can be neglected.

reviews.author: Rupali Chachad
reviews.title: Feel the magic of winter in Kashmir amid warmth of hospitality. Thanks Team Roamland Holidays
reviews.text:

The trip overall was memorable & everyone served us so nicely. We want to convey a word of thanks via TripAdvisor to all especially Khyber Resort who are magical in  hospitality. Highly recommended to visit Kashmir & Khyber Resort as well!

reviews.author: Atiroh S
reviews.title: Fantastic views around the hotel!
reviews.text: My family of 5 stayed there for a night after a full day of activities in Gulmarg. It was a perfect end to our visit to Gulmarg. Hotel staff were polite,and provided excellent service! You are expected to tip them for their service.

reviews.author: Akal1980
reviews.title: Location location location (and the POOL)
reviews.text:
What a perfect location. Breathtaking views no matter which window you look out of.  

The Good
- Location: Stunning views and amazing proximity from the Gondola and ATVs. Perfectly located
- Heated pool: Definitely the highlight of Khyber. Perfect temperature indoors with the snow clad Himalayas and beautiful tall pines  
- Spa: A must do, hard to explain the experience, just go for it
- In-Room dining: the food we ordered in-room (italian, Indian and snacks) were excellent.
- Room: bedroom and bathroom are an ideal size. The bed is huge and comfortable.
- Clean: very well maintained hotel. great housekeeping  
- Service: courteous, helpful and flexible staff like it should be in a 5 star. We lost one of our jackets at the airport. It was tracked, the hotel taxi arranged for it to be collected and delivered to our room (at no charge). During the dinner buffet, we wanted a white sauce pasta for our 3 year old, that wasn't on the menu, but they made it and didn't charge extra. We asked for a tour of the hotel, and they spent a good hour showing us every nook and cranny. 

Could Improve
- Buffet: While the breakfast and dinner buffets are good, they could be better. Eg. in breakfast, would be good to have more options of cold cuts, assortment of cheese, granola / cereals and non-veg.
- Food prices: Be ready to go light on your wallets
- Response time: We made a couple of requests where it look a bit longer that we expected for the staff to arrive - like a personal tour of the property (which was amazing, must do), and luggage collection at check out (its like they didn't want us to leave ;) ).  
- Cupboard: is a little tiny. Make use of the drawers in the room
- Bathroom hanging: between the towels, robes and wet swimsuits, you'll have insufficient hooks for hanging 
- Kids entertainment: while every kids channel is available, the play area could do with a few more options to keep kids engaged for longer.
- Internet: speed is a bit slow, mobile 4G (at least Airtel) is way faster. Will get better results using your hot-spot. 

Travel tips
- Get a guide: Go to the Gondola with a guide especially if you have a child. He will help manoeuver and carry the kid at slippery places. Its a big help.
- Negotiate: Even if its 'fixed price' for activities like skiing, snow-biking etc. Your guide will help you pull down the price by 50%
- Sledge: not worth it, stick to skiing. snow biking and the 13KM ATV ride
- Boots and coat: rent a set for your trip up the gondola ride. If its snowing, make sure you have them for your ATV ride as well. Whenever you stop and jump into the snow, you'll need them.

reviews.text: Haven't enjoyed any resort as the Khyber Gulmarg . Every aspect of our stay was special . Special mention of the house keeping staff . They were outstanding . Special mention of Kaiser he really knew what outstanding Hospitality means .

reviews.author: anusant

reviews.author: shoiabrafi
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradise
reviews.text:
