reviews.author: aditi b
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text:
This was my first visit to Kashmir. 
One of the most beautiful properties I have visited. I got a complimentary upgrade on request. The room and bathroom is fantastic. We had a lovely view from our room. The staff is very impressive!

reviews.author: Nisarg Vyas
reviews.title: Excellent property in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Best property in entire Kashmir.  I stayed with my family here for two nights. The hotel is amazing with such a beautiful location. Staff is extremely hospitable, service excellent. Food is good too. They have a heated swimming pool and their spa service is awesome. It’s a 5 star property so the rates will be high but definitely worth it. If you want to stay in Gulmarg stay in Khyber.

reviews.author: Shabar M
reviews.title: Quality of food not good.
reviews.text: I visited there along with my family. Although the Ambience is good but the quality of food and drinks is not good. The bakery in the coffee shop is stale and from the taste it is clear the is no fresh. By the name and desfription of the drinks on the menu it seems that it is something exclusive but the drinks are pretty ordinary and nothing more than just a fruit mixed with milk. Certainly it a waste of money for the amount they charge. I would think thrice before visiting them.

reviews.author: daud r
reviews.title: Visit to coffee shop with friends
reviews.text: I visited Khyber resort Gulmarg to day for the first time along with my family. I had heard a lot about the place but was really upset after visiting. We order nutrition smoothie which the suggested is quite good, but after having it was as if having medicine such as cough syrup. Ordered cold coffee with ice cream that also was average and not as good as one would expect at such a luxurious place. Ordered pastry which was not fresh at all. We get fresh and much bigger pastry at any bakery in Srinagar which is 10 times cheaper. Also as we were sitting on the open balcony of the coffee shop while waiting for our order we started taking photos on the staircase leading to the garden, but to our surprise the staff told us we are not allowed to take photos as we are non resident guests. Really a bad experience from such a costly hotel. No value for money and don't recommend the place. You have much better and cheaper places available at Gulmarg instead.

reviews.author: aheedshah
reviews.title: Best view, best hotel, best experience
reviews.text: I had taken 4 rooms with my family and the experience was unbeatable. Such a great view, helpful staff and an amazing pool. The garden was well maintained and so was the pool, steam and sauna. The heated pool feels so good in winters. Must go to this place if you're staying in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: almulhim_vip
reviews.title: Gulmarg City
reviews.text: منتجع فخم ورومنسي يقع في قلب غابة جولمارج ... مناسب لي اقامة العوائل والمجموعات ... اسعاره مناسبه على فخامة المنتجع...يوجد به خدمات ممتازة جدا...يوجد به مطعم فاخر يقدم افضل الاكلات الكشميرية الخاصة والهندية ...ويوجد به كافي فاخر يقدم افضل المشروبات الساخنة ... انصح به في شهر جولاي و اغسطس وسبتمبر لمحبين الاجواء المعتدلة والطبيعه والزهور الجميلة.... لمحبين التزلج والاجواء الباردة جداً ياتي في شهر ديسمبر وجانيوري ...

reviews.author: tusharcool20
reviews.title: Rude behaviour
reviews.text: I'll keep it small just like their shallow  personalities & mentality. The staff is Extremely high headed, very rude & full of attitude. DO NOT MAKE THE MISTAKE OF COMING HERE LIKE I DID. Now let me finish the minimum characters required for this post.

reviews.author: Hrithik Shrivastava
reviews.title: Best Propety of Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Nothing can beat this property in Gurmarg. Conveniently located near the picturesque, green main meadow in Gulmarg, Heated pool. Walking distance to the Gondola Ride. 

 The rooms are comfortable and the hotel organises sightseeing tours for their guests

Book in advance in peak Season to ensure availability. Recommend this place highly when in Gulmarg

reviews.author: icassamally
reviews.title: Excellent boliday
reviews.text: One amind the best resort in Gulmargh. Received by Khalida Lone, a pleasant lady, who is very professional and at ease of her work. The hotel has an indoor restaurant, gym, spa, swimming pool and different level of rooms. The staff are very pleasant and professional. The Heemalay visit by Gandola - cable car is just meters away and very easy to access.

reviews.author: Isha G
reviews.title: Beautiful !!
reviews.text: We took a 2 bedroom cottage. Must take for family and kids. Excellent , good service . Expensive. Incase of curfew, cannot leave the hotel unless going to airport. Gulmarg is so damn beautiful. Must take Himalayan view.

reviews.author: Sheikh M
reviews.title: Highly highly overrated utterly disappointed
reviews.text:
At first let me humbly apologise to those who thinks it’s a great property and worth spending 400-500 usd per night in this hotel.
To my opinion it’s a sheer wastage of money. When we step in to a expensive resort we expect service we expect facility we expect good food and good location.
I didn’t see any of these in this hotel apart from a very good location. Only good thing about this hotel is location but if you add on sloppy and slow service poor buffet spread and poor service the upside of a good location flows through your window.
At first let me tell you one by one my experience :
1. Check in. It took an hour to check in .... it’s not that our room was not ready ( we were not informed on that as a cause of delay in check in) we were in the lobby for more than an house before we came to know our room number .
2. Room TV connection was not there when we check in. We had to call few times the service man to fix TV connection.
3. WiFi is poor and slow and it also took more than an hour to fix the WiFi for me . Initially the way I was explained with pass word and ID , I could not log in to my WiFi devise with that password .
3. After paying that huge amount of money per night if you are advised that only two devises are free to use WiFi and more than two device is chargeable then you got a shock. In a family you have multiple device that needs WiFi and surely that more than two.
4. When I booked I mentioned in my booking on booking.com that we will stay with our 10 years old daughter but don’t need any extra bed. This hotel charged us 
USD 60 for my daughter irrespective whether I take any extra bed or not . Trust me no where I faced such and I am sure by now my trip advisor friends noticed that I do Travel a lot and I have never faced this else where.
5. Next morning we went to buffet bfast and the spread was very poor and the only non veg item in that buffet is chicken nuggets and egg which to my expense is poor and when I mentioned this to one of the restaurant guy he seem very reluctant to listen to his and acted like this is it .... take or leave it :(

My opinion is if anyone wants to waste money can surely pick this hotel or else with one night price of this hotel you can have a fantastic stay in gulmarg one night with a good hotel .... food in top rated trip advisor restaurants .... gondola ride with ATR for a family of 4 :)

So it’s your pick whether you spend that money in this hotel for one night or spend that money t have fun in gulmarg for a day with all inclusive.

My rating is based on the return against the price we paid for our stay.

reviews.author: Sharad99
reviews.title: Naysayers
reviews.text:
When I entered the resort I was full of expectations about it. As far as creation of physical infrastructure is concerned undoubtedly they have done a marvelous job. However service and attitude mars every thing. Since we were carrying two suitcases I asked for a stand in the room so that my wife who is suffering from back pain can manage. But the person keeping the luggage didn't turn up with any yes or no. I liked Rajma Rice of a dhaba on the way so I carried it. I requested them to heat it they refused. I went to swimming pool there I asked a person sitting on chair to take mine and my wife's photo he said they are not allowed. In the evening I was interested in having hukka and
 paneer tikka along with some mock tails while my  son was interested in having pizza. I asked them to serve pizza in the lounge as restaurants were about to close in an hour and all of us can sit in one place and have food of our choice but again to my horror and surprise they refused. Both the restaurants were only a few metres away. My son wanted to play with Xbox console but they were having only one unpopular CD. Overall entire staff is anti guest and specialises in saying no. After paying hefty prices this was not what we expected as we have stayed in some of the finest properties of the world including some Oberoi group properties where they go out of the way to pamper the guests.

reviews.author: Ruchita
reviews.title: Beautiful Location
reviews.text: It was just “heaven”... it actually justified to be a must visit in Gulmarg as it is called “heaven on earth” Surrounded by snow and view that gives you beautiful vibes!! Ambience and facilities all were great.. i was not very contented with food they serve coz of their taste! Rest all were good

reviews.author: Anand
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Excellent hotel with all the modern fecilities. Irfan at front desk was very helpful all the time.Hotel is well located in lap of nature. Snow laden peaks are visible. Lush green mountains give feeling of heaven

reviews.author: Omid Y
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: This hotel is probably the best hotel in Gulmarg. It’s a sky resort hotel. Staff are friendly as is with all hotels in Kashmir. It’s a bit pricy but being the only one at this level it would be. Overall I would say it’s a nice hotel and breakfast is good so is their alacarte menus. Pool and gym are nice and so is the spa.

reviews.author: PrashantSanghvi
reviews.title: 25000 per night is it WORTH ?
reviews.text:
The moment we say Gulmarg two things come to our mind GANDOLA which is World's highest and longest cable car  and the most sought after resort Khyber!!! Gandola I will definitely recommend but Khyber I would say is a waste of money as they don't have proper view for base category of rooms as evident from the pictures our room was too close to parking lot even after a complaint to the duty manager they were not able to give us a better room as for this amount of money you can stay at Taj Srinagar which has definitely a better view further they just provide 4 bottles of water in a day any additional is chargeable also as informed to us even the tea coffee will be replenished only to the extent of 20% of the stock They provide just two Twinings tea  and some open Tetley bags which is evidenced from the pic uploaded we are not theives or beggars which management should understand even no complimentary fruit basket and they don't even consider your anniversary or birthdays which other hotels do consider and makes some arrangements to make the guest feel special,  staff needs to be trained on customer relationship inspite of rooms going empty they have a policy to keep it vacant. 
Over all it was a disappointment to end our holidays at Khyber

reviews.author: Trip400959
reviews.title: Hyped up property
reviews.text:
Always had a different vision of Kashmir and it just puts me off how the tourism is here with the safety and many many things. It's a dirty place though it looks good in pictures one has to really think twice to spend a holiday here. We paid 4000 for each ATV to go to phase 2 gondola as phase 1 was closed  but actualy it was working and they shut it off for the pony rides and atv's as its an additional income. The people here try to rip you off further if you stay in Khyber.

Now the good things about Khyber so far.. they have an amazing view for the rooms with balcony. The food is amazing and yes it is very expensive each dish starts wth 800rs and goes upto 1800 plus. They have a nice indoor heated pool and jaccuzi and a gym. 

Except the view of the room there is nothn much to this property and its fairly small and old decor. Showers have no adjustment to the force of water and its very very hard to take a shower with either too hot or too cold water gushing. We are a group of 10people staying here and we all feel it's just a hyped up property !!!

At the end I feel 5days at Khyber all the excitement i had just fell flat and I shudve taken a holiday elsewhere out of the country.

reviews.author: Sreyans J
reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text: This is a must stay hotel in gulmarg. Amazing hotel amazing view amazing spa amazing food amazing swimming. Amazing staff . Words are not enough. Higly recommended. Sheesha too also good. Drinks not available. Happy stayed thr. Though didn't get upgraded to higher category room but still . Lil expensive.

reviews.author: Hari G
reviews.title: Excellent property, but definitely overpriced
reviews.text:
We were welcomed with traditional Kashmiri tea in the tea lounge. The views from the lounge were beautiful. The hotel had a very cozy yet luxurious feel to it. 

Was particularly impressed by the indoor pool and facilities. The food and restaurant should have been better given the price-point of the hotel. Rooms were spacious and well furnished. The property overall was very well maintained. 

In summary, anyone on a luxury trip should stay here, but be prepared to shell out 20k+ for the hotel's deluxe room.

reviews.author: sanjaychawla740
reviews.title: Location is not that Pictureisque what as shown on the website
reviews.text: Average Hotel especially comppared to the price they charge,high minded staff and ordinary food,had asked for a copy of bill thrice to be sent through the mail but nobody has bothered so far,looks very different from what its shown on the website

reviews.author: nilshah07
reviews.title: Nilesh shah
reviews.text: Best hotel of gulmarg with Himalayan view room. Very good indoor swimming pool with temperature control. Nice staff lead by ms khalida are very supportive and hospitality is at is best. A must stay property.

reviews.author: Soumendra B
reviews.title: Best place of stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Khyber hotel is the best place to spend your holidays in leisure. Just at he foothill of Gulmargh it commands a magnificent look of the snow clad Himalayas. The resturant of hotel has the most authentic Kashmiri food and the trout fish is out of this world. The cherry on the top is the heated swimming pool.

reviews.author: Minakkshi19
reviews.title: Ultimate experience
reviews.text:
Nestled in Gulmarg , Himalayan mountains is the beautiful Khyber resort.

Ticked box one of the items in my bucket list!
Warm beautiful scenic and ultimate experience . Some of the rooms do not have a good view. So check the same , staff is warm and proactive. 
Children friendly.

reviews.author: nirajsomaiya
reviews.title: taj mahal of india
reviews.text: the hotel is outstanding and one of the best hotels i have stayed in india. you have to take rooms facing the himalayan side. they are odd numbers in 2000 series and even number in 4000 series. hotel has over 80 rooms. the food is out the world. service is outstanding. the pool is indoor heated one and spa is really good. the hotel is just a 2 minute drive from the gondola.

reviews.author: Carlos E
reviews.title: Perfect Winter Escape
reviews.text:
First thing I want to apologize to the hotel team for posting this review so late! We actually stayed in Feb 2017. 

The hotel was fantastic! If you want a winter land escape look no further.  The team was attentive and extremely friendly.  Our driver Shabir had a fantastic personality and was very pleasant/safe drive. 

Being in such a remote location, food was very important. To be honest we only ate a la cart and Kashmiri staples. They where all great and we really enjoyed the food.

In general I hope the geopolitical situation gets better. The hotel and the team deserve to host many more people in this wonderful hotel.  

We where my wife, baby infant and my self on this trip. It was great to relax and to bond together in the long winter days.

reviews.author: Bhavin Doshi
reviews.title: Switzerland is Nothing
reviews.text:
We checked in 20 April and we were lucky to experience Snow storm in April.

Mr Manzoor Akhtar ensured we had smooth Check in and Upgrade to Himalayan Rooms due to which we could experience of a lifetime of Snow.

Mr Asrar Ensured we got an excellent Orientation due to which experienced amenities and facilities.

Mr Ameen provided us awesome Kashmiri Kehwa which refreshed us.

My Mukesh from F&B Department ensured we got everything we requested due to which we got awesome Hospitality and Taste. After 8 Days in Kashmir we got Homely food. We cannot imagine having Kahakra Gathiya Jalebi Fafda in Kashmir. Mukesh you deserve special Thanks.All 7 couples were extremely happy due to the same.

We definetely will visit again and will come only at Gulmarg Khyber when we come next to Kashmir.

Would recommend all to visit Khyber and experience Top Notch Hospitality.

reviews.author: Batul R
reviews.title: "Memories For Life"
reviews.text: Stayed in khyber in the month of April 2018 wat a wonderful experience.Must visit.Amazing buffet spread and amazing hospitality was more than comfortable and didn't realise how soon two nights got over :(  Went there with family of 8 adults and 2 kids.lovely heated pool and all the facilities were  up to the mark in the premises.Very welcoming and homely staff. Special thanx to Mr.Rashid in the front Desk to be an amazing host and also to Mr.Aijaz in the Restaurant Department made the stay ever more wonderful.had opted for MAP plan and hence choose breakfast and dinner.Buffet Spread for breakfast was amazing.Dinner was served on al carte basis to us which really impressed me.Will be visiting again soooooon just for Khyber.All the Best and you Guys rock

reviews.author: Nitin S
reviews.title: Truly Heaven
reviews.text:
Khyber is truly unmatched experience, Great hospitality, Amazing views, truly luxury experience. 

Stayed on anniversary last year had amazing memories. Kashmir is truly heaven on Earth and Khyber is adding to the heavenly experience.

reviews.author: Rohit Saraf
reviews.title: excellent
reviews.text: The Khyber has been one of the best resorts i have stopped in. the views from there are great the food is excellent and the people are warm .i would also like to mention about the manager mr manzoor akhtar he had been of great help to me.

reviews.author: Rachana R
reviews.title: Best view
reviews.text:
We've just had the best experience staying at the Khyber for a few days and it couldn't have been possible without the help of Mr.Irfan from the front office. He was helpful and knew how to treat his guests.

Mr.Shyam, the F&B manager, was extremely generous and helpful which made every meal at the Khyber a memorable one.

Mr. Burhan received us when we checked in and showed us around and was very kind when we needed help. 

Mr. Firdous makes the best Seesha. Thank you all.

reviews.author: Nidhi G
reviews.title: Nidhi
reviews.text:
This was my second trip to Khyber Himalayan resort. It’s a wonderful resort & must say it’s an all season place to be for a relaxing & comfortable holiday.
The hospitality extended by the staff is really commendable , especially Sakib at the front desk. 
He was a 1 stop for all our queries & needs.

reviews.author: mehzumuneer
reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text:
Amazing hotel with exceptional staff especially the housekeeper Mr Kaisar Bha anything I wanted he immediately brought it to my room as I had 2 young kids under the age of 5 years 
Also the hotel buffet amazing service from all the staff people 
Also had a amazing message from Nam she was excellent

reviews.author: arenski
reviews.title: another annual skiing week
reviews.text:
This will be our 4th consecutive annual stay at khyber. Everything remains the same as previous years.
Beautiful and luxurious rooms. Great location.
Swimming Pool and the Jacuzzi is top notch.
Spa is expensive but brilliant.
Service remains a concern.
Food is a major disappointment. Breakfast and dinner buffet needs to be fresh. someone staying for a day or two will not realise that the food served at buffet is not fresh. Staying for a week you would know that food and fruits being served not fresh. Must have been frozen a few times. Order A la carte and the food is tasty and fresh.
Chose to have dinner at highland park on a couple of occasions and was a delight. Plus massive quantities for every dish.
Getting in and out of khyber every day is still very painstaking. 
Will sincerely request the management to improve the buffet quality.
Stayed for a week March 2018.

reviews.author: anjmehta8
reviews.title: Gorgeous!!
reviews.text: Oh my what a hotel!! We stayed here for 3 days only but none of us wanted to leave. The staff, service, food, rooms, everything was amazing. The staff was very nice and they answered all of our questions, they suggested things to us, they would help us pick what food to eat from the really long list they had in the menu and they always had a smile on their face. The food = wow. There is so much to eat. Even though there is just one restaurant in the hotel, there was so much to eat. We never ate the same thing twice. The rooms were lovely, we had hot water, a heater and some rooms have a balcony. Our heater and TV did not work in the begining but as soon as we called the front desk, room service was there in no time and fixed everything very quickley. The facilities were lovely too. We didn't actually know about some of the facilties, we only discovered them on the last day but nevertheless it was fun. The pool was beyond beautiful. It was such a peaceful place. I spent a lot of time there. The steam, sauna and jaccuzi were so nice too, they were clean and very nice to use. Obviously, the location was extraordinary. I LOVED my stay here. It was so peaceful and just all round amazing. The wifi was not very great but honestly, I think that being in the Himalyas it was nice to not have wifi for a couple of days :) I recommend it 100%. Also, we went in March wish was nice because there was enough snow to play around in but the weather was still very warm and nice.

reviews.author: bhawna15
reviews.title: The best staff and hospitality ever
reviews.text: Khyber indeed provides peace to your soul as soon as you enter the property the warmth of the staff made my stay so comfortable and homely. The rooms provide such great views that leave you in awe. The food was also excellent. I would like to specially thank khailda for making my stay so amazing, she was there to help from there at any time of the day. She made sure personally everytime that we have a comfortable stay. Thankyou for your hospitality.

reviews.author: kanikasinghania
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Khyber is a beautiful property ..! Indoor pool, view everything is just perfect their staff is also very good..! They are very busy even in March and early April so couldn’t give a room on the upper floor. But lower floors front side rooms have beautiful view. But before booking request them from a upper floor room and front side view. The best part is even in early April u can see snow right out side of ur room snow . Pool is awesome.. all in all beautiful and serene property with courteous staff ..! Mudassar.. front desk person was very nice to explain in details about what to do and when is a good time to do certain activities which was quiet helpful ..!

reviews.author: Sazia S
reviews.title: Very good!
reviews.text:
The views with snow were amazing. Hospitality, comfort and food were excellent.
We had a memorable stay. Looking forward to going back in another season too. Thank you Khyber for making our holiday so good.

reviews.author: sal30
reviews.title: What the reception lacks in welcome- the restaurant team more than makes up for it
reviews.text:
First things first - we enjoyed our stay here so much that we're already planning for next Jan. We were here for a two day ski trip and got in to the hotel by 12pm. We had emailed earlier asking for a valley view not knowing that our valley view stared out into a hut like structure. We asked for it to be changed to the other side but were met with a lot of resistance at the reception since they said we had asked for this view- we admitted we did not know and were happy to pay any change charge to the other view. However, for some reason the reception staff seemed to keep disappearing on us which is not exactly what you want after long travel. Fortunately one manager seemed proactive and asked us to have lunch while he sorted it out (which he did fairly quickly after he took over - the rest just seemed to not know what they were doing). 
In contrast we walked over to the restaurant and Mukesh, Junaid, Bilal etc were just fabulous. From the start to the time we left, they went out of their way to ensure we were comfortable and happy. They are partly the reason we will head back. 
The other of course is the view and the fact that it is the best hotel in terms of facilities which is great when traveling with younger ones.
In short - 
We loved our stay at Khyber and will definitely be back next ski season 
Loved the food - do not miss the trout at the restaurant 
Get the mountain view (we learnt this the hard way) with balcony sit out - its like staring at a picture postcard 
The pool is wonderful and relaxing so do carry swimwear 
Kahwa at Chaikash is amazing and truly appreciated after a day long of sking
Mukesh, Junaid, Bilal and all of the restaurant crew - thank you !!

reviews.author: Sunita A
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel
reviews.text: Fantastic service. Wonderful staff. It is Best in gulmarg.Staff was really active and did their best to make our stay comfortable.Staff of restaurant was very proactive which was the best thing. Stay was short but awesome

reviews.author: ABID RASOOL KHAN
reviews.title: Holiday in GULMARG
reviews.text: STAYING IN KHYBER ! Excellent Rooms , Staff are Awesome ! Food and Ambience is beyond description !! We are enjoying our Holiday . During all my Holidays haven’t gone across such Hospitality, we are being pampered !

reviews.author: Jay_Banglore2018
reviews.title: Royalty at the roof of the world!!!!
reviews.text: This is our very first stay in The Khyber .... no words to describe this place..... the hotel reception and the common areas are decked with lavishness and royalty.... but the room( where we were put up) itself seemed a little old fashioned smaller than we expected .....can’t say it was worth the price we paid for .... but i can’t deny the fact that it had a stunning view of the mountain peak  at such close range.... it was surreal!!!!.... and the bathtub was put to good use by my little one....the Gondola ride station is only a stones throw from the Khyber.....which is really amazing as we can get back to the warmth of our room as soon as we finish our ride.... there are other activities in the hotel to entice us like the spa and various food lounges.... but as we just stayed for one day/ night, we weren’t able to explore much..... a special mention has to be made to the breakfast buffet... really grand!!!.....don’t know if we’ll ever check-in to Khyber again..... but we had an experience we’ll cherish for a lifetime!!!!

reviews.author: R1C
reviews.title: serene place with very friendly staff
reviews.text:
I highly recommend this place specially for families with kids. The place is really really beautiful and peaceful. It is pricier compared to most hotels but u get what u paid for. You get your money’s worth. We booked a basic room and it is quite spacious. I f u can shell out some more, go for the room with a balcony. I travelled with my wife and 2 kids aged 2 and 4. no charge for my kids since they are just young and they shlept with us in our king bed. We really enjoyed our stay. The lobby is very welcoming and cozy. u dont even need to queue to checkin. They will approach u and bring u to a comfy lounge and serve u the kawha, a very nice tasting welcome tea. You will just sign the form after you drink your tea and thats it, you’re already checked in. Great start after a tiring connecting flight from Delhi. 

It has a very nice and intricate interior design. Tha staff are very friendly. Special mention to Sohail and also Hamid. They are like friends already during our 3 days stay. They are very nice to us and treated us like we knew each other already. made our stay quite memorable. We even has a picture together before we left the place. We love the swimming pool my kids love to swim and since it is winter, it is a  plus to have a heated pool. I think this is the only hotel in the area with heated pool. They also have an indoor play area that our kids enjoyed. However, it is not well maintained and a bit dark. I am also not confident to leave my kids there because just outside the play room is a door leading to the outside area and no staff or security personnel guarding the door. 

The restaurant has a very nice view. There is also a hug balcony where outside the lounge area where the guests can stay and enjoy the snow without leaving the hotel premises. Food is nice, since we are not locals, it is great to have a few options for western food. My kids cannot take spicy foods yet and curry. that is a huge plus for us. The only thing that I think they can improve is to add more variety for breakfast. I am expecting more variety for this price range. Also no western food except for the omelette. Almost all food in the breakfast are local foods. Not a big deal for many I guess but since we have kids, it was a bit of a problem for us. And at this price range aroud 400usd/night, food variety should be much better. But overall, it was truly an amazing place and we had a wonderful stay.

reviews.author: mvinayak
reviews.title: Sweet memories@khalida
reviews.text: I believe I haven't seen a more beautiful property and hospitality than the Khyber. From the ambience of the place to the food ,everything was beyond excellence. All thanks to miss khalida, she was there with us from our check in and till the end. She made sure at every moment that our stay was pleasant and comfortable. Hoping to come back soon to this beautiful hotel.

reviews.author: NavyaBharath
reviews.title: Great Hotel with Greater Views and Hospitality
reviews.text: We stayed at Khyber from Feb 24th-27th and the experience we had is something that words can’t describe....right from airport pickup, room, food, views... everything was excellent. Our 3.5 year old had a great time playing in the snow...This place is actually a Jewel of Gulmarg. Take the Himalayan view rooms with balcony to wake up to the mesmerising view of himalayas from your balcony. The staff is very attentive. Undoubtedly the best place to stay in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Meghnasg
reviews.title: A great family hotel...
reviews.text:
We booked the Khyber and ever since I was full of skepticism. I had seen various reviews here on trip advisor regarding poor food or service etc etc.
Hence I went (along with my husband and 2 daughters- 8yo and 3yo) with an open mind. 
I must say we were in for a lovely surprise. The moment we entered the property (which was very warm - literally - thanks to the massive heating facilities) , we were given a more than warm welcome by Mr. Sohail. This made us feel very welcome and absolutely at home. We had booked a 1 bedroom cottage which Is a little away from the reception (but connected to the main building via the corridors). The room was very warm and toasty! It was snowing outside and we could move around the entire hotel in shorts!  
Rooms- 
We booked the one bedroom cottage. It had a living room, a bathroom and a small maid’s room in the ground floor with a small verandah opening into the gardens. The top floor was a very spacious bedroom with a huge balcony with breadth taking views. The bathroom was very clean, well equipped and heated! 

Food-
All the food was above average. We tried south Indian, Chinese, Italian and Indian cuisine. The breakfast spread was endless with live South Indian and egg counters. With freezing temperatures and such hostile weather, we must appreciate the fact that each and every ingredient that goes into preparation of the food is brought from the plains ( Srinagar mostly). And I think they are doing a fabulous job serving delicious and piping hot meals. 

- The heated pool is a must visit but it does get very crowded in peak season 
- the pool area has  lovely heated jacuzzis, steam and sauna too
- ‘chaikash’ serves free Kashmiri kawah (very delicious 😋) along with some lovely bakery preparations and snacks
- the spa is very good and must visit
- all postpaid mobile networks work in entire Gulmarg including the level 1 gondola place 
- liquor is not served in the hotel ( infant it’s born served anywhere in Gulmarg). However, you may carry your own drinks.
- beware of the guides and touts waiting outside the hotel. They are all cheats. Please do a thorough research on trip advisor and book in advance.
- we did skiing and loved ‘discover Gulmarg adventures’ run by Irfan and his very talented team. 
- the entire staff from the hotel waiters ( Junaid in particular ), housekeeping staff , restaurant managers etc were all very very warm and considerate. 

Only few pointers that I hope the hotel looks into -
-We saw lots of families with kids , but the property could be a little more kid friendly. The play area needs urgent upkeep. Some more activities need to be introduced.

Overall a super family vacation - we shall definitely visit again.

reviews.author: GyanVerma
reviews.title: Average stay, poor hospitality and over hyped
reviews.text:
I booked my stay through MMT with Booking ID: NH2003371406165
I feel Khyber is an overhyped resort due to absence of the other 5 star resorts in Gulmarg.
Location wise: It is good but what I noticed that you get similar views from other hotels in the Gulmarg also.
Room: Wooden work was nicely done, so rooms are good.
Check-in experience:  It seemed ok however what I despise is the fake accent of people, It does not go well with me anyways no major issues with this.I am thankful they allowed early check-in around 10:30 AM.
Food: Dinner buffet for 2.5K+Taxes was not at all worth , it did not taste well at all.
Breakfast: There was an incident regarding breakfast, the hot milk they were serving had gone bad and none of the staff seemed to notice that, I went to fetch some milk for my daughter and realised it had gone bad, I had brought this issue to their notice but did not get any apology for this oblivion behaviour and suddenly the manager was hard to locate, did not expect this kind of behaviour from so called "5 start resort".
Amenities: Swimming pool was good as generally you would not get swimming pool next to snow or mountains. Full marks in that front.
Checkout: The day we checked out It was our anniversary and I had communicated that at the time of check-in also but nobody cared to wish us. Anyways there was another thing that really made me feel embarrassed and I never got treated this way ever, it goes like this :During checkout the housekeeping guy came in to room to take feedback , I filled the feedback form, At reception while I was settling the bills ,the front office guy “Burhaan” asked me did I take any item from the minibar, “I said No” , so even after me saying No he called somebody and asked him to go and check in the room , this really made me feel bad, I had stayed in many luxury hotels but never ever somebody was so blatant in verifying the minibar items, I am not saying he should not have checked , what I feel is that either he should have done that surreptitiously  or should not have even asked me, When you would like to verify it by sending some person (it is done in lower grade hotels) then do not ask the guest you should do it with secrecy. I suggest Front office to be little careful in these situations anyways apart from this "Burhaan" did ask to give us a complimentary cake at midnight for our Anniversary, which we refused as we were very much tired that day, although I did ask for room decoration which he said would not be possible as they need to be informed 1 week before about this and also it was chargeable 2.5K+takes.

Anyways after average stay at Khyber we checked-in to Vivanta ByTaj-Srinagar and what an awesome treatment and service they had delivered, at least 7-8 staff members had greeted us, gave us complimentary upgrade, cake and nicely decorated our room with flowers and balloons.
I hope soon any other 5 star resort gets opened in Gulmarg, maybe then over hyped Khyber improves their service.
Advice to management: Good resorts/hotels are not only made up with  fancy architecture or building but also with cordial and smart staff also with good service.
Invest in your staff and get them trained well as I felt most of the staff is local and lack global exposure.

reviews.author: harin raval
reviews.title: Truly Great Himalayan Experience.
reviews.text: A great Resort nestled between snow clad Himalayas in one of the most amazing place on earth, Gulmarg. A world full of hospitality. Amazingly efficient staff whose aim is to provide the best of services be it in Restaurants or Room Service. I would suggest that they add a Bar and Hospitality desk which would take care of sight seeing tours and bookings for Gandolas and Helicopter Rides as well as Ski Instructors to facilitate tourists to have one window option to make most of their holidays. Their packed lunches or snacks are awesome. I would suggest booking of Himalayan view rooms which offer the most scenic and breath taking views of snow clad slopes and mountain peaks. The Hotel maintains the most efficient standards of house keeping cleanliness and responding to needs of guests. Their Loungue serves amazing Hookahs. Their Spa also offers amazing treatments by a wekk trained staff. A must visit Resort

reviews.author: drrganesh
reviews.title: Worth every rupee!
reviews.text:
Had heard a lot of good things about this property and so was on the bucket list for a family outing to Gulmarg.
About a 90 minute drive from Srinagar, its located within walking distance from the Gulmarg gondola , the main attraction of the place.
All rooms are well appointed with views either facing the golf course/meadow or the mountain ranges. Best option would be the ones with the balcony looking towards the mountains. 
Dining options within the property: Servings are on the smaller side. Rates  not so !!!
Breakfast options are excellent. 
Whats seals it for the property is the service- impeccable. Right from the front desk to the Ski room where all the jackets/ boots are store, everybody is out to please. 
Great option in Gulmarg especially during the "snow season " - Dec - March.

reviews.author: shristy t
reviews.title: Best property and excellent service
reviews.text: This is the excellent property in India and the way the staff treated is really very nice.... I really thank full to Ms Khalida and Mr Mohshin for their wonderful service.... everything was good in the hotel... location/food/spa/swimming pool everything... my wife and kids really enjoyed a lot .....

reviews.author: parul s
reviews.title: Super stay with stunning views of the pir Panjal
reviews.text: We just returned after a 3 nights stay at the Khyber , we had a fantastic stay which was smooth from the check in till the day we left . The food is great and there’s a huge variety of vegetarian food on the menu , the cottages are spic and spacious and they are much much better and bigger than what the website shows ( please take better pictures and repost )and the service is extremely prompt and the staff is very friendly and warm. The F&B manager Mukesh took great care of the food that was served to us and was always will to accommodate our demands . Asrar at the reception assured that we wasted no time checkin in.The staff is polite and always smiling and courteous... Enjoyed my stay to the fullest - definitely worth a trip .

reviews.author: MlAJAPAN
reviews.title: きれいですが。
reviews.text:
ホテルの雰囲気も良く、部屋やプールからの雪景色は最高の眺めです。スタッフの対応も良し！
また、ホテルにドクターが常駐しており、不調の折来ていただいたところ、とてもよく診ていただき助かりました。

難点をあげれば、連泊中のルームメイクはひどく、ベッドを整え、ゴミを捨てただけでした。アメニティの補充なし、床に落ちたクズはそのまま。
バスルームはシャワーにも問題あり。
辛かったのが、横の部屋のテレビの音が丸聞こえで眠れなかったことです。
これはボリュームの問題というよりも、壁の異常な薄さだと思いました。

いいホテルではあるのですが、宿泊料金に見合っていないようにも思いました。

reviews.author: Syed Zabi S
reviews.title: F and B department
reviews.text:
I  had been there in my vacation  with my family i really had grate  time and there service were damn good loved it special thanks for Mr:Ajaz,Mr:Bilal,Mr:Mukesh,Mr:junaid and Mr:ishfaq etc i would like to see you all soon.
Thank you

reviews.author: Alaina S
reviews.title: F and Bdepartment
reviews.text: The servic was good and we loved it staying  there and  f n b department  people like Mr.Ajaz,mr bilal,mr mukesh,mr junaid ,mr ishfaq and how can I forget manager as well. they helped us a lot in all aspects by serving us good food I would like to visit again and again to same hotel thank you so much

reviews.author: Radhika S
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with a lovely location. It feels you are at the end of the world and the view of the mountain ranges is the best in Gulmarg from here. Stayed in for two days with good service and nice food. Warm set of people at the hotel receive you with a very warm kahwa drink. They would like to pamper you in all possible ways and a must visit even in winters as snow and Sun play a lovely game which you can watch from the comfort of your room. Today early morning we enjoyed the snowfall from the terrace garden of the hotel. It's a safe heaven for travellers looking for peace and love. Be careful only with the guides outside the hotel. Worth visiting is the gondola and snow bike rides. If you love yourself do visit this lovely resort and get spoilt.

reviews.author: shoeman015
reviews.title: Could have been great
reviews.text: A  great building definitely the most luxurious in Gulmarg but it lacks any character. There always seemed to be lots of staff but when you wanted one they were nowhere to be seen. if you wanted something out of the ordinary like a booking for dinner in an alternative location the concierge refused to help. We had already paid for dinner but ate out 3 nights for a bit of a change. Breakfast was very good and the masala dhosa was the best i have had. The spa was good but the pool and steam room looked like they could do with a good clean. Gulmarg was great and the Khyber could have been.

reviews.author: Kaushik D
reviews.title: A huge property with zero hospitality!!
reviews.text:
We visit Gulmarg/Kashmir almost every year in different seasons. Wanted to try out Khyber after all the reviews. Overall, supremely disappointed!!!

Location : Thats an advantage, closest to the Gulmarg Gondola counter. Amazing views of the Aphrawat ranges, (only from high end rooms)

Ambience/Common Areas : It's a wonderful building. Well spread out property and well maintained.

Room : Moderately spacious. But the décor is pathetic. Neither traditional nor chic, just a hybrid, confused mess.

Food : Bad.!The breakfast assortment was sub optimal and didn't justify the "Luxury" tag. Variety was totally missing. Obscenely high priced for the taste and portion size. Hashbrowns and Croissants never tasted so dull and rubbery. The omelettes were good though!

Staff : That's the worst part of Khyber. They just don't care. Stayed for 3 nights and 4 days, there wasn't a single soul who reached out to check in if the stay was comfortable, no occasional "hellos". No greeting in the breakfast table. No hint of recognition as you pass by. As if you don't exist. Surprisingly it wasn't for all guests. Some groups did receive good dose of attention, so does it come with the room type. May be our experience would have been different if we stayed in the Presidential Suite ? How ridiculous!!

Being a Taj Inner Circle and La Cirque/Connoiseur Club member, and a Luxury Hotel expert, my understanding of a baseline expectation from a 5Star property is very realistic. Khyber, fails to meet that basic expectation - the warmth!!

Its not the property but the staff and their warmth who make those 5 Stars - anyone with a Taj experience would agree for sure. The staff in Khyber is as cold as the snow in the backdrop. Their cold and indifferent attitude stinks of arrogance at times.The supervisors exude that more than others. 
Check In experience was very messed up. The guy had no clue of the booking (made via Booking.Com) and made us wait for close to 2 hrs.

Best part - During check out, after 3N/4Ds, there was a customary question from the lady at the reception (Khaleda, if I recall correctly) - "How was the stay". I responded - "It was good, could have been lot lot better". That was the end of conversation, no further look/enquiry from the lady, no check in on what can be better, she just handed me the envelope with an arrogant indifference which screamed "Whatever..we don't care!!
And this was just one example.

The best and most warm acknowledgement we received was from the security at the gate - rest of the staff, and management should learn from him!!

One unsolicited advice to Khyber - You're in the hospitality business, its not your property but how you treat your guests will make them loyal and keep you in business. Don't take your guests for granted. 

Not recommended unless you have money to waste!

reviews.author: Bhavita C
reviews.title: Not worth of the money
reviews.text:
It is the best property in Gulmarg. But for the money it costs - one expects more. Below average service experience. 

Pros- The property itself is beautiful. Take the Himalayan facing rooms if u can. The swimming pool has awesome views n so does their coffee shop. Location is very close to the cable car starting point. Lots of place to play in the balconies if it snows. Our daughter was not well - they called a doctor promptly who even provided the medicine n we didn’t have to go hunting for it. Appreciate this a lot. 

Cons - Not worth the money if it doesn’t snow. Food is ok. Rooms r ok. Service is average bordering on below average. They didn’t even have snow shoes we could rent / buy to play in snow. When u pay this amount of money - you expect a wow factor in the service which was absent. They were clearly understaffed considering the crowd. 

There was only one staff member in the restaurant named Junaid who always had a smile on his face n would care of all my daughter’s demands. If he was not around - The rest of the staff was too busy to even care forget smile. 

Breakfast was included in our rate. Since we were checking out early we asked for two portions of bread n paratha to be parcelled. But they parcelled only one portion - for a total of 3 people! This when we have paid for a buffet breakfast! Unfortunately we came to know of the less portions only when we opened the packaging to have breakfast at the airport. 

We were staying here for our anniversary. My parents called to ask them to deliver a cake for us. The hotel had assured them they would. When we reached here we were asked when we wanted the cake. We told them. But the cake never came. Not a single person bothered to wish us. This when we told them we r staying for our anniversary and my parents had specially booked a cake. 

As I said if u pay a freaking 33k per night for a room - you expect more. This is not 5 star service experience. 

Overall not worth the money.

reviews.author: Amit Rajpal
reviews.title: Heaven on heart...incredible
reviews.text: Stayed there for 2 nights with my family (2 kids)......was an amazing experience....the staff was so courteous ,kind and prompt in their service...would especially like to mention about Mr. Manish executive chef.....met him in the restaurant and soon we were like good friends was really overwhelmed by his gesture to treat his guests......was given an upgrade and complementary meal during my stay....was like a once in a life time experience with such beautiful scenic views from every part of this resort......Thanks to all the staff .....khalida at front desk and Ofcoz Manish  for making my stay a wonderful and awesome one

reviews.author: sunitavinayak
reviews.title: Thanks to team khyber from Mr. Naresh kohli and Mr.Mukesh Vinayak
reviews.text: Our stay with khyber has been one of the best experience that we have had till date. Amazing property with an excellent hospitality from the hotel staff. Thanks to the hotel staff for giving us all the VIP treatment with so much love and ease. Special thanks to Mr. Manish Sharma and Vivek chhabra and also mr. Sanjeev gupta from the F.N.B dept for making our stay very memorable.

reviews.author: rounak t
reviews.title: Awesome and memorable stay at Khyber
reviews.text:
The entire Khyber  team were extremely kind, caring and very helpful. They did everything possible to give us a comfortable and a memorable stay at Gulmarg.
A special thanks to MR. Saqib and MR. Ishfaaq and the team at the coffee shop.  for the awesome hospitality they rendered to us. It was also amazing that one of the staff remembered that we had visited the Khyber 3 years ago for my aunts birthday. Its a highly recommended property to stay.

reviews.author: roopali agrawal
reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text:
Hi, 

We had a stay at the hotel from 28Jan to 30 Jan. The hotel has all the amenities like a good well maintained Gym, a heated swimming pool, steam , sauna and jacuzzi.My 4 yrs old son enjoyed the heated pool. The view from our room was beautiful, as it was snowing both the days.
The food and the hospitality is good.

reviews.author: T S
reviews.title: Just absolute Paradise!
reviews.text:
It was our first time to the Gulmarg and chose The Khyber Himalayan Resor after researching on TripAdvisor first. It totally surpassed all my expectations.Perfect to go in the month of January

We stayed on a 2 Luxury room balcony with Himalayan view of the Green Trees and the Mighty Himalayas was breathtaking. We had the Balconies to each of the Rooms, well heated inside, and with everything we would have wanted. Our Stay was for only 2 Nights!,Overall, It was so beautiful to see snowfall and after staying in this hotel makes our trip much more pleasant and amazing.

The location is amidst snow-covered mountains and pine trees, beautiful views all around, one couldn't do better with the location. The gondola/cable car ride is a 5 minute walk down the road,, but if you are older or not used to walking in the snow, then get a ride. The restaurant offers excellent food choices, although a bit expensive. 

Just loved every single minute on this beautiful Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Swaransehgal
reviews.title: Annual Ski holiday
reviews.text: We come to Gulmarg every year and been staying in khyber for last 3 years. This was our 4th stay in Khyber. As always the staff is very warm and attentive. Particularly Shauqat in restaurant and housekeeping staff was excellent. The vibe in the hotel is very friendly and hospitable. We will always stay here. The indoor heated pool and jacuzzi is a sure plus and Kashmiri food is superb. Tip- carry your own booze they do not have a bar.

reviews.author: mansi j
reviews.title: Heaven 😍😍
reviews.text:
Witnessed snowfall for the first time here..
Heated swimming with an awesome view of snow ❄️, tress and mountain ⛰ 
Super friendly staff
Perfect to go in the month of January.
Bonfire in snow with extreme warm snacks served with amazing songs is just the perfect combination anyone could wish for!!!
Would suggest a must visit.
It is truly heaven on earth
One of the best trips I have ever had !!

reviews.author: JASJIT S
reviews.title: Truly a lap of luxury
reviews.text:
The Khyber stands out and stands tall in Gulmarg. From the time you step out of the car and into the lobby, the warm hospitality of the staff hits you. 
Great rooms all with superb view in each one of them. Excellent heating. Great facilities.
It’s an experience worth having if you can fit it into your budget. 
Some minor negatives that can be and should be recitified. It’s difficult to walk up to the property. I feel the hotel should provide a free service to their clients. 
The evening room service is not so good. Replenishment of tea, water, turning of sheets is non-existent. However, I have to say, once you ask for this, it comes in no time at all. 
Secondly, I think the food leaves a lot to be desired. It is not really fine dining, but it’s definitely not value for money. For dinner you have virtually no choices and the buffet is too highly priced. The management seriously needs to look into this. This is a common complaint that I overheard from friends traveling with me and others who have been here before.
Now for the team. Pakeezah is a wonderful hostess. Bubbly, lively and makes you feel welcome from the word go. Sameer at the Sheesha Lounge was warmth and excellence personified. Khyber has a fine team and it should be proud of the same.

reviews.author: tanvi_jain14
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text:
Witnessing Snow fall!!! What else do you want in your life.
Beautiful view, rooms, food service
Bonfire in snow is a thing to do.
Heated pool with a snow covered trees and mountains view couldn’t be better!

reviews.author: Numan
reviews.title: Sharing experience
reviews.text: Let me first tell u .i have visited all other best hotels in gulmarg like vintage, highland park etc but the kind of food and the location of this hotel is exceptional..good management ,nice service and other amenities... awesome gym n facilities.... overall very good hotel

reviews.author: Aditi1613
reviews.title: Beautiful Property but poor hospitality
reviews.text:
Pros: 
Extremely Beautiful property
Great View
Covered with Snow in winters
Warm water pool with great view  (it is maintained at 28-10 degree Temp)
Food is ok
They even gave 1 room for early checkin (we booked 2 rooms)

Cons:
Poor in terms of hospitability

They charged us for a mini bar item that we did not use, it was barely priced at 60 Rs, we told them that we did not eat it, so they kept enquiring about it like CID for a 60 Rupee item, nevertheless we asked them to keep the change, this reflected bad hospitality 

Our driver got stuck 3 km from the resort, we asked them to provide cab to that point to which they refused stating various reasons, like unavailability of cabs (how is that even possible) etc etc we got really worried coz we had a flight to catch

this left bad taste while leaving the property

reviews.author: VivekSangita
reviews.title: Castle in fairy land
reviews.text: Its a lifetime experience. The property is a piece of art and marvel. But its the great hospitality which pumps life into it. Staff is extremely cordial. Menu is lavish. Rooms are large very well equipped with best of modern amenities. View from the rooms and also from the balcony is breath taking. Hotel has taken care of even smallest need of its guests like a room to store boots and over coats which are stored and returned with immense care.

reviews.author: Kalilur R
reviews.title: Excellent property at excellent location.
reviews.text: An exceptional hotel I have stayed in recent times. The location and ambience is great.Even in  the chill whether of December the whole hotel was maintained in warmth.Start from the reception to every place the staffs are cordial and very helpful. The  rooms are spacious and comfortable. The breakfast had good spread of variety foods .We have enjoyed a very delicious south indian food.I have not seen such a scenic resort even in Swiss.In all aspects it is a great hotel.

reviews.author: Sachin G
reviews.title: Food not good
reviews.text: Very nice resort &rooms but food quality is very poor   doesn't have taste in any of it's dishes ....tried North Indian food which was absolutely tasteless ...even the breads were not freshly served...stayed for 3days from 4th Jan 2018 to 7th Jan 2018 ...didn't find the perfect taste in d food in all the 3days ...our 3 days stay made me realize that the restaurant is comparatively smaller keeping in mind the resort ..we tried dal makhni, Yellow dal, Hari mirch paneer, kashmiri dum aloo , methi paneer makhni , & kashmiri lotus stem ...all below average ..also the breakfast buffet was pathetic .

reviews.author: Dwarak N
reviews.title: Amazing Service
reviews.text:
Beautiful Property right in Gulmarg amidst the Glaciers!
Fabulous service from the staff who work 24*7 to keep their guests happy.From their air side support staff to the folks at the spa,simply amazing service levels!
Special mention to GH.Qadir in the all day dining restaurant for his exemplary service and a never say die attitude to make the best version of the food available on our tables!kudos to him and the other F&B staffer the restaurant.
Overall a highly recommended property for a luxury holiday in Kashmir!

reviews.author: FinaIshak
reviews.title: Excellent Stay and Service
reviews.text:
We had the luxury suite and from the first day we have had the best service from the staff. One particular staff by the name of Burhan was very accommodating and he made sure that our stay was as comfortable as ever. We stayed there for 6 nights and had enough time to use the facilities such as the indoor pool and the jacuzzi, which were very welcoming after a hard day's work at the skiing slope. 

The location itself was amazing as we were surrounded by the mountains and the snow during winter, something that you look forward to everytime you wake up in the morning. Would highly recommend this hotel, and would definitely come again insya Allah.

reviews.author: Kunal S
reviews.title: Luxury property with a fantastic location
reviews.text: Luxurious property with great rooms. Since we travelled in the last week of December the heating was extremely good all over the property. We even used the heated pool, its perfect since the water is lukewarm. The only disappointment was the food from the buffet which was ok but this was more than made up by the excellent service of Mr Tawheed and team who made some fresh food as per our requests. Overall the best property in Gulmarg by far.

reviews.author: VidyuthBhandary
reviews.title: Heaven is a place on earth !!!
reviews.text: To best describe the experience at The Kyber would be in one word - "JANNAT". By describing the stay as magical would still be incomplete. The view from the room is STUNNING. Beats even Switzerland. And thanks Afwaq Ahmed for all the courtesy extended to us. Lastly, like i experienced, the spirit of the local people is the reason why Kashmir is still alive / exists !!!

reviews.author: rajivpmehta
reviews.title: Winter wonderland
reviews.text: The Khyber is well situated within Gulmarg and is staffed with the warmest people I have experienced at a hotel. The comfort of their guests is of paramount importance and they deliver with full marks. There is only 1 Multi cuisine restaurant but the food is very very well prepared with wide ranging options. Definitely a big recommend!!

reviews.author: RaviArora
reviews.title: A Vacation Unmatched!
reviews.text:
Traveled with my family, wife and 2 grown up kids. Was difficult to convince them to travel to Gulmarg during the winters, especially when you know it is freezing cold, with temperature going upto -14 degrees!

But once the uphill climb started from Tangmarg, the excitement made everyone forget about the temperature.

The Hotel - Khyber was located, amongst the Pine and Deodhar Trees, away from the place where quite a few Hotels are located, yet very close to the Gondola (Cable Car)

We upgraded to the Himalayan View Rooms as the vast view of the Green Trees and the Mighty Himalayas was breathtaking. We had the Balconies to each of the Rooms, well heated inside, and with everything we would have wanted.

So much so, that you would not miss the view even while in the Bathroom, as the Bathrooms had huge windows, allowing the same view as that from the Balcony! The Shower was fantastic, wonderfully hot and fantastic force, unlike the ones where you need to bucket up because of poor pressure!

The property is very well maintained and the staff is very courteous, polite and greeting you every time you come across them!

The Steam, Sauna and the Jacuzzi was excellent, and we could not help but using them repeatedly. And then the Heated Swimming Pool! Initially, we were a little worried about the temperature but then once we dived in, we did not want to be out! 

Swimming in water temperature at 30 degrees with Minus 12 outside! Snow covered Himalayas with the Green trees now turned White - result of the continuous snowfall!

The Food was equally good and with a nice spread! Though quite expensive, but then they do have a reason charging you for such fine dining at that heavenly location!

Would surely like to visit again, and would look forward to the Management offering us with Loyalty Upgrades and Benefits! :D

Ms Khalida at the Reception during the Check-out was concerned to know about our stay, and had that confident look, knowing that the feedback shall be worthwhile! 

The only minus point was  - Our Stay was for only 2 Nights! You need at-least 4 or 5 Nights, to enjoy this beautiful place and the Hotel! The view changes every hour and is worth every penny spent!

reviews.author: RanjeetNabha
reviews.title: An amazing time!
reviews.text: My daughter and I stayed at the Khyber this December.  It was snowing and my daughter got to play in the snow and build a snow man on the Khyber lawns.  This hotel is top notch in all areas - location (overlooking Himalayas), room (super comfortable and warm), food (wide variety and delicious) and service (amazing staff that take a genuine interest in your well being). We are already making plans to return next year!

reviews.author: Abhay Goel
reviews.title: Simply the best in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
I'm writing this review from the hotel room. Experience starts as soon as you enter the property. Lobby has typical Kashmiri seating areas which add to the beautiful ambience of the hotel. Rooms are spacious and tastefully done. Room had a big balcony with seating and beautiful view of the mountains. Rooms have automatic temperature control and maintain a comfortable warmth even when the outside temperature is 10 below freezing. 
Bathroom is big with a recessed bathtub and a separate bathing area.
There's lot of space outside the building for kids to play in the snow. My six year old kept herself busy making a snowman. The property has one of the best spas and an indoor heated pool.
Staff is very  friendly and courteous.

reviews.author: Rakshita S
reviews.title: An absolutely Spectacular Property !
reviews.text:
A beautiful property with breathtaking view!

We had the Himalayan view room with mesmerising view of the mountain. The property is very well maintained. The room was beautifully done up. It was a pleasure to sit in the balcony and enjoy the view sipping hot coffee :) The indoor pool was beautiful with awesome view !

The staff was cooperative, professional and well mannered. Special mention of Mr Showkat Wani who attended to us for our meals. He made sure we were comfortable and well looked after. We would surely love to visit the property once again and have been recommending the property to family and friends!

Thank you!

reviews.author: Aarthi I
reviews.title: Must Must stay for a day atleast...
reviews.text:
The Khyber was what made our stay at Gulmarg breathtaking and beautiful. Unfortunately, there was an accident at Gondola while we were there and fortunately we werent on the Gondola that day. Even though we couldn't take the Gondola ride, which was the main attraction, our stay at Gulmarg was one of the most memorable ones... 

Starting with the location, its one of the most beautifully placed, to give the guests the breathtaking views of the pine trees. The resort itself is about 4 years old only, so the property looks beautiful with the wood exteriors perched on the mountain. 

The food was good, I would suggest to take a package which includes the meals as they have a good chef and clean meals. 

The service is great, people are very hospitable and kind. 

The only downside is the walk out of the property, which is quite a steep one up and down. There isnt much that you can do around gulmarg without either a vehicle or a pony. Even a meal at a local restaurant comes out to be very expensive and you need to haggle your way through with the vehicles and pony guys. Your own cars too arent of much use there, as you have to end up using the local guys only. The hotel guys also cant help much int his regard as they are all unionized. 

A definite must try at the hotel are 
1- Swimming Pool - available free of cost for the guests, and is temperature controlled. A sure shot place for the family to enjoy even if its cold outside. You get swimming costumes to buy as well, in case you forget to carry. 
2- Sauna/ Steam/ Jacuzzi - all available for the guests free of cost. Except the jacuzzi needs repair and replacement, atleast the one for the women. 
3- Spa - Amazing specialists for spa massages, must must do when you are here. 

Lots of green area for the kids to run around and enjoy. I would definitely want to come back when it snows here...

reviews.author: hemantmehta79
reviews.title: Majestic resort with top of line services
reviews.text:
We stayed at Khyber in the first week of April for 3 days. One word that describes this place " Magnificient". I am sure one would think, how did they build a resort with this level of grandeur at 10000 feet above the ground ! We stayed at a time when there was unexpected snowfall in Srinagar and there was a complete cutoff of internet, TV and road networks for a brief period. The hotel staff was amazingly courteous in catering to various guest requests at this time. The rooms were spic an span and property top class. There would be only a few suggestions that could further enhance the experience of people traveling from o/s India:

1) Foreign Exchange-Hotel only changes US dollar. For other currencies, one needs to go down in the market to get money changed in the bank. Unfortunately, for us when it was snowing all the banks were completely closed and we had tough time to get currency changed.However, the staff was very helpful and provided us with a cash advance to meet local expense. ideally, we should have carried more INR but did not anticipate Hotel may not be able to change other major currencies. A new learning as Taj at Sri Nagar and Pine N Peak at Pahalgam were easily able to change other currencies ( We were carrying Singapore Dollar) . 

2) Alacarte menu was excellent. However, the buffet tends to be slightly repetitive if one is staying for a period of 2 or 3 days. food quality again was excellent in the buffet. My son still tells me to go back to Kashmir to eat dosa at Khyber :)

3) Bar facilities- Guess, this may have to do with Government permissions, but was surprised that the property does not serve alcohol.

All in all, this resort is in the ranks of Ritz, Four Seasons, Taj, Oberoi and other high end Hotels.I would definitely comeback to Gulmarg and stay again at Khyber. The staff is great and really takes good care of you. Take the Himalayan view room, if you can as it has direct view of the valley.Serene and beautiful.

reviews.author: Raj
reviews.title: Out of the world! A Must-Visit Resort
reviews.text:
What can I write to describe such a beautiful resort when we found it as tucked  in the midst of a thick conifer forest, covered in snow blanket on a sunny afternoon of March. If I were to judge the best hotel in India, I would rate this hotel resort as the best. I even dare to say that in winter, this would compete even with the luxury resorts at Gstad/St Moritz of Europe.

The architecture is stunning and augmented by high-end finishes to provide a unique luxury experience for the guests. We enjoyed the warmth of the room while braving the continuous snow fall and a -10C temperature outside. Kahwa provided at the lobby was the right potion we required after a long day in the snow. 

I found the quality of the food to be little off the mark. The dinner buffet was elaborate but some of the dishes were very average - lack of Kashmiri flavours and touch. However, the ala carte dishes were better in comparison. I must say this can be easily overlooked considering the location, weather conditions and continuous efforts by the staff to take care of the guests.

Recommend this strongly to include in one's bucket list and one has to come in winters to enjoy the unique weather conditions and a white landscape to take up skiing

reviews.title: Khyber Review
reviews.text:

The location is very close to Gondola but do not expect any kind of service or assistance from the hotel for the Gondola ride. Food is very average! Special Jain request was intimated to the hotel well in advance but no arrangements were made for the same on both the days of my stay. It is time these hotels start realising the fact that we pay the same tariff what others are paying and still they do not take any care of us. reviews.text:
I was with my family and friends with small kids when i visited Khyber in April 2017. At the very outset, they gave us rooms which were far off the reception and dining area. We had to use elevators twice and we (especially our kids) had a hard time to go to room and come to dining area at regular frequency. Swimming pool was even far and it took ages to reach there. When requested, they informed us that all the rooms are booked which was not the case.

On the next day, room was not cleaned properly at all. 
(1) Towels were lying on the chair.
(2) Dust bin was not emptied.
(3) Drinking water was not kept.
(4) Glasses and spoons were not washed.
(5) Soap, shampoo conditioner were not replaced.

On issuing a feedback form, they informed us that it will not happen the next time when we come. As if, we will travel again, the next time.

reviews.title: PICTURE PERFECT
reviews.text: Visited Khyber along with my husband, kids and grand children, hotel's location offers some of the best views of Gulmarg. The ambience of the hotel transports you to an era bygone. On arriving to the hotel front desk staff (Asrar) smoothed our check in process, on his advice we up graded the rooms which offered us excellent view from balcony. .....Over all it was a memorable experience.

reviews.author: priya a
reviews.title: Picture Perfect View
reviews.text: We loved this place for its view, location and food. But above all, the friendly staff. If you are visiting Gulmarg, don't even think of exploring any other property. Khyber is the best option available!!

reviews.author: Sunehra K
reviews.title: Stunning Views and Lovely Staff!
reviews.text:
We arrived at Khyber late in the evening dog tired after a long day of traveling from Bangalore. Check in was very quick and in no time I was asleep in my super soft and comfortable bed. The next morning I woke up early and opened the curtains.... my jaw just DROPPED! What a view!!! The Himalayas!!! The Himalayaaaaahhhs!!! Never have I been so mesmerised by such a view. 
Apart from that, what a wonderful stay!! Kind and friendly staff members always giving us a happy greeting and helping with whatever we needed. Fabulous food!! Oh my god that Khyber Tarami, I'm still dreaming about it! And that pool... so warm and welcoming after such a cold day outside!!! It was just SUPERB!
Love the little things they did to go the extra mile. The Buffet Breakfast starts at 8, we were leaving at 7:30am so they quickly rustled something up for us. Ready advice on the activities in Gulmarg which by the way are just amazing!! Phase 1 was just AWESOME!!! 
And the driver (Arshad) who took us to the airport - what a ROCKSTAR! We are Indians and we know the Indian style of driving but Arshad's moves were pure innovation!!! Asif at the airport was also so helpful and took care of us till we went through security. No words!
Thank you to all the Khyber staff for looking after us so well.. I will be back, hopefully in February 2018 and will only be staying at The Khyber!

reviews.author: Jayashri K
reviews.title: Great location and service
reviews.text:
We stayed at this wonderful place for 3 nights last week and had a memorable break. 
Reservations - process was relatively smooth and special thanks to Irshad for providing us with a good package
Airport transportation - convenient, and efficient given the additional security at Srinagar airport. Allows for quick halts on the way to enjoy the vast coniferous forest, and pretty flower decked forest floor!! Thanks to Shahnawaz for making the trip to and from airport amazing!!
Rooms - Balcony rooms with Himalayan view are a great choice if you wish to enjoy a cuppa in company of snow clad mountains and coniferous vegetation, a sight not worth missing. Rooms are spacious, with enough room for an extra bed if required. Although constant reminder to housekeeping on the replenishment of utilities such as water and tea/coffee/creamer was a bit of a nuisance 
Food - good choice in the buffet especially if you are ok with select dishes and prefer Indian cuisine, the team takes care to call out on special requests is any. Kids especially loved pasta and lasagna made to order for them. Special thanks to Aijaz who took good care of us !!

reviews.author: sameer
reviews.title: Heaven on earth
reviews.text:
I was there with my wife and son.  My kid is 19 months now. So I plan properties based on 5 star luxury cause my son needs it :) .
This resort is truly a five star 

Service =  This is very remote location about 90 mins from airport.  Sabzar picked us precisely at the time.  The surprising part is everyone is allowed at the baggage counter hence I found every all taxi driver looking for bags..  Reminded me of the Railway Station.  

The welcome was very good I did t bother doing anything..  Just gave I'd s and went to sleep (was exhausted after long flight)

Love the people at front desk and staff always having a smile. 

food is good.  But the spread matches of a two star.  
It was big turn off considering we a purely non veg.  They just have 3 non veg dished prepared every night and the fish was a repetitive in my last night.  
Only one kind of rice...  No Briyani no kebabs nothing.  
But  hats of to the Restuarant manager Abid he made sure at least my son got vvip treatment. Abid is best hospitality person I've met . He made sure we were very comfortable in terms of food.  
But again the spread was pathetic. 

location : they charge about 30k for a night in the room we stayed because the Himalayas is what u Pay for In a remote location. 
The property is truly 5 star. 

There is nothing to do here except going to the top of mountain and doing the activities like ski and atv.(Gondola)

That's just a day activity 

Considering the cost  I think two nights stay is perfect. 

Rooms are the best cause your likely to spend more time here staring at the snow capped mountains. 
We chose this may because it's not extremely cold cause we are travelling with toddler. But it's around 3 degree  that's very cold considering summer in India. during the day it warms up and feels good. 

But I dare young couples to go here during winter :) 
True honeymoon  destination. 

Spa was really world class and out of the world 

The swimming pool is temperature controlled  and excellent maintained.
Any thing warm is good thing . Additionally they have Jacuzzi,  steam and sauna felt really good 

They offer breakfast and dinner in package 
But for lunch and evening snacks this place is very expensive considering  tea 250 rupees and Briyani 1000 rupees which serves one person.  But the taste is good. 

People who drink prepare to get alcohol from outside when u land itself :)

Overall. 

Very good experience 
Will remember this for  years to come. 
Will want to come back if they give a good offer on rooms :) 

Thanks to Abid and support staff Iqbal

(who has best smile in the world and enjoy his work) 

And Wahid for arranging my Transport 

 Finally thanks to all the wonderful staff to make this happen. 

Hope to be back soon!

Thanks 
 Shahbaz

reviews.author: praveents
reviews.title: Luxury Resort with Stunning View
reviews.text: Our Stay at Khyber was perfect with unforgettable memories. The room is spacious with stunning view of snow clad mountains. Checkin was smooth thanks to Mr. Parvez who warmly welcomed us and offered hot kahwa.  The resort has heated indoor pool with nice view of the valley. The food was good but tad expensive, overall our stay was nice.

reviews.author: Parimal
reviews.title: It was an experience beyond words !! Superb location , kind hospitality and the ever smiling kashmiri people.
reviews.text: The hotel is just amazing with its views and hospitality. Great food and its proximity to the gondola rides made our trip a truly memorable one! The staff is very polite and always ready to help which is a true reflection of the kashmiri people. Would like to visit again and again 😊

reviews.author: Emma and JC L
reviews.title: Wonderful location for a relaxed and tasteful holiday!
reviews.text:
The Khyber is wonderfully located at the foot of the mountains, with lovely views and a tasteful mountain lodge design. The gondola is 200 m away and can take you up to 4000m above the clouds for an amazing view of the Affarwat peaks. 
The Restaurant offers a lot of options, veg and non veg, Both Indian and Western and the food is really good.
The rooms are large yet cosy, wonderful indoor swimming pool with a lovely view of the forest and the mountains. Amazing treatments available at the L'Occitane spa.
But above all, what makes the Khyber a place you'll want to visit again is the staff. All of them are really polite, helpful, smiling and make you feel like a VIP. Big big applause to all of them, they really are outstanding and the service is up to level with the likes of the Oberoi and Taj hotels.

reviews.author: Birendra1
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text:
The staff is courteous and polite, the report is beautiful and very peaceful excellent hotel and service, very clean and beautiful room, delicious food, in other words amazing Hotel, special thanks to housekeeping team who made my  birthday special. 
Highly recommended!!

reviews.author: Lal Bahadur Sin... S
reviews.title: Khyber resort the best
reviews.text: Excellent trip house keeping and management were fabulous. It was great  visiting  snow covered  mountains  all over. House keeping  services  were very prompt which made the stay very pleasant and comfortable.

reviews.author: Alaina S
reviews.title: Enjoyed a lot, great place
reviews.text: Awesome hotel with excellent facilties and varieties of food, great infrastructure with the swimming pool and spa. Visited with family and had a great time enjoying the natural view,keep up the good work...

reviews.author: Shaenaaz B
reviews.title: Loved the stay, worth it!
reviews.text:
Beautiful location, delicious food, especially breakfast and services were great, My family loved the overall leisure stay as well as the pleasant climate and cordial staff with smiling faces :) 
Looking forward to visiting Gulmarg and stay in Khyber again..

reviews.author: Shalini S
reviews.title: Awesome view
reviews.text:
