Located on top of a hill, the hotel commands an awesome view of snow clad mountains and vast valley. As we visited in April, the valley was covered in snow....One can sit on the terrace and feel peace descend on you.
The Hotel is luxurious with an old world charm. It's popularity makes it difficult to get a booking. However it's remote location makes it cumbersome to go back and forth...One has to arrange transport to nip into the town. Consequently, it gets crowded in the evenings as all the guests return from their excursions and are reluctant to go out again.
It's coffee shop has an excellent view of the mountains but it's menu leaves much to be desired. There could be more variety....
Their spa is just awesome...

reviews.author: Prisha C
reviews.title: Very Impressive
reviews.text: Gorgeous infrastructure with excellent ambience. Staff hospitality at its finest and very much welcoming. Amazing Experience! Recommended to all my friends and family. Scenic beauty of nature added more to the spectacular atmosphere created by the Staff. Perfect for anyone who feels the desire to be in Nature's lap yet in their own comfort. Perfect!

reviews.author: Dr Vinay K
reviews.title: Awesome Kashmir
reviews.text: Visited this beautiful property with family for new year celebrations.The staff was very courteous. The breakfast buffet was awesome .The children loved their indoor pool.Their drivers are very good and experienced as driving in snow is not easy.Over all  an great experience of this beautiful property,

reviews.author: Nisha K
reviews.title: New year retreat 2017
reviews.text:
Visited Khyber Himalayan resorts n spa with family in January 2017. Spent very good tym there. Stayed in 2001, luxury balcony room with amazing views of Himalayan range . Enjoyed snowfall along with mouth watering food and lavish buffet. Bilal , Shaukat, Saila were warm, courteous, helpful . Helped us to understand Kashmiri couisine and culture. 

Nisha

reviews.author: arenski
reviews.title: A mixed feeling - AGAIN
reviews.text:
Stayed with family during the week of Holi for 5 nights for a ski holiday.
Visited last year during the same time as well.
Nothing has changed from our last visit.
Getting to and fro to the hotel is a nightmare! After a long day of skiing this is extremely stressful.
The ski storage room has been made much smaller than the previous year.
Service still seems to be very hit and miss.
i doubt if the food served at the buffet is freshly made. the fruits on display at the buffet looks very good but one bite and you know its just frozen fruit which is being served again. Similarly, most of the food just didnt taste right. Maybe it must have been frozen and de-frozen on a number of occasions. Our two kids and myself threw up one evening on the dinner table. 3 days after eating the buffet we decided to order from the menu and paid the high rates. we requested them to prepare the meals fresh and finally we got something decent to eat.
The reason for our repeat visit is that there is no other hotel in Gulmarg with so much space. it is a beautiful set-up.
Unless the oberoi comes up soon.. we have no option but to visit this place for our annual ski trip. the owners are aware of this.
The normal routine revert will be given by the manager once this is posted asking me why i did not bring up these topics during my stay.
Sir, getting to and fro to the hotel - spoke to so many people about this. Front Desk, lobby manager and also to the people who wear long black coats and suited and are always hanging around near the reception area. None of them could give any answer.
With regards to the food - Time and again spoke to the person who manages the buffet.. The only response we got was that the food is freshly prepared and that they are sorry that we did not like the buffet spread or it was not upto our expectations. Finally, we ordered a-la carte and pai for the meals.
We also brought up the topic of hearing of TV from the next room. This happened last year and this year as well. We were politely told that they cannot change the structure of the rooms.
The hotel was at 35% occupancy utmost, but they kept mentioning that they are sold out whenever we requested for a change of rooms.
Owners, please improve your service before its too late. i hear the Oberoi will be functional in a years time!

reviews.author: ajay k
reviews.title: Awesome Gulmarg
reviews.text: It's a Awesome hotel located 100 meters away from gondola Station, Best place to stay serene views are awesome from the Room overlooking Apharwat peak Snow capped mountains and pine trees covered with snow from your balcony gives real happiness to sit & watch its like you want time to standstill. Execellent staff and yummy food, But food is costly. Mr Saqib was gr8 host he does everything needed to make our stay comfortable. Also after 6 pm due to heavy cold weather you don't have much to do in gulmarg hotel has temperature control pool, Jacuzzi, steam, sauna to keep you occupied, pool has amazing views, they also have best spa in kashmir world renowned spa by L'Occitane. For kids they have ice hokey, carrom, games to keep them busy. Please take rooms with balcony gulmarg view which are 25-30 % expensive but are totally worth it, taking premier room is like wasting your money.

reviews.author: Razoski
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel Ruined by Bad Service
reviews.text: The hotel is outstanding, with great facilities and an incomparable view of the mountains. The decor is tastefully done up. The big let down is the service. From room service to the cafeteria to the kids room, everything requires multiple reminders and follow-ups from guests. Else the staff just doesn't seem bothered. This is in stark contrast to the warm service you would receive from almost ANY other hotel in Gulmarg. A big tragedy - so much potential ruined by apathetic staff. I  did fill up a feedback form, but am almost sure it would never reach the proper people.

reviews.author: dyumna
reviews.title: Stay in Paradise!
reviews.text: The 10 Day trip to Gulmarg, Kashmir was rose to much better experiences by Khyber Himalayan Resorts and Spa. Every facility and provision was well managed and the staff was extremely helpful. Visiting this place in ski season was the best part! And the memories taken back will be forever

reviews.author: pallabeem
reviews.title: Not worth the value
reviews.text:
If it's only the view you are looking for then go for it , you could also request a tour of the hotel - that is wonderful and very beautiful right from the entrance to pool and the deck view of mountain.

But their service is terrible. 

I stayed in classic room and it's beds were so hard and the room partitions is nil, you can here even the whispers from the other room so imagine what must have been our condition when someone is watching tv and the people walking about in the corridors late at night. You can hear it all, no sleep and stiff back in the morning.

And the restaurant is below average, i ordered special Kashmiri dish tabak maaj, it was so very deep fried one cannot even take a bite. And in dinner I started with creamy mushrooms soup which I felt it tasted like lumpy knorr soup , no cream whatsoever.

By the price rate it goes , it's extremely over rated.

reviews.author: Tara M
reviews.title: Decent stay for a luxury hotel
reviews.text: Best part of the hotel - the heated pool and spa. The breakfast was average, the a la Carter menu was good only if you orders the Indian food. Stay away from the pizzas. The rooms are centrally heated so at times it would get really hot and stuffy. The room service menu was highly overpriced hence I suggest you eat in the restaurant. The staff and service was below average. If it wasn't for the spa and pool the rating would have been far lower.

reviews.author: Iqbalshk
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth
reviews.text: Best place to stay Views are awesome from the Room the Snow capped mountains and pine trees covered with snow gives real happiness to sit and watch. Best Destination for Snow lovers. Cable car ride was too good to experience and snow boarding.

reviews.author: Santosh Reddy
reviews.title: Surely will visit again
reviews.text:
The best resort by far in Kashmir. 
- Heated pool with a stunning view of the snow caps.
- View from the room is just awesome and you just can walk out to the snow.
- Children play area is not just huge but also the best equipped one I have ever seen. Kids will surely enjoy.
- Food , hospitality n service all top class.

As I have said ......... on one will visit this place just once.

reviews.author: Anshul Kumar
reviews.title: Good property
reviews.text:
Stayed there for 2 nights...the hotel ambience and rooms are very good. Location is great - overlooking the mountains and very close to the gondola.

Staff was very courteous and helpful

Food is average...limited options for breakfast...Kashmiri cuisine is definitely below par

Wifi reception in the room was a problem

reviews.author: baaggu
reviews.title: beauty.
reviews.text:
gulmargh is an absolute delight in the winters.
khyber resorts adds on to the beauty.

right from the hotel, staff, service, ambiance, views .. everything was superb.

Mr. Asrar did things out of his way to make our stay comfortable and was very helpful and courteous.

here was a doctor on call Dr. Tahir who was very co-operative and fantastic and had come to see my daughter who was not too well. 
Overall a must stay place while in Gulmargh.

reviews.author: Deepika1973
reviews.title: Disgusting
reviews.text: Since we had good experience at Khyber,,we decided to go there again but we came back deciding,,never again to khyber after such a bitter experience,, the most disgusting policy of not dropping back their customers to gulmarg city since they are located on a height,,we came down carrying our suitcases after a heavy snowfall with our daughter also bearing the grunt..most discourteous and horrible experience ever.. Friends go there only if you are ready to carry your own baggages in a property like KHYBER..

reviews.author: saddy1956
reviews.title: Great property
reviews.text:
What a wonderful hotel, everything abt this place is exquisite. The front reception, the staff, the decor all of the best kind.
Want to specially appreciate the f&b staff who allowed me to eat my own khaana in the restaurant since i was fasting. Guys the very first day you folks won me over
The property is breathtakingly beautiful, the ambience and hospitality spot on.
But, yes there is a but, the extra bed that they gave us as we were three sisters on triple share was the most uncomfortable bed one can sleep in. Pl do something about it. Its a sofa cum bed with 3 levels. How can one sleep straight on it is something we could not fathom.
So if my fellow avid travellers want to enjoy the best in gulmarg , go for this place. Its paradise

reviews.author: amirgazyani
reviews.title: Full value
reviews.text: If in Gulmarg it has to be Khyber hotel no second thought. Best property with best in class servic . Room are outstanding , food is good & the staff are helpful. The hotel location is also very good .

reviews.author: Abhishek S
reviews.title: "OLD WORLD CHARM"
reviews.text:
Had an amazing experience during my stay, beautiful architecture serene ambience and out of the world views from the room/ balcony.
Initially had a little difficulty during the check-in process but one of the staff, ASRAR took the initiative and smoothened the process, not only was he helpful during the check-in process but also enquired regularly about our needs and always tried his best to help us. My sincere thanks to him.

reviews.author: N K
reviews.title: Extraordinarily amazing
reviews.text: This hotel is the most amazing hotel in Gulmarg.  The views from the room are amazing. I definitely recommend this hotel to everyone. The food is wow. They serve sheesha for those interested.  The staff is polite and warm.  Kashmir is heaven on earth and staying this at Khyber gives us a view of this heaven every minute.  A must must must visit

reviews.author: oskyoscar
reviews.title: swiss experience in India
reviews.text: The Khyber is truly one of the most amazing properties, had a luxury room with the himalayan view. Loads of snow all around and the Hotel is walking distance to the Gondola rides. The heated swimming pool has a super view and the Spa is one of the best in India. The Khyber does lack a choice of restaurants and has one single restaurant that serves all three meals. The Khyber has no comparison in Gulmarg and is simply the most premium property in Gulmarg.  The rooms are not soundproof though and noisy neighbours could be annoying.

reviews.author: Gangadhar P
reviews.title: Luxury at a premium
reviews.text:
The hotel is top of the line.Jacuzzi here has seating which looked terrible arrangement.
Steam facility is very good and so is the heated pool.
The library could do with daily newspapers.
Food....spectacular,tasty and out of the world.Views are post card worthy.
I wish the Hotel arranges the guides to make the guests less prone to local exploitation.
enjoyed the visit and the stay.

reviews.author: Ranadhir74
reviews.title: Simply spectacular
reviews.text: This resort would make your trip to heavenly Gulmarg complete.An unparalleled location,extremely friendly staff,extremely comfortable rooms and astounding views make this one of the outstanding hotels of this country.A must-visit place and a must-visit hotel.

reviews.author: shruti s
reviews.title: assum trip till now my husband gave me
reviews.text: i had my 2nd marriage anniversary ,,and my husband took me to gulmarg as i wanted to be in snow and wanted to be in india ... as i landed in khyber it was next to heaven ... stafff superb , hospitality superb i havent seen such good 5 star resort in my life in india ...Saaquib from front office helped us a lot in all minute details even for things outside the resort ... khyber is a beautiful resort in itself .. i stayed there for 3 nights ... it was a wonderful experience Zzz food was very goood superb taste ... must visit in lifetime ... and for me again and again

reviews.author: Mehul D
reviews.title: Beyond expectations!!!!
reviews.text:
About Khyber,
Stayed at Khyber from 05th March to 08th March 2017
Its the best 5 star property in Gulmarg in terms of location, rooms, food and other amenities(pool, jacuzzi, spa, kids play area etc..)
Staff from the managers to the reception guys to restaurant staff to security guys..everyone is really well trained,helpful and ready to help always.

About Gulmarg,
Heaven on earth. Gondola ride and other snow activities on top of the hill are amazing.
Hiring a guide will be helpful.
Javid(contact details:7006124188,9622716814) is one of the best guide for Gulmarg. He knows the place really well, will arrange for your transport, pick up & Drop, site seeing,gondola tickets and other snow activities.
Also he will get everything done at much lower rate compared to other tour operators.

reviews.author: shimauli
reviews.title: Holiday with the kids
reviews.text:
Gulmarg is beautiful and a must must visit. Khyber is a great hotel, conveniently located. We went when it was freezing end February 2017 but the hotel is centrally heated so it wAs fine. 

The Khyber swimming pool is fabulous and the kahwa kept me warm enough :) they don't serve any liquor in the hotel so make sure you bring your own, you won't get any shops in Gulmarg for liquor! 

Rooms are nice and cozy, bkfast is elaborate, we took our girls along 5years and 5 mnths old. Both loved it! 

Staff was friendly and courteous ! And they have the fastest room service across hotels in india that Weve visited :) 

It was snowing, and we did snow biking sledging and skiing took the gondola to 1st stage it worked out great . We had A good guide and taxi guys were great too! 

Make sure you spend enough nights if you want to learn skiing:) 

All in all great experience ! Good value for money and wasn't so crowded when we went always a good thing 😀

Happy holidays 🙏🙏

reviews.author: Purvi S
reviews.title: Fantastic experience!!!
reviews.text: It was amongst the few best experiences... everything we needed was a call away... everything was perfect! After a long day at the slopes we would look forward to returning and getting spoilt by their always smiling hospitality... highly recommend it to all... Thank you Khyber. Will definitely come back soon....

reviews.author: 912nitins
reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel
reviews.text:
Khyber is undoubtedly one of the best hotels that Iv stayed in , in India .
The hotel staff is extremely responsive.
Upon checkin we were served Kahwa tea which was wonderful.

Our room had a wonderful  view as well.

I am definitely coming back again , and Khyber would be my choice of hotel .

reviews.author: AddyKohli
reviews.title: Amazingly beautiful place and incredibly warm people
reviews.text: Just finished a 4 day holiday. Khyber was excellent, it's location, staff and the best of all it's an extremely kids friendly hotel. Has a lot for both adults and children. The heated pool after a day of skiing was a bliss!

reviews.author: AnkkitV
reviews.title: Amazing!!!!
reviews.text:
Hello,

We stayed there for 3 nights and it was 36 of us! 

The hotel is superb in terms so location. Rooms are very nice and made as per the location using a lot of wood and old
World design syncing it with modern day needs. 

Food buffet is good and taste is nice as well.

They have one of the best spa's in india. The therapists work wonders!!

Have been there twice and looking forward to the third trip in 2018!

Cheers

reviews.author: genghis_on_road
reviews.title: Great hotel, kids' facilities were disappointing
reviews.text:
Stayed for 4 days with my wife and 2 kids (3 and 7 years).

What we liked -
Great property. really grand looking.
Service was fantastic. Very prompt and courteous staff. I think the service was the highlight of our stay.
Rooms were fabulous.
Amenities like the heated pool, jacuzzi and the sauna were well maintained and were great fun for the kids. the gym looked nice though we did not use it.
The food buffet had a lot of variety.

What we did not like -
Considering that most guests were families with children, there was surprisingly little to keep kids engaged. 
The kids play area was icy cold and dark and gloomy. There were no attendants so you could not leave the kids. Very few games. Basically you would not want to spend time there at all.
There was no kids menu - ala carte or buffet. It would have been good to have at least a couple of items on the menu or in the buffet that were specifically for kids.
Other than this, they had a peculiar rule of not allowing the locals into the hotel. So my guide and I had to stand outside in sub zero temperatures to plan our next day or any such conversation. Apart from the cold, it was just very distasteful.
And, the food is expensive. I must also add food is expensive everywhere in Gulmarg for obvious reasons. We had breakfast and dinner included in our plan. But when we did spend, meals were about 5000 for the family. Even if you ask for plain boiled pasta for the kid, it was charged at Rs. 900. At the Taj, they would give it to us for free, considering we were spending 4k on the rest of the meal anyway.

Overall, I think its a great hotel with a wonderful staff. I hope they focus on the little guests a bit more.

reviews.author: ariajainxx
reviews.title: INSUFFICIENT SERVICE
reviews.text:
The hotel is marvelous and grand, the rooms too are very comfortable. We however went at a time when the whole hotel was empty. We had paid for all the services but since the place was empty most things were difunctional. The television wasn't working. 
Everyday they made the guests walk down the slippery snow slope for 5 minutes in the snow because they had no ATVs. 
 The cafe didn't have most of the things on the menu. Service at the Khyber is poor, but if you go there expecting less, that shouldn't affect the comfort level.

reviews.author: NoinahJaeb
reviews.title: The Best in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Mesmerizing views from the room, from the pool and from the breakfast area. Topping it up with great service & high security, what more can one ask for in Gulmarg?

The hotel was just a short (but a steep slope) walk away from the Gondola station; making that an easy access.

There were flights of stairs at different parts of the hotel (at main entrance, to the room, to the pool & to the kids play room) so not sure if there any lift access (did not notice).

reviews.author: rajiv7679
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort at Nice Location
reviews.text:
It was my first visit to Gulmarg and I would say that words are less to write about Gulmarg. We stayed at the Khyber. The place is built at great location, it is at walking distance from gondola. The resort is built with heritage theme taking into consideration the culture of Kashmir. 
The rooms and facilities are fine. There are not many options for food in the resort. As the resort is comparatively new, it needs proper maintenance and up gradation time to time. There is a difference between very good and great and Khyber needs to cover that distance through its hospitality & warmth. Overall it was nice experience as I feel the USP of Khyber is its location, it's snow all around. Do visit it to feel and experience Enchanting Gulmarg!

reviews.author: MalikandScott
reviews.title: Hospitality....at it's best
reviews.text: It was just incredible being in Khyber, their Hospitality is awesome with best pool views you might ever see......room with balcony gives you extra edge....if you are at Khyber you just need not to go anywhere else.....it’s a kind of resort where you see everything you can see in gulmarg......

reviews.author: Akhil C
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: ........is a very beautiful property. We stayed here for first time and had a very nice experience. Staff is very cooperative here and very small or big thing of ours was taken care. It has amazing ambitions and very nicely maintained. Food is very delicious and quality is very well maintained. Mr. Bilal, who takes care of administration  , takes great care of guests and make them sure of every comfort.

reviews.author: dj031979
reviews.title: PARADISE ON EARTH
reviews.text: Its one of the most amazing properties i have ever stayed ..will visit every year for sure..thanks to sajjad the duty manager for upgrading us to the gulmarg view rooms with balcony ...would highly recommend these rooms or the himalayan view ones.the staff are very courteous specially the one handling the pool area..forgot his name though i guess it was tahir..everything about the hotel is brilliant ....most memorable stay so far....thank u khyber..see u soon

reviews.author: pritish_10
reviews.title: An Excellent Stay !!!
reviews.text: I have visited many five star hotels, but the stay at Khyber was one notch above any place I've ever been. From the airport representative, car drivers, security guards, hotel staff everyone is extremely courteous and friendly and go beyond their duty to make you feel comfortable. Extremely well trained and hospitable staff. The personal attention that they give to every guest, just makes the whole experience really good. The 2 night stay at this resort was really amazing, and I cant find any negative or anything which was not upto the mark to mention here. The Kashmiri Kahwa was too die for, so tasty and piping hot !!!! Mr. Bilal and the person taking care of the tea lounge in Khyber, really took excellent care of us. We had the most amazing view from our rooms, and the view from the pool is just breathtaking. One of the best stays ever and I'm definitely coming back here (it's very rarely that I praise something so much ;)) but honestly every single aspect of service and hospitality far far exceeds the expectations. Really happy and I hope you continue to maintain these standards of hospitality and service. Hats off to the staff and management  !! Highly Recommended.

reviews.author: sumitgup
reviews.title: Finest Experience in Hills
reviews.text: We stayed in Khyber for 2 nights, by far Khyber is the best resort on hills. Unmatched comfort, superb food, extremely courteous staff, kids friendly atmosphere....in simple term one big reason to visit Gulmarg will be Khyber

reviews.author: minijeswal
reviews.title: Khyber makes gulmarg even more beautifuk
reviews.text:
We planned our visit to Gulmarg only because of Khyber. Being one of the top 10 resorts of Asia , khyber has proven its ranking absolutely right.
The entire hotel staff was the sweetest ever. From parvez, bilal , showkat to people attending us at the pool and restaurant everyone treated us like god and took the best care of us.
The view from swimming pool is the best part of khyber.
Rooms are amazing too.
Thank you for having us at Khyber , we shall definitely see you all soon again.
I will advice people who are planning a visit to Kashmir to please visit Khyber.

reviews.author: neeraj404
reviews.title: Great Value for Money, Amazing Resort !!
reviews.text: A wonderful place to experience snow filled winter, i have stayed here for 2 Nights from 14 Jan 2017 onwards with my family, the hotel premises, the rooms and the amenities are great and very well maintained, food is very delicious, the heated pool is welcome in the freezing cold weather, the best part of this resort is the well trained staff who really take good care of yourself. Mr. Billal in the front desk is one such person who is always smiling and ensure that you get all comfort during your stay. Mr. Showkat Khan in the F&B section is another gem person who suggest you what to go for during all meals, he is very hard working and energetic person who ensures that you enjoy your stay by all possible means. Resort is located at the best location in Gulmarg, rooms are very neat and clean and spacious, service standards are superb...There is great value for money as you will feel very comfortable in this resort.

reviews.author: vkchoksy
reviews.title: Excellent Hote;
reviews.text:
The hotel is great

Staff excellent

Food Good

Enjoyed our stay

will surely go back

The heated pool is welcome

the gym is well equipped

the managers are very helpful

The property is lovely

Lovely views from the room

enjoyed with my family of 5

reviews.author: Sree G
reviews.title: Stay in Khyber in Dec
reviews.text:
Hi,

I had pleasure of staying in Khyber Resort. I had travelled to Gulmarg on Dec 28th and had stayed there for 2 nights. They had upgraded by room which was a nice gesture. The location of the property is breath taking. It is a serene place, I had hoped for the snowfall, but unfortunately weather god had other ideas. But the views from the property was amazing. The hospitality was at its best. I had loved to stay there for more days, provided there was snowfall, but it didn't. Now again planning to there in Jan if there is a snowfall. Food was excellent, lot of continental food was available. Hoping to visit Gulmarg and Khyber in Jan end again, hopefully with snowfall.

reviews.author: Manik Dhodi
reviews.title: A Heaven in Heaven
reviews.text: If Kashmir is called heaven, one may call this place a Heaven in heaven. Beautiful hotel wherein wood dominates the eyes. Heart melting views from all around the hotel. The "Kava" welcome drink is a blessing.

reviews.author: mformalay
reviews.title: Wish tripadvisor had a 6th star
reviews.text:
One visits lots of 5 stars hotels and resorts in India and aborad. Most of them gives a good service. Khyber's service is surely a notch above .They are genuinely happy to see you and take care of you. People like shawkat at clove, hamid at front desk and each and everyone was really good. Everything was taken care . Rooms are amazing. Book the himalayan view rooms. spa was good. pool really nice ,kids will have fun.Food was good. 
Some stuff that can we little better is stuff for kids. Create more interesting stuff for them to be busy. Keep up the good work. we are surely coming back again. YOU GUYS ROCK.

reviews.author: GauravAndSonali
reviews.title: Perfect hot spring refuge from the snow
reviews.text:
Great location, very close to the ski lift / gondola / ATV rides / ice skating rink etc. 

Excellent service. The staff couldn't do enough and were always eager to please. 

Game room and swimming pool kept my daughter busy. 

He spa was the perfect opportunity to take shelter from the cold weather outside. 

The best part was, the lobby , restaurant and corridors of the hotel were kept pleasantly warm, so we didn't need to layer up inside the hotel. 

It was the perfect refuge. We will definitely be back the next time we are in Kashmir.

reviews.author: Malhar Mehta
reviews.title: Great property, amazing location and excellent service
reviews.text:
The Khyber is the best property in Gulmarg. It has amazing view amongst snow clad mountains. You cannot find a place better than this in Gulmarg. The Gondola ride is walking distance from this place. 

All the rooms have amazing view of the snow clad mountains and pine trees. The hotel is centrally heated and it is only when you step out of the hotel that you realize what is the temperature outside. Hotel is well-staffed and the entire staff is well versed with the requirements of the travelers. They ensure that all the travelers do not face any issues with regards to the climate. The food is pretty decent with amazing spread in both breakfast and dinner. 

When we were checking out it was snowing heavily and hence we could not move out and our vehicle could not come to the hotel. The hotel staff arranged for special scooters and took us as well as the luggage to the place where our vehicle could reach. Indeed a very good gesture. 

The hotel has spa and warm water pool which is an added luxury in such a climate. 

Overall an experience worth remembering.

reviews.author: jain_anoop
reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: Khyber is the best hotel luxury in Gulmarg, Srinagar. The location is just unbeatable with views of snow clad mountains all around. The staff pampers you with their hospitality right from check in till checkout. The buffet breakfast and dinners are awesome. Spa is a must. Very good memories of this hotel

reviews.author: indianfoodie71
reviews.title: Amazing View n Spa
reviews.text: The rooms are modern and well maintained. The food is good and lots of variety in the buffet. The Spa was excellent and a variety of options.The staff are well trained .Its the best property in Gulmarg. I would love to visit during the skiing season. The whole ambience and view will change.

reviews.author: Jibran A
reviews.title: The Best Hotel in Kashmir.
reviews.text: Undoubtedly best place to stay in Whole Kashmir, Amazing food with efficient service, Snow fall on day-2 of our trip was icing on cake. Spacious room with sunken bath and beautiful valley view. Thanks to the Khyber team to give amazing start to our 7 nights trip in Kashmir. 😊❤

reviews.author: Ashish A
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, beautiful setting, very nice staff
reviews.text: Title says it all. The hotel is at the foothills of a mountain, close to everything. The hotel grounds are beautiful and meticulously maintained. The staff is super-attentive and caters to all your needs. Loved our stay there. Wish it was longer.

reviews.author: Niyati M
reviews.title: amazing place, amazing time
reviews.text:
Travelled in march 2016, we were 3 couples with 3 kids each 4 years old and we had a fantastic time in khyber, they took utmost care and made sure everything was just right. 
Our presidential cottage, had a huge space with a heated jacuzzi, a person butler mr. sajjad who was just very warm and made sure the kids were well looked after as well. 
It was cold and snowing in march, but their heated pool was super for all of us to have a great time. An amazing experience. Food was delicious and they did make it to the requirement of our kids too. A must for all to visit here.

reviews.author: Deepen D
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Kashmir
reviews.text:
The perfect place to enjoy Kashmir hospitality and weather. We were lucky to experience snowfall from the time we arrived to till we left the place. It was the last snowfall of the season. Perfect to cover the ski slopes. 
Elegant Kashmiri interiors. The rooms sizes are huge. The best place in the room is the bathtub next to the window and to see snow falling outside. 
The food is excellent. We tried the traditional Kashmiri spread for one meal. We were stuffed and highly satisfied. 
The swimming pool and fitness area is fantastic. Heated pool in a glass enclosure and snow outside make the perfect setting.

reviews.author: RadhikaAC
reviews.title: One the best hotels in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Family visit for grandparents anniversary. 

Take rooms with balcony. 

Great variety of food for breakfast lunch and dinner. Made special food for my grand parents as well. 

The kahwa served at the coffee shop was awesome. Must try. 

Have a lounge which offers Sheesha and kebabs and knick knacks. Doesn't serve alcohol but you can get own alcohol and sit at the lounge. 

The pool and spa are amazing!! Have to walk a staircase to get there so inconvenient for my grandparents but 
Amazing views from the pool.

Super close to the gondola ride. 5 mins walking distance.

reviews.author: MManish
reviews.title: Great weather, great property!
reviews.text: We had taken the 2 b/r suite. I must say it was huge. A Duplex suite opens to the garden.  Huge toilets. Luxury quality. Amazing speed in room service. I must say. Great spread of breakfast, dinner. Nice shisha place! Great outdoor space to sit and enjoy walks, just sit and chill. Swimming pool was under maintenance during our 3 day stay. The spa was also commendable!

reviews.author: suhelv
reviews.title: Most tranquil
reviews.text:
I just loved this hotel. If we will be in Gulmarg again, it's definitely Khyber. Loved every bit of our stay here. The property itself would not let u go anywhere. There pool is amazing. They have steam sauna and jacuzzi next to the pool which makes it more relaxing. 
Love it

reviews.author: rahjal1
reviews.title: Amazing Property
reviews.text: We had a lovely stay at this property in may, 2016, we were a couple with two children aged 11 each.The hotel is fabulous with sweeping views and well maintained. A stay here is highly recommended for a maximum of two days. The options for the children are a bit limited and the games room being unsupervised can get a bit messy. The Buffet is excellent but gets a repetitive after a while. The spa is top notch and highly recommended.The Staff is ever smiling and helpful. Room service is prompt and swift. Overall a thoroughly enjoyable trip!

reviews.author: Rinku B
reviews.title: Holiday at Khyber Resort Gulmarg
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, very comfortable and great staff! the restaurant staff was particularly very helpful, they made food as per our instructions and as per our child's liking. The view from the hotel is breathtaking. The heated pool was an amazing experience.

reviews.author: GAURAV
reviews.title: Best location and bet property in Gulmarg
reviews.text: The place is great, the people at the Resort are extremely helpful..the food is good. And such luxury at such a place is like...you have to stay there to believe it. Have been going there for the last 3 years and will go their again. Only one disappointment - nno free wifi - no cellular reception in the property - Free wifi a must

reviews.author: darshanaps
reviews.title: Amazing hotel, great food and beautiful location
reviews.text:
It a beautifully located hotel, very comfortable and amazing food. It has amazing views and has a party lounge area where if your in a group you can make it the most happening place in the mountains.
Rooms are very nice, but make sure to get rooms on the main floor especially if your visiting in winter. 
If you have children, please be careful while using their heated fool as some of the tiles and edges in the pool are broken and chances of your child getting hurt is a possibility.
The spa is worth using.
Food is amazing and if you inform them of any special preference or meal requests, its usually taken care. Do ask them for suggestions, especially if your ordering A-la-Carte meals.
Its a magical serene and truly a heaven on earth. Must stay property.
Needs advance booking and during your booking put in your room floor request.
Floors at the lower level are not advisable while there is still snow or in winter months as it can be a very gloomy room. 
Please make sure you check your bills correctly when settling your accounts at the hotel.

reviews.author: shilpamehra
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: It was like a magical kingdom at the foothills of the Himalayas. Khyber surpasses all expectations. The building and the construction, with the intricate wood work is outstanding. The food at Cloves, the multi cuisine restaurant was great. The servers and chefs were out to please every whim and fancy. The tea, or rather, Kehwa at the terrace was fabulous. What is so extra ordinary about the property is its location, with a stunning view of the snow capped mountains and the lush greenery.The General Manager of Khyber, Mr. Vinit Chhabra was a pleasure to meet. Puneet the front office manager was kind enough to show us around the property. Khyber has all the ingredients for an awesome stay. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: the place is very nice, and has a heated pool and a lovely spa also. It is like heaven on earth. It is a must visit should not be left at any cost. We enjoyed a lot over here. Will go to the place again.

reviews.author: Rashi R
reviews.title: Disappointing ! Annoying ! Waste of money !
reviews.text:
When I made my booking for KHYBER resort, I was extremely hopeful and looking foward to an experience of a lifetime. Needless to say the 2day stay costed us a whopping amount, yet even receiving an advance warning from my friends and relatives I continued to take my chances.
At the time of check in i was extremely delighted to know that we had been upgraded to the Himalayan balcony view room, and I was very thankful to the reception staff for this gesture.It was only later that I got to know the upgrade was the effort of our dear family friend Mushtaq Bhat, who continues to recieve 'best performance award' as a travel agent from the hotel during every assisment. Contrary to this, the extremely arrogant and disrespectful manager had the audacity to stop Mushtaq Bhai from entering the hotel premises. My mother was very upset by this behaviour recieved from the reception manager and even threatened to cancel our entire booking at that moment. The reception staff assumed that we were escorting our guest Mushtaq Bhai to our room and they objected due to this reason. This was very absurd and totally non acceptable. We had booked our entire trip through Mushtaq Bhai and are extremely thankful to him.From this point on followed a series thorough disappointments.
1. After paying 60,000 for 2 night stay at the property , we are charged 700 rs / day for wifi ! Are you kidding me ! Such a shame on the hotel !
2. The pool overlooking the Himalayas , proclaimed to be one of the countries best , is not function due to some unending repair activity ! Disappointing once again.
3. On my second day at KHYBER , I decided to use the Gymnasium. I enthusiastically put on my gym wear and headed to the gymnasium which looked well equipped in terms of the machines , only to discover that I would choke to death if I continued to work out in the presence of the hot air pumped into the gym, and a temperature of 24degrees being maintained by the staff of the spa! I repeatedly requested the staff to switch On the A/C, and they kept assuring me that they were in the process of doing the same all through my work out!
Agitated this time ! 
4. These guys should set a record for the worst room service ever ! Period !
5. The F&B staff was very arrogant and cold. The seemed to be extremely disinterested except for one girl from the staff, who was more diligent as compared to the entire hotel staff put together. 
Special service was provided to the big groups, I guess they are ones who leave behind a whooping tip as well. The F&B staff did not even care to refill servings that were finished, even after we repeatidly requested. I don't think the staff understands the meaning of a 5 star hotel in the first case !
6. We visited the hotel in July and needless to say there was no provision for ventilation in the rooms. It was hot in the days, and warm in the nights ( pleasant outside )
Now this is really mysterious whether the hotel has air conditioning services of not! At the time of check in we asked at the reception and were turned down saying tha hotel doesn't offer this service get! However the room service staff offered to switch on the same upon on a special request , but I guess he was later thrashed by the staff to revealing this secret! We continued to suffer in the heat. In the remaining 2 days, we were utterly confused as half of the staff proclaimed that the AC was deliberately switched off by the hotel authorities and the other half said that this service was yet not available at the hotel.
We felt extremely cheated!
If I am asked to summarise my stay at KHYBER resort , I would simply compare it to that fancy gift wrapped box, which is stuffed which newspaper from the inside!
Guys if you think you have too much money to make a booking with this resort I think you rather make a donation instead , atleast that would earn you some blessings!

reviews.author: pmathur2014
reviews.title: Brilliant resort
reviews.text:
We spent 2 days at Khyber , the staff and management are wonderful .
property is probably one of the best in the country ..... 
food , service and facilities are exceptional and world class.
Thanks to the team at Khyber who take pains to ensure all guests go delighted .
Truly a relaxing and enjoyable place.

reviews.author: Kuldeep K
reviews.title: Paradise in a Paradise
reviews.text: I think this resort deserves more than  5 star ratings. After travelling in many countries I can say that this is best resort/hotel we ever stayed. We can not forget the wonderful view from our room (better than Switzerland/Sweden), the hospitality and we still remember mouth watering food. Staff is so friendly that after our 4 day stay we knew most of them by name. I think Khyber resort is a heaven in the hills. One can not get this kind of hospitality in any other resort.

reviews.author: seema m
reviews.title: luxury hotel
reviews.text: from the entrance only u can feel luxury there. property is very well design . very close to gandola and golf course. their swimming pool and jacuzzi is must enjoy . food is good. but at coffeshop sevice is very slow.

reviews.author: FamilyTravel
reviews.title: Top class resort
reviews.text: Stayed during summer (June end) in their two bedroom suite/cottage. The living area was huge/spacious with two separate flloors (including servant room with attached bathroom at lower level) and everything was impeccable and luxurious. The view from the room was great overlooking mountain peaks. Couple of minor problems, the hot water took a long time to come through (had to turn on all the faucets including bath tub). WiFi was not included in the room charges and was limited to two devices per day, which is annoying when free WiFi is available everywhere.

reviews.author: Chirag D
reviews.title: Heaven in the Hills!!!
reviews.text: Had a wonderful visit and stay at Khyber. It is a stunning property with magnificent rooms and cottages. The staff is extremely helpful, attentive and welcoming. A special mention for Saqib who took care of all our needs, including on his day off for Eid. The only negative point of the hotel is that they do not serve alcohol, but you are allowed to carry your own. I look forward to going back again, next time to experience the Winter!!!

reviews.author: Puneesh P
reviews.title: Good property but poor management
reviews.text: I have stayed in the property for 2 nights along with the family in the month of june 2015 & the management is below average as compared to the beautiful property. The pool was under maintainance at the time of visit & the management was not compensating. They were filling the pool with a 1 inch plastic pipe & it was going to take 3 days to fill.

reviews.author: Priteshdel
reviews.title: Property is Good , Claimed 5 Star , but servicing below average
reviews.text:
WE have visited Gulmarg and stayed in Khyber for 2 nights. The Property is good, ambiance and surrounding is fabulous but when it come to the servicing is is below average. The price what they charge is so high and very expensive as compare to similar properties in any other (other then J&K) , they Claim they are 5 star but the quality of Servicing Housekeeping, F&B , in room dining, Front office is below average.
And worst part  is no one is bothered about this. I have already told the Front office of the hotel about my feedback, but i dont think they are bothered..

The quality of food is also average and worst part they dont have items to serve , which they have in there menu card and in in room dining .'

I have to think twice now  before I book this property for my next trip to Gulmarg, in coming winters.

reviews.author: Kinshuk A
reviews.title: You Rule Gulmarg!!!!
reviews.text: The only reason for staying in gulmarg was this hotel because i happened to see the hotel in Conde Nast and a few special recommendations from friends. This hotel is outrightly the RULER of Gulmarg. Beautiful furniture, tastefully done rooms with magnificent room views, amazingly courteous and polite staff. The facilities were far too many but we managed to enjoy the most of it. The only thing we missed was the swimming pool which was not under maintenance. Mr Sadiq from Reception was the highlight who made us comfortable in every possible ways. A must experience property for luxury travelers.

reviews.author: 62shwetad
reviews.title: Jannat~e~hind
reviews.text: Last year..in March wen it was all white everywhere..snow dashed;we stayed at Khyber fr two nights..never ever to be forgotten, the warm interiors were a treat to body n snowfall ,a treat to soul!!!amazing food , high end hospitality:n sipping ka wah was all we enjoyed. Experience at spa was ultimate too. The temperature controlled indoor pool wasanother way to keep our spirits high...I can visit n revisit the place ,any no of times , given a chance.. Must go if u think "Dharti par bhi swarg hai"

reviews.author: HIMALAYAS0904
reviews.title: LUXURY IN THE LAP OF HIMALAYAS
reviews.text:
Luxury in the lap of Himalayas
 
We visited Khyber during may end 2015 with two young kids. The check in was pretty smooth but It took about 20 minutes till when we were asked the sit in the lobby which has nice views of the snow capped mountains .Since the entire hotel  is centrally airconditioned except for a few areas hence one doesn’t feel the chill of gulmarg once inside. Since we all were very tired hence the checkin executive offered to discuss things in the room itself.The balcony was simply amazing with the best views one can have of the Himalayas in any resort in the hills.the luxury himalayan view room was what we expected it to be , quite nicely decorated with touches of Kashmir yet modern overall with a sunken bath with a huge window offering the snow capped mountain view.We were given the traditional kashmiri tea called the kawah which was nice.However, thereafter there was no voluntary interaction from the management to help the guests chalk out their stay plan .The kids play room was quite a disappointment as the only thing good was  the xbox and table tennis which we could not play both the times we visited the playroom as it was preoccupied by another family both times. I was also expecting some swings and slides and hammocks in the outdoors but found none .
The swimming pool was one high point during the stay as we all enjoyed it a lot but the tiles need a lot of maintenance as my daughter cut her foot with the small broken tiles . The attendant was prompt enough to get the first aid kit and tried to help my daughter . We then requested the staff to ensure repair of the broken tiles as anybody could get hurt and we ourselves were walking cautiously thereafter in the pool as we found many broken small pieces on the pool floor. The kids pool was nice and my son enjoyed it a lot.however the walk from the pool the the rooms is very long and cold as the entire passage is not heated .
The snack menu and the main menu both have very limited choice and need more variety.The staff otherwise courteous was reluctant to warm the amul taaza I was carrying the for kids and infact one of them advised to heat it in the room in the water kettle and the  kettle got spoilt because of this wrong advice.The staff was not very quick in clearing the mess and I had to pitch in to help them.
On the day of check out we had to check out early as our flight was at 10.30 am from Srinagar , hence we requested the staff to pack some breakfast stuff from the buffet breakfast but they were very reluctant and said that there will be extra charges on the sameFurther , no one from the hotel is there to inform you on the Srinagar traffic on weekdays and we got stuck for an hour in the traffic jam and missed our flight. 
Overall the hotel scores high on the location but needs to work towards making the stay more memorable by offering to help  guests plan their days in gulmarg and also be more helpful and supportive as is expected of any five star like TAJ or Oberois.

reviews.author: umesh_12
reviews.title: Feel Royal at Khyber
reviews.text:
It's one of the best resort in Gulmarg. You can spend good time with your family. Plan for atleast for 4-5 days. Try to spend 2-3 days in resort also. Plenty of activities for children as well as for adults.
Resort is having different interior & exterior look. Food quality is also good. Those who likes spicy food, they can also enjoy.

reviews.author: sameeragarwal0009
reviews.title: The Khyber
reviews.text: Extremely wonderful to be there. We had lunch buffet at the Khyber and the food was awesome and the menu was elaborate. Perfect ambience for staying. Good view of the valley from Hotel Lobby. Interiors and Architecture of the hotel is very good.

reviews.author: santosh t
reviews.title: Best hotel with great hospitality
reviews.text:
We have stayed in many high class hotel properties around India and abroad . .

This was undoubtedly one of the best property with stunning views of Ice capped mountains and pine and fur trees. . It is one of the largest property with excellent Resturant serving finest food for foodies like us.

The class in hospitality was experienced from the word go . . Our checking inn was handled very efficiently and a personalised service by Mr Bilal , with a ever smiling face and ever ready to help attitude was a very nice experience . . Such a staff makes the property a class apart. He was very helpful to even change our room with a far better views . .

The staff in the Restuarant was equally efficient and well trained to treat every guest with smile and willingness to serve. . They made our 3 nights stay in the hotel very memorable. 

The place is just 3 minutes walk to the Iconic gandola station in Gulmarg. Be ready to hike the peak on which this property is situated as in Gulmarga , you can not use private or tourist vehicle. There is Union which makes it compulsory to use either horses or local vehicles . .

After a tiring tour around  , you have the option of being pampered by a classy spa in this hotel. . Of course - over priced but must try . .

Stay in this world class hotel with best security arrangement was memorable. If you can afford then this is truly the most luxurious hotel in entire Kashmir. .

reviews.author: Ashish A
reviews.title: Overhyped
reviews.text:
Stayed for 2 nights. 
Positives : location, facilities (heated pool, games room).  

Issues :
1) Air - conditioning /room ventilation. As a winter ski resort, designed for central heating but no ventilation /cooling for the summer. Whats worse they have a promising panel in the room which gives the sense of individual temp control.  
Uncomfortable sleep while paying 5 star rates is unbecoming. 

2) F&B: Quality of food is average. The service is unfortunately sub-par. Waiters needed to be reminded multiple times before you got what you needed.  

I should mention that when the feedback was escalated to Mr.  Basheer and Nawaz, they reacted very well and made best attempt to make amends.  

Overall, we had a reasonable stay at the hotel and it is probably the best property in gulmarg - but there does seem to be a complacency in service in knowing they will have a good stream of business regardless.

reviews.author: MSGarcha
reviews.title: Great place to stay ! Best hotel in Gulmarg !
reviews.text:
Overall great 5 star hospitality. Rooms are spacious.
Food is also very good but breakfast options can be enhanced a bit keeping in mind the Tariffs, which are high.

Great Service, recommend Mr Sajad Lone, our server in restaurant who took great care of us during our stay.

We stayed as a family & enjoyed the heated pool & spa facilities.

reviews.author: parvinder b
reviews.title: Beautiful property
reviews.text:
Khyber is worth a visit. Best place for relaxation and to enjoy good food and gulmarg. View from hotel is excellent and pleasing.  gym , swimming pool and other amenities are good and well maintained. Staff is very courteous.

Its Located very near to gondola so it's add on plus.

Overall worth a money to stay

reviews.author: avashib
reviews.title: amazing! Must visit!
reviews.text: Great rooms with excellent view! food was amazing! the spa and swimming area is pretty amazing with glass walls and a view of the snow capped mountains! service was good! it is located very close to all the attractions including the gondola! Must stay or at least get a meal!

reviews.author: 254saurabh
reviews.title: Over hyped and over rated
reviews.text:
the rooms are nice.
rest is average. food options not that great.
they have a cigar bar but they don't sell cigars.
i asked them if i could smoke my own cigars but they said smoking cigars is not allowed in the cigar bar??
only shisha is allowed in the cigar bar and that also in the evenings only.
weird and overhyped resort.

reviews.author: Himanshufootloose
reviews.title: Gulmarg with a class !
reviews.text: If you are not the touristy types and wish to soak in the meadows , this is the place to go to,in Gulmarg. It is breathtakingly beautiful , done up all in wood with the most modern and state of the art amenities . And yes, you can enjoy swimming in the heated pool looking at the snow clad mountains. The restaurant does delicious food , of most cuisines . The staff is welcoming and friendly . Sajjad was particularly attentive in making our stay comfortable . L'occitaine , the spa was a bit of a disappointment though .

reviews.author: vasundhara18arora
reviews.title: Overhyped property
reviews.text:
Over hyped property which is nowhere close to being called a 5 star 
Lack basic facilities like free WiFi. ..not many options in restaurants 
 Staff not courteous and helpful
Front desk poorly managed and do not receive calls and clear your doubts 
Maintainance is poor. ..can see dust on the railings and looby

reviews.author: travelunlimited
reviews.title: Amazing Property!!
reviews.text: It was quite a wonderful place so beautifully constructed. Rooms were spacious and cosy. Bathrooms are large and clean. Food was very delicious with lots of variety in the morning buffet and dinner too. Having such luxury and comfort at such a high altitude was totally a different experience. The hotel has indoor pool with large glass windows from where you can have a spectacular view of the valley. It is complimented  with jacuzzi and sauna facilities. Staff was helping and efficient. Overall it was a great experience 🖒.

reviews.author: Harkirat_Singh
reviews.title: Luxury nestled in the Himalayas
reviews.text:
The best place to stay in Gulmarg (or rather Kashmir) by far. Absolutely no doubt where to head to, if you want to experience luxury in the hills. The property itself is nestled up on a mountain with great views all around. While the valley view rooms & city view rooms with private balconies are awesome, even Premier Room with Forest View ain’t bad. The lawns are well maintained and provide for a calm walk. 

The spa itself is great, managed by L'occitane. The use of steam, sauna and jacuzzi is complimentary with the stay, while you can book an appointment with the spa for anything more specific. The indoor heated swimming pool is out of this world. With huge floor to ceiling glass walls enclosing the pool overlooking the mountains & trees, you need to experience it to believe it.

The food is great and the service prompt. Since we had a small baby, we did trouble them for baby food, baby cot, etc. and they didn’t disappoint. 

Do note, the access to the hotel is through a very steep short road. So if you’re walking down to the town, be ready for a steep climb back, though it isn’t a long one. The Gulmarg Gondola is located very close to the hotel and you can just walk down.

reviews.author: Ashish G
reviews.title: Amazing Place
reviews.text:
In the middle of nowhere nestled amidst the pines is this wonderfully exotic hotel. The rooms and and food are really worth every bit that they charge. The unfortunate part is that there is no free wifi. This is such a small thing and yet bugs you to pay. I have yet to come across a hotel in this sort of category charging for wifi. Its like charging someone to use the loo !!! ;-)

Otherwise, the whole holiday was wonderful there.

reviews.author: HotelEEFA
reviews.title: Mesmerizing khyber
reviews.text:
I saw this hotels ad many a times in travel magazines,so when the time came to book gulmarg,i knew we had to stay here.i am glad we stayed here,our room had the best view,of the mountains right infront of us,me and my family spent almost all day in the balcony watching.worth the stay

Drawback

The spa which is quite famous is soo sooo far that we cancelled our booking because of that.they must either have a short cut or a lift to the spa,they r losing spa business because of where it is..

reviews.author: Prashant
reviews.title: Warm and Comfortable
reviews.text: Its very warm and comfortable place to stay in Gulmarg. Its very close to Gondola ride. The resort has been setup nicely to give you great views of the snow capped mountains throughout the year. Their attention to service and food is amazing. Try their Kashmiri Kahwa.Their spa and heated pool is worth a visit. The bathrooms are neat and very modern and rooms are a fine mix. Its a place where you find warm Kashmiri hospitality at its best. Its a very quiet and wonderful place to relax.

reviews.author: RambhushanK
reviews.title: Lovely Property
reviews.text: The property is really classy and is very impressive. Lovely facilities and good helpful staff make the stay very comfortable. Breakfast was excellent but the dinner was ok. Facilites are quite good and we had a wonderful time.

reviews.author: Karishma88
reviews.title: Service needs a major overhaul!
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 2 nights.

Positives:
1. Good location - Close to main attraction (Phase 1 and 2/Gondola ride) and great view of snow capped mountains
2. Spacious rooms and good amenities
3. Good spa experience 
4. Beautiful pool
5. Amazing breakfast spread

Negatives:
1. Wifi is on chargeable basis. Even their main competitor Hotel Highlands provides free wifi!
2. Service is very slow. Took them ages to clear the used dishes we placed outside our room. Took them ages to send someone over to collect the luggage for check out. The receptionist hung up on us abruptly in the middle of an enquiry. They were aware that an elderly person was travelling with us but still gave us rooms in the far end of the hotel which were quite a walk from the main lobby and 2 floors at the bottom! This was a major inconvenience.
3. The women's jacuzzi looked worn out with a big rusted nail lying loose in the tub and parts of the surface peeling out. 
4. The pool area is beautiful no doubt, but a huge piece of shattered glass remained on the glass wall just above the pool. This is a major hazard and it only takes a small bird or a twig or a huge gush of wind to send it crashing down and seriously injure someone in the area. 
5. The restaurants are terribly overpriced.

When we pay so much for our stay, we expect good service. It is for these reasons that Khyber was not our most preferred hotel during our entire trip to Kashmir, although it was the most expensive!

reviews.author: Sunil Bhat
reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: This is situated in the middle of the jungle and is one the stunning Hotels i have ever seen with a scintillating views breathtaking landscapes you got to visit property once in a lifetime service is also awesome

reviews.author: Ritikanayyar
reviews.title: Excellent property, great food..
reviews.text: We visited the resort in th first week of March 2016. The resort is superb, very nice rooms, lovely scenic views from majorly all rooms.. Especially at the time of snow fall, which we experienced all the three days that we were there.. Food is very nice!! They make arrangements for gum boots for walking in the snow as well.. Staff is very helpful and friendly.. The indoor heated pool is big plus.. It's a gorgeous scene wen ur swimming inside and it's snowing outside.. We had a lovely stay..

reviews.author: Anang_11
reviews.title: Over Hyped - Over Rated - Over Priced
reviews.text:
We were in Khyber for 2 nights stay. We booked this hotel almost four months before. When I entered my credit card details, entire amount was charged immediately, without asking for pin., which was surprising. 

Any how when we reached hotel, we showed our online booking receipt. Staff agreed that booking was confirmed but were not sure that payment had been made. Room allotted to us was premium and having himalayan view. Rooms were specious, clean, well appointed. There was open gallery with sit out, facing snow caped mountains. Bed was large and comfortable. Wash rooms were clean and well designed. But room was not properly ventilated. We had to keep balcony doors open to avoid suffocation. But after some time found room too cold in side and had to close doors. No proper room temperatures were maintained. We called then in the midnight to set A/C temperatures but were advised to keep gallery doors open.

Location of Khyber is a great advantage. (walking distance from Gandola Ride, the main attraction in Gulmarg). View from Rooms, Restaurants and from all over hotel are beautiful. Entire property of the Hotel is Decent and well maintained. Right from Entrance to Rooms, Spa, Pool , every thing gives a feeling of Five Star Hotel.

But when it comes to service and hospitality, it is no way near Five Star Category. The Rates we pay for Rooms are too high as compared to service, warmth and hospitality to be rated as Five Star. It lacks the feeling of luxurious treatment. Staff is required to be trained properly. 

When you are charging so huge rates for rooms you are supposed to provide basic amenities and facilities. No Free WiFi. No proper Travel desk to provide full information and assistance for Gandola Ride. Though Hotel is a walking distance from Gandola, approach road is on a steep slope. Difficult to walk. But no complimentary dropping and pick up facility. Restaurant is too small, considering number of rooms in Hotel. No Multiple restaurants and dining options available. Room service was pathetic. Telephoned to then several times to remove dishes after lunch but nobody turned. We ourselves removed it and kept it outside and it was lying there for hours. But no one bothered to remove it. Restaurant is overpriced and above that room service rates are further 30 % higher. No Chinese food available. At the time of check in we were told to book restaurant first for dining. When we telephoned to book a seat, we were told that restaurant is full and we had to go there and wait for a seat to sit. and this happened every time. 

In all it was a mixed feeling for us. Too costly Five Star property, which lacks five star hospitality. Awesome location, great views, Good Rooms but at the end of the day no luxurious feeling. 

I will not visit again and will find better option next time.

reviews.author: Vinod D
reviews.title: Luxurious!!!
reviews.text: Stayed here in may2016 for 3days.....very beautiful place to enjoy the scenic gulmarg....comfortable rooms...great food....a bit expensive though....very close to all the tourist spots in gulmarg....overall a premium place to stay.

reviews.author: Tejalk139
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth
reviews.text: Khyber resort was a wonderful experience . The service n hospitality was excellent . The food n beverage team was excellent n manager Mr Bashart personally took care of our food needs.The 3 Bilal's took extra efforts to look after us. It's a great place to stay n enjoy the resort with beautiful n picturesque surrounding!!!

reviews.author: RamNit1996
reviews.title: Great location but not so great restaurant service
reviews.text: The biggest plus is the location and views. It is walking distance from the Gandola and hence you are very close to the biggest attraction of Gulmarg. Most locations of the hotel have a great view and many picture spots for families. The restaurant is really overpriced compared to the presentation and taste. Since there are not many restaurant options in Gulmarg you have to put up. Good place for one night stay but not more.

reviews.author: MD-qwerty
reviews.title: Great views, but leaves a lot to be desired. Not luxurious....
reviews.text:
Awesome location, Lovely views.
But for the price, not worth it.
No free wifi.

There is a general sense of stuffiness in the entire hotel. Many places you feel that you can smell sh**. Suddenly from somewhere you can smell this funny thing. It is all prevalent. From the toilets in rooms, to the lobbies, in the spa, everywhere.

The rooms are smallish. But well appointed. Again circulation of fresh air is not there. We had to keep the windows open, but at same time, close it every some while, because it got too cold.

The hotel has only one restaurant, and it gets really crowded. While service was very good, the food taste left a lot yo be desired. The hotel needs multiple dining options and definitely needs more covers. 

I think hotel realizes this and has placed about 15 covers just outside the restaurant to manage this, but 
A. It feels like you are eating on the street.
B. There is no service here.

The spa-pool area, also needs changes.
The swimming pool water looked dirty. I am not sure whether it looks dirty or is it actually dirty. But inspite of excellent setting, I didn't want to go in because of this.

The Spa by L'Occitane was ok. The area did not give a feeling of occasion. The room decor was not luxurious. The steam was not working properly inspite of changing the room.
While the massage itself was good, again the feeling of luxury was absent.

reviews.author: RohitSatiVini
reviews.title: The Khyber Paradise in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The Khyber is beautiful paradise in Gulmarg. I stayed in room no 2016 for two nights (19th& 20th May) with my wife and son. My experiences –
Don’t miss evening Kahwah and Tea in ‘Chaikash’ and beautiful view of snow covered hills of Pirpanjal range from ‘Chaikash’. 
‘Clove’ is beautiful restaurant its menu is filled with delicious, mouthwatering dishes. ‘Clove’ waiters are friendly loving persons, their affectionate behavior makes you very comfortable and gives homely feeling. Thanks to Chefs of ‘Clove’ for delicious breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Rooms are very comfortable with beautiful bathrooms and scenic views. 
‘Laundry’ don’t forget to tell them to clean your clothes properly, in hurry they forget to remove cloth stains.
Front office Mr Junaid is very cooperative, I forgot some article during check out, I had a telephonic talk with him after few minute telephonic talk he promised me to send it through courier. The Khyber is very caring.
The Khyber guide (Mr Javed phone no 09622716814) is awesome young man. He stood in Gulmarg Gandola ticket line at 4:45 am. He is a good skier, in phase 2 of Gandola he gave few good skiing lessons to my son. 
Take ATV ride from hotel or outside to see beautiful landscapes of Gulmargh.
Gulmarg is beautiful heaven in earth and The Khyber is its pearl. Looking forward to visit The Khyber in winters with family. Missing the sips of Kahwah and Pirpanjal range view from ‘Chaikash’.

reviews.author: Ashish S
reviews.title: Excellent property with a poor service
reviews.text:
No doubt the property is itself a part to get explored like gulmarg.
Very beautiful property with such a brilliant view of the interior lounge, lobby, and many antiques wodden crafted things much more.
But thats a part of a 5 star property at the same time it's more important how the guest are treated we felt like the management head were in too much of attitude.
Staying here was a like a prison with many rules to be followed likewise had to go long way for smoking secondly the connectivity doors from swimming pool to the rooms are closed had to walk as if we are on tracking.
We complained of some chemical solution sprayed on wooden furniture  ( as of the entire property is made of wooden things and great wooden carving) but the person denied and even dint changed the rooms.
No doubt the food is excellent I rate it 5 star.

But after all dissatisfaction is more.

Remember it's a business promoted by word of mouth I was recommended by my cousin who visited in 2015 but I don't feel like advising any one.

reviews.author: Yash1977
reviews.title: Beautiful views
reviews.text:
A stunning property. Great location. Beautiful rooms and views of the majestic Himalayas. Very luxurious interiors in our room. They also have a warm swimming pool and gym overlooking the mountains. Location also close to the gondola ride. Walking distance in fact. 

They don't serve alcohol but are fine with people carrying their own alcohol and consuming it in a nice room off the main lobby. 

They only flip side was the quality of the playing area for young children or toddlers. They could have invested a little more in getting better slides and swings for children. Additionally they have a play room which has a few screens, games (table tennis, carrom etc) and toys etc but given their location where they have heavy snow or rain this room needs to be focussed on a little more. Maybe some slides and other items for toddlers.  Additionally this room needs to be supervised as a lot of games and toys were in poor shape/broken. 

Food is excellent at their all day dining area.

reviews.author: shar2210
reviews.title: Location location location!!
reviews.text:
Excellent hotel with amazing views.Its the place to stay in Gulmarg.
Easy walk to the ski lift and the cable car.
Its an uber luxurious place with a fantastic spa and pool
Well maintained well trained staff adn great food.
A winner all the way

reviews.author: Dhwanirshah
reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text:
Definitely one of the best hotels I've ever been to in India. The view and hospitality were amazing. L'occitane spa is an absolute must for all spa lovers as its one of the best few spas In the country. 
There inhouse service is also very quick. I had a sprained ankle during my stay and the doctor was very kind to constantly come and check on me to make sure I was comfortable.

reviews.author: cigandhi
reviews.title: khyber is amazing place,
reviews.text: Khyber resort at gulmarg is excellent property, starting  from reception to all areas they score above every other resort, rooms are good and clean, food excellent. staff very cooperative and for jains there is no other place than this. you talk of any area they score excellent grade. one suggestion they should have one more restaurant if it is full you must plan your dinner nor you have to wait,and they should have one more lift to go down. I was there for 4 days with group and enjoyed stay.

reviews.author: Pramod L
reviews.title: heavenly hotel in middle of mountains
reviews.text: Excellent place nestled in the middle of the mountains.The mountain view rooms have a magnificent view of the snow clad mountains.Food is quite good and the property is well maintained.The staff makes sure that the stay is memorable.One advice to the hotel is to have some live music playing at the lobby or restaurant.

reviews.author: MenonRajeev
reviews.title: Great Place to stay
reviews.text: Stayed at the Khyber for 4 nights. Since this was our first trip to Kashmir, the expectations were very high and we were not disappointed.  The rooms were quite spacious to accommodate a family of 4 (extra bed included).  The view from the room was simply amazing.  The indoor heated swimming pool was definitely a hit with the kids.  The best part of the hotel is its location.  Buffet is expensive for the spread that they have.  Staff were courteous and helpful and we enjoyed our stay at Gulmarg.

reviews.author: sheen c
reviews.title: Elegant, Romantic stay...
reviews.text:
Stayed 2 nights in last July with my wife.  I loved not to sleep to enjoy the moments.....
Perfect architecture that suits to the area, friendly staff, better facilities and the food is awesome. In total excellent..

reviews.author: nikunj b
reviews.title: Very beautiful property and excellent service
reviews.text: Great place to stay and very near the Gondala. .Kids play area could be better located and more  lively.The interiors are beautiful and rooms spacious. Very good indoor pool. Courteous staff and good check out timings - 12 noon.

reviews.author: Mukesh Mundra
reviews.title: A perfect hotel to spend quality time
reviews.text: A very well maintained property with amazing view. A must stay property. We stayed here for two days and the stay was amazing. The restaurant has pretty decent choices on a-la carte as well in buffet.

reviews.author: RajanCShah
reviews.title: Amazing Property! Stunning Location!! Simply Perfect !!!
reviews.text:
This is easily one of the most beautiful hotels that I've stayed in. We stayed in there for 2 Nights and 3 Days..... and I must mention that it was a very pleasant and satisfying experience.

The Location and The Hotel Property - The best part of the hotel is it's location. It is simply amazing. One can have breathtaking views from around the hotel. The rooms were just perfect. Rooms have great decor, perfect size, all the modern amenities that a 5 start hotel should provide. Rooms have great views of snow clad mountains dotted with pine trees.

Activities - There are plenty of activities available. The best one is indoor heated swimming pool!! The pool is located in a glass room with view of the snow just outside!! This is the most amazing and unique feature of the hotel. The hotel has a separate game room for activities like TT, Pool Video Games etc. They also provide board games on request. The hotel also has a nice hookah bar where one can just chill with hookah.  There is a lot of activities to do in the hotel.

Food - We had opted for a plan inclusive of breakfast and dinner. Both are provided in a buffet format. The food is delicious. The spread is also reasonable. Just felt that the restaurant size is a bit too small and under-staffed, resulting in slow service during rush time.

Staff - The staff is pretty courteous and pleasant. They are polite and helpful. The service is great. We reached the hotel way too before official check-in time and the staff obliged by giving us early check-in. What I noticed that the staff is really concerned about the experience guest gains and they always vie to make it pleasant for them. This is so commendable!! 

Overall - Khyber is easily one of the best hotels that I've stayed in. Had a great, relaxing an extremely pleasant stay. Will definitely return here - may be in different season, to enjoy great hospitality and location of this hotel.

reviews.author: Pinankd1121
reviews.title: Just Perfect Place for Jannat
reviews.text:
Stayed at the resort for 4N/ 5D in month of April End... Location of Khyber and views from the hotel were absolutely Stunning..it's an amazing place to stay. Every photo is a Perfect postcard.  

At the entrance lobby we were welcomed with Kashmiri Kahawa. (must have!)
we were made comfortable, in mean time they processed the documents and allotted the rooms. We were escorted to the rooms and were introduced to the property. 
All the staff are very polite & very help full. Always a smile on there face. 

Restaurant had a very good Menu.. We were served everyday with variety of impressive delicacy. People who served us took very good care of us... Namingly
Sajad, Bilal, Tanveer, Umar.... and many more. 

Please request for Rooms facing Himalayan Mountains

If you wanna know window to Jannat is.... Visit Khyber Hotel.

reviews.author: Yogesh C
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text:
It's a amazing place to enjoy. Though gulmarg itself is fabulous but except gandola ride there is not much to do. So if you plan to stay in gulmarg for more than 2 days for its weather and snow mountains then it's necessary to have a good hotel. Khyber is a amazing place to enjoy with family. More or less all rooms have mountain view. There is not much difference in premium rooms and luxury rooms besides the balcony in luxury room but it's very cold to sit outside. Even the chaiska tea parlour has a outside sitting. Location of resort is very good it's hardly 5 mins walking from gandola. So no need for taxi in gulmarg if you are staying here. The spa of the resort is also good with lot to offer, spa rates range from 4500 for 60 mins to 10000.
The most amazing thing I liked is the swimming pool. In such cold weather the water and surrounding temp is well controlled. Me and my 5 year old sone enjoyed a lot in the pool. 
Except spa all other activities are complimentary. Though the children gaming zone igloo was not working. Food quality is good. If you can get package inclusive of food it's good as you won't go out for food mainly for dinner. Buffet is around 2000/- per person. Buffet has a good spread with starters also.

We stayed for 2 nights and we enjoyed a lot. I'll surely recommend it.

reviews.author: SanjaySurana
reviews.title: Just Superb!
reviews.text: Stayed at this resort for 3 nights as part of a marriage group. Location of Khyber and views from the hotel were absolutely wonderful.  Hotel is mostly wooden and is beautiful. Rooms are spacious and well done. Staff and service were up to the mark. Khyber has a heated swimming poo with great view  and their Jacuzzi is wonderful. I really enjoyed their Kashmiri Kahwa and massala tea. . Only problem I could see was the navigation from rooms to banquets and other places was a little confusing especially because there were no proper directions laid out. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: kagarwall
reviews.title: Stunning property !
reviews.text: Breath taking property ! Fantastic ! The hotel is really beautiful. It was amazing swimming in the heated pool in a glass house with snow outside. The view is also amazing.
