The rooms are also very nice. BUT very expensive. The food is excellent but also VERY EXPENSIVE. NO FREE WIFI even in the lobby. Service is very good but not excellent.

reviews.author: jitendram2014
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel, Service is Mediocre
reviews.text:
We stayed for a Night at Khyber after hearing very good things about the place. The Hotel is located at one of the best spots offering beautiful view of Mountain clad with snow, There is snow in the property also
Service: Very mediocre considering the overall offering, Five star positioning and the cost. 
Cost: The cost is very high for the services. The Menu is heavily overpriced.
Location: Beautiful. 
Food Options: Good options for food. There are interesting options like a dedicated Cigar Bar and a Chai Bar.

A better service and a fair pricing would definitely move it a notch up

reviews.author: Shweta M
reviews.title: Pricey but no option
reviews.text:
A lot of the glitter of Gulmarg rubs off on The Khyber, and even though you've paid a bomb and received sub-par service (especially for those used to Taj standards), you come back feeling - Where else, in this snowy wonderland.

First a disclaimer - mountains are difficult to live in, basic amenities like water and hot food are difficult to come by, so giving 5 star amenities & service is commendable.

The Non-so-great parts : The grounds are not very expansive, there is a small courtyard and the rooms on the outside look onto the wired fence - not a bad view when everything is covered in snow. The food is decent but no authentic Kashmiri flavours in the breakfast or dinner spreads. There is a kids' play area but it's not well stocked and either are there any caretakers arounds. The corridors get drafts of cold air so be careful while walking down from the spa or pool. 

The Bad - the service is slow and patchy. 

The Awesome - The heated pool and spa area is amazing. A great way to relax sore muscles post skiing or playing in the snow. The glassed pool looks onto the snow & is almost magical. The lobby has little niches with a Kashmiri touch - carpets, carvings etc which are lovely and great for kids to be contained.

The Practical - The Khyber doesn't serve alcohol, but allows you to carry your own in their hookah bar, so do stock up in Srinagar.

reviews.author: dsbhatt
reviews.title: Holiday 2016
reviews.text:
Fantastic property,had a great time.

Courteous staff and well maintained...

The spa is definitely worth trying and the food too is well prepared.....

The view too from their rooms is awesome.A must visit property

reviews.author: Ajay J
reviews.title: Exceptional location and exceptional hospitality
reviews.text:
I am a world traveler and Khyber is one of the best locations I have stayed so far. The location is exceptional, the hospitality is par excellence. The GM Mr. Sujith Herbert is a committed Hotelier and under his guidance the entire team of Khyber works very hard to make the guests stay comfortable.

The huge lobby area is comfortable and warm and furnished in style. The snow clad view of Mountains from the Lobby is stunning.

The staff is very friendly and smiling. 

The rooms are very comfortable, specially the size of the Balcony is very large and the views outside are just perfect.

The Wi Fi worked perfect in every corner of the Hotel.

If one is in Gulmarg, One should be in Khyber.

Best Wishes. Ajay Joshi

reviews.author: vikramsaraf
reviews.title: Heartwarming Experience
reviews.text: Had an awesome stay at Khyber for 2 nights. Incredible location, facilities and sumptuous food. Special thanks to the GM, Mr. Sujith for personally taking care of my son as his feet had become numb after playing in the snow. Would strongly recommend this to anyone visiting Gulmarg. 3 cheers to Khyber!

reviews.author: RadhikaAC
reviews.title: Great stay with amazing views
reviews.text:
Best time would be from Nov-March when it is snowing. The views are amazing. 
It was a family trip with grandparents, parents, children.

ROOMS 
take the rooms with the balconies, has amazing views.  

FOOD 
There is only 1 restaurant but the food is very nice. 
Definitely include breakfast - there is a live dosa/ uttampam counter, live eggs, and a great spread. enough to keep you full till evening snacks. 

There was a dinner buffet as well, but since we don't have big appetites & we were with grandparents & children we ordered  a la carte- we tried the italian chinese & indian. 

They have a seesha lounge too - where you get seesha & starters. They do not serve alcohol so Don't forget to carry your own alcohol & you are allowed to have it in the seesha lounge. 

Coffee shop (forgot the name): Amazing kahawa (local kashmiri tea) & a nice place to enjoy the view & have evening snacks. 

POOL & SPA 
The L'occtaine spa is really nice. Pool has amazing views & is temperature controlled. the changing rooms have nice steam, saunas & a good jacuzzi too. 

TRAVEL 
There is a taxi union in gulmarg, so you have to use those taxis only. 
Khyber is very close to the gondola ride as well, you can actually walk it up. 

2-3 nights would be an appropriate stay if you are going in a group.

reviews.author: Rajiv M
reviews.title: Less than advertised
reviews.text: It's the best hotel in the area. However, not close to a 5 star. The food is average. The service tries but needs more training. The spa is good but it is too far from the rooms.  The buildings are drafty and the room gets cold. I'm not likely to come back.

reviews.author: Trisha C
reviews.title: Perfect holiday
reviews.text:
Superb property nestled in the gorgeous valley of Kashmir. Every thing is perfect. Perfect for families n friends for 4-5 days. Blissful 
The breakfast buffet is very satisfying. Lunch n dinner buffets have a nice spread and yummy food. The rooms are spacious. For family, would recommend taking the villa/appt. 
the skiing is very close by. Hotel takes good care. Even the 2 hour drive from the Srinagar airport to Gulmarg is beautiful and scenic. 
It's a paradise so close to home.

reviews.author: pknrajasthan
reviews.title: Spectacular place to stay in snow
reviews.text:
What can I say about gulmarg and this little hotel set ambist the mountains and deodhar trees ..

Truly kashmiri wooden architecture 
Service with a smile 
All rooms have beautifull views 
The swimming pool is heated and indoor and gives a wow feel with its glass walls thorugh which u can see the snow 

After the somewhat tiring day at gondola the spa is a nice feature to have ..

Overall a wonderfull stay

reviews.author: arenski
reviews.title: A mixed feeling
reviews.text:
We booked our rooms 6 months in advance through the hotel portal. You maybe surprised as the moment you put in your credit card details it will charge your card immediately without asking your pin or any other details. Looked like a off shore account transaction. Scary for a moment.
We traveled in a large group during the 3rd week of March. Its during this time Gulmarg received the highest snowfall of the season. The result was the drive way to the Khyber had snow and cars could not travel up or down resulting in a nightmare to get to the hotel.
We took nearly 2 hours to reach the hotel from the bottom of the drive way. It was very chaotic and Khyber management had no clue as a large number of guests were stuck down. Calls to the hotel would just end up to an answering machine.
We finally walked up with young children and there was no one at the door to greet us. We had to beg the reception to send a car down to pick other guests and our baggage. Overall it was total CHAOS.

Once in the room, we had to wait for an hour for our bags to arrive.

Without doubt the resort is very well located and is very picturesque. The rooms are comfortable and ours had a very good view of the valley.

We were on a 5 day ski holiday. However, we wasted more than an hour everyday to get our ski's etc. from the storage room. Our gear was marked but yet its a task finding your gear.
The major let down was the task to get to and fro Khyber. Most of the taxis would not make the journey up the slope and the hotel cars were not allowed to drop the guests to baby slope. Often cars would get stuck in the narrow drive way and there would be a massive jam. Every day we were fleeced just to go up and down the drive way. Anything from Rs. 600 - 1000 per ride per car. ATV's would charge anything around 600 from the bottom of the hill.
After a long day on the slopes it was a let down to deal with this on a daily basis.
The hotel concierge has no answer or a way out of this. They said they were having issues with the taxi union of Gulmarg and they could not help it. Also, they did not have enough cars incase you wanted to hire a hotel car for the day.

The room was very comfortable. However, the wall where the TV console is placed is made up of  particle board. The adjacent room's TV console is on the same wall as ours. It means that one could very clearly hear TV from the adjoining room. How BIZZARE!!! We would retire to bed early but could not sleep as the TV in the adjoining room would not shut till late in the night. We checked this in all our rooms and it was the same story. Every evening we had to politely ask the hotel staff to ask our neighbours to reduce the TV volume.

The food is decent but the buffet breakfast is pretty average.

The heated swimming pool and jacuzzi is super. We were warned about some tiles being chipped in the pool. 

Its a mixed feeling for us as the resort is beautiful and the rooms are comfortable but there is a lot of stress related with the stay. We are unsure if we will stay again unless there is a huge improvement. 

As of now we are left disappointed!

reviews.author: Shwetasree
reviews.title: Does not live up to the hype
reviews.text:
When we were driving up to Khyber I was skeptical. The steep cobblestone driveway covered with black ice was treacherous to say the least and our Toyota Innova was not equipped to do the climb. We called the hotel who asked us to essentially go figure. Disappointing for a property of this nature. Taxis just below were making a killing charging guests Rs. 600 to take them up 300 metres.
The entrance was impressive and the lobby is awe inspiring. Check in was smooth and the staff (both at the reception and the restaurant) were super nice to us throughout our stay - attentive, polite, friendly and helpful.
We spent the initial hour or so soaking in the stunning views and then eventually it hit me - the noise. I will not be exaggerating if I say that this is the noisiest mountain resort that I've ever been to. At nearly 400 USD a night (for a basic room - mine!) that's a big shocker and an immediate thumbs down for the place. The lobby is a veritable fish market - the place seems to attract (and unfortunately encourage) loud patrons. The bar opens into the lobby and the raucousness wafts into the resto as well which is a chaotic melee of loud folks and running children. They appear to have kept all the staff hanging around the lobby to service the steady stream of guests (with the late snowfall this year, the place seems full even in March) with the result that housekeeping completely sucks. For every little thing much follow up was needed.
But the worst is yet to come...paper thin room walls. I am writing this at midnight - second midnight in a row when I am waiting for my neighboring room to get done with their film watching so I can sleep. After a long day at the slopes I have resigned myself to less than 7 hours of sleep AGAIN! I knocked on their door and requested a reduction of TV volume but realised that it wasn't that high in the first place. 
Safety concerns - swimming pool had a broken tile and a kid cut her finger badly in front of me...
The L'Occitane Spa was very average - the therapists didn't do such a great job - yes I gave them positive reviews at the time but came back to the room to a lower back pain that aggravated over the course of the night.
They're killing it because of the lack of competition but honestly the place needs to do more about "the experience".

reviews.author: ra1189
reviews.title: Worth a stay!
reviews.text:
A wonderful hotel wit great views, great staff and great food as well! The day we stayed at the hotel, there was an amazing snow shower and the views from the hotel were just breathtaking. The spa and the swimming pool are worth giving a go. Everything was perfect except the heating was not really proper in some areas of the hotel - some areas were really cold. 

Avoid room 6005 in cold weather as the bathroom has no heating and it was really really cold in there.

reviews.author: Rajneesh J
reviews.title: Luxury in the lap of nature
reviews.text: Beautiful resort and very well located at the centre. Enjoyed our stay thoroughly. Had a wonderful and luxurious stay. The amenities were too good. Just one word, expand restaurant area as in the morning it was too crowded and could not relish that...overall a great and pleasurable stay.

reviews.author: HimanshuJindal
reviews.title: Simply Awesome
reviews.text:
this hotel is one of the best in which i have stayed ,simply classy

Value for money..i paid rs.25000 but it worth

ambiance is awesome...hotel location is fantastic just view the sunrise from mountains covered with snow
dinner  buffet is awesome

reviews.author: Gautam73
reviews.title: Fabulous hotel
reviews.text: We visited the Khyber in Feb 2016 and loved it. It was our first visit to Gulmarg and it turned it out to be amazing. Everything from the rooms, the food and the service were very good. The property is very well located and with very easy access to the ski slopes. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anybody planning to go.

reviews.author: Nitin A
reviews.title: Luxury
reviews.text:
Very good and luxurious hotel. The moment we stepped in the lobby, we were impressed with the lavishness of hotel. The hotel was very good!! Spa/ jacuzziwas very good! 
Service was exceptionally quick. Very impressed on that part. But not at the restaurant, where it was slow. 
Some lackings though - 
the kids play area was hardly anything.... The kind of hotel that Khyber is - a much better play area was expected!!
Restaurant - Kashmiri food served was not authentic, the service not very prompt. The staff at restaurant seemed to be bit unwelcoming kinds as compared to the staff at any other area of hotel. 
The concierge was hardly of any help to plan day trips!! 
But all these shortcomings were overlooked by the beauty of gulmarg and the hotel itself. Having a dip in warm pool, with views of snow all around was a heavenly experience. 
Definitely an expensive property, but then it's a lavish one!!
If it fits in budget, don't look anywhere else in gulmarg!!

reviews.author: Bhavna2016
reviews.title: Warm hospitality, tasty food, and a lovely pool !
reviews.text: Nice hotel with simple tasty food and warm service from all staff especially Ishfaq who made a special effort to make sure we were well looked after. Chef veer organised a delicious dinner for us for a special occassion. All our demands were happily met by Basharat and Jerin whether it was F and B or housekeeping. Memorable trip in all thanks to the staff at khyber. The pool and spa were lovely and heated perfectly to make you forget the cold outside!

reviews.author: Michael C
reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.text:
Khyber is a nice resort, but not worth the money.
We booked directly for 3 persons, accepted the rate, but when we arrived we were told we had to pay additional 3000 rs for extra bed as the rate was only for double room even I think we already had paid enough.
We raised it to the reservation manager, but no help here.
Our room on the ground floor was extreme noisy, both from the neighbouring room as well from the corridor, so we contacted the reception first day, but they weren't able to help. Same the next day after very limited sleep, but were again told, they had only a small basement room available, which would be too small for 3 of us.
3rd day, we were pretty tired after 2 nights with little sleep, we asked to meet the Hotel Manager. He wasn't available, but would come in later. 
Eventually we met, and he was fully aware about the problem with noise in the rooms as so many are complaining !!
He would try to sort something out. Which he actually did later in the evening, so we shifted to a 2nd floor room.
Food is basic indian, taste fine, but not exciting,  not up to 4 or 5 * standard. 

Not cheap :say 950 rs for a Club sandwich., but when you stay at khyber, you better be prepared to pay for everything : bed 3000 rs, soft drink 250 rs., tea and cake 650 rs, internet 750 rs per day, all plus taxes 
The 500 meter taxi ride down or up the steep hill side to the road from the hotel can be negotiated down to 3-400 rs.  
 .

reviews.author: SYK3
reviews.title: Third great stay at The Khyber
reviews.text:
Even though there was considerably less snow this year due to the early onset of warm weather, the experience we had at Khyber was thoroughly enjoyable.
They have upped the quality of the F&B compared to the last two years.
The service was also a notch above the past - with exceptional care especially by Ishfaq and Brijkishore in the restaurant.
Thanks also to the staff in the ski room especially during the morning and evening rush time for being patient with a lot of the first time skiers.

reviews.author: Krishan S
reviews.title: Below average stay
reviews.text: Poor service and response to complaints made our stay average in khyber resorts gurnard.  The check in took us good hour and a half as we were told the check in time is 2pm which wasn't told to us at time of booking. The service staff was always busy in service large groups leaving individual guests unattended many a times. The hotel had no bar & that came as a huge shock. Overall disappointed.

reviews.author: MsPragati
reviews.title: spectacular
reviews.text: We spent the last week of december at this gorgeous resort nestled in the beautiful breathtaking gulmarg valley. Right from the onset, when we landed in Srinagar, the hospitality by Khyber staff was just immaculate. They assisted us with the luggage and we were in the hotel cab immediately. Highly recommend booking a cab through the hotel , there are innumerable checkposts on the way to the hotel and the hotel chauffeurs handle them promptly. The stay at the hotel was superbly relaxing and enjoyable. The welcome drink- the traditional Kahwa is droolworthy. Their spa , indoor pool and the evr helpful staff - made our stay totally memorable.

reviews.author: Ashir
reviews.title: Short stay
reviews.text: We visited Khyber recently. We were there for one night. Superb hotel, nice interiors and surrounded by snow. Can't get better than this. But once we checked in the difference between taj n Khyber started. No warm welcome. The room 6003 were we stayed didn't have hot water it had only warm water. With -7 degrees outside and paying almost 24 k per night without food u at least expect hot water 24 hrs. After complaining thrice nothing happened. Even in breakfast while I was still having food they rudely closed all the counters even without informing. Inshort they have that attitude that in gulmarg it's their monopoly. Whether u are satisfied or not u have to stay there. Beautiful hotel no doubt about it.

reviews.author: PriyaSuri
reviews.title: Brilliant Hotel
reviews.text: From the minute we entered the hotel, everything was seamless. The check-in process was quick and they had upgraded us to Luxury Balcony room. That was a big room. They view from the room & bathroom was stunning. The indoor pool was very nice. Didn't have the time to check out spa. Food was average and a bit over-priced. It's very well located next to the ski entrance. I felt a 2 night stay was short and would definitely like to go back again.

reviews.author: sjaveri
reviews.title: Terrible service ruins a potentially magical stay in Gulmarg!
reviews.text:
Pros :

Stunning views, fantastic location near the Gulmarg gondola.
Exceptional health club and heated swimming pool
Very spacious and well decorated rooms with great central heating
Large breakfast and dinner buffet spread

Cons : 
Abysmal service, the worst i have experienced in a luxury hotel
Poorly maintained games room, no staff nearby to help and equipment missing or broken
No free WiFi
No taxi service unless you want to visit the airport only

This place could easily have been one of the best places to stay at all over India, there is an incredible amount of potential. However, the facilities (aside from the health club) are not well maintained at all. The snooker table has places where the cloth has torn, the table tennis table didn't have a ball that we could use. Their is a foosball table as well with a ball missing, and the air hockey table didn't have running electricity. They have some console games as well but those didn't work either. Upon calling someone to help us, we waited nearly 20 minutes and finally left. The staff was not particularly warm in general, we stayed in other places in Kashmir at half the cost and the staff was much nicer. The worst was when we wanted a taxi to take us down the mountain from Gulmarg to Tanmarg. The hotel informed us the only taxi available is to the airport and we cannot go anywhere else due to union issues. We had a flight to catch at Srinagar and we already had a car waiting to take us there, all we had to do was take a car from the hotel and descend down the mountain. After refusing to give us a taxi, we requested them to offer us a taxi to the gondola atleast where we could perhaps find another tourist taxi willing to take us down. Even that option was not entertained by their staff. Despite the poor weather conditions (-8 and snowing heavily), they probably expected us to walk on our own with our luggage down their hotel slope for 10-15 minutes and hope to get a taxi ourselves. Either that or pay 4000 for a taxi to the airport. When you stay at a luxury hotel, you don't expect to ever have to worry about these things, yet when something as basic as transportation cannot be provided, it's a real shame. Will not come here again.

reviews.author: Highlandtrekker
reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.text: Stayed in the hotel for two days . It has an excellent location . It's a beautiful property and have lovely interiors . The whole of Gulmarg was covered with snow at that time. The food is ok , bfast is a good spread but the restaurant is expensive . They have a good spa . The reception teams needs to be pushed a bit . They are slow to respond and don't have ready answers .

reviews.author: Gautam_Meetu
reviews.title: A 5 Star property in Gulmarg
reviews.text: It's a wonderful 5 star hotel at 9000 Ft above sea level, with lounges, a huge dining hall, coffee lounges, all wth huge windows and facing the hills / forests. It has a fanstatic Spa and a heated swimming pool looking out in the lawns, which were covered with snow when we visited. Typical chain hotel, with all modern amenities and conforts. The only draw back, was that it does not have views of the Gulmarg Valley. But overall great experience of playing in the snow in the lawns and coming back to the comforts of a star hotel.

reviews.author: doshiketan
reviews.title: "FIVE STAR HOTEL WITHOUT HOSPITALITY"
reviews.text:
Stayed at khyber from 5 to 9 feb with my son. My bad experience started even before i checked in. After booking long back, i tried to contact them by telephone atleast 30-40 times for requesting twin bed room but either no one picks up phone or line is busy or told to wait n then line gets disconnected . Finally i wrote mail request n then instead of checking content of mail, i was sent quote for room rate so again i sent mail informing that i already have booking n i need twin bed room. Then i got very rude reply .
At the time of check in i told mr Bilal that i had sent mail for twin bed room n he said he doesn't have any information about my request but kindly agreed for providing extra bed but it was very uncomfortable n I couldn't sleep for first two nights .
Check in was done at counter itself instead of lounge n no welcome drink was provided to us for reasons unknown to us. 
After reaching room waited a long for my bags to arrive but after many calls also it didn't arrived n finally i told them that i m coming to reception personally n then it came after more than an hour .
Same day went to spa n was given locker key which was already occupied by someone else n had to change the keys. 
Next day morning while at breakfast table no one was ready to attend for tea/coffee n finally caught hold of one of the server n got tea.
Next day room was cleaned but tea cups were not changed n replenishment was not done. Called housekeeping many times but it didn't came.as a last resort went to reception n talked to Mr.Manzoor informing about all above mentioned problem n still after reaching room nothing happened inspite of promise made by mr Manzoor, finally shouted at housekeeping n then cups n tea replenishment came .  
Next day evening when returned to room, electronic key was not working so opened room with the help of housekeeping staff n then requested him to replace key but it didn't came for hour. Called reception still it didn't came n then again went to reception n fortunately met Mr.Sujith Herbert GM of property n explained him all above facts. Things turn around after talking to Mr Sujith . He is the man n Mr.Shyam from restaurant because of whom i rated khyber 3 stars otherwise i would have given them 1 star rating only. As a very kind gesture mr Sujith offered us complimentary dinner n also took very special care even at the time of check out by sending bell boy immediately n confirming if all luggage came or not?
Same day morning at breakfast table after ordering tea/coffee three times to different servers it didn't came n finally when it came only coffee was served n again v had to talked to manager on duty n then it came properly.
Apart from above issues, cleanliness of general area needs lot of improvement.
As far as rooms are concerned, its well done with very good view. Also their spa/swimming pool was best amongst all hotels i have visited world over. 
Overall its very good property but needs more people like Mr Sujith /shyam to run it better to meet expectations of any five star grade hotel.

reviews.author: akhilbhansali
reviews.title: Amazing location, good service average food
reviews.text: This resort is an amazing place for family outing. Right in the heart of Gulmarg. Very good view. The food however seems to be very average and expensive. The indoor pool seems to be an unique feature which is hard to find in a place with -4 C temp. Hot water is available round the clock, you will know the importance of this when you compare this feature to the other hotels in Kashmir. I enjoyed my stay there. Better food could have made the trip five star.

reviews.author: PuneetDave
reviews.title: Khyber...U r just awesome...
reviews.text:
Couple of days back i stayed in Khyber for three nights. I and my wife enjoyed the gulmarg truly. Luxury carved in Pine woods. Location and picturesque sight is like the nectar for eyes. Room quiet spacious and comfortable. Swimming pool ans spa quite soothing for body.
Food is bit expensive but worth to have. During stay i faced a problem of frequent power cut. Rest as per of what i expect when i reserve it.

reviews.author: Bhappy0143
reviews.title: Luxurious resort, warm staff, beautiful location
reviews.text:
Our decision to stay at Khyber resort in Gulmarg for our 6th anniversary was best over nearby hotels (Highland park, Vintage etc). We finalised Khyber as we were visiting Gulmarg in winters during 2-5 degrees temp with our 3 months baby. The resort is centrally heated, offers all required amenities and has Luxury room with Himalayan mountain view which my husband couldn't let go. The staff is very warm and is readily available to serve you at all time. Food is way beyond expectation. Dinner buffet and breakfast buffet had many varieties and I couldn't stop myself from trying it all.
The indoor heated pool is super awesome. The himalayan view while swimming is mindblowing.
We took a taxi from airport to Khyber and it cost us Rs. 2000 one side. The driver Umar Amin (09419593474) is nice and very helpful guy.
Unexpected Gulmarg has warm people around, smiling, helpful. I think its a major point that added to the overall satisfying experience of staying at Khyber.
Keep it up!

reviews.author: ajay_satija7
reviews.title: Good hotel but need better staff trainning
reviews.text: We stayed in hotel khyber gulmarg. It a a new resort and good during winters. The attitude of the staff however is not nice. We were not allotted room for good one hour in spite of having a confirmed reservation and there was no apology. The rooms got too hot & in spite of several complaints the fault was not rectified. The room service is very slow and they took almost 1 hour for a sandwich to arrive. Better staff training required if they want to improve services.

reviews.author: Ashok C
reviews.title: Unbelievably luxurious and amazing location
reviews.text:
My advice to anyone visiting Kashmir is to stay in this hotel to have a splendid views and strategic location to the cable car. Though the view may be not as good as highland park, it still is the best serviced hotel in whole Kasmir valley. We just were able to have one lunch due to paucity of time, we had amazing food and great view. The staff is service oriented and well cultured true to kasmiriat.
Must visit property.

reviews.author: ploytenkate
reviews.title: Hotel with a view
reviews.text:
Khyber arguably offers the best view of the Himalayas among hotels in Gulmarg. The property is centrally located with a few steps away from a Gondola ride, shops and ski slopes. 

We just came back from a three-night stay in February which is also one of the busiest months for Gulmarg. Indians and foreigners staying here mostly come to ski or snowboard. 

You can book a hotel car pickup from the Srinagar airport for 4,000 Rupees and it would take you 1.5 hours to get to the hotel. Local cars, however, are cheaper.

Upsides:

1.) Loccitane Spa is a must. Lives up to its name. Would recommend its Signature Lemon Balm massage. Treat yourself for 90 minutes after a long-day of skiing or walking up and down the hills.

2.) Heated swimming pool, fitness and wellness facility: The mountain view from the pool is stunning. The fitness is well-equipped w/ treadmills and weights. The locker room has well-maintained sauna, steam rooms and jacuzzis. The staff is polite.

3.) Rooms offer great views and spacious.

4.) Most of the staff (the spa, the fitness and an IT lady) are responsive and polite.

Downsides:

1.) The Internet here is chargeable at 750
Rupee/day with relatively slow speed and frequent disruptions.

2.) No shuttles or golf carts available from the hotel going up and down to the main road. This makes it inconvenient for the guest, especially the elders or tiring skiers. Be prepared to walk up and down yourself.

3.) Empty minibar. Or the staff failed to stock it up otherwise.

4.) Unreliable power system. Frequent blackout.

5.) We enjoyed local Indian food but international menu isn't quite up to par. The breakfast spread was ok but served Nescafé (not freshly brewed coffee until we asked for new ones). Room service needs improvement with slow pre- and post- services. Certain food on the menu can't be ordered until after 7.30 pm. 

6.) Amenities aren't quite 5-star standards. No shaving cream. No qtips.

7.) No information from staff about the gondola or ski shops. They basically refer you to touts outside the hotel.

reviews.author: Bhavik Khera
reviews.title: Himalayan King
reviews.text:
truly a great place to stay if visiting Gulmarg. ideally located with close access to all the activities around gulmarg. great hotel spaces. good food. ask them to do a private dinner at the top and bonfire in the lawns on a nice day (will cost extra). 

lounge for consuming alcohol is available but you need to take your own. food is good and buffets are a good spread. good activity room for children.

reviews.author: Rishiraj17
reviews.title: Not seen a better resort!!
reviews.text: I visited the Khyber with family in November 2015, the experience was amazing to say the least, we were put up in one of the deluxe rooms that I shall strongly recommend, since these have a balcony that has a recliner chair and a beautiful head lamp on top. The resort is tastefully done to meet international standards and is unexpected to disappoint any tourist from any walk of life. We spent half a day looking around the place as the swimming pool, gym and spa were located at various corners of this vast property, the lobby is very beautiful and should be seen patiently ,the gym is impressive and open till 11pm, so gives enough time to relax after a day of trek and adventure. The kids play area is equipped with a play station, foosball and table tennis. Security is impressive but polite. The bathrooms are very good since these are of concern to a lot of travelers, one can be reassured the bathrooms are very well designed with a huge tub that can accommodate two adults. We had snow all around our balconies and that was exactly what we came for. Sipping a warm cup of coffee in a balcony surrounded by snow is mesmerizing. The only flipside was the food that probably didn’t match the standards, but it was ok, not bad. The resort is conveniently located near the Gondola entry point, so one can walk down, a tourist guide is helpful as he purchases Gondola tickets before hand and keeps sledgewallas away. Snow scooter for level 1 and 2 should not cost more than Rs 1000 and guide will take Rs 600, rented shoes and jackets for Rs 400 for one person, skis’ with teacher comes at Rs 600 per person for one hour, and Gondola till Level 2 is Rs 1400 per person. I strongly recommend going to Level 2, its clean and very beautiful, but don’t get fleeced by touts offering skis’ as walking in snow is more enjoyable and fun. Khyber is the place to be in Gulmarg if one can afford it, because it’s costly, but well worth it.

reviews.author: RMAggar
reviews.title: Magnificent and Impressive
reviews.text:
Gulmarg is one of the most inspiring places I visited first in 1972 and then in 1974 and planned once again in October 2015. We were told that there is a striking change and major transformation in hotels at Gulmarg since 1974 and therefore, while browsing internet to find out which hotel to reserve for our holidays in Gulmarg, we were highly impressed by the positive reviews of the Khyber; and if this was not enough, I was compelled to get our accommodation pre-reserved because I was mesmerised by the views of the hills all-around and the valley down from a distance the Restaurant ‘NOUF’ in the Khyber offered.  After checking in I first of all went to the deck of the ‘Nouf’ and relaxed there for quite some time, thinking that we shall have our evening tea/ drinks there.  Thereafter we checked in our room and it exceeded all my expectations; because the huge bay-window of the room gave me the same view as that while sitting on the deck of Rouf.  We all know that the first impressions are long lasting. How correct is this saying.
Khyber in Gulmarg is in stark departure from the rest of all other hotels in Gulmarg. It is at a short distance upwards from Gondola and All-Terrain Vehicles stand. It is magnificent and impressive. It is vast and newly constructed.   I was highly impressed by the architecture, designing, the amount spent especially on the quality and quantity of wood used all-around the resort. It is located on the hilltop in the lap of other hills ever green Pine and Fir trees on two sides, hills on the third side and valley on the rest and amidst score of pine trees.   Linen was neat and clean. Bath room was spacious and with all modern quality fittings. Room service was remarkable. Hot water indoor swimming pool was neat and impressive. We enjoyed the services of health club and the gym. Complimentary breakfast spread was superb.  However, in Kashmir’s such a good resort we could not get good kashmiri food. Had the ala-carte food been good (as expected), the resort could get my par-excellent.

reviews.author: Sagar P
reviews.title: Brilliant
reviews.text: Very friendly staff, including the Hotel Management. The food, rooms and the ambience of the resort are to be cherished for life. In house medical services are provided, which can be necessary if one goes for skiing or other adventure sports. The best resort to stay if you go to Gulmarg!

reviews.author: aamer_ali
reviews.title: 5 star hotel with spectacular views
reviews.text: I booked this hotel after reading the reviews on tripadvisor and the hotel met our expectations barring some minor hiccups. This 5 star hotel is optimum placed offering spectacular views to the Himalayas and at the same time a 10 minute walk to the Gulmarg Gondola Station. I stayed here for two nights on the 4th and 5th January with my wife and 3 small children and had booked the Himalayan view room. Room 2011 was on the first floor , centrally located and had the best views of the hotel. My appreciation to the staff for having arranged one of the best room for us. It was snowing when we arrived and the balcony views were just surreal. However one must understand that when arriving at the hotel a change of car is required at Tangmarg during January when it usually snows as only cars fitted with chain tires are allowed to go upto Gulmarg. Waiting times can be long. Also Boots and Jackets that are rented are not allowed inside the hotel premise. They have a cloak room where you can store them prior to entering the hotel, however with small children this hassle is best avoided if you don’t wear them at all and carry them instead. A minor hiccup at the time of check-in was that our luggage was not delivered to our room promptly. It arrived after I had spoken to the front desk about 2 hours post check-in. The welcome drink , Kashmiri kahwa was refreshing indeed, however nothing was served to our three children. We were guided promptly to our room and Nazia briefed us about the room and hotel facilities adequately. The Himalayan view room lives to its name, “experience like a star”, and like celebrities did indeed we experience. The view is just awesome, the best in my entire stay of hotels so far. Nothing  beats the snow capped himlayan mountains and the snow studded fir trees infront of the white hotel grounds.  From snowfall, to sunshine to fog, each has its own marvelous view. The Room was fabulously large, well furnished, and very warm even with sub-zero temperatures outside. The sofa turned into an extra bed and was useful when you have children around.  The toilet also had the himlayan view and the kids relished every moment in the bubble bath tub. Hot water was immediate, and plenty and never ran out even after we filled the tub to the brim.  The hotel’s Igloo was well equipped, table tennis, carom, air hockey, kept the children occupied, however the playstation joysticks weren’t working. The Restaurant cloves had delicious north/ south Indian food and kashmiri cusine. The freshly prepared hot dosas and omlete during breakfast were a hit with the kids. The pasta corner was great at dinner.  I particularly enjoyed the non-vegetarian kashmiri cusine and the sweet dishes laced with kashmiri saffron. Instead of Ala-carte I would advise families to go for the dinner buffet as children get included complimentary. The hotel grounds had a feet of snow and was enough for us to enjoy thoroughly. Last but not the least returning to the hotel after a tiring day and then swimming in their heated pool with the amazing views to the pristine nature is truly an unforgettable experience, something that should be in your list of things to do. The Airport drop arranged by the hotel concierge was fine. I would advise that you start at-least 5 hours prior to your flight departure time. The spectacular views of this hotel have been ingrained in my memory forever and I truly look forward to staying here again.

reviews.author: Shruti P
reviews.title: Luxury you'll fall in love with
reviews.text: I travelled with my family in the month of October.  Though we checked in before time we were served with kehwa while our rooms were being prepared.  My young toddler had a wonderful time running here and there which was met with a smile by the courteous and friendly staff. Very near to the gandola ride this is the place to stay in gulmarg.

reviews.author: Hemzzy
reviews.title: Luxury in a winter wonderland
reviews.text: Hotel is very luxurious, rooms and bathrooms included. Kahwa Tea (welcome drink) was a special treat.  Staff and Management were friendly and especially Zaffir Malik who was always at our service. The food was delicious most of all the vegetarian Kashmiri dishes.

reviews.author: Nirmal C
reviews.title: An experience, U'll yearn to repeat
reviews.text:
I don't understand why i didn't visit this place enough!
Is the question that came to my mind when my stay in Khyber - Gulmarg was coming to an end. I went there as a family holiday, we were 6 of us (My parents, sister, brother in law, my wife & me).
So cherished and fun was my trip that a greedy part of me felt i should not tell more people about it, as that would help preserve this wonderful place from commercialisation.
To Illustrate my point, lets start with Travel time, from Mumbai. It takes only 8 hours tops to reach Khyber - Gulmarg. Compare that to Manali and 8 hours is only from Chandighar to Manali.
Even before the plane lands, Srinarag literally hugs you with its snow capped mountain range, which i may add is a breath taking sight. Being done with this first impression, in a matter of 2 hours you are at the lobby of Khyber where you will meet the most courteous and warm staff to usher into your room, which is in stark contrast to the freezing temperatures outside.
The place is centrally heated, kawaz in the lobby area are on the house and its surprising how khyber functions so effortlessly in such adverse weather conditions. The secret is its staff. Hats off to them , their energy, their dedication, attention to detail is something words cannot do justice to and i think they are definitely drinking some Kashmiri concoction that gives them superhuman strength to do their work.;)
In the lobby & restaurant there are:
Shyam, Basharat, Ativ, Saptrishi & Aabid who you will see on their toes around the clock & at the pool side which faces the Affarwat you'll find Naseer & Zubaida who single handily cater to a plethora of guests of different whims & requests. 
The food is something the taste of which i yet recall fondly and the view from the rooms can be visualise just by closing the eyes, once you've been there.
If Gulmarg is the place one is hitting, Khyber is the place to be.
I look forward to planning a trip in summer where the landscape will be diffrent but the faces will be same at Khyber. :)

reviews.author: rahulg77
reviews.title: True luxury in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
I went to Gulmarg with my wife and son. Everything was perfect right from check in. The staff was very courteous. The GM - Surjit Herbert was around in the lobby and spending time meeting all the guest. We got kahwa as welcome drink and since. My son didn't want kahwa he ordered a hot chocolate for him

The dinner and breakfast was also good and delicious. As good as one can expect up in the mountains. Only thing I didn't enjoy was the dessert on both the nights we had dinner there. They should do something about the quality of desserts. 

The spa was of excellent quality. 

Couldn't fault even one thing. Will definitely stay there if I travel with my family.

reviews.author: palanivelbabu
reviews.title: THE BEST EXPERIENCE IN GULMARG
reviews.text:
Beautifully located with a scenic view from all sides and the main places of interest are easily accessible from this resort. The food they serve is amazing and do not forget to be lost by the taste of the BAKED YOGURT.Service is good and very courteous staff.
The best place to stay at GULMARG..

reviews.author: Arshad786848
reviews.title: Super Place to Visit
reviews.text: This is a place where a person should visit if he is visiting Kashmir, though little expensive but a place for value of Money. I was fully satisfied and plans to visit next time shortly. The food was good and the place was super, the staff was excellent.

reviews.author: ashwika2008
reviews.title: Khyber Spa and resorts
reviews.text:
We went to Kashmir in the month of November...and chose to stay in Khyber for 1 night and I am glad we did...we were lucky to get snow fall a night before we reached Gulmarg.The whole of Kyhber was covered in snow..It was all so beautiful..I could open the window of my room and touch snow..The resort is truely a luxury resort..Staff is very helpful n courteous. They have an insulated swimming pool which was unfortunately under renovation when we went..They have a nice gym and..I loved the seating areas they have kept at different places in the resort..
Food is very expensive though..So go for a package deal
.. I would strongly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: binalv
reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text:
Only 2 thing which is good.. comfort stay and scenic beauty. Except these two it's OVERRATED. Services and food is pathetic. In buffet as well as in room service they serve ice cold food and when you complaint they don't even bother to rectify or apologise.
There's not a single service which u can say is 5 star quality whether you take in room dining or housekeeping or laundry service or any service.
There are few staff to whom if you tell that this is the mistake instead of accepting they keep on arguing unless you shut up or complaint to manager.
A big disappointment.

reviews.author: Anamika_Butalia
reviews.title: Great hotel, horrible service!
reviews.text:
For my birthday recently, I decided to do a winter holiday in Kashmir with a group of eight comprising family and friends. In Gulmarg, we stayed at The Khyber and were mesmerised by the property—its location, views, property as well as rooms. We stayed for two nights. 

Although we had a really pleasant stay, since the rooms are very comfortable and spacious, the food is good, there were a LOT of negatives!! 

On check-in, the front office desk didn't even take us through the hotel's offerings—the various restaurants, the spa, the pool, etc. In fact, when I enquired about the pool, they mentioned that it was closed due to maintenance and would inform me when it opens up. I didn't hear back from them at all. On my last day, I decided to walk around the property before checkout and much to my dismay found that the pool had been fully-operational during the period of our stay.

The next evening, we ordered some room service and no one showed up with our order. No one even called to express regret at missing the order. It's like they'd forgotten or that we were unheard.

Neither did the housekeeping staff give us proper instructions on using the heating system. So, every few hours, we had to call and ask for someone to come and fix the heating, change temperature, etc. 

When you go to a place like this, you expect exemplary service. Unfortunately, The Khyber fails in this very category. During checkout, the front office desk didn't even ask whether we had a pleasant stay!! For the hospitality industry, this is an offending low! I had to ask to fill up a feedback form to put down our grievances.

reviews.author: Namy10
reviews.title: Best place in Gulmarg...
reviews.text:
We booked 2 rooms in Khyber. We stayed in the month of November.
 
It's a human marvel & architecture at a place at this altitude. The lobby is grand . You are welcomed warmly and the check in procedure is completed at Chaikash with "Kahwa"  as Welcome Drink.
 
We were escorted to the room and explained all the functionality. The rooms are good carpeted and excellent view from the room.

The hotel is just a few minutes walk from the gondola station.

The hotel is beautifully maintained throughout. They have a play are called Igloo which is much needed as there is not much to do after sunset.

The only downside to this magnificent hotel is the F & B services. We were booked on a breakfast and dinner plan. All the days we were there the buffet was a complete letdown. The buffet spread was minimalistic. This was brought to the notice of the duty manager. He tried making up by offering a complimentary starter.

All in all a great place to be when in Gulmarg

reviews.author: Sopy80
reviews.title: Fairy Tail Rooms and Hotel
reviews.text:
The only Four star hotel in the vicinity , a wooden hotel with real Kashmir art and architecture.The grand entrance and the big chandler above the entrance gives the feeling of grand welcome and richness of the culture.
The lobby is well furnished and decorated with authenticated kashmirii karigiri including the seating arrangement and their choice of covers which represents nice nakashi. The staff bestows all the goodness of the Kashmiri hospitality and culture and same applies to the food which has its own taste and a treat to test buds.
The Rooms are grand and best with their available resources , one must see the Gym area which has huge glass with the view of deonar trees and falling snow..  
Over all its a treat to eyes and mouth .. go ahead and enjoy it

reviews.author: Traveller7019
reviews.title: Breathtaking, ideal place to stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The hotel is fabulous and serves very delicious food. They serve authentic Kashmiri Wazwan apart from the International cuisine that they are very good at. The location and the view is breathtaking. We were fortunate to witness the season's first snowfall too. The rooms are high end, the hotel is warm. The staff are very welcoming and always there to help you.

A must visit for anyone visiting Gulmarg. We will be back for a longer duration soon!

reviews.author: Imraan S
reviews.title: Gulmarg Tour
reviews.text:
Our first ever snow experience as sunny South Africa rarely experiences snow.  Our stay at The Khyber was thoroughly enjoyable. I traveled with my wife and 5 children and we received a warm reception. The rooms were flawless and our needs were promptly attended too. The only thing that I could have picked on which wasn't a really big deal anyway was the toilet rolls which had a paper consistency. No free wifi was also a disadvantage for a foreigner as my prepaid SIM card purchased with roaming in Mumbai did not work in Gulmarg as it is a "Restricted Area" which made communication difficult. 
Special Thanks to Shyam at The Cloves and Nazia at reception for the warm hospitality. I would recommend using a Tour Guide when visiting the Gondolas as their cost for the day is 600INR. Our Guide Mama made it easier for us as he had purchased our tickets and negotiated tariffs for use of the snowmobiles and skiing. Our Driver Mushtaq 9906656151 arranged Mama for us. We used the service of Mushtaq as he operates a 4 wheel drive SUV that is capable of withstanding snow ridden roads and his tariffs are reasonable. 
Highly recommended for all South Africans to visit who want a snow resort

reviews.author: Adventure601895
reviews.title: I can never forget this place^^
reviews.text: Food was yummy! View is awesome! Cleanliness is right at the top! Service is great! I would like to give recognition to this staffs: Bilal, Sajad & Nawwaz; Thank you for making our stay memorable! Everything there is so convenient for the customers to obtain any information we want. This is the hotel that definitely most will want to return again!

reviews.author: vikas1205
reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: Just perfect...right from reception to room service to restaurents to check out...love everything..location is just too perfect and view from the rooms towards the hills is mesmerizing..amazing buffet at dinner and breakfast..and not to forget the lovely Kahwa served at the time of check-in

reviews.author: RKD
reviews.title: "Best place to stay with family its real paradise on earth"
reviews.text: This property was booked by my travel agent Sandhya from "Redchilli Holidays" .. I must be thankful to her for giving our family a memorable as well as beautiful stay. Amazing staff with very polite and humble nature and plus point is awesome location of this property, And with all such nice thing when you get your food right in taste and a good spread of variety into it than it becomes for joyful ... The view from our room was fantastic the forest and hillside full of ice .. uffff.... simply great stay.

reviews.author: Himani Aggarwal Gupta
reviews.title: Initial glitches but awesome experience.. best hotel in Gulmarg!
reviews.text:
Booking initially happened with some technical mistake where website booked 3 adults instead of 2 adults + 1 child sharing bed. Mr Irshad was super rude in telling me that website has no technical issues and nothing more he can do about my payment of Rs. 49000.
But but but, Mr Jerin Phillips who is a FOM of Khyber, immediately called me and assured me that everything wud be taken care of. He also offered us a category upgrade with some other discounts as well. 

Anyway, airport pick up was smooth and transit happened in no time. Welcome was very warm personally by Mr. Phillips and awesome kashmiri kahwah. He happily called his chef to share the recipe of kahwah which my husband requested for. No wonder kahwah was out of the world. 

Khyber rooms are very neat and clean with lot of space and beautiful sit out and view. My bad luck happened when I immediately felt dizzy and breathless and had to be bed ridden completely. Next morning at 6:45 am we requested for a doctor on duty. Immediately Dr. zareen (not sure of the name I guess) came over, did few tests and administered oxygen etc. Of course, I didn't feel better immediately but he took so much extra care to come and check twice in a day, kept tab on medicines and other issues that we felt very safe. The need of calling him didn't arise coz doctor was very proactive.This part of stay deserves special mention as I have never come across any doctor who attends to his patient proactively and who is so caring. I felt so appreciative.

Food at Khyber was good, free of those extra spices and tasty at the same time. Buffet breakfast can be improved with extra creativity and thought. Lot of room for improvement in menu options and variety.

Everything else was impeccable and proved its rating. Must stay!

reviews.author: KETAN   P
reviews.title: EXCELLENT  HOSPITALITY
reviews.text:
To stay at The Khyber ,  Gulmarg, is an excellent  experience. To be precise its an experience  of  lifetime. Its staff, right from the reception to Dinning  area, Security  personnel  all were marvellous. The kind of personal touch they give to you is just to be experienced  once in life. Mr Zaffar Malik, in particular  was absolutely  amazing. He became like a family  member in just two days. Mr. Rouf, at the  reception  Mr. Shyam, Mr Asif at the Dinning were very good at making  us feel at home. In all it was an amazing stay at The Khyber. We would definitely  recommend  and revisit it whenever  possible . 
Ketan Pathak ,  Mumbai .

reviews.author: Anol B
reviews.title: Early winter in heaven
reviews.text:
Stunning surroundings, great view from all rooms, helpful and courteous staff, nearby the Gondola ticketing counter - what can go wrong? Plus we got to see a majestic snowfall during our stay.

A great hotel, worth every dime.

reviews.author: manan1785
reviews.title: Awesome hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is I guess the most modern hotel in Gulmarg. Awesome rooms and a great ambience. Stayed for 2 nights and enjoyed the breakfast and dinner in the hotel. Short walk to the gondola too. Surely suggest this hotel.

reviews.author: DIPALDESAI
reviews.title: Must visit & enjoy Khyber Gulmerg
reviews.text: It's excellent Property in India Kashmir world Paradise Gulmerg... Khyber its Rooms and Ambiance superb and visit on December snow fall @ Hot Swimming Pool... So, many things for Children and for senior citizensview of rooms are wow...

reviews.author: BenitaMumbai
reviews.title: The Best Ever
reviews.text: Highly recommend this beautiful property to all who visit Gulmarg. Truly appreciate the hospitality of Mr Zaffer Malik, the duty manager who took personal care of us and made our stay so memorable. His entire team were totally hands on and extremely well coordinated. As soon as we reached we were give the best kehwa ever as a welcome drink at Chaikash, the tea lounge. We were upgraded to the front view rooms. The entire hotel had a modern and stylish decor. The indoor pool was was very good with warm water very comforting in the cold The location was good and one could walk down towards the cable car.

reviews.author: sameer B
reviews.title: Very UNSAFE HOTEL TO STAY
reviews.text:
It is a most unsafe hotel to stay where female privacy is at the top most risk and the management cares a hoot.  We stayed on the 17 and 18th nov 2015. My wife was using the steam and sauna and suddenly she see a man walking inside the ladies steam and sauna and when enquired with the lady who was the person who entered inside a ladies room she had to say he had come to check something. How can a man enter a ladies steam and sauna room without prior permission. Totally not acceptable. We called the manager he was not available later his Jr came and said sorry and argued when we asked for a written confirmation of the whole incident which we gave in writing to him and it is been 5 days now no revert or call anything from the management such a shame that such a high quality standard hotel is not able to meet customer privacy and proper answer to  their grievances. 

Will definitely put in the paper once I reach mumbai and ensure that such incident doesn't take place for other women.

My advise for people going there is pls be careful 

Attached is the pic of the letter given to the hotel management

reviews.author: ADITSETH123
reviews.title: The best stay ever
reviews.text:
Highly recomment a stay at khyber gulmarg. By far the best hotel here. A pure beauty.
I stayed here only for one night and trust me that was my biggest mistake in the entire trip. The hotel was spacious and huge. Stagg was humble and by far the best stay in kashmir.

reviews.author: Anand K
reviews.title: Best hotel
reviews.text: This place is just awesome..go for front rooms for best views..the Gondola is easily accessible from the Hotel and you can literally walk to it. Do experience the indoor swimming pool, it's one of the best I have been in. If you are in Gulmarg, this is the best option

reviews.author: JASM007
reviews.title: Awesome stay with kids!!!
reviews.text: We have been trying to get a room at Khyber for the last one year and when we got. Vacancy we jumped and took the opportunity to go visit Paraise on Earth as Kashmir is called!! We went with our two kids and they had the most amazing time. During our stay it snowed and the hotel has beautiful views of the snow capped mountains.. The staff was very courteous and friendly .. We were taken care of really well.. The manager in the restaurant Basharat was extremely hospitable and looked after us very well...Asif was very on the spot And alert to our every need in the restaurant.. The buffet was decent and the ala carte menu had a lot of variety and the dishes were very presentable and yummy... There is a hookah restaurant also... They have an indoor pool for adults and kids separately !!! The view from the poolside is to die for... Overall a very nice stay and can't wait to go back soon !!!

reviews.author: Amit A
reviews.title: Heavenly experience in Paradise
reviews.text:
Was there for 3 nights while in Gulmarg which others said to be long for the place, but being at Khyber was worthwhile and in fact made us think of extending our stay! 

The rooms were a good size and offered nice views. The facilities provided were at five star standards and the swimming pool / fitness center were really nice. 

The staff from check-in to room service and the restaurant was consistently brilliant and soft spoken. We were there during Dussehra holidays and the hotel was well occupied but never did we feel "not cared for". Traveling with a small kid can usually be tough but the staff took real good care of my 06 year old when at the restaurant or the play area. 

Will definitely return myself and strongly recommend everyone to experience Khyber.

Cheers, Amit

reviews.author: Pawan Kumar
reviews.title: The best place to stay when in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a nice place to stay when in Gulmarg.
Rooms are spacious and well made.
Entire hotel staff makes you feel at home and treats you to a 5 star experience.
Non veg food was not upto the mark.
Do the Gandola ride with snow bike & do the ATV ride too.
Try the kawa and egg bhurjee in the local market area.

reviews.author: dr_rishig
reviews.title: one of the best
reviews.text:
Khyber is of course the best in Gulmarg or would not be wrong, one of the best in India
The ambience, room quality, location, proxomity to gondola etx. makes it stand out.
Would like to thank Mr shyam and others at the Khyber for making the trip a memorable one. Highly recommendable

reviews.author: Vivekbansal637
reviews.title: One of the best stays in India. I would love to be back and soon to The Kyber.
reviews.text:
There is nothing i can write about Kyber thats probably not yet been said or written. It has to be 1 of the best located properties in India with the view it offers. The whole view from the pool & spa can be compared to the best in the world.
The staff and management is attentive to all your needs & were serving with a smile even at 5 in the morning.
The GM, Mr Sujith Herbert and the senior management was always around to cater to the needs at all times.
Got the first snow of the season while i was there and that added to the amazing experience i was already having at The Kyber.
I would love to be back and soon to The Kyber.

reviews.author: runumehtakesarker
reviews.title: Lovely hotel with bad service
reviews.text: A beautiful hotel property in gulmarg ! Good rooms , though we did not get a room with a ovine of the snow capped mountains . Bad service in terms of food . For an ala crate we were served food one very late , two cold food . They can up their service to make it a brilliant experience . Also paid wifi hurts !!

reviews.author: amit_8
reviews.title: Heaven in mountains
reviews.text: A beautiful hotel property in Gulmarg. Excellent rooms, excellent food. the staff is brilliant. Special mention of Mr Jaffer Malik, Manager , He is brilliant in looking after Guest comfort, always smiling and upto task. he made our stay special. the spa is great, the staff better at the spa . overall an amazing property to stay.

reviews.author: Gautam m
reviews.title: The place to stay
reviews.text:
A property to die for. Simply its the best property one can find in Gulmarg with breathtaking view and great food.
The property has a proper spa with an indoor heated pool . The Staff is very courteous and helpful.

reviews.author: Rahul L
reviews.title: Gulmarg
reviews.text:
This is the best property that you will find in Gulmarg; overall a very pleasant place with good hospitable staff.
Sometimes the rush during the evening hours in the resturant does make the place look a little out of place but easily understandable.

reviews.author: renuyou2015
reviews.title: Fantastic service, excellent people and cannot thank them enough for handling emergencies so well
reviews.text: We had 150 people form our family staying at the Khyber for 3 days from 2nd oct 2015 - 5th Oct 2015. The hotel handled such a big group with all smiles and excellent service. We enjoyed every bit of the stay, felt like our home for all age groups.  We had 2 emergencies, serious ones and cannot stop Thanking the hotel in the manner they handled the situations. they were so efficient and calm, we did not have to worry at all. They are superb, we all highly recommend the hotel and would love to go back again! Love the pool and its location

reviews.author: Reshmi_Sameeth
reviews.title: A Memorable Stay !!!
reviews.text:
I travelled to Kashmir with my family in the month of October.We chose to stay at Gulmarg and from the tripadvisor reviews we decided to book Khyber.And I am extremely happy to say that we were not at all disappointed.Infact it turned out to be one of the most memorable holidays ever.We stayed in the balcony room with mountain view and the view was just awesome.
The food and service at Cloves Restaurant was extremely good . 
Khyber is within walking distance from Gondola .Also,there are some local sight seeing spots nearby.
Khyber shall surely be my choice if I ever visit Gulmarg again.

reviews.author: rohitgurgaonguy
reviews.title: Could have been much better
reviews.text: We recently stayed in Khyber resorts gulmarg and we rate our stay as average. The hotel is new & has god rooms but same cannot be said about their food and service. The food is very rich and in spite of putting a special request for light food we had lots of cream and rich gravies. The service also is slow. The views from the hotel could have been better. Overall average.

reviews.author: Jignesh d
reviews.title: The best of best hotel
reviews.text:
Quick check in and check out
Superb hotel
Great view ( breath taking)
Excellently maintained 
Already recommended and they loved the place
Never seen such a superb resort
They had the courtesy to call back and inform that we have forgotten some valuables. 
10 out of 10

reviews.author: pranav kapur
reviews.title: Pool with the view
reviews.text:
If you like the mountains you will love this Resort.
We booked the cheapest room so it did not have the best view but we hardly spent any time there.
Its a spa so they don't serve alcohol but I suggest you carry your best malt for that weather.
The indoor heated pool has got the best view so don't forget to take your trunks.

The only issue was the smell in the corridor which refused to go on both the days we were there for.

reviews.author: sanjuverma
reviews.title: very good, calm and awesome hotel
reviews.text:
excellent hotel, all wood wood finish everywhere. I loved the place though expensive. we were greeted very warmly but at the entrance luggage was scanned and we were told to open bags, disappointing.
we paid Rs35800/- for two rooms for one night plus we paid Rs 5000/- extra for two kids. they gave us Gulmarg side view which was disappointed, we requested for mountain view rooms which was politely declined stating hotel is full. it was not true as one can see next morning, it was not even half occupied. staff is very polite and courteous but only in talking, not in making small favors for their guest. 

excellent indoor pool, Jacuzzi and sauna. enjoyed thoroughly. 
Wi-Fi is not free.

reviews.author: The_Meanderer
reviews.title: Preparing for the winters
reviews.text:
Full marks for a great view from the hotel towards the mountains, appetizing meals (special thanks to the chef for kid meals), courteous staff & for the property itself.

Issues were regarding the reservation desk at the time of booking, inflexibility on dates even in off-season (and It was off season!), intentional or unintentional ignorance of local developments and lack of complimentary wifi (even budget hotels offer free wifi these days). The worst of it all was the smell of paint right outside our balcony; think they were preparing for the winters when the foreigners come in droves. My sense is this could have been easily avoided with better logistics given the low occupancy during our stay.

reviews.author: Ruchi K
reviews.title: Great Hospitality!
reviews.text: We stayed in the two bedroom cottage  in Khyber for two nights 2nd and 3rd October . The location of the property is ethereal , the tranquility is mesmerizing and the beauty of the nearby hills ( the view from our cottage ) simply exquisite !! Thank u for the great hospitality and service at Khyber ! We had a great holiday ! Special mention for our friendly driver Mr Shahnawaz who got us from the airport and took us back to Srinagar !

reviews.author: Sirinder
reviews.title: Weekend Getaway at Khyber Resort.
reviews.text: Spent a weekend end of September. A really beautiful experience. The room was excellent with a breathtaking view of the snow-capped mountains. Service was courteous and efficient; food very good, with a wide variety of choices. Highlight was the beautiful indoor swimming pool with sauna/Jacuzzi and a well equipped gymnasium

reviews.author: Kumareshr
reviews.title: BEWARE OF GIVING CREDIT CARD DETAILS
reviews.text: When you book for this hotel through online or phone if you give your credit card number and expiry date that is enough for them to debit your card for the entire amount of your stay without you swiping the card or any other second line authentication the bank can't do anthying because they use a foreign website to debit your card bypassing RBI REGULATIONS REGARDING SECOND LINE VERIFICATION. imagine the kind of security risk when they are able to debit our card just by credit card number and expiry date the main aim of the hotel is to debit your card before your arrival even though you pay an obscene amount with no value for money for this property if you not negotiated small things like wifi also they will deny you uncourtesly this is over hyped property by various sites you will end paying exorbitant food price for dinner if you have not negotiated for dinner plan other than it is close to gonadala there is nothing extra ordinary about this property for the price you pay presently as of today Iam staying in this property and this is my live expericience BEWARE BEWARE ABOUT GIVING CREDIT CARD DETAILS UNLESS YOU ARE READY TO BE DEBITED BEFORE YOUR ARRIVAL AND READY TO EXPOSE YOUR CARD WITH FURTHER DEBIT BECAUSE IT IS POSSIBLE ONCE THE RBI PROTOCOL BYPASSING IS DONE FOR PNP TRANSACTIONS WHICH THIS GUYS ARE DOING.

reviews.author: Fayaz A
reviews.title: Hospitality Redefined !!
reviews.text: We recently spent a couple of days at this resort and what a fabulous experience it turned out to be!! The location was absolutely breathtaking and the premier room where we stayed was a perfect blend of luxury and elegance. What really bowled us over was the top-notch quality of service at the resort. To say that the hotel staff was friendly and helpful will be an understatement-they were well-groomed, very pleasant to talk to and were incredibly supportive throughout our stay. From offering quick medical assistance when I was down with flu to getting a complimentary cake for celebrating our kids’ birthday-they did everything they possibly could to make our stay at the resort an unforgettable experience. We were particularly impressed with Sajjad, Ashfaq, Rafiq and Ishaq who went out of their way to make us feel at home with their warmth and impeccable service. With its stunning location, classy ambience and outstanding hospitality, Khyber certainly ranks as one of the best hotels we have stayed in. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: mahesh p
reviews.title: Decent stay at Gulmarg
reviews.text:
It was last week in September and season in kashmir was about to end.
We had a 2 day's decent stay here. Location of of the property is beautiful. Interior and decor was simple. It had all fine amenities but would not rate it as five star.
Entrance climb is so damn stiff that one can not think of walk down or up. Food was nice and had all kinds of cousine.

reviews.author: yasif07
reviews.title: ROYAL, CALM AND SERENE PLACE
reviews.text: Our stay at Khyber resort was the best from all the places we stayed in Kashmir. Their service was very welcoming , friendly & very warm.  All the guests are treated with a welcome drink of Kashmir named " kahwa".  The tea was one of the best Kahwa i ever had . We book the cheapest rooms in the resorts and even then , we were super excited in seeing the layout & views the room had to offer us. They were very lavish at providing us a lot of complimentary water bottles and tea, which usually is charged in every other hotel we had been :). The show stopper for all these amazing facilities in the resort was when we entered the pool and spa at the resort , the design intend was perfect to please every customer who had come in search of a place to relax ,detox and enjoy the calm natural  paradise that was seen everywhere we looked in Gulmarg. the pool was heated and it offered a clean views of the beautiful surroundings. one can lay in the pool for hours gazing at the beautiful ice mountains & pine trees around.  Over all i would suggest this hotel to everyone who wishes to visit Kashmir & you would be missing alot if you dint . :)

reviews.author: Atique K
reviews.title: Luxurious abode
reviews.text:
Great place.
Worth every bit of your money.
Service, location, spa, pool, steam are splendid...
Very close to gondola
The welcome drink is refreshing and sets the tone of the place 

Food options can be better 

But nonetheless....it's a super place.

reviews.author: Rohit S
reviews.title: Superb stay at one of the finest in the region
reviews.text: Stayed on 13th sept nite. everything from check in to checkout was smooth.rooms are big and clean and the resort is in midst of tranquility and peace. Food was the best we had on our trip to kashmir. one small thing which they can offer to guest is complimentary wifi which though currently available on chargeable basis. still as there was phone connection we could use our 3G services. tried clove restaurant and the spread was amazing. tried igloo play area for kids which has table tennis and some Xbox for fun. overall highly recommend if you are in the valley and if you haven't experienced Khyber hospitality then you surely have missed a lot.

reviews.author: Jasmiet M
reviews.title: Magnificent view .. No words can describe the feeling
reviews.text: Amazing best 5 star property in Gulmarg next to Gondola. The balcony rooms give an unprecedented view of Afharwat Mountains. Food is awesome with choice of 3 restaurants . Loved enjoying long hours at the balcony...

reviews.author: Vchellani
reviews.title: Superb!!!
reviews.text: The Khyber resort is an amazing experience, the decor of the hotel, its location and the amazing staff make this the best hotel in the area by far. The experience of staying at the khyber is unparalleled, the food at the clove restaurant was very good and chaikash their coffee / pastry shop is very good too with very friendly and helpful staff. The service in the hotel overall, from room service to the restaurant to spa was just excellent. We took a luxury room with the mountain view and it was spectacular and worth the additional price. We trued the spa as well, covered that as a seperate review

reviews.author: Parth B
reviews.title: Not what promised , arrogant staff
reviews.text:
We visited in august and booked a 2 bedroom cottage with "full service kitchen".
When we reached the hotel the definition of luxurious kitchen was a microwave without any utensils.
They randomly made us put some stuff at the gate for security purpose, the head of security was a super arrogant person.
If you don't allow any stuff you should pit on the website.
We contacted repeatedly, but there was no answer finally almost at night manager responded.
The swimming pool floor tiles are broken at many points, you may seriously injure your toes there.
I may still go back to Khyber for the location and lack of other major competition. However with an expectation of some cheap guesthouse at a nice location

reviews.author: Gaurav Agarwala
reviews.title: Every request is a NO
reviews.text: A nice property ruined by the pathetic attitude of the staff. Everything and anything you ask for is a big NO which turns into a yes sometimes after arguments and contacting the manager. Extremely unprofessional and frustrating. Staff is untrained and totally not ready to help. Highlands Park will turn out to be the best option in the long run. The newly renovated cottages are awesome. Won't ever come back to Khyber. Also, the food here is pathetic

reviews.author: BobbyGujral
reviews.title: amazing Experience in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Before Gulmarg never thought India is so beautiful and marking it special is Khyber , I compliment the promoters behind it no match to kashmiri's warmth services food location is remarkable , they gave us a butler sajad he didn't let us miss any services of our home .. a must visit

reviews.author: SKKHANNA
reviews.title: GREAT PLACE TO BE IN WHILE IN KASHMIR.
reviews.text: Khyber Hotel & Spa is the best place to stay in any season. Situated next to the famous Gandola it has one of the best Spa,s i have used. The ride on Gandola, particularly the second part is breathtaking and takes you to the top of the world at about 14,000 feet and good snow even in summers.

reviews.author: abhineetsingh
reviews.title: Best hotel In Kashmir
reviews.text: Amazing Hotel the best hotel in Himalayas in india.... Amazing location beautiful view from the windows of the hotel,,,Beautiful rooms with all facilities and its the best hotel i had stayed in any hilly area in india...great to sit at balcony and enjoy the beauty....

reviews.author: Smita L
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text:
This resort is one of the most beautiful places we have visited. Starting right from pick up from the airport till dropping us back, everything was beautifully taken care of. 
Check-in was hassle free and we were promptly taken to our rooms. The view from the room was breathtaking. The room was clean and well equipped.
We were here for about 3 days and dined only at their multi cuisine restaurant "Cloves". The service was very good and staff was extremely helpful and courteous. 
Overall we had a great stay and would love to visit again!

reviews.author: UshaShreyMurli
reviews.title: Am I In Kashmir?
reviews.text:
We drove from Srinagar to Gulmarg in an Innova driven by Pervez, a very helpful person. Nice road, drive can be accomplished in less than two hours. 
As per Pervez's recommendation, we stopped at a curve about 2 kms away from Gulmarg to pick up warm clothing which we would need when we reached the ski slopes. We also had deliciously soothing cups of Kahwa with low-sugar. 
Reached Khyber, which is in one word....Awesome!! The style and luxury it conveys is like an Alpine ski resort. The room we were in was large and spacious, for the three of us. The pasta that we ordered, fusilli with basil pesto and olives, in the restaurant was superb!! The breakfast spread in the morning was also very satisfying.
In Gulmarg, the highlight is the gondola-ride, which takes us to the top, and is done in 2-parts....both were working and we were told that if the weather is bad, the second one is shut. At the top there are no shops, places to relax and the air is thin. So please be prepared. My husband and son climbed the peak and managed to get a look at the LOC with Pakistan.
The other big deal in Gulmarg is the spa in Khyber. The family had the most satisfying, soothing massage ever, after such a long day!! Hats off to the Spa!
A good place to grab a quick freshly cooked vegetarian meal, is the Bakshi Dhaba, where we enjoyed a Kashmiri meal.

reviews.author: Rama r
reviews.title: Kashmirs bestest resort
