reviews.text: Visited the lovely heaven on earth Kashmir and 2 days stayed at khybar, gulmarg. It was beyond words, the place has its own flavour with the rooms a haven from the cold and perfect view of the snow clad mounts frm the balcony, kids play room at the ground floor,with wonderful collection of books by the lobby, perfect for the weather. Can't find a better resort than this in gulmarg.

reviews.author: Yash Beswala
reviews.title: Poor parking arrangements for tourist Taxis & Rude behavior of security personnels
reviews.text: We had been to your valued  hotel  on 22nd n 23rd july 2015 and staying in room no 1010 during our Kashmir Holidays. Whereas the Hotel is very good in all respects, to our surprise you have not provided any parking space for cars and don't even allow them to stay for 15 minutes to take instructions from the Tourist. Your hotel is on height and the tourist has to come down by foot for gondola or other rides. But it becomes very difficult for senior citizens to climb up for Hotel while coming back  or spend Rs 600/- for such a small distance. There are local unions in Pahalgam but no such rudeness in allowing your car for reaching your Hotel or for parking even for 15 minutes. This is very ridiculous. Needs the management attention to promote tourism in kashmir & even your own image

reviews.author: DrRavi16
reviews.title: Unexpected Amazing Beauty in Himalya
reviews.text: I have never expected such a beautifully crafted resort at  isolated Mountain peak. perfect location surrounded by snow peaks. walking distance from Gondola rides which is the main attraction of Gulmarg. Room servic is good . Centrally heated. with all modern amenities.

reviews.author: PankajKumar781
reviews.title: A Heaven on Earth
reviews.text: Visited the place during November 2014. It was a great experience for me & my family.The place itself gives a great feeling of having on a different part of the planet, the beauty, the snow especially the Sunrise & sunsets at #The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa. it was a tremendous experience of the #Cloves-the coffee shop, #Chaikash-the tea lounge,#Calabash-the hookka lounge. the cloves i liked the most. The room service was also good on the click. Mr Aman Dhiman #Manager and his team Vikas, Iqbal, Prabhakar, Brijkishor had a great contribution for making this trip a succesful one. They guided us to encounter those beautific scenes which i would not been able to see elsewhere.

reviews.author: AnnRa
reviews.title: Fantastic rooms!!!
reviews.text: The rooms are gorgeous and every detail is exquisite.. The lighting is beautiful and the scenery from the balcony is breathtaking... Though there are resorts with better view in gulmarg, the ambience of this place is to be experienced ..it is a stone 's throw from the gondola ticket window. However it would be good if the resort arranges drop /pickup from this point as it's a difficult steep climb esp with kids..the staff is polite but felt the service was mechanical and did not match the ambience of this place. No one approached us and asked if our stAy was good at any point in the 2 days v were there. The kids room called igloo should be housed in a glass like structure like the swimming pool.. Right now it is 2 floors down in a windowless room and seems out of place in this well designed resort. My husband visited the spa and gave a thumbs up for the experience, must do when at the hotel ..

reviews.author: dillliwala
reviews.title: Superb Hotel
reviews.text: Gulmarg is a small pristine valley with not much to do except take the gondola up the mountain or trek around the area in summer. So this oasis is a great retreat with excellent rooms. The ones with the balcony make more sense considering the weather and the heavenly experience of sipping a beverage there any time of the day.Rooms are generous sized and very well appointed. Bathroom is a treat. Everything works and still feels new. Service too is warm. If one had to be picky, one would ctitique the service level in the restaurant ...takes long for anything. All things considered - highly recommended!! Must go again.

reviews.author: indiancouple
reviews.title: The ultimate in luxury
reviews.text:
The place is expensive, but if you can afford it, you would be foolish to look anywhere else in Gulmarg. The hotel spells class at every nook and corner. The rooms are superb, so are the restaurants, and so is the spa. In fact, you are tempted not to leave the hotel premises at all. The hotel itself becomes the main attraction in the lovely town of Gulmarg !
We have stayed at many great hotels around the world, and I can say that this would surely rank as my best ever hotel experience till date.

reviews.author: DEVANSH10
reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: The best part of whole of Kashmir trip was Gulmarg and what made it even more special was Khyber! Truly its a wonderful property with serene views of the mountains and lush green lawns. The rooms are just fantastic. Every thing of this hotel is perfect!! The heated swimming pool and jaccoussie are a great time pass. Though everything here is a bit overpriced but its worth it! Overall a fabouless and memorable experience!!

reviews.author: MeghaMawandia
reviews.title: mixed bag.. read carefully
reviews.text:
Rooms and location is fantastic. However there are lots of stairs! There are stairs to go to rooms to go to the lawns along each layer of lawn. When we asked them for a ball to play in the lawn they said the lawns were not for children. Only place children to play was a closed room with no windows called the igloo. I don’t fancy the idea of taking my children to a beautiful location like Gulmarg and cooping them in a  room to play the xbox. To cap it the ‘Igloo’ was 2 stories down with the toilet- you guessed it 2 stories up! 
Their famed heated pool decked with bisazza tiles had tiles popping off and their changing room was wet and worse then a roadside toilet.

All this apart, the food was excellent! Their chef is adept at Italian as well as Indian and their service staff is courteous and polite. I would go again but restrict myself to the rooms and the restaurants.

reviews.author: RasheshShah
reviews.title: Fabulous Hotel and great experience
reviews.text:
We visited Gulmarg from 30th June-2rd July and stayed at the Khyber and really loved every minute of it.  The Hotel the facilities and the staff all were excellent. Great food too! would definitely love to go again

Would recommend the Gondola ride. Both phases. The view from 2nd phase is an experience.

Planning to go again in Winter for Skiiing in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: CHANDAN C
reviews.title: The place to be!!! Must visit in kashmir!!
reviews.text:
The cherry on cake is what i call this in my kashmir trip. Stayed at the hotel for 2 nighs on 3-4 july 15. And it was a memorable experience. The most amzing hotel in hills. The staff is very courteous and friendly. Mr sajad in restraurent totally floored us with his hospitality. Very cooperative and attentive staff. Extremely helpful. Very well maintained pool spa gym sauna..
Best was the spa . Extremely luxurious spa at par with any five star hotel in delhi. Massage was too relaxing!! Food was amazingly good and portions served were also large as compared to other hotels in five star category!! Perfect location near the gondola.. Awesome view . Best place .
Rates are on a higher side but they truly deserve it. Go if u want to seek luxury!!
Also- guide mr ahmed very genuine gor gulmarg (+91 97-97-280163) 
Taxi driver for kashmir trip- mushtaq bhaijaan - 099-06-460370.  The best person in the whole trip. Very genuine and caring taxi driver. Felt like family with him. You can book him for entire trip! Reasonable and genuine . Will take you to right places and gives genuine advice!!Highly recomended!!

reviews.author: sanjaysilli
reviews.title: Overall good experience
reviews.text:
I with my family stayed in this property in month of june '15. Ever smiling and helpful staff. The location and archtecture is spell binding.
The let down is the food and dinning area. The dinning hall is too small, cogested, crowded and choatic for otherwise such a fabulous property.
The food has limited range and average in quality.
The rest of the stay makes up for this short coming.

reviews.author: vkuthiala
reviews.title: Truly World Class setting
reviews.text: The last 45 minutes of road journey from Shrinagar to Gulmarg must rank as one of the most beautiful that you would encounter anywhere in the world - if you love the mountains. The zero point en-route would mesmerize you and then the large meadow that looks alike a green bowl housing a golf course - indeed breathtaking. And then when you drive up to the hotel Khyber - you are left in a stupor that takes a while to dissipate. The balcony rooms are fantastic - facing either side. The restaurant serves excellent food and the serving staff is ever willing to top up the buffet selection. Try the Tandoori Trout. And they have fantastic indoor heated pool - which would transport you to Norway or North Scandinavia.

reviews.author: Haresh55
reviews.title: Khyber makes Gulmarg feel like mini Switzerland.
reviews.text:
High priced but you would never want anything more. Very classy decors, temperature controlled swimming pool, spa, well equipped gym.... you name it. Rooms were in excellent condition with breathtaking view. The staff was warm and very prompt to help.
I was impressed by the hospitality of the General Manager Mr. Sukhjit Herbert who personally interacted with us (guests) and made sure everything was perfect. He also asked us for some suggestions and our overall hotel experience. We thank him for his time and patience.
Food experience was also good in terms of variety and taste. We had taken dinner and breakfast buffet. My wife is Jain religion practitioner and the food was prepared fresh for her according to her own choice. The entire restaurant experience was excellent thanks to hard work, politeness and dedication of Mr. Sajaad Lone. His enthusiasm, care for the guests and management skills contributed to our excellent experience.
Overall I would say, Khyber is the best hotel one could find in Gulmarg. Though a bit expensive, every penny is indeed worth the experience.

reviews.author: Sanjeev S
reviews.title: Simply Awesome...but devil's in the details
reviews.text:
There isn't much to do in Gulmarg. But one can spend 2 nights, or even more in Gulmarg, just for the Resort! There's class, there's expanse, there's thoughtfulness in the design, style & decor of the place. Heated indoor pool, with glass all-around, global Spa, not so trained, but really warm staff. I would love to go there again, surprisingly, in spite of a few small-small misses.
Like, really low class, broken tea kettle; AC that you can't control; toilet jet that has very long pipe and water flow is just too much; tea stuff that's not replenished;  mattress that's just too-too soft; food that doesn't taste great; rate for same food in room being much higher than restaurant; staff that keeps banging things and makes so much noise and a front office manager who's a bit racist....

reviews.author: prasadmehta
reviews.title: Superb
reviews.text: Superb location, courteous staff and amazing spa. View from the room is amazing with snow clad mountains. Had one of the authentic Kahwa on arrival. The lobby is grand and rooms are quite spacious and comfortable. Food is great and especially the options for breakfast. Will visit again!

reviews.author: rogercharlie
reviews.title: Stunningly Beautiful
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Khyber for three nights in a Himalayan View room. This hotel has class and character. The common areas and the rooms are beautifully designed. Probably one of the most beautiful hotels I have stayed in - and certainly the most beautiful setting for a pool I have ever seen.

The food is quite good - and the menu offers a very wide choice - there is something there for everyone.

I see several negative comments on service. I found the service to be quite good. The hotel staff were very welcoming and accommodating.

reviews.author: SanjayRajpal
reviews.title: Went to meet some friends..
reviews.text: The place is like a grand palace. Fantastic from outside and inside.. It has everything from an indoor pool to a gym room, spa ..recreation etc. Good restaurants. Rooms were very nice and big with a sit out balcony but Frightfully expensive.

reviews.author: AkneogTikna
reviews.title: Can do better
reviews.text:
The title is a typical comment from my school days' report card.
- can do better
- still can do better
- good. but can do better with a little more effort
That's exactly how I felt. More involvement from the team & genuine warmth needed. I interacted with Jerin who showed me around the property quite a bit. Thanks for your personal attention.
Little more professional touch would do wonders.
Food menu also needs variety just like I mentioned for Pahalgam hotel & Vivanta Srinagar.
Views are great & luxuriously done all the way from reception to the bathroom to the amenities. ATTENTION MANAGEMENT - solve the seepage issues ASAP while your woodwork can be saved. Oh! and buck up with the check-out process!!!! None paying in the range of 20k per night finds it acceptable to wait anything in excess of 5-10 mins for baggage to be transferred from room to portico. We and other guests in our presence waited beyond half an hour!

reviews.author: Nareshjindal
reviews.title: Good hotel, good location but bad in services
reviews.text: Hotel location superb, rooms and facilities excellent but when it comes to services, they are not good. Any order on room service may take even 2-3 hours usually. House keeping staff still more worse in their behavior.   At time of checkout, i informed the reception at 9:45 am but luggage didn't come down even by 11 am.

reviews.author: Vadiraj Kulkarni
reviews.title: Himayalan beauty
reviews.text: The majestic royal hotel and resort is the best place to stay at Gulmarg. The expanse and the treatment are out of the world. The rooms are very majestic and functionally exceptional. Food is outstanding and staff very warm and courteous. The best part is the view from the sit outs. You can just sit, relax with a cup of kahwa and watch the beautiful snow capped mountains and trees.

reviews.author: Vyomaparikh
reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: Extremely unfortunate to have visited this place.. Hospitality and service could be marked negative... They cannot cope up with the guests.. Would not recommend anyone to visit ... Not at all worth the price you pay.

reviews.author: Abhiroop
reviews.title: Awesome ecstatic place amidst the mountains but bad service
reviews.text: We were here for only 1 night since next day we had to leave for Srinagar. At first, when you enter you would feel the royalty that is presence in the decoration of the lobby and the surrounding areas. Exquisitely decorated interiors and wooden finishes all over the hotel is just amazing. Coming to the room, they upgraded me to the  mountains view room with a quite large balcony to sit and feel the calmness around. Everything is ok except for the service and no free Wifi to resident guests. Other hotels of lower category such as Vivanta by Taj  offer at least 24hrs of free usage but Khyber does not. Another point which disappoints you the most is the poor service when it comes to necessary in room services such as toiletries or such other things. Also they dont provide packages such as including one major meal or something of that sort which makes it a little tough on the pocket if you staying for 1 day. Apart from all of these, this is the best place to imbibe and feel the pure snowcapped mountains.

reviews.author: Siddhid
reviews.title: Heaven nestled in snow peaked mountains
reviews.text: Amazing royally done up property with excellent location in Gulmarg. Staff is nice and food is good too. Best to take the rooms with a private balcony overlooking the snow peaked mountain range. Thanks for the warm hospitality Kashmiri style!

reviews.author: Very L
reviews.title: Stunning hotel with soulless service
reviews.text:
The Khyber is a grand property worthy of the praises it has received, view were stunning, rooms were great and food served was excellent all at par with any 5-star international hotel. 

Physically it may live up to its reputation however the service was without soul especially front desk and mid level staff appeared not to be well trained and unmotivated.

And 5-star hotel charging for something as ubiquitous as wi-fi?

reviews.author: NIkhilSama
reviews.title: Heavenly !
reviews.text:
Food, Spa, Pool, View, Room - Everything was outstanding ! 

Heated pool with floor to ceiling glass overlooking surreal snow capped mountains.  Excellent spa.  The restaurant, clove is the only the second place I know (first is 360), that can do a good job across cuisines.  We tried Indian, Kashmiri, Italian, South Indian and breakfast - Each cuisine was done as if it were a Clove specialty.  

Without any doubt the best place to be in Gulmarg !

reviews.author: Laosin
reviews.title: The only Place worth staying in Kashmir 'The Khyber'
reviews.text: This was our first visit to Kashmir and would like to share our experience. We visited Kashmir in May 2015 ( 9 persons) and were super excited as Kashmir is supposed to be Heaven on earth.Before zeroing on hotels my brother in law and I went through every site and review on the Internet but still after paying a lot of money( 10 days cost more than a foreign trip) and booking the best hotels , like Senator Pine n Peak (Best in Pahalgam according to reviews) Heevan , Lalit , Queen Elizabeth House Boat in Srinagar  etc. the only place that felt like Heaven was The Khyber Himalayan Spa and resort in Gulmarg. We spent two days there and it was the best days of our trip ( book the Luxury Room ). The other great experience we had was visiting the Zero point location from Sonmarg ... It was snowing to our good luck and it was the most amazing sight....truly magical, though quite far from Srinagar  and very tiring. Pahalgam was just okay not the great visual treat we had expected. The most disappointing experience was Gondola( after being at Zero point in Sonmarg this felt like a waste of money as visually it was disappointing and not worth the money, time and energy ( spent 5 minutes at Phase 1 and 10 minutes at phase 2  and paid 1400 per head plus 1000 for a guide ). All said and done the next time we visit Kashmir we will drive straight from Srinagar airport to The Khyber in Gulmarg which is about 1.5 hr drive and spend our full vacation there as believe me it is one of the best 5 star Resort and Spa in India Or maybe in the world  too and worth every penny.

reviews.author: RuchiMehta2014
reviews.title: Amazing holiday spot
reviews.text: I loved the heated indoor pool where the kids and I spent the evening. The deep intensity massage at the L'occitane Spa was relaxing. The connecting rooms we got were perfect for a family holiday. All in all, a great place to stay in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Sumeetbr
reviews.title: world class
reviews.text: everything about the hotel radiates class and good taste...from the grand lobby and common areas, the views from the coffee shop, the welcome, the rooms which are absolutely 5 star, to the staff, the spa and the heated pool with a view, the food, the breakfasts, the service...absolutely top class...nothing in kashmir comes close to this...

reviews.author: rajneesh2052
reviews.title: Awesome Property and Simply paradize in Gulmarg
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at Khyber Gulmarg, would like to specially thank Mr. Aman F&B Manager who was very helpful during the stay.  The location is superb just next to gondola ride with superb view of snow claded mountains. Simply You Guys Rock !!

reviews.author: menonkk
reviews.title: Heavenly View
reviews.text: The entry to the hotel itself was awe inspiring.   The sight of the snow peaked mountains  from the hotel makes your jaw drop.  The lobby which is centrally heated makes a warm welcome from the chill outside.  The rooms are large  and spacious.  The washrooms  are elegant and neatly done. The  window  of the  bathroom offering view of nature is interesting and beautiful. The balcony opening to nature is nice place to relax and have a cuppa.  Good Health Club facilities. The view from  the Gymnasium and the heated swimming pool makes it very difficult to pull yourself out from these places. Can still improve on the food palate and food charges are exorbitant.  Staff are courteous and special thanks to Mr. Sajad who arranged to transport our misplaced camera  at the Hotel to Srinagar. The higher altitude makes breathing a bit difficult.

reviews.author: Sheela3
reviews.title: amazing experience
reviews.text: very good resort in gulmarg with view of mountain snow hills , it is near ropeway starting point so can walk and go to snow peaked mountain, excellent view on way . hotel have loccitane spa very good peaceful nice experience ,heated  pool also inside , other facilities also good . food was good , staff corteious helpful . once in gulmarg must to stay in khyber resort.

reviews.author: PGglobetrotter
reviews.title: I would give it a 10 star
reviews.text:
Honestly, I have never EVER seen such a beautiful property! I was there in March and I still miss it every single day!

I would give it a 10 star but sadly the highest they go is 5.
Its fantastic. Gorgeous view, right in the center of Gulmarg, good breakfast and dinner buffet, amazing rooms and nice atmosphere.

It is the only place you should stay at when in Gulmarg! 

Hats off to the Khyber Team for making my stay so so so so enjoyable.

reviews.author: Aman P
reviews.title: One of the best hotels in the world
reviews.text: Better than any suisse chalet.Fantastic property to take the kids to and just as well for a Honeymoon couple. A real class act from the owner.The gym and pool facilities are state of the art,heated and all.Would love to visit again.Just need to improve a bit on service and food.

reviews.author: Sanjay Jain
reviews.title: EXCELLENT LOCATION AND GREAT HOSPITALITY
reviews.text: It is the best resort currently on Hill in India with the best view of nature mountain and snow. To top up it has great indoor recreation facility. The general manager Mr Succoth is a great person to interact and ensures that you are the most comfortable guest in his hotel. The food too is great so is the Gymnasium and swimming pool. You rally need to be hear to experience luxury with nature.

reviews.author: Vani Sachdeva
reviews.title: Best stay ever!!!!Gulmarg was never so beautifully admired before
reviews.text: With the opening of khyber himalayan resort and spa gulmarg one will never come to know how many days have been passed staying there.  Excellent property best rooms specially the balcony rooms with mountain view have an eye soothing effect a perfect place to enjoy nature at its best.  Excellent food , mind blowing service friendly staff and a perfect outlook. Mind blowing place to relax in your vacations. A must stay and an only best of the stay hotel in gulmarg. The resort has added a five star in the beauty of gulmarg. Had visited gulmarg many times but the stay at khyber is simply unforgettable.  One more point to add on super clean and well maintained rooms and attached bathrooms.

reviews.author: NaseemVora
reviews.title: Nestling in the woods of Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Our first impression was very favourable, as it is crafted with great love. the wooden exteriors and the interiors are gorgeous! We were escorted to a lobby and served warm Kehwa while all the formalities were taken care of. The food was very good, though standard. The breakfast buffet was extensive and the service very prompt.
The road upto the hotel is pretty steep, so walking up and down was a little tiring.
It is located right next to the Gondola, so that is convenient. The entire staff was very warm and welcoming. 
However the rooms we had were on the lower floors and my childrens room actually looked out onto the car park. so that even the drivers etc could look in and there was no privacy at all. 
Another strange thing was that the rooms had only heating facilities, not air conditioning. so no fresh air was coming in at night, and it would get pretty stuffy. The alternative was opening the windows. But that was a security issue on the lower floors. 
Also a library would be very welcome. Also, free wifi would be very welcome. The paid wifi was pretty steep

reviews.author: Jstolia
reviews.title: Way beyond Excellent.... Superb...!!!
reviews.text:
Amazing location... very nice property....
Lots of amenities and things to do for kids...
staff & guides were very helpful....
Its truly said when you in Kashmir heaven can wait and experiencing with Khyber really made our vacation memorable.
Only thing to look after when you have group booking please make them stay on separate floor to avoid disturbance to others. Also need to repair leakage in shower area towards Swimming pool...
Thanks..  See you soon...

reviews.author: Madhurima M
reviews.title: Divine
reviews.text: An amazingly beautiful and breath taking view awaits you as you enter the hotel lobby and are escorted to the coffee shop for the warm welcome drink. The Hotel is situate a little away from the Gulmarg golf course, but near the Gondola (gifted by the French) and provides the most picturesque view of the mountains as well as of the woods. A beautifully laid out property. The spa is a must try and the pool is a luxury to be enjoyed.

reviews.author: KP
reviews.title: Close to heaven
reviews.text:
When one of our friends showed me the pictures of the foothills  of Himalayas from this resort I made up my mind to visit this resort for its own sake, all the way from Ahmedabad to kashmir.I visited the place in first week of April.
We were totally delighted to enjoy this resort, which was trull heavenly and one of the most outstanding scenic resort in India. I would definitely rate it as one of the best.Their SPA is fantastic.
The buffett was however mediocre, but that was compensated by the willingness of the restaurant staff to order outside the buffett to our liking with a great smile.
The Hotel Manager Mr.Sujith Herbert was fantastic and is always around to check out the property and the guests.
I am definitely planning to visit this resort during the skiing season within next 1-2 years.
A must place to visit at least once in lifetime

reviews.author: gauri g
reviews.title: fabulous !
reviews.text:
beautiful property, fab service and definitely worth repeating. the kids play area is good but needs to be spruced up. the pool , gym spa is top class. the service is warm and promt.
Mr Zaffar the manager was extremely helpful and courteous. my 4 year old daughters needs were handled very well.

reviews.author: NAVEEN M
reviews.title: One word to describe the experience - Awesome
reviews.text: The hotel is a beautiful property located near the Gondola station- in fact the best property in Gulmarg. The exterior gives the feelings of Chalets. Lobby area is good. Restaurant is excellent. All the rooms have nice valley view. Hotel has got good Spa, Gym and swimming pool, a nice kid play area with Kinect & Xbox. Room service is impeccable. Rooms are good. Bathrooms are also good size. The shower in the bathroom operates in full speed from Cold to Hot and there is no way of reducing the flow to limit the loss of water. Food is quite expensive but good. Everything else is excellent. We have gone in a group and enjoyed the stay thoroughly except for one issue. While making the reservation online, we have mentioned as 2 adults and 1 child of less than 12, and got an all inclusive rate. However, at the time of checkin, hotel insisted on charging the rates for kids saying the rate was not included in the package and forced us to shell out rs 12000 more.

reviews.author: Jeswanthr
reviews.title: Nice hotel, but service can improve
reviews.text:
It is a great property and I guess the best to stay in Gulmarg. The location is also very good very close to cable ride station. The hotel room is very well kept as well and the views are also good. The food is also nice. 

On the minus side the service was just ok, it seemed to me that the staff was not trained enough.

reviews.author: Nilesh G
reviews.title: Nilesh
reviews.text: We visited to Kashmir in November 2013 my wife ,1 INFANT and my 6 year old daughter. My daughter are asked to me papa I see the snow I decided to plan go to Kashmir mu tour are start to srinagar to pahalgam and go to gulmarg I stay at your resort my at 2 night all the staff are well helpfull food are also good I i stay many more hotel and resort but your resort are best of the best my daughter are enjoy at the resort.....

reviews.author: rupal k
reviews.title: Fantastic property but just not warm enough!
reviews.text:
Positives:
Great view
Beautiful rooms 
Fantastic food
Very peaceful 

Def the best Gulmarg's got

Negatives:
Arrogant senior staff
Need reminding twice atleast for anything the guests may need
No extra efforts taken to make sure the guests are comfortable
Everyone here has duties which they carry on fantastically without even glancing at their guests to greet them

Would still recommend it simply for the location and the view!

reviews.author: KAMALSARAWGI
reviews.title: Khyber-Its one of best places to stay
reviews.text: We (08 people) stayed at Khyber from 02 May to 04 May and had a wonderful time . We stayed in Gulmarg View room ( the view of Pine tree and Himalayas ,from the room is just amazing). You can also stay in Premier Room with Himalayan View which has view of Himalayas. The base cateogory Premier rooms are also good and only diff is they dont have balcony.The food was also amazing though the rates on higher side. Gondala ride station is just a furlong from the Hotel. Can take ATV car from the hotel to see the gulmarg valley(extra cost). Wifi should be complimenatry as hotel tarriff is too high.  Any person visiting Gulmarg should stay here.

reviews.author: saketsaraf2015
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text:
We enjoyed a lot , food & hotel staff was excellent.

I stayed with my family for 2 nights & the day was fantastic & life long remembering.  

Every staff of hotel was very polite & helpful always. One of the staff from cafeteria 
gave my kids Hot chocolate as complimentary while we were having tea & snacks.

Hotel has good play room for kids. My kids enjoyed a lot. 

Room was very neat with a good view.

reviews.author: Drmohindroo
reviews.title: HEAVEN ON EARTH .....yes believe me
reviews.text: Khyber Resort in Gulmerg is the most divine place in Kashmir to anchor yourself.One is taken aback by the magical ambiance it presents.The welcome accorded by the staff makes you feel so special.The amenities you name it and they have it.both the Eat and the Eating place are delicious.The rooms are as unbelievable as is this Fairytale Palace.The view offered from room balcony reminds you of The Swiss Alps.Enter it to believe it.

reviews.author: 449adityam
reviews.title: Haven in jannat
reviews.text: Stayed on dec.13.2014 qith family its a super luxurious resort.centrally heated with hot water pool in -5 degree temperature. Once in a life must stay there .cable car station is walking distance from Khyber resort.

reviews.author: Jasmin1963
reviews.title: paradise on earth
reviews.text: Khyber is the best resort to spend quality time with family,it amazingly beautiful with majestic Himalayan view.Restuarants & Spa provided good experience with wide range of relaxing & rejuvinating treatments.

reviews.author: samirtrip
reviews.title: overhyped resort in the hands of unprofessional managers
reviews.text:
Khyber is a good property given its location and decent size. There aren't better option in and around Gulmarg either. However, it does lack the quality levels of other bigger players like Taj Vivanta and Lalit in Srinagar.

The worst experience I had was about its non-transparent policy. We had booked our rooms online through hotel about 45 days in advance and we were offered Rs. 21,000 for their premier category on EP which we found was being offered at Rs.19,000 by the hotel. When we inquired about this, one of the managers at the reception suggested we must book through a travel agent in order to get  the discount. The other said the hotel changes rates daily. They had no justification for the variation and were only trying to avoid the conversation. The desk manager was unfriendly and uncooperative. 

Moreover, considering the tariff the rooms were too small and stinking. For someone who  does not want to go hiking/skiing or do any outdoor activities there is no point in staying at Gulmarg and/or Khyber. If one is only interested in experiencing the Gondola ride and visit the highest point, it is better to make a day trip from Srinagar which has better hotels and packages than Khyber for sure. Both Vivanta and Lalit are a lot better options than Khyber. It would be criminal to spend more than Vivanta at Khyber.

Even while visiting the level 1 & 2 by Gondola, be careful about the full on cheating by the ski taxies (They transfer you to a short distance 400/500 mtrs on ski) which demand absurd amounts like Rs. 4000 per person. It is not worth spending more than Rs. 400 (four hundred). They try hard to scare you by talking about the adversities of the place, but one can easily walk down this distance. Please do not spend more than Rs. 500 on ski transfers.

reviews.author: 0703nehag
reviews.title: extraordinary
reviews.text: We visited gulmarg in 2013 with one infant 2 yr old and another 7 yr child.In terms of cleanliness loved loved the place..exceptional location.overall a wonderful experience. ..the staff and manager would do everything in their control to make yr stay memorable one !!!eager to go back!!

reviews.author: Hariharan_NRS
reviews.title: One of the Best Hotels ever stayed
reviews.text: Arguably one of the best hotels I have ever stayed. Right from the room,hospitality, food and the view from room all are excellent...A definite place to stay.............................................

reviews.author: Saurabh Agarwal
reviews.title: Great Experereince at Gulmarg
reviews.text:
This is great property at Gulmarg. As Gulmarg is very small town there are very few options. First let me inform about Gulmarg City as there is no local civilization due to government has declared as "No Civilization Zone" due to weather conditions and due to the heritage value the town has. This is the reasons there are no new development  in this town. Hence there are very few hotel available. 

We stayed here though the hotel is 5 star deluxe but due to it's monopoly there is absence of customer delight services. The location of  hotel is beautiful and services provided by the hotel is as per the standard no extra customer delight like in The Lalit Grand Palace, Srinagar. Both the property can not comparable in term of service or it's ascetic value. The Gondola ride is just stone throw away from the hotel. The hotel has internal temperature controlled leisure pool which is lovely. The fragrance of aroma  would definitely refresh you. The food is good though the variety for vegetarian is less due to reason explained above in my review.

reviews.author: arm648
reviews.title: Great place for a weekend getaway
reviews.text:
Our family of 5 stayed at the Presidential Cottage at Khyber for 4 nights. Overall, I would rate the stay as a value for money 4.5/5 star. It was a perfect weekend out in the mountains of Kashmir and we will definitely be returning soon.  I think the fact that the property is not part of a large major chain meant that they were not able to take advantage of the decades of luxury hospitality experience that fine hotel chains such as a Four Seasons, St. Regis or Relais and Chateaux would bring. Although some of the names I mentioned above would charge much more per night for a similar property but you would also expect to get a lot more. I feel that although for the money they charge, they fall within the top few properties in India, but if they truly want to be recognised amongst the best (and there is a lot of potential), a little more work needs to be done. In summary:

Positives:

1. One of the biggest reason we enjoyed our stay at Khyber was because of our butler Sameer. Sameer put in 16-18 hour days for the entire duration of 4 nights to make sure every little request from morning to night was met. He seemed to go out of his way to make sure we were comfortable. He was there to help us all the time. All we needed to do was lift our heads and look towards him and he was there before we could even lift our finger. Whether it was ordering room service, setting up the table, serving us, placing an order in the busy restaurant, helping us organize spa treatments, making sure we knew our way around, he was there all the time. 

2. The cottage was luxuriously appointed with 3 spacious bedrooms and bathrooms, large balconies (with 2 rooms) and a garden. The silverware and crockery was high quality and the dark wood panelled decor gave the apartment the feel of a high end European ski resort.

3. The property was large with lots of things to do both in and out. It was located at a walking distance to the cable gondolas which would take us higher up in the mountains where we could find snow. 

4. The front office manager and most of the staff seemed extremely courteous.

5. The food was good and there was a lot of variety (Chinese, Asian, Punjabi, Kashmiri, Italian).

Negatives:

1. I found most of the staff in the spa not trained enough to manage guest expectations. The changing rooms next to the pool area was badly maintained with water spewn all over the floor (I almost slipped a couple of times) and the jacuzzis were not functioning. I had a little incident in the spa. I feel at the level at which they desire to be, meeting guests needs (even though guests are sometimes wrong) should be a priority. As a guest paying the kind of money we were paying, I dont expect to be told that I cant have a head neck and back massage for 60 minutes because the head and neck treatment is 45 mins and the back option has to be for 30 minutes, nothing more nothing less. I was told that  either I would have to pay for 75 minutes even though my treatment would be 60 or select a 30/45 minute option. To be fair I was at fault for reporting late but at a service oriented 5 star property, 9 out of 10 times, the staff wouldnt argue about this and just satisfy the guest. The 2000 rupees didnt make a difference to me and neither would it make a difference to the hotel but it didnt speak the attitude of a truly exceptional hotel.

2. The bathroom in the bedrooms was not properly air-conditioned and most of the time, it was absolutely freezing and uncomfortable. I hope they would install some sort of heating before the arrival of the winter. 

3. The room description mentioned that there was a heated jacuzzi in the room but we were very disappointed to see that the jacuzzi was all ripped out due to some maintenance. Now ordinarily this wouldnt be a problem, but as a guest I expected to be told about this during the booking itself and not while being shown around the room the first time. 

Overall the property exceeded expectations and I hope to return soon. I complement the owners and managers of the property to be able to run a great operation such as this.

Regards,

Abhishek.

reviews.author: Sidbhalla
reviews.title: Khyber Resort gives a world class experience
reviews.text:
Be it the property, the interiors, guest experience or quality of food, it is the best one can get at Kyber Himalayan Resort & Spa in Gulmarg. We had an amazing experience and a very comfortable stay at the Resort.

Customer delight is their motto and it reflected at every step. Sidharath Bhalla
Ruchika Bhalla
Pratyush Bhalla

reviews.author: crazymanmeet
reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text:
My family (Three of us in Srinagar) had an awesome trip. 
We loved the Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa Gulmarg - no hotels could have been more beautiful or welcoming. It seemed specially attuned to nature and contemplation. We just wanted to be there longer. We felt like visiting royalty every step of the way.

reviews.author: ssamra
reviews.title: Something is missing
reviews.text: Khyber is the best option in beautiful Gulmarg. Even towards end of April Gulmarg was all covered in snow. Hotel location is excellent and very near to Gondola boarding point. Staff is very good and so is food, spa and all other hotel facilities. But something seems to be missing to rate this property excellent. When I compare  it with Oberoi's hospitality at Wildflower Hall or Cecil Shimla or with the newly opened JW Marriott at Mussoorie, I definitely feel something is missing for the price I paid. But I am well compensated with the beauty of Gulmarg. Gondola ride to  Apharwat  is not to be missed. If you afford Khyber is the only choice to stay at Gulmarg.

reviews.author: JainKavyah
reviews.title: ONE IN A MILLION!!!!
reviews.text: Visited khyber in this april with my family. It is d most beautifull property in gulmarg. The food was xcellent..the breakfast buffet was one of its kind. The most important thing in any hotel are d staff.... N the staff here are simlpy beyond comparison.. Not just one but all of them!!!  Hats off to  mr. Umar tramboo who has put kashmir hospitality back to its best. My one destination for an ideal holiday will definately be "khyber"... An advise to my trip advisor friends, if u r in gulmarg then dont miss khyber....its one in a million!!!

reviews.title: Fantastic on all counts
reviews.text:
More than a 5 star. Excellent location and great view from all the rooms. Excellent food and a massive buffet spread. Staff was kind helpful and most attentive to every minute detail. 
Had a fantastic 3N stay

reviews.author: Sunayna Pateria
reviews.title: Birthday celebrations in the snow!
reviews.text:
I went for my birthday in April to Gulmarg this year and it was absolutely fantastic.

Khyber hotel offers the best indoor heated swimming pool which was the highlight of the hotel. My husband and I did the couples retreat in the Spa by L'occitane which was very good as well. They also have swimming costumes on sale which came very handy.

Their Sheesha lounge had very good sheesha which I personally was very happy about.  The food however in their restaraunt is super average. I would recommend to try other hotels which we did not have the liberty to do as we were short of time. Highland Park seems to be high on everybody's list.

They donot serve any alcohol but have all the crockery necessary which was a plus as well. Overall the service was great even though it was a bit slow. The view from the hotel is unimaginably beautiful.

reviews.author: YusuF P
reviews.title: Best of everything
reviews.text:
The hotel service and rooms are both excellent. the best part about it is that it is situated closely to the Gondola ride, which is a walking distance from the property.

amazing amenities, excellent rooms and all with such fantastic view. we were lucky to have snow at the time of our stay, which just romanticized the entire holiday. 

Lovely food and excellent service with a special care towards children.

reviews.author: DheerajRathi
reviews.title: The best I have been to
reviews.text: This is the best hotel I have been to. The interiors, facilities, swimming pool are awesome. Service and food is great. Don't miss this place. Only minus no free wifi. It is one of the most special swimming pools you will swim in

reviews.author: MeenalmumMumbai
reviews.title: A modern oasis of luxury in snowed out Gulmarg, with great service...
reviews.text:
Firstly, one is awed when one walks into the large lobby in a place like Gulmarg. Clearly it is a comfortable, luxurious hotel in a small town which has otherwise quaint hotels. We stayed there when the flood news was at its peak and it was a luxury to drive up to the lobby in the car in five feet plus snow. Most definitely the service is great with all requests and questions immediately attended to. I would like to specifically congratulate the hotel for the following two challenges we faced. Firstly, my 13 year old son fell very sick and the house doctor was very responsive and genuinely concerned. Secondly, my mother thought she had lost her wallet, but after we had checked out the housekeeping staff found it. Zafar called us after we had left the hotel and followed up diligently for the safe return of the contents.

The staff is truly warm and caring and extremely prompt. 

The only issue I have was that food was hugely overpriced. I think they should have a child menu. 

The second concern is that during times of snow (when we visited) we almost missed our flight as our car was stuck in a jam created solely by hotel guests leaving. Given such a large property in such a small town with limited infrastructure the hotel may have to step up the logistic arrangements. Again the staff went out of the way to get our luggage to our car rental that could not get to the hotel due to the massive traffic jam. It was a bit unnerving as all the guests were on the same flight!!!

reviews.author: ROHIT V
reviews.title: Truly Heaven On Earth!
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful places on earth. Khyber with Himalayan Views was really breath taking, views that you may not also get in Switzerland. The property was well maintained and the staff very courteous. Food was delicious. I was upgraded to the Himalayan View. Thanks a lot for that, otherwise would have missed something unique. Unbelievable, property in the mountain. Double thumbs up!

reviews.author: Omar A
reviews.title: Truly a masterpiece! Out of the world experience
reviews.text:
I would start this review by thanking the Khyber Industries for giving the world a chance to feel and experience the beauty of Kashmir in a truly grand way. We stayed for two nights and it was mesmerising. I would like to add the stay at Khyber, with their highly dedicated staff and five star amenities, was a real delight and an experience of a life time. I would personally like to thank Mr Junaid Ul Hassan and Mr Imtiyaz as they made our stay a real smooth one with memories to cherish for a life time. All staff is really friendly and the food is decent too. 
Highly recommended!!!

reviews.author: Dr C P Khandelwal
reviews.title: Most beautiful place
reviews.text: We stayed in Khyber resort on 22nd March. It was snow every where. Gulmarg was mesmerising. Khyber is the best property in Gulmarg. Very close to Gandolas. Hospitality was excellent. Rooms can easily be rated 7 stars. Views from rooms as well as restaurant was amazing. Food had variety and was excellent. Property is clean, tastefully built and well maintained. There are many thoughtfully created sitting spaces in property,from where you can leisurely emjoy the view. It was really heaven like experience. One day stay was less,will definitely visit this place again.

reviews.author: Bhingri
reviews.title: Exotic!
reviews.text:
Gulmarg is arguably the most beautiful place on earth and Khyber adds luxury to it. The location is good- quite close to the Gondola. The decor is tasteful. Rooms are spacious and clean. (Loved their bedcovers with exquisite kashmiri work on it). Views are breathtaking. The swimming pool, jacuzzi and sauna are fun. Taking a dip in heated swimming pool looking at the snow all around is an experience. The restaurant serves decent food. It is commendable how they run the hotel at such a height. 
However, their service is a mixed package. The reception staff and restaurant staff were helpful and courteous, while some others were very cold and unwelcoming. For some unknown reason, there was no minibar in the room. The bathtub was clean but in a bit rundown condition. The water in the shower was spilling outside even with closed door. Bathroom slippers were missing. 
One big issue is that they do not have any arrangement for the drivers. Most of the people who come here use taxis, hence the concern for driver is very relevant. The outside temperature is pretty low for the driver to spend the night in the vehicle. They have to rush down to Tungmarg - 10-12 km down the hill and come up every time we need their service. They do not want to wait at the hotel because if there is heavy snowfall or any such problem, if the car refuses to start due to cold, they claim that the hotel is very unhelpful and the they get into a fix.
 
So, all in all, its a mix package of goodies with the hotel, but Gulmarg with all its uniqueness and charm makes your trip memorable for sure :)

reviews.author: Moloy Biswas
reviews.title: Great Stay at Khyber
reviews.text: Khyber is one of the best resorts I have stayed so far. The room was quite spacious and had a great view. The decor of the room was very good and was full with required amenities. The room had a very good temperature control system and we were very comfortable inside when it was -2 degrees outside. Buffet Breakfast was well spread and had lot of options. Though the price is quite high, but I feel it is worth the premium class hospitality we received.

reviews.author: Madhu Naiker
reviews.title: Excellant place to visit just before winter sets in
reviews.text: The staff were courteous and attentive especially the dinner waiters. Very spacious to wonder around and absorb the scenic atmosphere from outside balcony. Security features very excellent and very safe. A walk away from the Ski lifts "Gondola" make it a very convenient location to stay. Well worth the money.  the hot spa pool is a must especially in Winter.

reviews.author: Sumit K
reviews.title: Enchanting Luxury amidst Exotic Gulmarg
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure to visit this place during end march. I had booked 4nights stay and keen interst was on ski-ing. The property is amazing with good wooden decor, centrelly heated pool and premises. The main part is service which is excellent as every staff greets you each time you pass. My package included dining and breakfast. The dining spread was not much but each time the dishes were different though I expected spme signature Kashmiri dishes like Wazawaan. The breakfast was pretty uniform, nothing much to home about. The hotel is located close to gondola but one needs to climb a steep 700 meters to access it if the visist are frequent so one with small babies be aware of this. From Gondola few cabs can drop you to the hotel at 300 Rs. The pickup and drop is not included and the hotel charges around 4000INR one way which is steep. So its advisable to book a taxi from airport around 2000-2300RS. Sometimes in heavy snow taxi can plough till Tanmarg from where new vehicle, an 4X4 is to be booked around 700 INr but it still is economical. 
The hotel has a central heated pool which gives great view of surrouding snow. The hotel offeres complimentary steam, sauna and jacuzzi services along with gym. The housekeeping and room service is excellent and the quality of towels, linen is upto mark. I had booked the basic premier room which served the purpose if you are family of 2. The views are breathtakig and one can clearly see the sunrise and sunet on adjoining peaks.
A great luxorious experience desrving for a placelike Gulmarg. Khyber hotel is the best with a broaddaylight bewteen it and the other adjoining the area.

reviews.author: IanP-SGP
reviews.title: Great hardware, weak software
reviews.text:
We spent 3 nights at this property in mid March.  Looks were deceiving.  We were delighted by the greeting at the grand, top of the hill entrance and swept into a comfortable lobby with a registration desk and an activities desk.  Perfect!  We wanted to ski, hike wander the area... so after check in, presented ourselves to the Activities desk.  We outlined our hopes enthusiastically.  Response: There are ski shops in the valley.  Gondola tickets? You'll need to queue.  Hiking choices?  Talk to a guide in the village.  And so on.  Disappointed, we weren't going to let the hands off approach cramp our holiday and did indeed manage to find, with much effort, the right stuff.  Why the hotel was unequipped to help was perplexing.

However, as we were now negotiating and settling directly with providers we were running through rupees at an alarming rate.  No problem.  Let's change some US$ or Euros at the desk.  Nope.  Response:  Too much paperwork.  You go to the bank in the village.  Doubly perplexed, we asked to see the manager on duty to understand if this was really the right answer for a hotel with aspirations.  Nope.  Response:  He's too busy.  Leave your room number.  We did.  He never called.

So the conclusion: Great location, brilliant surroundings, incompetent and indifferent staff.

reviews.author: Reema_Kesarkar
reviews.title: A deserving Luxury for Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Visited Khyber for 4nights during end of march. The entire hotel is centrally heated with good wooden decor fitting for a 5 star luxury. The best part is the welcoming staff and service which greet you each time you pass them. Room service is very quick and so is housekeeping. I had taken an Himalayan package which included breakfast and dinner. The dinner spread though limited was new each day although few of Kashmiri signature dishes would be welcomed. Breakfast was almost same but good enough to start the day if you stay here and want to go out for ski-ing , my main purpose. I had booked a premier room which is the most basic yet it was spacious. The higher suites have balcony but for family of 2 with a kid the premier room is good enough. The hotel is located near the gondola but one needs to climb a steep incline to reach it so take that in mind if one commutes each day for ski-ing. Ski equipment can be rented at hotel. The hotel charges around 4000INR for pickup and drop one way to the airport which is quite steep. One can easily get good cars around 2000-2300 from srinagar or Gulmarg so keep that in mind. Most times the vehicles if snow is too much get changed at tanmarg which charge around 700 rs till gulmarg, still a good bargain. I also used the spa facilities. The treatments range from 3500 [massage per 60minutes]. the whole approach is good and is relaxing and one can opt for the spa after a day long ski. The hotel has a heated pool just to relax. Its small so do not entertain much of swimming but gives great view of the surrounding while resting . The hotel also gives complimentary steam, sauna, jacuzzi facilities along with gym. The view from the room are breathtaking and one can see amazing sunrise and sunset on the peaks 
To sum up I would say, excellent staff, excellent service, great place and quite a daylight between Khyber and other similar hotels in Gulmarg

reviews.author: Mohashak
reviews.title: A  beautiful property with amazing views
reviews.text:
We have been travelling all over the world and have stayed in some very good hotel, but this hotel is truly special, the view from our room was amazing with the added bonanza of snowfall during our trip which our kids loved, very courteous and helpful staff, although the check in is a bit complicated. Even though the front office staff try to minimize the hassle. The hotel should keep some OTC medecines as we wanted panadol for my son which was not available , and there was no option as shops close early. But to sum up a great place visit and stay.
Mohammed
Kuwait

reviews.author: nimeshshahdr
reviews.title: snowbound at gulmarg
reviews.text: We stayed at khyber recently for 2 nights and we were amazed at the quality of service and food at a place which is difficult to access as we were with 4 to 5 ft of snow.The kids love it as there were ample activities for them once back at the resort. . The resort is 5 to 7 min from the gondola.

reviews.author: dagamanoj
reviews.title: A memorable trip to Gulmarg
reviews.text: I along with my wife and our 2 grandchildren visited Gulmarg in 2nd week of March,2015 and stayed at The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa. The resort is so wonderful and the location is awesome. The breakfast menu is excellent and the quality of food overall is excellent. The staff are very courteous and very helpful. The first floor room with balcony is most sought of. By luck we had snowfall during our stay and it was so lovely. Even though it was so cold outside, but inside the hotel due to central heating, the temperature was pleasant.It is 5 star property well maintained

reviews.author: ArianPranav
reviews.title: Heaven in snow, but bit costly...
reviews.text: We went there with a group of 3 families during January and stayed for three days. Though the resort is on costly side but at such a high altitude its tuff to offer such 5 star stuff. There is indoor pool of warm water and there are ample games for kids including two X-box. They have dedicated 1-2 SUV which can take you to Gondola (rope-way) ride. They provide rubber boots for guests including kids while they want to enjoy playing in snow. Food was having lot of variety and offerings were nice. Buffet is served for breakfast, lunch and dinner which have ample options. Since it was snowing outside so remained indoor most of the time. Overall the resort is centrally heated which makes it convenient for elders and kids for most of the time while outside the temperatures are in minus. They offer kahwa as welcome drink which make you indulge in Kashmiri spirits….

reviews.author: Sandeep_Raturi
reviews.title: Loved my stay here  !
reviews.text:
Loved my stay at the hotel. 

You can't beat the location. Simply one of the best Hill Resorts in India. New hotel but built in a style that gives its Lobby a Heritage and classy look. A lot of wood work in the hotel. Framed photographs (depicting Kashmiri culture) are used as artwork instead of paintings. Rooms are carpeted, fairly spacious (350 sq ft) and offers stunning views of the pine trees and slopes. I visited during the heaviest snowfall and the views were surreal. The pool area is very good and looks amazing with wild pine trees just behind the glass wall. Play area to keep the kids busy. Wifi is chargeable and so is the mini Theatre. 

The staff at the hotel is predominantly Kashmiris and this I personally think is highly commendable  as employment to locals is the necessary component of Eco Tourism. 
The check-in at the hotel was smooth and quick. We were given a hot cup of 'Kahwa' in the coffee lounge and by the time we finished our drink, the keys were ready and we were escorted to the room not by a porter but by a smart front office executive himself. Room service is prompt and orders were ready in no time. I waited for only 15 minutes for the Dinner to be served in the room. However the quality of service is not uniform as one would expect from a luxury hotel. The dinner plates were not cleared till my check-out next morning. This is unimaginable for a luxury resort.  More training is required for the staff especially at the restaurant. During breakfast, I had to ask for water and tea/coffee. In a Luxury resort and for that matter in any good hotel/resort, it is expected from the waiters to keep a tab on the tables and fill/refill glass of water even before the guests ask for it. I asked for a glass of water and I was given one and still the water was not served to my family which is nothing but a  lackadaisical attitude of the service staff.  But these are minor glitches and I am sure it will improve with times. 
Bathrooms are spacious with bathtub, shower cubicle and a transparent window that separates it from the bedroom. If the blinders are up, you can enjoy the view of the pine trees from the bathtub itself. Wooden blinders looks good but messy to operate. If I start nitpicking, I would be tempted to say that the WC shower appears tacky and very low quality.
The food is said to be highlight of the hotel. I am a vegetarian and not a foodie so can't comment much on it but have heard very good things about the food at this hotel. One should know that there is NO BAR at the hotel so one must come prepared with his stuff packed. There is a nice Cigar lounge for the smokers. 

I work for a travel company and overall I find it a very nice resort which I can easily recommend to my clients. I loved my stay in the hotel.

reviews.author: Mamta M
reviews.title: Winter wonderland - fabulous views and very comfortable hotel.
reviews.text: We stayed in the Himalayan view rooms and had the most amazing views of the mountains. The hotel was very comfortable - fully heated and very nice rooms. The service was very good even though the hotel was totally full. The restaurant staff went out of their way to serve a Kashmiri vegetarian thali which was not even on the menu.

reviews.author: Prateek_Rungta
reviews.title: A must stay when in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Stayed for 2 nights at Khyber in the month of February 2015. Excellent location, great property. Very close to the gandola and other ski places. The lobby and restaurants have a great ambiance. Rooms are well done but slightly small. The balconies & common areas have decent views - we had 2 feet of snow inside the balcony and a blanket of white all around.
The staff is very helpful - bell boys, front desk, security and housekeeping.
However, at approx INR 21000 per night may not be quite value for money.
Overall, great experience and would highly recommend it to first time visitors to Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Naman49
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I visited srinagar during the winters and I don't think there is any hotel/resort better than khyber. The location is on the hill top so you can get amazing panoramic views from every room. Only minus is alcohol is not sold there so you have to bring your own but other than that its a 5 star resort.

reviews.author: ashajainDelhi
reviews.title: Jannat!
reviews.text: Location, service, facilities n ambience , everything is superb about this place! Would certainly love to visit again, this time in summers! Just a request to the concierge to arrange the activities for the guests so they would not have to deal with guides and drivers outside and are confident that they are not cheated.

reviews.author: rksharmadelhi2015
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: We stayed in Khybwer in Gulamrg but we wre disappointed with our stay. The hotel calls itsel;f a 5* deluxe property but does not have a Bar, the breakfast spread in average with no pork or ham. The views premier rooms are also average as compared to Highlands park which we happened to see during our visit. Overall a disappointing experience considering the amount they charge.

reviews.author: AvyaP
reviews.title: Beautiful is the word
reviews.text: beautiful property with great indoor facility plus extremely mesmerizing surrounding. would recommend more for people either on honeymoon/ big group as there are lot of activities to do be done both indoor as well as outdoor

reviews.author: manakmoti
reviews.title: Excellent Resort in Himalayas
reviews.text:
I have visited this super luxurious resort in Gulmarg, Himalayas in 28 feb to 3 March 2015 with family & friends.
Excellent interior, luxurious rooms, suprb location, breath taking view of himalayas, and above all always smiling staff.
Forget Switzerland, every nature lover must visit this resort for atleast 3 nites during winters & enjoy snowfall.
Room Tarrifs are worth its luxury, location and service....  
And Rafiq I miss aroma of your hot Kahwa.....& smile.....
Rest assured Mr Herbert (GM), all my morning walk friends & many more family members will soon be there.....
A must visit resort for all snow & nature lovers....

reviews.author: vishalforlife
reviews.title: Hotel location
reviews.text: This is one of the most amazing located hotels in India. more beautiful than Switzerland . I went in 7 feet snow still the hotel was fantastically well maintained. Just next to Gondola gate . Rooms have excellent view . It has a heated swimming pool throughout the year which itself is an achievement considering the temperatures in Gulmarg. the hotel GM Mr. Mata personally supervises everything. excellent food .Very nice staff and you are treated royally in the hotel. Big room and even bigger bathrooms make this an absolute delight to stay.

reviews.author: k_vishwanathan
reviews.title: Amazing place in paradise
reviews.text:
Stayed at the hotel in Feb right in the midst of a snowfall. It is truly paradise. The hotel service was impeccable, staff most friendly, amazing amenities. Will go there every year.

Please do take the number of Farooq (9797248209). Amazingly knowledgeable, very helpful guide and ski instructor.

reviews.author: Shilpa N
reviews.title: Great property but at an exorbitant price & very unprofessional front desk staff
reviews.text:
Our bad experience with the Khyber service started even before we reached. Booked this place through booking.com but got a message closer to our stay saying that there was some issue with the card details. I contacted one Mr Mashood from the hotel and he suggested I either use another card or do a bank transfer. I confirmed on email that I shall execute the transfer from my bank acc and promptly did the bank transfer the same day. In a few days I get a message from booking.com saying the transaction has failed and my booking stands cancelled. On contacting Mr Mashood again, he arrogantly replied that I did not email the transaction details post the transaction, hence the booking stands cancelled. If the transaction details were required, couldn't Mr Mashood do a quick call back post my confirmation email and ask for the same? Anyway, here's what he had to say: "you are lucky there is a room still available. Send me the details soon now." I did that and got an email from him giving the date of transaction, amount & my bank acc details. Soon got a confirmation voucher from him.

We arrived at Khyber on a snowy February day. 

And then the wait to check in began: almost half an hour and then the front desk staff tells me I will need to swipe my card before check in as they can't trace my payment. I was livid since I'd already done the transfer in full. When I showed the confirmation voucher, they claimed it's not enough and they need the transaction id.  I had already given my bank acc details and date of transfer, so couldn't understand why it was rocket science for them to check their with accounts instead of making me wait so long and insisting that I log into my bank acc and give them the transaction id right then. This was after a 3 hour long journey and I had a toddler in tow.
None the less, I offered to check into my acc and give them the details if I had access to the internet, but there was no 3G connectivity on my phone/laptop in this remote location. They promptly suggested that I BUY a premium wifi package!! I was astonished at the audacity!! Finally, managed to get hold of their desktop and fish out the details. On speaking to the manager about my experience, I did get a customary apology which neither meant much nor changed my opinion about the service.

As a parallel, when I compare this experience to the experiences we had at other luxury hotels like the Taj, Khyber doesn't stand a chance. No special surprises or personal touches by any staff member. Khyber comes across as mercenary and cold.

However, while the service was disappointing, here are the pluses
-The place was opulent and we immediately fell in love with the property. Warm wooden interiors, rich furnishings and full length glass walls offering magnificent views of the snowy landscape outside.
- The food at the restaurant is quite nice
- The L'Occitane spa is out of the world. The staff at the spa is very professional & well trained

This place costs over 17k INR(close to 300 USD) per night with no inclusions other than breakfast. Even the wifi comes at a price tag(very, very regressive). One expects great service when it is THE most expensive hotel one has ever stayed at. Not meant for travelers who spend hard earned money and expect a once in a lifetime experience.

reviews.author: sanketutility
reviews.title: Khyber - Lives up to its reputation and more!!
reviews.text: When we booked Khyber, with a toddler in tow, we were really not sure what to expect. We had heard about its excellent hospitality and location, and within a couple of hours of reaching there, our apprehensions were all gone and we settled down into the sheer opulent luxury and outstanding hospitality of its staff. Everyone was courteous to a fault and they made sure that we did not have the slightest of problems during our stay, even if it meant delivering a glass of warm milk within 5 minutes at 4 am for our son. The Gandola is within walking distance of the hotel and the views are breathtaking. The food is excellent and the breakfast is a treat. Can't wait to go back for my next ski vacation to Khyber!!

reviews.author: Rakesh D
reviews.title: Arrogant Staff- Bad Food
reviews.text: Checked in on 18th Feb with Family as we had heard lot about this hotel with raving reviews. Right from the entrance the security was very rude not ready to help or provide with wheel chair for senior citizen . Buffet had very little spread with most of the dishes uncooked with arrogant waiters not ready serve water inspite of asking several times. Overall very frustating experience.

reviews.author: francesca d
reviews.title: A cozy indian experience
reviews.text: We enjoyed our four day stay in gulmarg. The hotel is cozy and warm, with beautiful large windows over the snowy landscape. The hotel has a very scenografic spa area, with a nice and warm swimming pool, exactly what you need after an intense day of powder snow skiying. The spa itself is l 'occitaine and the quality of the treatments is very very good. The room is decent size and we had a very large bed. Personell is extremely attentive, helpful and kind and takes personal interest in the comfort of your stay. Extremely kids friendly staff and place ( there is also a kids pool). We wiould certainly stay at the kyber again.

reviews.author: Badri Beriwal
reviews.title: Only place that stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text: this was my second time to Gulmarg and found this property to be the best place in Kashmir right now with amazing people and fantastic food. This is just my second day and I am loving it. Will keep you all updated.

reviews.author: pravinsri
reviews.title: himalayan wonder
reviews.text: Our 2nd visit to this hotel and it was more awesome than the Ist. Perhaps because we were able to witness snow fall the first time in our lives! But it's an amazing place anyway, beautifully located and with very nice comfortable rooms. The ambience is just right for a relaxed stay with extremely hospitable staff. The restaurant too is good and the staff there very very helpful. Aijaz, Ishfaq, Arshid in particular were outstanding in their service. A hotel truly worth a visit by everyone who can!

reviews.author: mughal13
reviews.title: Could have been better
reviews.text: We stayed at newly opened resort in gulmarg khyber as previously we used to saty in hotel highlands park. The hotel is located next to gandola nad does not have spectacular views as probably highlands park does but the rooms, heating are good. The food needs improvemnt as their kashmiri food is very mediocre. Also a la carte rates are exorbitant and do not justify as per portion size and taste. Khyber can be better with improvement in food quality.

reviews.author: Arun K
reviews.title: Fantastic hospitality
reviews.text: Khyber Himalayan Resort and Spa is truly a spectacular property and the staff are the most courteous and follow a "Never say no to customer" policy which is amazing. The rooms are spacious and well furnished and so are the bathrooms with a separate shower area, comfort room and main wash area, well segregated. We get a wardrobe area where you can keep your luggage. Facilities in the hotel are awesome like a well equipped Steam, Sauna and a Jacuzzi- separate area for men and women. A nice well equipped play area for kids and adults called the "Igloo", they have an air hockey game, carrom and x box (3 sets) and some toys for young kids. Table Tennis was a miss and thy can easily add this.

reviews.author: Isha2512
reviews.title: it's a paradise !!!
reviews.text: Had a 4 night stay at the Khyber Gulmarg and just got home yesterday. It's one of the few hotels which I couldn't wait to get home and review. Had a fantastic wholesome experience at this beautiful property. Its a complete package where nothing goes wrong, great rooms, beautiful location overlooking the mountains and pine trees dotted with snow, nice cozy well-heated rooms, clean, luxurious spa and health club, mouth watering food and lovely friendly and extremely helpful staff who were more than willing to make us feel comfortable, recommending some delicious dishes, helpling out with last minute taxi bookings and pretty much looking after all our needs. We were travelling with a 4 yr old child and were a bit apprehensive initially of the snow and weather, but staying at Khyber my little one enjoyed it soo much , he keeps asking when we are going back. Kudos to the friendly staff who made him really have a good time made him so happy with gulab jamuns and chocos and stuff everyday.. the hotel really knows how to pamper its guests :) feeling truly pampered and spoilt with all the luxury... can't wait to go back to the khyber soon !!!

reviews.author: Riddhivardhan
reviews.title: Divine Snow Wonder
reviews.text:
One the most amazing snow luxury hotels in the world, KHYBER is a perfect combination of nature and luxury. The views are mind blowing.......u feel close to the Divine.I went in late january, could enjoy the snow fall and snow carpet all around with chilling cold. 
          Courteous staff, nice ambience, good food , heated pools with good himalayan views and close proximity to Gondola make it a perfect recipe for fun. As the word khyber means extremes of health , fortune and spirituality..........U FEEL IT !!!!! One of my finest holidays , i will remember khyber for a long long time, i strongly recommend this himalayan resort for your trip to gulmarg.

I want to thank Mr Zaffar Malik (Manager Operations) for giving me a complimentary upgrade to himalayan view room which made my experience more beautiful.

reviews.author: PrateekBhargava
reviews.title: Absolutely brilliant... One of the properties in India
reviews.text:
Khyber is by far the best luxury resort to experience snow across the country. Better than even Oberoi's wild flower hall. Set in the beautiful valley of Gulmarg the resort is absolutely superb.

Brilliant rooms, latest technology, amazing food.

We stayed in the 2 bedroom cottage and it is absolutely brilliant. Spacious luxurious and awesome views.

We were well taken care of by our private butler Bilal who was absolutely perfect. 
Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Srinagar and Gulmarg.

reviews.author: ajaymehta20
reviews.title: Gstaad and a hotel to match!
reviews.text:
I'm not a snow person! Decided to stay at the Khyber for 3 nights with the family, 2 kids and my parents. from the airport till the hotel and throughout our stay, the service, the quality of people, the food, the rooms, gym, pool, spa and the overall quality were all, in two words, FIRST RATE!

Special mention to - Zafar, at the front desk, very pleasant young man who was eager to meet our requests and did so efficiently! - Shyam - at the Restaurant - super chap who knew that a good meal was the best remedy for a day out in the snow - he did not stop the goodies and was very intuitive and efficient! 

I don't have the names of the some of the other staff, but they were all Super and really made us feel special! 

My compliments to the GM too! He was again intuitive and forthcoming!

Great Stay!

reviews.author: Anon299
reviews.title: Excellent Ski/Mountain Resort
reviews.text:
There is simply nothing to fault this hotel about. I doubt if you would find a better ski/mountain resort anywhere else in the world. 
Excellent rooms, excellent service, excellent food, amazing property and facilities.
Superb indoor heated pool and spa facilities.
The staff could not be friendlier or more helpful.

reviews.author: ahmedunaiz
reviews.title: Great family retreat!
reviews.text:
What an experience! 
This was my first trip to Kashmir and going to Gulmarg and staying at the Khyber hotel made it all the more memorable. The staff were really friendly and went out of they way to make us feel comfortable, we had kids with us  and the hotel was equipped to take care of them, they had play area and a room with games and stuff.
The spa treatments were really world class, after a day of skiing and being outdoor  the massage was relaxing and masseurs were experienced.they even had a steam room in each of the massage rooms. 
We used the gym and heated pool as well as the jacuzzi . All of which were clean and well maintained.
The rooms were tastefully furnished and care was taken to provide all the necessary comforts. The deep sunken tub with Himalayan view had a romantic yet relaxing feel.
They even have a cloak room at the entrance to leave the boots and snow gear. That was very thoughtful and convenient.
The hotel felt like a palace and was maintained like a seven star stay. 
I would definitely recommend it for families it really worth the stay.

reviews.author: MFNAZ
reviews.title: Best resort
reviews.text: We stayed here in the month of July,it was the best experience  we had.staff of the hotel is well trained.Hotel is newly built n will take time to get better in all aspects.We enjoyed our stay.Would love to visit again.

reviews.author: 102brijesht
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth :)
reviews.text: One of the best resorts in India, Its certainly a heaven on earth, once you stay at khyber you're not going anywhere else. You come to the balcony of your room & what you experience is surely not to be described in words, snow clad peaks, amazing forests, The gondola rides close by & the world class restaurants serving amazing kashmiri cuisine. There's a brilliant cinnamon fragrance around the property, wonderful managed & a luxurious experience put together by the management. Can't wait to get back here.

reviews.author: Avijit D
reviews.title: Has the potential to mature into its distinctive uniqueness....
reviews.text:
It's important to state, at the onset that khyber, is just a couple of years old. So its distinctiveness & certain elements of its character is yet to evolve. But certainly got the start going for it, which has put Gulmarg glamourously on the map of snow destinations.

The Architecture and the picturesque setting, modern bathrooms, heated indoor pool, the spa and being a short trot away from the Gondola are definitely spectacular starts. It's probably the most comfortable and luxurious that you can get as a winter destination. Is an Must do experience.

The human interactions, the distinctive food as well as integration with the local culture & environment is what creates lasting impressions. Food for thought, as Khyber i am sure, will go about creating its distinctive uniqueness in years to come.

Allow me to elaborate.....

Will always remember Gul Chacha, our guide and the chacha for the whole Gulmarg. Will remembers the conversations with locals @ Bakshi dhaba down at the village.
