Unfortunately, don't remember any such human interactions @ Khyber which have made an impact. Pakizah at the front desk was sweet & did stretch herself to attend to our needs. Should be mentioned. An unfortunate start to our stay at Khyber was that while checking in, the front desk announced that the transfer that we had made prior to arrival was short by 11k INR, so if we could settle that first before settling into our rooms. After showing email interactions with Imran Khan @ reservations, the front desk apologized that they had made an error and everything was paid. Maybe systems issue, but was not a very great start to human interactions within 15 mins of arriving @ Khyber.

Surprisingly Kashmiri dishes were not part of the room service menu. The buffet dinner was standard stuff without any emphasis on local culture & cuisine. The Tabak Maas and the roganjosh that we ordered Ala-carte, was similar or worse than what we have had at any restaurant at Delhi or Mumbai or other metros.

Little details could have made the difference. Gondola tickets made available right at the hotel for example, anti-skid mats in the showers (and please do away with the decorative carpet in the bathroom. Slipped and almost fell twice), personalised butlers, more seating capacity for breakfast across the property, are some of the suggestions, which could be positive steps in the right direction.

Will probably return to experience Khyber 2.0

reviews.author: Bobby15801
reviews.title: THE BEST SERVICE EVER
reviews.text:
We, my children and grand children, stayed at the Khyber from 3 Jan 2015 to 13 Jan 2015. We had come to enjoy the snow and do some skiing - but it was not to be. Though we were a little disappointed as there was no snow, the staff of this wonderful hotel made up for this lack of snow and made our stay most enjoyable and memorable. 
We were received and welcomed by the General Manager, Mr Sujith Herbert personally, inspite of his busy schedule as the hotel was fully booked. This warm gesture of his made us forget the lack of snow. Through out our stay the complete staff were very friendly and most efficient and ensured there was nothing wanting. Whereas I thank the complete staff for making are stay so comfortable I would also like to make a special mention of Dy Manager Zafar and house keeping staff Gulzar & Ishfaq Wani. I would like to make a special mention of Mr Herbert, who went out of his way to make us comfortable and made it feel like a home away from home, a gesture very few people at his level do. 
Thanks team KHYBER we will definitely be back soon and highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: ramaaIndia
reviews.title: Beauty , with some beast issues .
reviews.text:
We stayed in Khyber  during the last week of December  2014 . The hotel is built very close to the gondola and is a visual treat . There was some snow , and we  were awed with the entire experience of driving in into the  hotel..The lobby  was mind blowingly awesome and the kahwa delicious . Our check in  was very smooth , in fact the service was excellent throughout our stay .Every staff member was very courteous and eager to please . The restaurant staff especially were extremely  courteous and  prompt in their service . Food was exorbitantly expensive , but then in Gulmarg ,  choices are few . Sheer pampering during the spa sessions , very professional . 
Letdown - quality of sleep , we were in the  premier rooms  and there was an issue with the heating   in the room , the room felt stuffy at night  and though the problem was instantly attended to , it just spoilt that night for us . We again faced the same issue on our second night stay there , but we slept through as we were tired , having gone to apharwat that day 
This was not expected , for a five star luxury resort and it was a definite letdown after having stayed in the Hyatt group of hotels in the same trip.
This apart , Khyber is a very beautiful  place to stay in and enjoy for sure ! would maybe stay there again .

reviews.author: anubhavbindraa
reviews.title: Could have been much better
reviews.text: Hotel Khyber in gulmarg is a relatively new hotel and best in its class in gulmarg. The rooms are a mix and match of everything but workable. The lobby looks lika a museum with loads of memorabilia. The food is not that tasty as it should have been and service is slow. Spa though is good. For the price should have been much better.

reviews.author: Ravi D
reviews.title: A must to visit Khyber Himalayan resort Gulmarg
reviews.text:
We visited Khyber on Dec 25th 2014 to 28th Dec 2014, and what a place to stay in.The reception guys introduce you to this beautiful property overlooking the snow capped mountains.Take a room with a balcony.The pine tress are a stone throw away and at a few mile distance you see the snowy Himalayan range and the view is just magnificent.In the morning the cold winds blow and sipping coffee in the balcony breathing that air is a true aphrodisiac.I traveled with my wife and daughter and the staff makes you feel so warm.The buffet is just great but also try the kashmiri dishes from the Ala card its good too.The location of the hotel allows kids to play in the snow in the hotel itself and jumping back to a warm environment as soon as the play is over.The hotel is like a fortress and the security guys are just fab.They look the NSG kinds.
Special thanks to Mr Sujith Herbert, the general manager  a special person you can never miss during your stay.Guys from the restaurant,Aijaz and Ishfaq doing a great job.cheers!!

reviews.author: ZMR
reviews.title: GREAT STAY
reviews.text: What a wonderful location...... A great place to base yourself to visit the stunning Gulmarg . Really enjoyed our stay at the exceptional rooms , overlooking the snow covered mountain side. As for the staff, from the GM to all his support team, a very big thumbs up. Exceptional level of hospitality and care. The rooms with balconies ( upgraded rooms from what I was told) have a fantastic layout and facilities. Some pointers though: ..in winter, oil heaters maybe more useful as the room gets very dry with the air-conditioning heaters. It will be good to have some heathers in the bathrooms. The buffet at the restaurant was average.  Overall, a memorable experience and well worth recommending to others

reviews.author: Nihar1905
reviews.title: Magnificent Khyber
reviews.text: Nestled in the slopes of Gulmarg the khyber is one resort which offers tourists a true himalayan experience in the lap of five star luxury. From an indoor heated swimming pool to a fully functional spa the hotel offers a fully functional restaurant, coffee shop and a cigar lounge. The breakfast was an elaborate spread. The rooms are well heated and offer an excellent view of the mountains directly across. The staff at the hotel were very courteous and helpful with all our requests. A special thank you to Mr. Sujith Herbert, GM, for ensuring that our stay was comfortable. Mr Zafar, (front desk) keep that wonderful smile going!! Surely looking forward to visit the Khyber again.

reviews.author: Megsmumbai2014
reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.text: This is one of the most spectacular and beautiful resorts in India, where modern day luxury meets colonial charm and old world hospitality. Kudos to the owners and the teams that run this property. It's truly a jewel in Kashmirs crown, making our visit to Gulmarg totally worth it and memorable. Superb views and its perfect location near the gondola, only add to the almost perfect charm to this hotel. Will surely go back some day!!

reviews.author: Harsh J
reviews.title: great view and good amenities
reviews.text: This is one of the hotels which i have liked and stayed there for a day though, but there were some nik naks which were to be addressed to like the in room facilities to be looked into. etc but was a great experience there. heard that sometimes there are a few lions that come but as the property is guarded it is ok.

reviews.author: PradipSKumar
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: I stayed with my family at the Khyber Gulmarg and truly appreciate the way this hotel and its staff is. Beautiful Decor, Excellent Rooms, Spacious Bathrooms above all of this very very courteous staff and delicious food. No wonder it is one of small leading hotels they really deserves it. But only thing is the reservation staff should be more proactive in responding to phone calls and mails. Need to make too many calls and mails exchange to get the booking confirmation.

reviews.author: Fareed Suliman Dindar
reviews.title: Winter Wonderland
reviews.text:
Gulmarg, Kashmir and Khyber the combination in winter can only be described as a "Winter Wonderland". Outside may be a freezing sub zero temperature but one can jump into the heated pool and look out at the snow.
The service and personal attention guest receive from the GM and Preet is amazing. Our tour guide was rather late for the gondola ride up to the snow capped Himalayas, the GM at a distance noticed our irritation and immediately walked over and went out of his way to resolve our frustration by offering to provide a hotel sponsored guide so that we do not miss the gondola ride. 
The rooms are well specked and spacious with breathtaking views of the snow capped mountains. Indeed we were even upgraded at no cost.
Indian service and hospitality is par excellance.

If I were to nitpick , I missed the little slippers in my room offered by most of the 5 star establishments.

reviews.author: Praveen Rao
reviews.title: Great Location, Good Staff, Expensive Food!
reviews.text:
Khyber is indeed #1 place to be in when you are in Gulmarg. The location is superb, the rooms are luxurious and neat, views are fantastic. The staff is friendly and helpful. The hotel has good amenities for kids (Igloo with Xbox deployed, staff to engage kids, etc.)
The food is highly overpriced and the hotel is at such an elevation where you have to think twice before stepping out to dine out. Hence, it is highly recommended to go for a package, which bundles airport pickup and drop, two meals.

reviews.author: AakashGupta92
reviews.title: Just exceptional !!
reviews.text:
Staying at The Khyber is just a lifetime remembrance. The property is exceptionally good, very well maintained, very cosy and totally a royal feel.

The rooms are very good..great size but the view of only Himalayan side is good and not the Gulmarg side. The balcony in the room is the most enjoyable part of it and also the tub by the window in washroom. 

Service is top class and this factor made the stay most comfortable. They don't sell liquor in their property so they allow you to consume your own liquor in the cigar lounge..this was liked by us all as it's the first 5 star property where we saw this type of arrangement for the guests.. normally we used to drink in our room but here you can have it in the cigar lounge comfortably. 

Other great factor is the food which is exceptionally good. Our dinner was included in the package and on reaching the restaurant we found out that our snacks are also included in the buffet dinner (snacks are normally not included in the dinner buffet.. most of the time it is soup + main course + desert).. and the variety was also very good along with the quantity.

Staff is very efficient and helpful... Heated swimming pool was also a very enjoyable thing.

Many many thanks specially to Mr. Aman and Mr. Bilal for their exceptional service at the restaurant and the cigar lounge. 

Totally a repeatable property !!

reviews.author: Madhu Naiker
reviews.title: A great get away
reviews.text: Excellent reception and continued service until departure. Room service was exceptional and very prompt. If you want peace and quite, this is the place to recharge your professional battery, Extra bedding for 3rd guest in a room could have been of higher standard.

reviews.author: hotelshreeresidency
reviews.title: Stunning view from Swimming pool & spa
reviews.text:
This resort is the best in Gulmarg. In late summers or monsoons you may find it a little overpriced because no snow covered peaks are visible from the hotel. 
But yes once the snowfall starts till early summers this resort is pure luxury with amazing views from the Chaikash (Tea Lounge), Centrally heated Swimming pool, Spa Rooms, room balcony, etc............(SNOW....SNOW.... & SNOW covered trees)
Truly a five star hospitality between the snow.......

reviews.author: Jeevan_Talwar
reviews.title: Good Hotel But Pathetic Service
reviews.text: Khyber is one of the Best and only 5 star Hotel in Gulmarg. Its one of the most recent constructed hotel in Gulmarg having activities for almost every age group . The Hotel Luxury Rooms are very nicely done and so are the washrooms . The rooms with balcony are very airy and welcoming giving warm feeling to the guest . But the story on the service part is most unexpected or unacceptable . We checked in in the hotel around 2.30 PM . The rooms which were provided were 1 Himalayan view and other was Gulmarg View . We refused to accept Gulmarg view as it had hopeless view and  looked very dull compared to the Himalayan view rooms . The  Hotel blocked the ( Himalayan View rooms ) rooms for the guests who didn't even checked in . On our request the manager agreed to give 2 Adjoining rooms with same view . Although both the rooms weren't ready and we were told to enjoy lunch in the meanwhile our ( 2 rooms ) will be ready . We entered in the Restaurant and the buffet was going on but we decided to go for Ala cart  order .The order was placed at 3 PM . The food wasn't served to us uptill 3.45 PM . On asking the waiter the repply was blunt and shocking that the staff was busy dealing with room service and buffet thats why we weren't served the food . Finally we had to call manager and FnB Head for our rescue and provide food at 4.00 PM . A 5 star hotel takes 1 hour to serve food . There is no denial that food served was HOT and tasty . The Hotel has a very nice kids play area equipped with all facilities like XBOX air hockey carom-board blocks etc . There is nice heated swimming pool too. Overall all our experience was good . This hotel is meant to stay for atleast 2 Nights . The Gondola Ride is just walking distance from the hotel . The surroundings are lush green and a Nature loving person would love to be here . You can also see Top of Gondola from balcony view rooms .

reviews.author: S D
reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: The Khyber is the best hotel in Gulmarg. The location is away from the town so there is ample peace and quiet. The Hotel has a grand entrance, lot of wood used in the décor . The food is good, but while you are staying there might as well eat at different places rather than same food at the Hotel. Due to off season we had a slow service and very forgetful waiters. The rooms are nice but there is a typical odour in the bathrooms. The hotel is right next to the Gondola ride so very convenient as that is one of the prime attractions when the ski season is off. The last leg of the walk up to the hotel provides good cardio exercise.

reviews.author: DelhiTraveller1979
reviews.title: Not as expected
reviews.text:
We went to gulmarg on a family vacation, and everyone in delhi was talking about this property called Khyber. Everyone we spoke to said we should stay in this property. With very high hopes we arrived at this grand looking building, and loved the scale. But soon we realised the various problems this property had. The luxury that the building expresses is not translated into the service or the management. While we were there, everyday there were fights at the reception about poor service, many guests complained about poor management. Food at the restaurant was average and basic beverages like coke took twenty minutes to arrive on the table. The staff seemed to be untrained but very courteous. The food was very very average and the Kashmiri food wasn't good.

We stayed in the base category rooms, and we had to change rooms do to could smell and lack of cleanliness. The rooms are a decent siZe and the bathrooms luxurious but the servicing of the room was poor. The toilets floor was dirty, one day there was no hot water and the guy who came to check put on the shower and walked in dirty wet shoes all over my room, the housekeeping guy who came to clean had a stinky mop making the whole room unliveable. After several complaints and me visiting the reception since no one on the phone seemed to be understanding the issue,  over two hours, I finally got hot water and managed the night but wet cleaning the floors myself to get rid of the foul smell.

Also ever time we opened our window since they didn't that there Ac plant running and it would get hot and stuffy in the room, we got a foul smell into the room. Also the entire hotel seems to have a lot of damp while the lifts and the staircases were dirty and not cleaned. But on the bright side, the spa services were fantastic. The spa staff is very good and my experience was relaxing .

Even if I disregard this experience as a bad experience anyone can have, the hotel is poorly located. The real charm of gulmarg is the rolling hills which can't be seen or experienced from Khyber. Also Khyber is planned in away that you are always looking inwards into the hotel grounds rather than out into gulmarg. 

If you really want to experience the heaven like beauty of gulmarg, Khyber isn't the place to stay until you want to climb down a very steep slope and go on a pony to the other side everyday to experience it. If you want to take a cab it's three hundred rupees just to get dropped one way. The hotel does not provide this service and they ask you to go to the parking and take a local cab.

Khyber as a hotel could be on any hill station and does not do justice to being located in gulmarg. 
If this property isn't managed well, it will start looking very run down in a few years, which is sad because the owner seems to have made it with a lot of passion and love.

reviews.author: travelBugs5040
reviews.title: Simply Beautiful
reviews.text:
We stayed for 4 nights in March with a group of friends (adults, teens and kids) . We had heard that it's a lovely place from people who had visited and had great expectations.. Well, Khyber lived upto our expectations. 
The stay was comfortable, food was very, very good, staff was very polite and the surroundings were spectacular.
The only hitch was the climb to get to the hotel. Hope they have a car service as the climb up is very steep.
We even went to the spa and it was excellent!
To sum it up.... We are definitely be going back!!!!

reviews.author: ManishRaut
reviews.title: Breathtaking Place
reviews.text:
Mind blowing surroundings 
Impeccable service 
Beautiful rooms and excellent staff 
Negatives been on the incline hence the trek can be arduous but worth it atleast once
Close to the gondolas 
No place for drivers 
Beautiful swimming pool and the lounge is well maintained

reviews.author: Kiran Shingwekar
reviews.title: The Jewel of Kashmir!!
reviews.text: Had been over only for lunch, but even the brief stay convinced me of the class, the beauty and the detailing in making this very beautiful yet very modern hotel. Located on a hillside, the reception  area is modern day  palace, with beautifully carved facade and ornate furniture. The food at the restaurant is excellent.

reviews.author: Manish S
reviews.title: Very Good Hotel,and very bad staff !!!
reviews.text:
i have been visiting Kashmir since 2008 , almost every year . i always stay at the Lalit in Srinagar ,and used to make a day drip to gulmarg since there wasn't any luxurious Hotel in Gulmarg . The hotel rooms are beautifully furnished especially the luxury balcony rooms (where i stayed).the bathroom is one of the finest i have ever experienced in any hotel in India. It is indeed a luxury to avail of such wonderful amenities in the heart of Gulmarg.
Special thanks to Mashood Ahmad at Reservations for allocating rooms nears the lobby , as i had requested prior to my visit for my parents comfort  . (advisable for elderly people to stay near the lobby , else the further the better ).
the Negative are some staff , who are ill trained and absolutely ill mannered  .
 The WORST front desk staff i have ever come across in any hotel is SHAKEEL . I doubt , whether he is fit for any industry, let alone hospitality ! He does not know how to greet the guests , nor does he know how to use simple words like THANK YOU or SORRY . 
My F&B bill was Rs 9720 , He did not even bother to say thank you , Nor did he return the change of Rs80 , (i had TIPPED almost rs 5000 in KHYBER itself ) As nothing works without tipping in Kashmir.
i would have let go of this petty amount , BUT i was waiting there to see  , whether this Ill mannered disgusting , insult to the human race person  SHAKEEL , ignored me , while i was waiting for my change , for which he kept me waiting for like 10 minutes . Ultimately i had to ask him for it and yes , he did give the change back , making a pathetic face !!!
SHAKEEL , one advise to you , you can earn more money by begging in Mumbai , than fleecing the customers on vacation .                                                               Guests , please DO NOT expect anything special from the staff EXCEPT some restaurant staff especially mr khan , who was brilliant . AVOID  the front desk staff at any cost .

reviews.author: Kanupriya J
reviews.title: Amazing experience
reviews.text:
My mom & me checked in The Khyber on the 25th of August 2014 around 12:00 pm & were very impressed with the surroundings & the hotel.  It is indeed a beautiful property with the loads of natural beauty all around it. As soon as we entered the hotel I knew I would love every minute of it. The welcome drink was the delicious Kashmiri Kahwah which really warms the body inside out.  It was very gracious of the hotel to upgrade us from a deluxe room to a luxury room. It really made our stay in Gulmarg much more memorable. The room was beautiful & had a touch of Kashmir. I loved the soap, shampoo & body lotion provided by the hotel. The hotel provides many services like free use of the gymnasium, Jacuzzi & steam. The WiFi is chargeable which disappointed me a bit because if the airport can provide us free WiFi then why not he five star hotels who charge a huge sum for the stay.
The restaurant is aptly located & has a beautiful view you can enjoy. It also has the facility of sitting outside. The À la carte menu had a variety of cuisines’. The buffet I thought was slightly expensive at Rs. 1680/- per head according to Gulmarg, it should have not been more than Rs. 1200/- per head.  I was a bit disappointed with the breakfast buffet as I thought it didn’t have much choice of continental dishes & it had more of junk food like doughnuts, pastries, chicken nuggets & potato wedges which I think are not appropriate for a good healthy hearty breakfast., although my mom overall enjoyed the breakfast. The fresh watermelon juice was delicious & the egg white omelet was very nice as well.
We especially want to thank Dr. Nazeer the hotel doctor who took special care of me when I wasn’t well & provided with complimentary medicines & also lent me pair of his gloves which was very thoughtful & kind. 
The hotel staff is very friendly particularly want to mention the hotel in charge Mr. Zaffar Malik who gave us personal attention & care. I will surely revisit The Khyber Himalayan Resort & Spa again & relive the beauty & hospitality of The Khyber Gulmarg.

reviews.author: RitasishB
reviews.title: Good stay, fantastic view of Gulmarg landscape from rooms
reviews.text:
Stayed there for 2 days in August with family. This hotel is located in a spectacular strategic location and undoubtedly has one of the best view of Gulmarg landscape from the room and the terrace. The staffs were nice and courteous. The rooms are very good with a combination of modern and traditional Kashmiri interior decor, spacious washrooms. Food was quite good and the breakfast buffet had good options to choose from. It has a temp controlled swimming pool (with Jacuzzi), recreational room for kids and adults. The Gondola station is very near to the hotel and max 5 mins walk (you can avoid the unnecessary bargaining with the ponnywallahs). 
Now coming to the let-downs..The check in process was not smooth at all. A non-smiling person was sitting in a small check-in counter and instead of greeting people was busy with his computer and doing all other things than giving me the room key. While checking out also, I was lucky enough to do it fast whereas I was witnessing people waiting for 30 mins as their luggage still didn't arrive. The surely need more people and expertise in that area. The person in the main coffee shop was rude and like me many guests were disappointed by his rude behavior. Another suggestion is the hotel should arrange for a complementary drive to the gondola station (which can be 2 mins max). I could see people was being fooled by the private car rentals and ponnywallahs just outside the hotel gate, who were charging 300-500 rupees for a one way ride.

reviews.author: SCenturion
reviews.title: Almost Excellent
reviews.text:
This property has aged within a year to look and feel rather old and worn out.  I spoke to management and they advised they have been sold out since opening, and were unable to perform some maintenance rituals.  The will have to figure it out because the setting and the property are spectacular indeed.  

The staff is fantastic and the Kashmiri hospitality is genuine and unparalleled.  The high altitude made my parents a little sick, but the staff doctor arrived immediately and was very helpful.  He was kind enough to return the next day to check upon them, without us calling him.

There was chaos at check-in, they could use more staff there.  The main coffee shop could also use better management.

The L'occitane spa is excellent and I enjoyed a relaxing treatment here.  But why won't the hotel use L'occitane or other aromatherapy remedies for the entrance is beyond my comprehension.  The entrance to the hotel was constantly smelling of pest control and insecticides.  Please figure out a less toxic option for your hotel and for the guests.

reviews.author: Bindun
reviews.title: A place to explore beauty
reviews.text:
Best hotel in whole gulmarg, with temperature controlled room, ice outside your rooms was amazing experience in my life. It has very cooperative staff. bath area is very spacious.
In my room temp control was not  working they tried in all ways to make my stay comfort with providing extra heaters.

reviews.author: nms01
reviews.title: The Grand Khyber of Gulmarg!
reviews.text:
What a spectacular hotel to stay in finally in the prettiest part of Kashmir: Gulmarg! The whole hotel is wooden and right from the entrance one does feel the beautiful Kashmiri touch everywhere. The hotel is on a slight gradient and very close to the Gandola station.The rooms are done up very well and the wooden interiors of the hotel give it a lovely mountain feel... The deluxe balcony rooms are amazing with every possible conceivable modern comfort: Perfect bed, superb bathroom with a separate tub and shower area with 24hrs hot and cold water too, spacious balcony with comfortable reclining chairs and an in room coffee and tea maker. The room also had stunning views of the Gulmarg peaks. The heater was super effective but in the summers we needed to open the balcony door and sleep... which wasn't much of a problem infact we loved the fresh air! The Check in was smooth and the staff was very courteous and helpful! The room doors maybe need to be made sound proof as more than once we were awaken by noisy hotel guests talking loudly in the corridors while returning to their rooms. 
Had read a lot about the food served here and hence didn't know what to expect but was very impressed by the quality of the food the 2 days we stayed there. The indian fare was yummy as was the live pasta and chaat station that we had on 2 separate nights. The dinner buffet was wide and varied... right from a good Indian mix to Chinese too!The Caesars salad and the Waldorf salad was the best i have ever eaten in India! Kudos to the chef on that... the Indian breads were served fresh and crisp each meal and the desserts were simply superb! Special mention to the coconut cake, the almond and moong dal halwa and the pineapple fresh cake!! The breakfast was filling too with a wide array of eaties and 2 live counters for omelettes and dosas... The dosa chef made amazing hot uttapams and dosas.. thanks to his experience he did manage to satiate the food buds each morning deftly and swiftly! The cappuccinos at the restaurant were amazing! The service in the restaurant needs to be looked into as i felt that a lot of the staff there lacked experience in the field of hospitality... Yet understanding where we were, we did appreciate Mr Kamal for his absolutely impressive service each day and night, trying to tie up the loose ends. Thank you for your superb hospitality... Another special mention is BrijKishore, who each night with precision served us to the best of his ability!
The pool area was lovely... with enough deck chairs ready with towels and tall glass walls 2 sides. The pool itself was temperature regulated which was very comfortable. The staff was both helpful and knowledgeable there. 
All in all... a must stay when in Gulmarg! Such luxury in the heart of the Himalayas is a treat! We shall surely be back... this time during the winters for sure!!!

reviews.author: Global-Citizen
reviews.title: Excellent view and poor service
reviews.text:
This hotel has an ideal location facing the Aparwat peak , the rooms are large with balconies. It is a new hotel however the services are far from five star!
Housekeeping is poor, they forgot to put towels in the bathroom, the water was Luke warm and there were water patches leaking from the shower. The staff are very slow to respond. There is only one restaurant with average food and slow service. In short apart from the size of the rooms and the view this is by no means five star.

reviews.author: ZubairJalal
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: This is coming from a SPG platinum member since 4 years now. I stay in hotels around 70 days in a year all across the globe and by far this is one of the best hotel that i have been to and that too in my home state. The management has put in a lot of effort to keep the local asethetics in place. Things like a 'vaguh' in the rooms, the chandeliers, the wall lights in the hallways - all of them have something that every Kashmiri can relate to. The service is good, the swimming pool is a good one and the location is breathtaking.  Its money well spent by the management. One advice - tie up with brands like SPG, Hilton etc. I am sure these brands would be more than happy to associate their names with The Khyber.

reviews.author: Neeraj Raheja
reviews.title: Excellent location and great service
reviews.text:
We were a large group of 12 adults and 7 kids and didn't want to compromise on our last destination in Kashmir and wanted it to be truly luxurious and I must say that The Khyber stood true to its reputation. The check-in was through a warm welcome by Mr.Zafar and complimentary Kawa for all of us which we all enjoyed. Can't complain that the check-in took a little while as we were a large group and a lot of us got busy checking out the beautiful hotel.

The rooms allotted to us we're all good and on the same floor. Must say that rooms with view opening to the swimming pool and the garden have better views than the rooms on the other side. Having said that the size of the rooms and the luxurious bathrooms and the balcony offer you just the relaxation that you are looking for.

The quality of food was excellent. Though a little on the expensive side we thoroughly enjoyed the buffet breakfast, ala-carte and buffet dinner. Yes it is true that the restaurant gets a little crowded during peak times but doesn't take like hours for one to find a seat.

Another point worth noting was that the hotel had an in house doctor to cater to any health needs of children with medicines being available in the hotel itself. It also has a large play area for kids called the Igloo which had a lot of games for the kids like air hockey, x-box, board games, blocks, etc

Overall a very enjoyable and memorable experience. Would love to go back in the future.

reviews.author: Suhail A
reviews.title: 5_star property with 2-3 star service and 7-Start charges
reviews.text:
I was very excited to stay at this Hotel as this was my first time at this hotel.
Hotel is in a very good location. The buildings and the rooms are very well done and nicely decorated.
However, everything good about this hotel , unfortunately stops there.
The hotel claims to be 5-star, however, the service and amenities are barely 3-star.
Right from the check-in, service is poor.
There is only one check-in desk which is not even properly marked. Guest are just standing around to check-in.
The staff at the check -in desk is not fully trained which makes check-in an arduous process.
There is only one resturant in the hotel which has to serve all the guests staying in the hotel. This makes for crowded tables and poor , slow service. The food choices are very limited.
The buffet is over priced with very poor voices. Plates and utensils are dirty and not up to par for a so called 5 Star hotel.
Room service leaves a lot to be desired. Out of 4 dishes that we ordered, 3 were made wrong despite us walking to the restart and talking to the person taking the order personally.
Prices for everything are exorbitant. Even to open the sofa bed in our room for our kids, we were charged 9000 rupees. I paid 9000 rupees to stay in JW Marriott in Delhi for a full room with excellent breakfast buffet and to and fro airport transfers. 
There were only two bath towels in the bathroom of the premium room for which the charge was 20,000 rupees per night. The staff was very reluctant to provide us with more towels. They wanted to charge us even for that.

Overall, I had a very bad experience at this hotel and will not ever again stay here. It saddens me that such a beautiful hotel is going to go waste because of poor management.
Being a Kashmiri, it saddens me more that we cannot provide service to our visitors that would be at par with any 5 tar hotel in the country.
I would request the management and the owners to visit JW Marriot in Aerocity, New Delhi, to see what good customer service means and how guests are treated in a dignified manner.

reviews.author: sunilkatariya
reviews.title: Khyber
reviews.text: The property was good and the service was ok. Given the price, they charge, I would rate them who just meets the expectations. However quality and variety in breakfast was not so great and also found the buffet dinner priced on the higher side.

reviews.author: Goabizzle
reviews.title: Nice 5 star property
reviews.text: We visited in July 2014 with 2 rooms for the family.  We were greeted by a very friendly lady staff at the reception.  We really liked the rooms, it was clean and had a perfect view of the place.  I would definitely recommend this property.  The buffet however is catered mainly to vegetarians and with only 1 chicken and 1 fish dish for the non vegetarians so please check this before you book.

reviews.author: Anks124
reviews.title: Surreal property with exceptional service!
reviews.text:
One of the most beautiful properties I have ever been to! Highly recommended... If you are in Gulmarg, this is the place where you ought to stay.. expensive, but fully worth it.. Now the details..
Loved its:
1. Location- High up on the hill with astounding view of the valley. You cannot take your eyes off the view.. (Please take a room with the mountain valley view)
2. Service- Staff is extremely helpful and caring. This was my first vacation with my 5 month old son and the staff took extra care arranging a baby cot, warm water, mashed apple, whatever I asked for.. they even gave us a complimentary cake when I told them that this is Ahaan's first vacation. They gave us good advice about where to go, when, etc.
3. Pool, jacuzzi, sauna and steam- Their pool is oh so awesome. On the hill, it is an indoor heated pool but two walls are made of glass reaching up to almost 20 feet of ceiling giving amazing views of mountains and trees while swimming. The free jacuzzi, steam and sauna refreshes your body and mind!

Additionally, the interior of the hotel was very traditional and Kashmiri but still quite modern and tastefully done. The food was also good in Cloves restaurant and not over-priced. (Advice: Please go for Ala-carte. Buffet is expensive) 

What could be improved:
1. The property is on a high hill and the walk down till the valley where the Gulmarg gandola is there is quite steep. Downhill is still ok but Uphill.. phew!! The hotel could arrange for some golf carts or something for the guests.. But I think this is more of a Gulmarg problem since the local people with horses do not let any taxi or even hotel cars operate in the area since it cuts into their business.
2. Another restaurant serving some other cuisine could be added.

Please definitely stay at this property.

reviews.author: PUNEESH PURI
reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: The property is good but the staff & hospitality is nill. The staff & service is not up to the mark. The GM of the hotel should be demoted to a captain level as even after making a written complaint there was no answer from him. You can visit only for the property

reviews.author: Samyak M
reviews.title: Excellent Location
reviews.text:
This is probably one of the finest places one can stay in gulmarg. The property is simply beautiful with a breathtaking view of the himalayas from the rooms.
The staff is extremely friendly (though the accent might make you feel that they aren't warm), and the rooms are very well appointed. Though the walls are very thin and you can practically hear almost everything from the next room.

The hotel is very close to the Gandola Ride - which is supposed to be the main attraction in Gulmarg.

The rooms do NOT have A/C - but have heaters instead. Make sure while checking in they show you how to operate it.

Food quality is strictly average, but is excellent as compared to the other restaurants in gulmarg.

reviews.author: sam122014
reviews.title: "Why go to Switzerland"
reviews.text: I stayed with my family 3 weeks back at The Khyber it was out of the world hospitality .As soon as we entered the hotel we were amazed with the lobby and the architecture of the hotel . We were then taken to a Tea lounge for a free Kahwa Ms Preet took us around the property and showed us the different area and things to do. We planned a dinner for our family at Nouf  it was a traditinol Wazwaan dinner which was great i really recommend everybody to try the experience as it is out of the world.Overall food and service was excellent and staff was very cordial and humble.Will difinetely come back again with a bigger group.......

reviews.author: sparkle217
reviews.title: awesome experience
reviews.text:
We just got back 2 weeks ago from our trip to kashmir. We spent 2 nights at The Khyber and it was a wonderful experience. 
First impression as we entered the property took our breadth away. The meticulous details are worth a mention. The interiors are so gorgeous that you just want to stare at every corner. the views from the rooms are amazing. The location is just perfect, We just could not stop taking photos! We found the staff extremely helpful, special mention to the F&B assistant manager Mr Kamal. Also Miss Preet and so many members of the staff in the restaurant. I was impressed when Ishfaq( i hope i spelt his name right) asked how both my girls were doing and he remembered their names. Small gestures goes a long way and most hotels are almost robotic nowadays. Here the staff was friendly, indulging the children with small treats from the buffet etc. From the guy at the gate to the house keeping staff all were very polite. All in all we had a wonderful experience, the kids had a blast we shall definitely go there if we go to gulmarg.

reviews.author: RashmiChawla2014
reviews.title: Heavenly
reviews.text: The place is awesome. A place to pamper yourself and worth the money spent. The service is excellent and staff is extremely courteous. The steam and sauna really helped me unwind. The spa treatment was extremely relaxing.

reviews.author: Arun0102
reviews.title: Realy a home away from home
reviews.text: It was a great experience. I visited the Resort last month and had a memorable stay. All the staff was too caring and helpful. Check in was smooth and room was nice. The restaurant experience was outstanding. Staff over there was too attentive. Kamal the Restaurant manager was too caring and very soft spoken. Over all I had a great time in the hotel and will say that it is the best option in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Prabir Jha
reviews.title: Excellent property!
reviews.text: We spent some memorable time at the Khyber in Gulmarg, an amazing property, with excellent large rooms and bath. Very well appointed. The service we experienced was brilliant, including the hot Kahwa on arrival. We enjoyed a well spread Wazwan, excellently done. The view from my room of the snow capped peaks was riveting.excellent place I would love to return to when it is all covered in snow.

reviews.author: BAhuja
reviews.title: Beautiful locale
reviews.text: Hotel was probably the best option available in gulmarg, rooms we good, but d service generally was sloppy especially d kitchen . Food was ok, but service in d restraunt as well as room service was bad.had to wait long for d food n specification were not taken care of. Staff was a bit callous ( may b raw) as also no help from reception vis-a-vis guidance for travel/ sight seeing.

reviews.author: 894Rahul
reviews.title: One of the best hotels of the world!!!
reviews.text: I with my family visited Khyber last month,and it was quite amazing ....food, rooms,hospitality at its best.Also staff is quite helpful.I recommend this property to every one coming to Kashmir!!!!and also one of the best thing is its location,it is a walking distance from one of the famous cable car i.e gulmarg gondola

reviews.author: Naman D
reviews.title: Deja Vu
reviews.text:
Had stayed here 6 months back, that time gulmarg was in blanket of snow, this time it was in smell of horse dung and greenery, loved my stay with this particular hotel.

Nothing have changed from the last trip, staff is very much the same, always ready to please , full of smile.

only on dampener is hotel have stopped giving kehwa as complimentary, now they charge which is not a great idea....

heated pool is a great way to unwind and must admit i thoroughly enjoyed my time in pool, very few people use this great facility, thus had practically whole pool to myself.

keep the standards as it is, will visit again for the Ski in next year...

reviews.author: pranav s
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Indian Hill Station
reviews.text:
I went with my family a few days back, and this hotel was one of the best hotels i have ever visited in the Indian hill stations.
We were booked for a luxury room with balcony and the view was mind-blowing. the view of the snow capped mountains was unbelievable at this time of the year.
The Rooms were great, the food quality was very good, the room service was also unto the standard, the only thing is that when you are having a meal in the restaurant the service was too slow. Except the slow service it was a complete package in the Himalayas.

reviews.author: Mehru B
reviews.title: Gorgeous property!
reviews.text: Khyber, Gulmarg - property and rooms are fantastic. Food and service are also very good. Jacuzzi, sauna and steam room and pool are also lovely. One suggestion - there should be separate small changing rooms in the swimming area. (which do not have a shower or toilet. These are just meant for changing clothes) In the women's side, you are expected to change your clothes either in the shower or in the toilet.

reviews.author: ViralAhmedabad_India
reviews.title: beautiful location
reviews.text:
a luxury property but with service that needs loads to improve. the rooms allow sound to leak in from outside. nice upgradation for sure. food quality and service needs to improve. 

still the best and most expensive place to stay in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Shalini S
reviews.title: Oasis in Filthy Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Gulmarg is definitely not as pristine as it's been shown in Tourism Brouchers and documentaries, it's smelly, filthy and extremely unhygienic, had a disastrous first impression of this destination while entering it.

Kudos to team khyber for ensuring and changing my whole impression about this place with their hospitality, service and going out of the way to my demands.

Special mention to the reception kids who were always smiling and not letting even one request of mine in negative, wonderful people...

Pool water is a concern which needs immediate attention, It need daily cleaning which is definitely not happening. Spa is superb, masseurs are well trained and well behaved.

Overall a great place to unwind, specially if nature is your elixir

reviews.author: D0shi
reviews.title: Room for improvement
reviews.text:
No doubt, once you enter The Khyber, you feel high. The entrance to the resort is just grand. Once you are in, and if you have a taste of collections,what they have, you just can't stop appreciating. 

But there is a lot more required in SERVICES. It is just POOR. We checked in at 2 PM and had our bookings for two nights, for two rooms. Our one room was not ready till 4 PM. We just waited in our one room. Even after second room was ready, we had to call almost thrice  to have our room keys delivered, and programmed. Ultimately I had to visit personally to the guest relation area to have my room key delivered. The one room which we were given Room No. 3001, did not have any partitions in Bathroom. It was under some renovation, and even a single use of shower by one person, could make the whole bathroom wet and slippery. And it actually did. We complained for almost full day about it, and did ask for compensation for the services not provided to us, all went unanswered. We got the change of room only on next day.

Swimming Pool was under some repair, and we could not enjoy it during our stay for two nights. 

Food menu does not have much change, or does not have more option to choose. Vegetarian desserts were out of stock even at 9.30 am on breakfast menu. But still the food is just good.

BUT>>>BUT>>> that's all.That's the only bad about The Khyber mentioned above...

 Rest of the things are just TOOOOOOOOOO GOOD. The best view, The best feel of stay. Since there is nothing much to do in Gulmarg in June-July, you can have full use of Hotel amenities and can hit the Gym, Have your Spa. We enjoyed a great. Every hotel does have some sort of Service related Problems,and Khyber is not exception. But I would very much strongly recommend this Hotel.

Gondala is though not properly maintained and not clean and though OVER PRICED as Rs.1400/- each for 2 levels,  One must go for it. Do not try Ski in July, and the charges are too much for a small span of ski. We were asked for Rs.2500/- each for Ski, charged for Rs.1500/- each, was not worth it. Some people from other Hotel managed to have the same thing at Rs.800/-. The name Khyber to the local guide makes you pay more. But the Stay is just worth the money. Go for it. They will improve...

reviews.author: Arjun L
reviews.title: Awesome hotel.
reviews.text: Had loads of fun great rooms. Good pool. Enjoyed a lot. Very secure hotel.we were in room number 4010. 4009. 4014. A bit expensive but still had fun. relaxing spa. Heated and air conditioned room. Game room with air hockey foosball table and three x boxes with kinect sports it is known as the den

reviews.author: MahendraPoddar
reviews.title: Lousy service , lousier maintained , only ridiculous prices
reviews.text:
Out of all the luxury hotels I hv stayed in, Khyber had the worst service, 
And surprisingly such an expensive property is very badly maintained 
Things are falling out of everywhere.
The shower room water flows to the wc area. 
The pool water is not recycled & is murky
& this is supposed to be a new hotel... I wonder what will happen after a couple of years

Absolutely not worth the money even by a fraction.

Thank god I stayed in other properties in Kashmir or I would hv thought that bad service & lousy maintainence was a norm

reviews.author: Pratibha K
reviews.title: Khyber is Gulmarg, Gulmarg is Khyber
reviews.text: From where do I start.. Gulmarg is a very small area and not much to do except the Gondola ride (3-4 hours max) but Khyber Resort has turned this idle location into an exceptionally perfect holiday place. The view from the resort entirely engulfs the beauty of Gulmarg. The facilities of the resort are comprehensive - nicely done rooms, fully equipped with modern amenities(airtel HD TV in rooms - Taj does not provide it in Srinagar) , play areas outside and inside for kids(XBox games) , spa for adults, swimming pool, jacuzzi, steam, sauna, mini theatre, tea lounge, hookah bar and lovely sitting areas all along the property. The staff is well trained and a special mention for team leader 'Zahoor'. The space has been used very well to give you a wholesome experience; from majestic entrance, grand lobby to walkways. For e.g. the walk towards the spa/pool area itself is so beautiful that you don't mind taking the many stairs it involves, very thoughtfully sitting areas are made along the walkway. Their Spa is far superior than many in urban cities. Our stay at Taj in Srinagar was disappointing as compared to Khyber Resort. If you are visiting Kashmir do not miss Khyber Resort at any cost.

reviews.author: Sujata752
reviews.title: Heaven is the word
reviews.text:
We were here in Jan 2014. Awesome is the word. One of the best properties ever visited and the best hospitality even experienced. Awesome view from balcony.First, when booked, though it to be overpriced, but once in - felt should have been there longer. If you did not experience Khyber, I would say you did not experience Kashmir.
The gondola is just outside Khyber and a bare one min walk.
Very good food. Excellent Kahwa to keep u warm.
Words fall short for this particular property!!

reviews.author: capetown7848
reviews.title: Misleading pictures and missing descriptions ….
reviews.text:
hi,

We recently booked for a forthcoming trip, the Luxury Balcony Rooms agh this hotel. The website shows pictures (obviously the best) but while booking they palm off rooms in this category which do not have the view as shown in the website gallery pictures. The guest is either up for a surprise or fight on arrival or the more alert ones notice on the bookings itself additions such as Gulmarg View or Golf Course View while describing the Luxury Balcony rooms. Whatever they are, rest assured, they are not Mountain or Forest Views as shown in all the pictures used to describe this category of rooms. If you want more, you pay more …… Can't we stop this nonsense in our country so that domestic & international tourists can take things at face value and relax when planning a holiday ??

reviews.author: Siddharth1850
reviews.title: Amazing Hospitality !!!!
reviews.text: SUPERB !!!! This one word sums up the entire Khyber experience. The hotel is located on the far end of Gulmarg. The suites are excellent and 7003 in which I stayed was breath taking, done up immaculately and very very spacious. The resort has fantastic club and a heated swimming pool , good kids room and a modern gym. I am visiting Khyber soon !!!!

reviews.author: Lata K
reviews.title: Service could be better
reviews.text:
I had heard a lot of Khyber. So when we planned a trip to Kashmir, we made it a point to book a room at the Khyber. We visited in the month of December and let me tell you! you have to book welllll in advance to get a room as we came across many people who couldn't get a booking. Now, why the rush? Coz that's the only five star hotel in Gulmarg! It's a beautiful hotel. The drive to the hotel is awesome! The hotel's lobby is exquisitely designed n spacious. You have a sit down arrangement there, where you can have a card game or just gossip with your family. The check in took some time but they made it up by serving a delicious hot kahwa! Yes, there are too many exclamation marks, but that is how you feel. After waiting for a while, we were checked into a room on the lower ground floor, numbering 600 something. Why am I telling this? So that if you are allotted this number n believe in room service, say an emphatic NO to them. These rooms are the farthest from the pantry n housekeeping and if you order anything, it's going to take at least 1/2 an hour. Even a towel! My husband fractured his hand and there was no first aid and getting a hot water bag was Phew! The water was not hot n it came damn too late! 
This was the only negative point in this otherwise exquisite hotel. The swimming pool was not operational but it is now. It's a beautiful indoor pool. The gym is well equipped. 
Now, the food! The manager at the restaurant was very courteous n gave us some awesome deals as he saw that we were more interested in la carte while my son wanted a couple of things from buffet. The food was tasty. Everything from soups to desserts. Pizza to Chinese to tandoori! 
We stayed for two days. And don't forget to dip your hands in the candy jars strategically placed in the lobby. For the hookah lovers, there is an exotic cigar n hookah lounge. All in all, a good stay soured by bad room service. 
PS: I had mentioned this lacuna in their service in my feedback and I hope they have done something about it. :))

reviews.author: Karthik Subbiah
reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We stayed at the Khyber for a week. The hotel itself was beautiful, however the drive to the hotel was quite painful. The rooms were beautiful, and there were a lot of options for food inside the hotel. The hotel staff were well trained and friendly. The architecture of the hotel was amazing. If I had the choice, I would definetely go there again

reviews.author: VibhutiGarg
reviews.title: Pristine beauty!
reviews.text:
A wooden architecture covered with snow all around made our stay very pleasant. The day we arrived in Gulmarg, it started snowing though usually at end of March that is not a regular phenomenon but we were lucky to witness snowfall. The property is very well located and at a walking distance from the point of gondoal ride. The kahwah drink which they offer as the welcome drink is palatable. The food is delicious but the service of the staff at the restaurant is not very good. There were just 1-2 waiter at the restaurant to serve people during the day and even during breakfast though there were couple of them but seem a bit confused and thus were taking lot of time or after repeated reminders, dishes were served. The hotel definitely needs to improvise on the same.

The pool was large and it was a pleasant sight to swim when it was snowing outside. However, the pool was functional when we arrived but after taking an hour rest when we finally decided to go for swimming, were informed that there was a problem in heating and thus closed. The spa was refreshing with all the aroma therapy, adding to perfect romantic holiday. The rooms were well equipped and comfortable. Overall a very pleasant stay.

reviews.author: ntibrewal
reviews.title: Nice, comfortable stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text: A good hotel in Gulmarg, well located near the gondola, courteous and efficient staff, comfortable rooms and a good multi-cuisine restaurant. The check-in did take irritably long, but probably that was due to guests not having vacated the rooms on time. Local transportation from the hotel is a problem. A taxi from the hotel to the town (2-3 kms away) costs Rs.1000/-. Besides this, the whole experience at The Khyber was wonderful.

reviews.author: Aninda_p
reviews.title: Hoteliers are the worst guest
reviews.text:
Doctors are supposedly the worst patients, and hoteliers the most  difficult  guests.
It probably enemates from the fact that our eye for details , makes us over critical.
However once in a while , we go through such experiences that conforms the  old adage that service comes from the  heart.
Recently in this hotel two young executives at the middle of the night , went out of their way and helped us in our hour of need , for which we shall remain eternally grateful.
A hotel is as good as its staff and this hotel shall always be a front runner as long as it has such wonderful caring young executives.
Aninda Palit
Hotelier
Director, SHPL

reviews.author: Vishal D
reviews.title: Luxurious but ......
reviews.text: We stayed for 3 nights from 23rd May 2014 onwards.  We were allotted room no 4001 which opens up into the parking lot.  The first view was a scorpio jeep  staring at my face . Mr Bilal shifted us to another room on the next morning after we complaint about drivers standing outside our room window. PLEASE DON'T STAY IN ROOM NO 4001. After all we didn't pay a bomb to have a room in the parking lot.  The service was average when it came to room service because everyone seemed to be confused. The property is fabulous and extremely beautiful. Their temperature controlled pool was very good. The Mediterranean food at cabalash (cigar lounge) was very nice where you can carry your own bottles of alcohol.  The food is good but highly priced. A dal costs 500 plus tax. The hotel is excellent but the management needs to improve.  Very few options in gulmarg of this class.

reviews.author: Akshay B
reviews.title: Beautiful Wooden Palace
reviews.text: We Checked in here for a night, there's no dearth of wood here, wood paneled walls, wood floors, stairs and so on. The main attraction of this place is balconies where you can enjoy stunning views of beautiful Gulmarg. There's also a SPA in this property which have a heated swimming pool, sauna and Jacuzzi pool. My family was quite excited about this idea of swimming in a pool when temperatures out side are quite low. And we enjoyed Jacuzzi pool and steam in sauna room as well. But swimming pool was laced with access of chlorine, and quality of water was bad as well, which left our eyes burning even after few hours of swim. Another painful experience was their sole lift was not working at all, made our experience of staying here quite  tiring. There is no doubts this property is excellent, though they need to manage it in a more professional way.

reviews.author: meenakshee
reviews.title: great location. more interesting during winters may be with skiing going around.
reviews.text: The location of this hotel is great, since its just a 10 mins walk to the gondola that takes you up to phase 1 and phase 2. Walking down to the gondola is easy and also the way to nearby places for walk is great. the rooms were great with great views .loved it. i enjoyed sitting around reception lounge area and reading books on kashmir. stay was for 2 days.they also have kids area where kids enjoyed. liked it but quite expensive resort.I think it will be much more fun to visit this place in winters as its close to skiing area.food was great but quite expensive compared to VIVANTA TAJ,KASHMIR which was much more affordable.

reviews.author: nandini1571
reviews.title: Felt duped
reviews.text: As for most travellers, booking was done personally. During booking thru mail, the reservation team insisted that we have to take an extra room since room size being small, extra bed cannot be accomodated. We agreed, but on arriving, realised that room size was fine. On speaking to the manager on duty, a mass of denials and false assurances like "enjoy your stay, we will take care of this next time, Yes, extra bed could have been accomodated etc" were made. We felt duped as the money involved was appreciable. One does not expect this kind of cheap tactics from places like these. Pl always verify before booking specially couples travelling with kids.We lost an appreciable amount of money.

reviews.author: Nitin K
reviews.title: best place in gulmurg
reviews.text: We spent two night at this lovely resort which has beautiful interiors as well as the spa was also very very relaxing. Just was not very happy with the food, might be because of the hotel running on full capacity.

reviews.author: asunnylife
reviews.title: Superb Resort
reviews.text:
One of the best resorts in India I have stayed in! The swimming pool was under maintenance! Waiting to go back again. 

I wish they'd take over the Gulmarg Gondola station next to it and also make that experience as pleasant as their hotel!

reviews.author: ar_anupammittal
reviews.title: awesome but incomplete
reviews.text: Strange but true. The Khyber is just awesome property, one of the best wooden cladded castle I have ever visited and enjoyed every corner of it. During our stay last summer, we stayed there for three nights and could realize after first day sight seeing that the place must have much to offer with in he property so started looking for swimming pool, Spa, steam etc but surprisingly nothing was functioning and we were told that the work was on and could not be delivered this season. Since we had nothing else to do, we choose the entertainment room/ theater room for kids at least, that was good but overtly booked in absence of other amenities. I sincerely hope that the same has been taken care and one must check with them before booking this year.

reviews.author: jbee
reviews.title: In the lap of luxury
reviews.text: The khyber has a breathtaking view of snow capped mountains. Rooms are luxurious . Staff is friendly and hospitable. Breakfast spread is awesome. Sadly elevators never work. During my 2 day stay elevators were nonfunctional and we had to climb 3 floors up and down to lobby level . The dinner buffet is very expensive at Rs1700 per person .  While booking please request for lobby level rooms or else keep climbing. Play area has limited games. Pool is fab and temperature controlled. Worth visiting.

reviews.author: Vinita2601
reviews.title: Gorgeous and Grand
reviews.text: Khyber is everything you have been told. Beautiful and grand. I loved the location and the views. However the best part was the temperature control system... if you are in the resort the outside temperature will not bother you at all. They have used some beautiful Kashmiri design elements in the interiors of the resort. Loved the woodwork, the silks and the carpets. The staff was very helpful. Avoid the l'occitane spa... well made but poor therapists.

reviews.author: Nareshparekh
reviews.title: Excellent view and great location
reviews.text:
Location : Excellent location can walk down to gondola.
Staff : Very very helpful and polite staff.
Rooms : Big and comfortable.As Gulmarg was experiencing snowfall the view was of snow al around the resort.Have an excellent climate control and hence never felt cold anywhere in the hotel premises.
Food : Need to add more variety in the buffet as it is not value for money as the cost compared to other 5star is very high.
Amenities : A very good heated swimming pool and billiards table.Children centre toys or games were non functional a turn off for children.

Worth a stay would surely visit once again with complete family.

reviews.author: punyapanday
reviews.title: Classy and Luxurious  !!!
reviews.text:
We stayed in Khyber for 2 nights and we found it to be very Luxurious and classy  . Right from the lobby to the rooms were very well done up and the view from the coffee shop and rooms was  excellent . Staff was very cooperative - at reception  Mr Zafar and Miss Preet were great at their job . While Mr Shyam ( F & B Head ) and his team were superlative at the restaurant . My Son is a fussy eater and they made everything he asked for despite of the rush  . 

The hotel was at almost 100% occupancy and the staff put extra effort in meeting the needs of all the guests . 
We were there for our anniversary and they  decorated the room and got a nice cake for us for our special occasion   . 

The swimming pool was not functional which was a put off but the rest was great  . 

Thanks to the team for making our stay special  .

reviews.author: CFerns
reviews.title: Perfect Hotel, best location in Gulmarg but lacking service
reviews.text: I and my family really loved the hotel. The entire hotel surroundings were covered with snow during out stay and you wake up to a beautiful view of the Afarwat mountains from the hotel windows. The overall service wasn't up to my expectation compared to the hotel star status and room rates. The hotel climate control seemed to have some problem with some kind of bad stench at times. To make matters worse, the elevators were not working. I also had a problem with their reservation. My reservation included 2 adults and 2 kids but they charged me extra for a child citing problems with their reservation system when I didn't even ask for extra bed. Maybe they were right but from my perspective it's unethical practice not to show accurate charges at reservation time. The restaurant staff were the only saving grace. Overall the hotel is good value for money with the view, proximity to the cable car, the heated pool and enough entertainment for kids.

reviews.author: Jennifer Lobo
reviews.title: A perfect getaway in the lap of LUXURY!!!
reviews.text:
the Khyber Gulmarg was everything it promised to be. Opulent , luxurious, warm and splendid. Right from its fabulous lobby to the breathtaking view from the terrace to its spacious and lavishly done up rooms, absolute delight!!

Khyber also serves one of the best Kawah in Kashmir which is also the welcome drink. Children were engaged thanks to the entertainment zone, indoor pool and the SNOW all around the property. Its proximity to the Gandola is a plus and makes the visit convenient.

The restaurants serve delicious meals be it breakfast or dinner, the service too is excellent. Our stay was made more comfortable thanks to the warm and well trained staff. Special mention to Mr Zaffar from the front desk who made it a point to look after our well being.

Khyber is a perfect getaway for those seeking peace and tranquility amidst the lap of luxury. Sure to come back again in December - Jan to enjoy snowfall.

reviews.author: mukulsGurgaon
reviews.title: Most beautiful resort with a splendid view
reviews.text: Khyber is a beautiful resort very tastefully decorated, food could have been better, breakfast spread was good, rooms excellent and specially the paper mache wall and excellent room size with lovely balcony and furniture. Bathrooms were very good. Beds very comfortable.

reviews.author: RahulP
reviews.title: Luxury amidst snow!!
reviews.text:
Let me start by saying - this was one of my best trips & credit goes to Kashmir & Khyber!

Our journey with khyber started with a small glitch - we faced some difficulties at the time of booking - the manager who was co-ordinating with us on mail went unwell & hence there was lack of communication. but it was later sorted out. we were sent pick up cars to Srinagar apt on time & good vehicles. The driver was very good & courteous. we were blessed with heavy snowfall on our way!! at the entrance of gulmarg we were stopped by locals (I guess taxi union) to show our reservations. as the papers were with my other friends who were in another car we were made to made there in heavy snowfall for 20 minutes. again a small area of improvement for the resort

Once we reached the resort it was bliss - nicely built, excellent décor, courteous staff. the rooms are well laid out. the best part is the resort occupies a large area & hence we played in snow in the resort itself. our kids enjoyed the snow at its best!! they have a small verandah outside the main lobby where the kids made snowman! the rooms were awesome, beautiful bathroom, excellent TV connection, good hot water.. I was impressed by the kind of services they were providing in this extreme climate! the rooms had lovely views of snow & long trees.. what a sight! the swimming pool was lovely- it is surrounded by full glass enclosure.. again what a beautiful setting.. though providing a heated swimming pool itself is commendable i would advise the resort to work on making the heating more strong..  the kids playing area igloo was superb. good facilities. but a big downside - the area was not heated!! it was very cold for the kids there.

now for some downsides - the resort charges for Wi-Fi. being a luxury 5 star it should provide free wifi. the food is really average for a vegetarian. they should include more varities & work on to suit indian tastes. the in-room, swimming pool & Igloo heating should be more strong. 

All in all a lovely experience!

reviews.author: Akash Choudhari
reviews.title: Amazing views...Good Hotel....
reviews.text:
Visited Gulmurg after 15 years with the family. There was still plenty of snow which was a pleasant surprise. 

The hotel is well located right next to the Gondola (which is nothing but the cable cars which takes you to the top of the mountain and probably best thing to do). The views are as good as you can get and it has a heated indoor poor with one of the best views you can image (full glass facing the mountains). Hotel rooms are good with greats views but slightly run down but nothing to complain about (probably in such extreme weather the wear and tear is going to be high). The Kashmiri food was very good but make sure you order well in advance (they took 40 mins to get the food). Also you need to have the Kava Tea in the coffee shop (overlooking the mountain) which was the best I have had in all the hotels and restaurants I visited in Kashmir.

I left my bag in the Srinagar airport and Staff was quite helpful in getting it for me. So overall a Good Experience.

reviews.author: khuku
reviews.title: Home away from Home!
reviews.text:
As soon as we entered the hotel, Shubhangi at the reception was surprised by our senior status & immediately gave us a room in the same floor, so we do not have to use the stairs! Such consideration to minor details justifies its name in the World's Small Boutique Hotels! In this hotel the staff addresses us by our names & knows us personally. 

Our rooms were very comfortable with a beautiful view of snow. Our children and grandchildren enjoyed the snow & all the fun that involves while we seniors enjoyed watching them. 
The food was very good & we had a great vacation bonding with our children & grand children! The staff went out of their way to give us this memorable holiday.

reviews.author: Kanwarbs
reviews.title: Simply The Best
reviews.text:
Simple the best one can get. Amazing property, nice people. Everyone in the hotel greets you all the time whenever you cross. Zaffar engage well in case travelers reach before check in.

Simply Superb & Excellent !

reviews.author: MoinBin
reviews.title: Dazzling Experience
reviews.text: i along with my family stayed at The Khyber in early April, I have no words to describe the expereince @ Khyber,I had come all d way from Dubai and i had apprehensions of d service and hospitality.However i was awe struck during my stay right from the checkin to checkout everything was flawless.The service at the Cloves deserves a special mention. I understand dat their restaurant is small to adjust all their guests however their staff makes sure that they make d dining experience a special one.I would highly rate this hotel to my friends and family,

reviews.author: MahimaG28
reviews.title: Brilliant
reviews.text: This hotel is gorgeous , placed in absolute winter wonderland during the colder months in gulmarg. I stayed here in January 2014 and absolutely loved this paradise. Gulmarg was WHITE , all snowed out and beautiful! The hotel sends you transport to pick you up from the Srinagar airport and Khyber is about 2 hours away. Comfortable drive and you arrive at this winter palace , perfectly heated for the chilly weather outside with beautiful kashmiri interiors and not too forget the beautiful photographs of kashmir displayed throughout the hotel. The rooms are comfortable and have windows to enjoy the views of the outside. The hotel is equipped with a spa , a heated pool and a gym all functional. I got a massage at the spa during my visit which was very relaxing. The pool is placed at amongst huge windows with views of the outside , something which caught my eye being a nature fanatic. We took ski lessons on both days which is about 5 minutes by car from the hotel. The service of the hotel is great , the staff is humble and very very helpful. There is one restaurant with a buffet dinner , with really good food. There is a cafe , where you can ask for authentic kashmiri kava (kashmiri tea) and there is also a lounge serving sheesha! My only drawback would be that the hotel doesn't serve alcohol to be sure to carry some with you before getting here as you are allowed to have it and they will serve you which is great. All in all absolute paradise , a great place to vacay with your family or loved ones. Gulmarg is beautiful during the winter months , absolute winter wonderland!

reviews.author: Aarti Sethi
reviews.title: It's Average
reviews.text:
We were super excited about this trip-we were going back to Kashmir after almost 30 years! And we had heard good things about this new hotel-the Khyber.

It was nice. Like any hotel anywhere in the world. A nice spa, central heating, Heated swimming pool et al. 

The service as far as the waiters were concerned was great. But the management really needs to have a long, hard look at itself. There is a serious attitude problem at the Khyber and we fail to understand why. With the exception of Mr Amir at the coffee shop (he was very good) we could not understand why all the guys in the black suits were surly, unhelpful and just-plain stuck up. In the hospitality industry, it is baffling….because our stay is not free, we are paying for our rooms.

Having said that, the view from our balcony was spectacular. It was snowing when we were there and we loved every moment of that. The view from the coffee shop was also great (there is no other restaurant) and we really liked that, but be prepared for average food, and do not talk to any manager. 

At the 'Cigar Room' were told that we can smoke cigars but cigarettes are not allowed. Really?

There's a nice cappuccino machine at their pastry shop but they will not serve you the coffee at breakfast unless you go to the pastry shop and pay for it. (as we were told rudely by someone called Rajiv).

On the other hand, the hotel is located very well near the Gondolas, and is a very short walk from there. 

Please arrange taxis for anywhere before hand, because the hotel will not help you with this.

reviews.author: Avinash C
reviews.title: mountain palace
reviews.text:
stayed here during my kashmir trip..... and i was fortunate to witness gulmarg in its full snowy beauty ... we stayed in the balcony room .... and the view is all snow ( stay dates 22 to 24th april 2014).... hotel .... has wonderful staff very soft and and quick ..... the heated pool/  gym ... are in immaculate condition ..... try to take all meals plan as there is hardly any hotels nearby .... its  not a bad idea for a weekend plan from mumbai as you can reach the hotel within 3 hours of landing at the srinagar airport

if its gulmarg it has to be Khyber

reviews.author: Surojit Ray
reviews.title: Amazing property
reviews.text: This is the best staying option in Gulmarg without any doubt. Possibly, the best staying option in Kashmir. I stayed there with my family in April 2014. Everything in this hotel is flawless (the view, the rooms, the service, the food, the staff, the hospitality and the location). This is one of the best hotels I have ever stayed in (this is after having stayed in several five star hotels in India and overseas). The view from some of the rooms can take you to dreamland. It is hard to express in words how beautiful the views are! Gulmarg in itself is beautiful and this hotel is a jewel in the crown of Gulmarg. Hats off to the management for maintaining this property so brilliantly. Every person going to Gulmarg and having the capacity to afford this hotel should go for it blindly. It is a once in lifetime experience without doubt....Special mention for the food,,,it was awesome....

reviews.author: madhurtodi
reviews.title: Amazing ! Super Duper !
reviews.text:
Anything that i write will not be enough for this property. The promoters have not spared any money in making this truly a world class property right in the middle of such scenic environment. 
The rooms are spacious and large, the bath rooms are big and spacious ! The huge tub in the bathroom has a window right beside it and it was great fun seeing snowfall outside while soaking in the hot tub !!!
They have an indoor / heated swimming pool and a separate one for children, this was a very good feature about this property and the kids loved splashing around while it was snowing and raining outside !
We had gone there to celebrate my moms 60th birthday and the hotel gave a complimentary cake for the same. They even decorated one of the room balcony with flower petals and candles and we cut the cake birthday cake there !
Only negative was the service during the breakfast buffet. The area is not very huge and they are not properly staffed to handle 100% occupancy ! We saw many guests complain of poor service and we also faced the same. My wife had asked for coffee at 10.10am and then had to remind the waiter at 10.40am that she had yet not got hot coffee. The waiter was so rude that he pointed to his watch and said that he could not serve it to her now as the breakfast time was over at 10.30 !!! We were appalled and called the manager in charge. This is the first time in my life i have heard such an rude tone and answer from any staff in any 4-5 star property anywhere in the world !
Overall, this is the best property in gulmarg (and maybe in J&K). Even though it is highly priced (23k INR per night incl only bfast) I would recommend people to stay here.

reviews.author: Murari T
reviews.title: excellent property
reviews.text:
We had wanted to book this property but it was heavily sold out and finally our travel agent was able to manage some premium rooms with balcony for us. The rooms were great with v good view. The balcony was good place to sit and relax although it was snowing most of the time.
The rooms, corridors and reception area were well heated and one need have to go out to reach spa/pool or your rooms. The IGLOO (playing area ) was great fun.
The check in process was completed but person assigned to escort us to rooms was non courteous and more busy chatting with others until finally, after 15 mins, Ms Shivangi from front desk came to our help. She was really helpful through out our stay.
The Gulmarg was better then any hill station (including swiss) and with snow it was icing.
I would recommend this hotel to any other in Gulmarg.

reviews.author: ShyamReddy
reviews.title: The Best in Gulmarg. Period.
reviews.text: Had a very pleasant stay with stunning views from the room. Service is outstanding and the food is very good. There is no other five star property in Gulmarg.
