Of special mention are service personnel in the coffee shop and the cigar room. They have a very good collection of cigars as well.

reviews.author: Amit K
reviews.title: Beautiful Gulmarg, Good Hotel
reviews.text:
Khyber is a well respected property in the Gulmarg region. Evident from a half raised eyebrow from most locals whom you mention it to within the city. A group of us checked in for the weekend. Here are the good and bad, good first:

The Good:
wonderful property, spread out, adequately heated so don't need thick layering inside the hotel. Food across the various cuisines offered is excellent. The menu is quite extensive and above expectation for a hotel in the hills with limited access to raw material and talent. 
The guards at the premises are excellent and helpful - they take initiative - helped me carry my 3 year old child over a steep incline on their own. 
The spa and the pool (which i didnt get to use - did not have swimming gear and they had run out of mens gear for sale) is excellent - the biggest regret I have is not being able to get into the pool. 

The bad:
Housekeeping had to be reminded at 1030am and then again at 230pm to clean room. Bathtub when filled with water had hair floating in it. The upkeep of the rooms is mediocre. The shower head flew out when the water was switched on, I left it on the floor for the housekeeping to see and fix but happened again the next day. Carry your own umbrella - room does not have any and porch had run out. The walls are thin - and you can hear everything from the corridor outside to the floor upstairs - footsteps, baby crying, people laughing - making it difficult to sleep at night. The uncomfortable mattress does not help either. Everything is expensive, I guess because they are the only hotel in this category in gulmarg. There was a electricity fluctuation issue through our stay - was told the hotel transformer had been acting up that week. Power goes frequently and you are in pitch dark from 10 seconds to a few minutes so be prepared. We were 2 adults + 1 toddler in room, I asked for an extra bed was charged another 3,000 Rs.  and the housekeeping guys came and opened the sofa to make it an extra bed - felt robbed. There is a kids play room - with basic stuff - better than not having one at all.

The biggest experience make or break for me is the first point of contact at any check in i.e. reception - here the hotel failed miserably. The check in person feigned ignorance on my credit card companies tie up for an upgrade even though I had it in writing. I understand it is subject to availability but she was of the belief that there is no entitlement only. Was kind of rude until her senior stepped in and took over. 

On the whole a good weekend family property, excellent food, go with low expectations on service and a heavy wallet.

reviews.author: ShantiTravel
reviews.title: Prefect hotel in winter holidays & summer
reviews.text:
Staying at Khyber hotel has been a great experience. The staff is great and the management too.  Spa is awesome, the pool is great with crazy view. Rooms are big. The food was  good even if we slept and there for 3 nights. 
For Skying, there are places to keep our skys. Trasnfers have been a bit complicated but finally it worked.

reviews.author: Rohit912
reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: The best place to stay in Gulmarg. Cant ask for anything more. Special thanks to Mir Zafar Malik for his exceptional service and hospitality. Will recommend everybody who wants to experience luxury. The view from the rooms are breathtaking.

reviews.author: Kumar R
reviews.title: The only 5-Star around at Gulmarg, placed strategically close to the Gondola Ride.
reviews.text:
At the last half hour of our trip towards Gulmarg, amongst the twist and turns driving up the beautiful scenic pathway ever seen with abundance of snow, we finally reached Khyber Resort (5 Star) at around 6 pm. As we exit out of the car, it starts to Snow & my kid is already excited.

The room given to us is a Premier room, the view outside our room was breathtaking. Since our room was at the ground level, we could see snow everywhere. Must be 3-4 feet of snow. My son & myself were all gung-ho to get out, but we could not, as there was a delay on sending our luggage to our room.

By the time the luggage came in, it was already snowing heavily. But my son just wanted to get out there & njoy every bit of it. The temp outside was 4 degree.

The room was excellent with comfortable beat, central heating, wardrobe, safe, bathtub with separate section for shower & toilet.. We stayed here for one night only. It is good to stay and get acclimatised before you head up for the Gondola Ride.  Only problem was the lift was not working. The elders here has a torrid time to climb up and down .

The Buffet dinner & breakfast is simply awesome.. The service was also excellent.

The walk towards the Gondola ride from the hotel was only 5 mins downhill. At the ticket window, we were disappointed to know that Phase II (Rs. 800 per head) was shut because of heavy snow & mist. Nevertheless, we bought the tickets for Phase I (Rs. 600 per head)

The 12 min ropeway ride was just awesome with beautiful pine trees covered with snow that could be seen below. As we reached the top, visibility was near zero due to the heavy snowfall again. Once we reached outside, it was breathtakingly beautiful with soft snow covered layers everywhere.. Gulmarg is famous for it’s soft velvet snow that falls here.. 

Post clicking some snaps, myself & my sons tried our hands in skiing (Rs. 900 per head unlimited time post a good bargain). I found skiing extremely hard, but my son took it as a duck to the water. After a few rounds, I was able to get a hang of it and ride it easily. My son continued for another half hour. Later the crowd started to swell in and there was hardly any place to ski around. 

Would definitely suggest to stay at this hotel. Though prices higher, it well worth every dime.

reviews.author: Anil J
reviews.title: Magnificent
reviews.text: The Khyber is an awesome hotel in one of the most pictureque places in India. I stayed with my family in March, and the experience was wonderful. The staff are extremely cordial, the facilities excellent (TV, swimming pool etc.), and it is very near the Gulmarg Gondola. Also, the room tariff is very reasonable considering the quality of this property. The only drawback, if i may say so, is the uphill trek from the gondola to the hotel, which can be very difficult if there is ice on the road. Overall, a great experience. A special thanks to Shakeel for all his help during our stay

reviews.author: Everywhere Escapes
reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text:
Visited last year. Nothing short of spectacular. The location is breathtaking!The views through the property rooms are unbelievable! A must visit if in Gulmarg! Certainly number 1 hotel in Gulmarg at this point. 

The restaurant has a reasonable selection. The service is quite impressive.  THe rooms are nicely done, and are at par with any 5 star hotel in the world.

The proximity to the Gondola is a plus.
The only minus is the overpriced rooms.

reviews.author: Nirajp
reviews.title: Luxury, Great views - Service could be better
reviews.text:
As soon as you enter this property, one can figure that this is a luxury hotel. Beautiful wooden interiors with beautiful furnishings. The lobby has a coffee shop overlooking the beautiful nature outside. When we reached, it just started snowing and the view was awesome.

Check-in : Check-in process was very quick. No issues

Room - The room is spacious, with almost all rooms having great views. The room has a large LED TV with a separate DTH connection. First hotel in India where I have experienced HD TV and HD DTH connection. There is a clear intent to maintain the luxury quotient. The bathroom is spacious with a separate tub and shower area with top-end bath fittings. The bathroom and room are separated by a half glass panel (covered by blinds) which might not be something which all families would be ok with. A mini-bar and tea / coffee maker.  Overall a good comfortable room

Location :- A 5 mins walk (hike) from the Gondola, the location is perfect. Close but yet not in the midst of crowd.

Food :- The taste was average, including local Kashmiri cuisine. They definitely look at this aspect. The breakfast spread was also not great, though they do offer a complete spread of Indian + Continental breakfast. Room service is very very expensive.

Acitivities :- They have a large game room with XBOX installed. Also a small theater with a DVD collection. There is an indoor heated pool as well.

Service :- This was the disappointing part. The staff doesn't seem to be professionally trained for service at this kind of a luxury hotel. The service was nowhere near 5-star standard. The communication (or lack or it), promptness left lot to be desired. There is lot of scope for improvement in this area. We got a glimpse of this during the check-out process. I had to dial atleast 3-4 times before someone picked up at the reception. Even after this no one turned up to pick the luggage. Finally I had to personally go and request at the reception.

reviews.author: Sajeev S
reviews.title: Good location, bad staff
reviews.text: This is in a great location with stunning views and very close to the gondola. The room service is horrible. It takes ages for staff response. We had dinner in our room on both days we stayed there and after dinner we asked to remove the plates but were never taken despite twice reminding them and finally had to leave it outside our room. The same happened on the next day also and in the morning at 8 AM we asked for a bottle of water to prepare tea. This bottle never came until we checked out at 9.45 !!! so much for room service.

reviews.author: Sanjeev A
reviews.title: Sanjeev aggarwal
reviews.text: We were visit hotel at 31 march for 2 nights resort is excellent,good location just 5 mnts walk to gondola cable,restaurant & food is good but there is nothing to do in the resort if u are single family u wll be bored no fun zone,no dvdplayer in the rooms,no games like ,chess,cards,ludo,there heated pool was not working children's get bored only option see tv at room.

reviews.author: Sekhar1966
reviews.title: Super Resort
reviews.text:
I just stayed for 3 nights at the Khyber Himalayan Resort last week. I was traveling with my family and friends and we had booked 8 rooms & cottages.
The resort property is simply fantastic. The rooms are large and very comfortable. The bathrooms are spacious and have all modern amenities. The resort's close proximity to the Gondola is a huge benefit.
We had taken a 3 night package which included breakfast, dinner, free Gondola ride to phase 1 for 2 persons and a free pick up and drop to Srinagar.
The package rates are very attractive.
The resort has great facilities such as a heated swimming pool, spa, a private theater room, restaurants, hookah bar etc.Or stay was very comfortable and will definitely go back again.
The only negative that I can think of is that the room service menu is very highly priced. It is more expensive than a super deluxe 5 star hotel.

reviews.author: AJAYNAGPAL
reviews.title: Fantastic stay and Divine experience....
reviews.text: The final journey of Kashmir Trip was a mesmerising stay at Khyber, Gulmarg. The resort is ideally situated next to Gondola. Commendable are the efforts of the management and staff to provide luxury of a 7 star at such a height in cold weather conditions. The place has very comfortable rooms and the bathrooms are lavish. Food is good. If you are a vegetarian it is advisable to go for a-la carte and choose food to suit your taste buds rather than lavish buffet which cater to taste buds of non-vegetarians. A special mention here is in respect of indoor activity for kids and the indoor temperature controlled pool. Stay was indeed Fantastic and a Divine experience......

reviews.author: Hema I
reviews.title: Amazing Stay
reviews.text: Excellent staff, food is great and the service is polite and timely. I would recommend trying the Kashmiri Firni and the Kashmiri traditional tea - Kehwa. The view from this hotel is breathtaking. Overall experience was memorable....We will come back to stay here again.

reviews.author: Shalini S
reviews.title: World Class Service
reviews.text:
Location is great, service staff is polite, enthusiastic and full of love. I have traveled more then 20 countries allover the world but must admit warmth in gulmarg was simply a life time experience. we were a family of 8 and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay, pool deserves a special mention, it's worth a time to leave nature and go for a swim.

Special thanks to mashood, bilal and yatin, they made our stay a life long memory, manuj was always there to ensure we do get what we got in the end. Only dampner was the transportation which was not as per the standards...

reviews.author: Travelbuff_A
reviews.title: Lovely Hotel, Pathetic Service!
reviews.text:
We were a group of 4 who stayed here in for three nights. The property is beautiful, and the rooms have a breathtaking view of the mountains. 

I would rate the hotel high on all parameters such as the rooms, ambience, spa and even the food. We received a very warm welcome from the staff when we arrived. When I stayed here the hotel was full, with only one restaurant serving food, you can imagine what a chaos would occur during breakfast and dinner time! The service was pathetic, you had to wait for a long time for tables, they refused to take reservations. they could not even offer the roti/paratha of our choice, and when they did it took them over 30 mins to serve. We saw guests even getting water for themselves. At no point was all the dishes in the buffet, they took forever to refill them.By far the worst service I have ever experienced. A huge disappointment. 

If you go to Khyber go the the fabulous property, the location, the view and the amazing ambience and rooms. The staff at the reception and concierge are extremely helpful.

reviews.author: salil
reviews.title: 5 star property, 2 star service
reviews.text:
The property is lovely. Beautiful setting and lovely facilities. 5 minute walk to the Gondola. The pool is one of the best I have ever seen, the the spa is lovely and the food is decent.  

The service levels are simply unacceptable for a hotel that is charging premium prices.  Wait times for  specialty coffee drinks during breakfast is upwards of 20 minutes possibly because they have maybe 1 expresso machine for the whole hotel. 

One of the hotel staff was rude to my friend and upon complaining to the hotel management was rude again in front of hotel management (in fact yelling at him for no fault of his). The situation was so bad that hotel management called security was called to handle their own staff member. We saw the same person an hour back on duty later serving coffee to hotel guests suggesting no action was taken by management and that they do not really care about how the staff talk to the guests. Very disappointing about the service and management handling of customer service given this incident.

Our  room came equipped with a sofa cum bed but apparently there is  a 3000 INR charge PER DAY for using the opening up the sofa bed and you using it  as an extra bed for a 4 year old child . There is no mention of this charge in the reservation or anywhere else so be aware of hidden charges. 

Awesome hotel location but service / policies need a ton of  work.  

Stayed in March 2014

reviews.author: siddharthgajjar
reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text:
This teaches to guests quality of property doesnt ensure good service..
1. we reach hill top 1 km away from hotel and called for pick up and got a government like answers  call this no.. will transfer the line and so on for 45 min..
2. on reaching hotel asked for GM.. but mr jermin meet claiming  he is the GM.. Such a FRAUD responce..
3. got a hair in breakfast sambhar.. no action taken even after information passed on..
4. at checking out forgot one bag  once we reach back to collect after 45 min.. staff replied the were about to call  dont know what they were waiting for..
Mr. Manu should know what thier guests are going through.. absolute INSESITIVITY.. EXPERIENCE IS NOT ABOUT PHYSICAL PROPERTY  BUT THE SERVICE YOU GIVE....

reviews.author: Rutli
reviews.title: Awesome Stay
reviews.text:
What sets Khyber apart from a lot of other hotels I have stayed in is the attitude of the staff.
the staff here goes way above and beyond call of duty and brings alive the true Kashmir hospitality. A must try for all those who want a feel of home in their stays in hotels

reviews.author: sachinvividtraveller
reviews.title: Good hotel but average food
reviews.text: By far hotel Khyber in gulmarg is the best property in town but we being pure vegetarians cannot echo the same about their food. We stayed for four nights and found the vegetarian food lackingin taste, variety. They only know how to cook Kashmiri & little bit of mughlai food but beyond that there's nothing much to rave about. They must improve on vegetarian food for a better rating.

reviews.author: nixongupta
reviews.title: Khyber Hotel and Spa Gulmarg
reviews.text: I was there from the 5th of March to the 9th of March, the Hotel is just fabulous the location the rooms all are perfect nothing to complain, the food is ok nothing too great to rave about and so os the service the service by the waiters and other staff is also very average to ok, but other than that the whole experience in Gulmarg was just fabulous.

reviews.author: sswang
reviews.title: Magnificient!
reviews.text: Though we were not residents at the hotel, we used the restaurant services of the hotel during a break while sight seeing. Even though the property was still under construction, we could tell by the look of it that it was magnificent and had the best views in town. This review is really for the Manager & restaurant staff who were very nice, despite just a brief interaction over a cup of Kehwa. They were gracious enough to even provide the tea & snacks on the house! The Manager was kind enough to provide a tour of the hotel to ensure that we would love to stay at the Khyber the next time in Gulmarg!

reviews.author: Jigna06
reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 2 nights and We were overwhelmed with the level of service that we experienced starting with our room upgraded to the most beautiful mountain balcony room.These are  absolutely amazing in terms of view and comfort.One Can spend hours lounging in the balcony with a beautiful view of the mountains not just that even the bathrooms are so well planned,  the view of the mountains covered with snow from the hot tub is just out of the world experience.The place is very cozy and luxurious with great warmth.Hotel staff including the drivers were very helpful and made our stay even more comfortable.The whole experience was beyond our imagination.Special thanks to Zaffar for looking after us and making our stay memorable.Overall just the perfect place with breathtaking view and wonderful staff. couldn't ask for anything more. 
I did not want to leave this beautiful place and had to literally force myself to leave but I will definitely be back at Khyber.

reviews.author: jindalnick
reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text:
Kashmir is heaven on earth..but it truly lies in Khyber.. Awesome stay experience.. 
According to me ,"To Be Treated Like A King You Dont Have To Be Born In Royal Family..Just Visit Khyber"..esp thanks to Mr. Zaffar malik for making our stay so wonderful. Whole staff from ground level to upper level is so customer service oriented that is just beyond imagination. Food, rooms, ambience, spa area every corner, every inch is just wow....ATHITHI DEVO BHAV.  MEANS GUEST IS GOD.

If you havnt been to Khyber you havnt seen paradise.. So must visit...i just simply lived my dream by staying over here...

reviews.author: anshulmumbaii
reviews.title: Good hotel poor service
reviews.text: We booked khber gulmarg as the best 5 star resort hotel in gulamrg but we were disappointed with the servcies and attitute of the satff. We were made to wait for 1 hour for check in though we reached the hotel at 12:30pm, we were alloted the last corner room inspite of our booking done nearly 15 days before. The a la carte indian food which we were served looked stale and was just preheated with loads of cream added on it! We requested for a kichdi for an infant which was denied outright. The staff was over burdant and attention was on foreigner groups & owner with his friends, again we reuested for kadi at night which again was refused. They did not even allow us to have our own liquor in public areas this despite the fact that they dont have a in house bar. Overall we were highly dispappointed.

reviews.author: maitreyi k
reviews.title: what an experience !
reviews.text:
We were here with our 2 children on a 4 day ski trip and despite bad weather ( we got snowed in ) , it was a great trip only because of the hospitality of the Khyber team . All our little demands and fancies were met with ease . The property is great , well located and close to the ski slopes . The food is excellent , the pool is so inviting , the spa is very good . 
Mr Aditya Mata , the General manager was around at any point to deal with any situation . Our sincere thanks to him and his team . 
Look forward to next year again .

reviews.author: lm1900
reviews.title: Impeccable Service and Hospitality!
reviews.text:
Would like to start this review by stating just how extraordinary the attitude of the service staff was!
To elaborate, at every instance they were so polite and just out to help and make you more comfortable, right from the doorman to every waiter and other staff.
We were on a Snow package that included our transfers from Srinagar and b/fast and dinner.
As were a group of 10, and the hotel does not serve alchohol, we had carried our own bottles which we would sit in Calabash, an area with tables outside the restaurant in the lobby for hours drinking listening to our music and no one bothered us.
Even if we got some food out of the restaurant to feed the kids, they were adjusting unlike most other hotels which are unnecessarily finicky not looking to the convenience of the guests.

Food
Food was generally good, especially their SHEEKH KABABS were to die for!! However, those we ordered a la carte and food apart from the buffet is expensive.
Buffet had decent variety and food was fairly good, better on some days than others.

Rooms 
rooms are decent, nothing extraordinary but for the remote location of the hotel, I guess good.
BUT even in winter the rooms get very very stuffy and suffocating at night, so much so that we opened the door the first night a bit and then got table fans to circulate air  the following nights.
We did complain and people did come to fix but I think their system doesnt go below 24 degrees into air conditioning, so dont know if it was just our room, or whether changing rooms would have made a difference?
Also goes to show that their insulation so good or the quality of their glass/windows/doors that despite it being below minus outside, still not freezing in the room! 
Mattresses are also ok, not particularly comfortable and pillows very large, heavy and uncomfortable.    
THE MOST IMPORTANT thing is no matter what anyone tells you, please get a HIMALAYAN view room versus the GULMARG view!!!!!!
The room with the balcony makes no differeence in winter as balcony does not get used so though we had it, was not worth paying the price difference. In summer, probably yes!

Room Service too was extremely helpful and willing to finger cut some carrot and cucumber I had carried with me as my 4 year ols has food allergies! 

Spa is run by L'occitane and the facial I had was good and therapist though fairly new and from nagaland but decent.

Jacuzi and indoor pool was also really enjoyed by the kids! 

Overall the staff goes out of their way to satisfy and are very courteous and polite in a very genuine way and not just how the thai do it because they have to or are supposed to!!

All in all would surely go back, just wish they would aircondition the rooms!

reviews.author: San67S
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
New Excellent Hotel, great service,good food, spa (Occitane), and very well organised. even have an excellent in house Doctor ( Nazir).

Probably the only 5 Star destination in the State in a Ski area.

Carry your own booze !

reviews.author: hems76
reviews.title: very Good
reviews.text: We stayed here on 25th Dec.. and its a awesome experience. I would rank this hotel at par at any ski resort in western countries.. Food is no problem at all, tho expensive.. Used the spa and no complaints.. Overall a great destination for 3 nights.

reviews.author: Taurean20
reviews.title: The Carrim Ganey Family Visit
reviews.text:
I would recommend this Hotel To Any family
We were a group of 12 and our Visit In December 2013
Staff Very Friendly, Hotel Great, Near Gondola Entrance.
Rooms Comfortable,Service with a Smile
The Snow Capped Area was Highlite

reviews.author: AditiManchanda
reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: The trip was great, and choosing Khyber Hotels was one of the best decisions. It is one of the best hotels out there. People are so welcoming and well trained, which made the experience wonderful. I would recommend it to all my friends.

reviews.author: PrateekBhargava
reviews.title: Finally a luxury hotel in the beautiful Gulmarg
reviews.text: Khyber is an incredible property and undoubtedly the best in Gulmarg. Perfect if you want to experience the Gulmarg in ultimate luxury. The cottages at the resort are not yet open but the mountain balcony rooms are brilliant in terms of view and comfort.

reviews.author: shailasharmadugala
reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Stayed there for 3 nights in last week of Dec13 ... amazing experience ...location is very nice ..very peaceful and amazing scenic beauty .The hotel is also very beautiful ..very cozy and luxurious with great warmth. Room service was also great.Food is simply amazing . However the best part was the staff ..they were so warm and hospitable and always ready to help ..too good ..nowdays a rarity to have such nice staff .. Tariq, Gulzar and both the Bilal in Kahwa and Shyam too ...well done. .

reviews.author: Michael R
reviews.title: Khyber Ski Holiday
reviews.text:
We visited the Khyber on a family skiing holiday along with several other families during the second week of January 2014. 

Overall we were very pleased with our stay, and we look forward to returning on an annual basis.

Rooms:  We had two adjoining balcony rooms.  They were spacious and well appointed.  The beds and pillows were very comfortable.  Storage areas were enough to accommodate all of our extra ski gear / clothing.  However the passage way between rooms was a little narrow.  Bathrooms were spacious with lots of natural light.  Overall the fit and finish of the rooms was quite nice.

Service:  Outstanding!  We travel frequently each year (Asia, Europe, and North America), so we are exposed to many levels of service.  The personalized service we received at the Khyber was excellent on a global scale.  The team at all levels are very well trained, and attentive to details.

There was some work going on near our room - down the hall leading towards the Spa and pool.  When walking through there was a strong odour from the paint / adhesive being used.  However this was not noticeable in our rooms, nor was it persistent throughout our stay.  Both the staff and the trades people did a good job at minimizing the inconvenience.  Even the trades people were very courteous as we walked by!

Special mention for Mr. Adityia, GM.  He seemed to be always present in the main hall, and checking on how his guests were enjoying their stay.  It was very clear that he enjoys his role, and takes great pride in the property he looks after.

Monsoor at the front desk was also exemplary in his assistance.  Both check in and check out was seamless. 

Aabid, general assistance at the front door.  On a daily basis he helped with ski boots, equipment, and the general chaos of getting several kids ready for a day on the mountain.  He went far beyond the call of duty - and it was greatly appreciated!  

Location: There is tremendous natural beauty surrounding Gulmarg and the Khyber is well situated to enjoy all of it.  Fantastic views from almost every part of the resort, we enjoyed all of it.

Moving between the hotel and the gondola requires the use of the hotel transport.  The walk is simply too far for children (especially in ski boots).  Moreover given the grade of the hill and icy conditions it wouldn't be advisable to walk. After a day of skiing, the last thing you'll want to do is hike back up that hill. The transport provided by the hotel was hit and miss, granted there were many guests utilizing the service.  Taking the direct number of the driver helped.

Possibly with some future planning, this property could be ski in ski out - but for now, take the transport and skip the walk.    

From a skiers perspective, there are two things missing at this property:
1) a large fireplace in a common area.  After a full day of skiing, sitting next to the fire is a great way to relax and warm up.  Possibly this is something they can add outside on one of the large patios at a later time.
2) a good Ski shop.  It would be a tremendous service and convenience for skiers if there were a quality facility within the resort to: 
     a) Purchase clothing, equipment, or accessories that may have been forgotten or lost
     b) Rent equipment - skis, boots, poles, gear, ect.
     c) Ski School - 85% of the skiers in Gulmarg appear to be utilizing some form of instruction 
     d) Ski / tour guides - skiing, trekking, snowshoeing, snowmobiling, ect.

While many of these points can be found within Gulmarg, they are in various stages of development.  Some are great, some good, others are to be avoided.  Gulmarg may be decades behind whats offered at European and North American ski resorts - but its changing quickly.   It would be great to have a single stop location within the resort that maintained the quality and service of the hotel itself.

Overall a great property worthy of a recommendation.

Thank you to the Khyber staff for a memorable holiday.

reviews.author: Dinesh B
reviews.title: Holidays in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Extremely great location near the Gondola (for skiers) with well furnished and comfortable rooms.Excellent food but service can be very patchy and takes time. Stayed in December 2013/Jan 2014 for peak season and not all restaurants were opened apart from a central buffet. Room service was very slow.The dedicated shuttle service into Gulmarg can be non-existent during high occupancies. Rafi at the Front Desk was excellent sorting out our issues. I was not told that alcohol was not served when i made my reservations,

reviews.author: Anshu S
reviews.title: Great Stay and Enjoyed
reviews.text:
I was on a Holiday with family stayed there for Two Nights. It was a great experience staying at the Resort, Rooms is nice and cozy 
The hotel is luxurious with spectacular view from the room
One can just sit in the balcony and keep watching the mountains and natural beauty of the place 
The restaurants and classy and the service is impeccable. Breakfast spread is well offered 
Staff is friendly and willing for Help, they are extremely courteous......

reviews.author: DELHIGURU
reviews.title: OVER RATED BUT NO OTHER CHOICE
reviews.text: Ok, I stay in the best hotels of the world but I am not at all fussy. I take most hotels in good stride. Being a road warrior, I am in hotels across the globe more than 150 nights a year. I was very excited about my first trip to Kashmir and my initial stay was at the Taj Vivanta in Srinagr which was excellent (would hopefully write a separate review abt that). Anyway, expectations were high about Khyber. Excellent, mind boggling, wow were some of the superlatives which I heard from people about this property. Well, anything but that. Heaven forbid you are not in their deluxe wing but in the premium wing. Congrats if you are because you can hear everything what your neighbors are talking about, from going to the loo to what time does breakfast end. Every word. We saw "comedy nights with Kapil" without even switching on our own TV. So, what these guys have done is build a brick wall of one brick and ensured you can hear every word, every loud f&&& which happens in both the corridor outside your room and in your neighbor's room. Ok, given they have built a hotel in one of the world's most beautiful places which would have been rough terrain to build a hotel but still, no excuses for the rates they were charging us. If hearing your neighbors talk about their loo habits was not bad enough, the nauseating smell in the corridors would kill you. Seriously. Bad bad bad smell in all corridors and attempted to cover it  up with "Ittar" fragrance, especially again in the lower premium room corridors. It was the worst smell and that is what will hit you the moment you enter the hotel. The third aspect of my review is the funniest and most dangerous. I twist the knob of my rain shower and boom, I get an electric shock through the handle. I thought I imagined it. I turn down the water pressure and boom again, another mild electric shock. Yes it was fixed after my complaint but still that was quite a first. Couple of other peculiar points :- the hotel does not have enough cars of its own to cater to all the guests. In the cigar room, cigars and sheeshas are allowed but no ciggies!!!!!!!! Breakfast buffets was bad. Bad in taste and bland.  Very claustrophobic hotel. The problem is there is no other hotel in Gulmarg, with Highland park gone down the drain over time (the old Kashmir travelers still speak so nostalgically about it but alas, it's finished... Went there for a drink and promptly walked out... It seemed they had not changed the curtains in 50 years)..... So, for all delhiites and bombayiites used to the luxuries of their Oberoi and taj hotels, you will find this property very very disappointing....at most a 3 star property... In my books, not even that... Oh yes, some of the staff was very helpful and that was a plus....gulmarg was amazing and it snowed when we ushered in 2014.... So the electric shocks, smells, bad breakfast buffets were all forgotten in the chill and thrill of awesome snow falling from the heavens :). Forgot to mention, no bar in the hotel and it does not serve any alcohol so BYOB people and there is no liquor shop in Gulmarg

reviews.author: Kunal B
reviews.title: Well Built Property but Location of Highland Park the best
reviews.text:
Its a beautiful Property with well appointed rooms and good central heating. We were provided a Complimentary Upgrade for which I would like to thank the management.

However, the hotel disappointed in the variety that was laid out in the buffet (breakfast lunch dinner). Having just come from the Lalit Srinagar the buffets were a big disappointment. The Ala Carte was comparatively better. There were issues regarding availability of a vehicle for the gondola drops and pick-ups especially in the snowy-Icy Wintertime up the steep slope of the Hotel. The Kahwa served at the hotel was excellent. The spa seemed in good shape but the pool had some heating issues which should hopefully be sorted out soon. The location of the pool is excellent though. 

Though the Hotel does provide excellent views of the mountains but the main affarwat peak gets blocked due to the pine trees. In fact the best views of the meadows as well as mount affarwat are to be had from the Highland Park. 

Though we enjoyed our stay at the hotel but I believe the hotel is a bit overpriced.

reviews.author: RENUKA S
reviews.title: If there is paradise then its surely this place
reviews.text: We were on a 4 day vacation to this place and we were with kids. There is no doubt that this place is a class apart . for me the prime parameters are VIEW, FINISH,HOSPITALITY,FOOD,KIDS FRIENDLY. This place deserves a 5* for all of it. One of the morning is snowed and one cant imagine how beautiful the place looks. My husband was enjoying the worlds best kawa looking at the view, my kids were  playing in the snow and as for my self I was painting this wonderful  moment which I still treasure  every day. My Special thanks to Mr.Alex for replyin to each ans every corrospondance, Mr Zaffar , he was wonderful and took care of each and very minutes details , conversations with him were very pleasing and last but not the least Bilal for patiently making those unlimited -worlds best kawas for all of us.

reviews.author: TraveldocMumbai
reviews.title: The Khyber experience - heaven on earth
reviews.text:
We were 2 families and had booked our stay in Luxury Balcony Rooms for 3 nights well in advance by direct payment.

The back office is a little slow in their response and one may require to telephone once or twice to get acknowledgement of funds transferred. I suggest that they have a pre-determined  cut-off time window (say 3 working days) to streamline this.

The location of this resort is really 8 star ! The view from the room gives a heaven on earth feel in winter. We were welcomed with Kahwa and the check-in was smooth.

There were few issues in the bathroom area which had leak around the glass partition which they fixed with sealant and the other room had a problem with the bath tub taps which also they fixed by 2 people working for more than 2 hours. Apart from this the rooms were in immaculate condition and upkeep.

Whenever there was a power outage the power came back within 10 seconds ! We were also informed of an emergency flashlight in the room, but we never required to use it.

If one wants to experience the beauty of Gulmarg and relax, then Khyber is the place.

We had 3 teenagers with us interested in learning skiing and we had contacted Khursheed (9906609693) well in advance and he took excellent care of the children and all of them learnt to balance and do basic skiing within 3 separate sessions of about 2 hours each. Snow shoes were delivered to our hotel within a hour of our arrival.

Khyber provided free drop and pick-up to and from the Golf course where the beginners slopes are and their service was prompt. Thank you Mr. Mudasir - Concierge.

The breakfast was a lavish spread and we have never eaten such tasty Potato Vadas even here in Mumbai ! 2 mini-meals items like fish stew, chicken stew, chole, baked beans and pao-bhaji were always on the menu for breakfast !

We had nearly all our meals in the our rooms since the children were tired after the skiing sessions and the service  was immaculate. We were particularly impressed by Mr.Yasir Ahmed Shah (Guest services associate) and Khyber management should cite him as an example for others to follow. The Chicken Tikka  in red chilli & Seekh Kababs were fantastic. The Chinese and Continental  food was also delicious and we were given the liberty to order from the daily buffet menu also.

I am not too sure about this ( and my apologies in advance, if I am wrong ), but the menu card seems to have mixed up Rista with Gushtaba in describing Rista as one with white gravy and Gushtaba with red gravy while the converse is true ! Mirchwangan Korma really stood out as a spicy dish.

The changing rooms in the gym & spa area  were not fully functional and we were one of the first guests to enjoy the swimming pool which was heated to about 27 Celsius. A small kiddies pool was also functional. The steam room should be operational as I write this review, but sauna was functional. The pool attendant was kind to deliver our swimming costumes dried to our room within an hour ! The hygiene in the spa (outsourced) was immaculate. There is also a small café just outside the pool for beverages/snacks.

The heating within all areas of  the resort  is really comfortable and it may sound paradoxical but one actually looks forward to the blast of icy air (at a cool minus celsius) hitting your face as you step out of the hotel. In fact Khyber has installed transparent plastic vertical split curtains outside to even minimise this blast of icy air !

The resort is in the process of opening a new cottage section with small individual cottages, which should be another attraction, but we were in no way bothered by any noise and / or workers.

Khyber will turn out to be a world-class resort if only they train their restaurant & house-keeping staff to five star standards. The front office guys, concierge, vehicle drivers are perhaps the only ones who really stand out. Mr. Mudasir (Concierge) satisfies every request. We extended our stay by 1 more night since the children were enjoying the skiing lessons and the food; were lucky to be accomodated for the additional night due to the efforts of Mr. Manuj Bahl & Mr. Wasim. Thank you for the wonderful experience ! We will visit again.

Visiting Gulmarg without staying at Khyber will deny you the heaven on earth experience.

reviews.author: Amit_Mittal66
reviews.title: Great hotel and location
reviews.text: The location of the hotel is great and its ambiance amazing - done up in wood and warm feeling. Very upmarket pricing both in room and food. The a la carte options work out well and decent if you are a large group. Food is good and tasty.  A tip for travellers - instead of booking through the hotel directly or even sites like agoda, go through a local Kashmir travel agent as they manage to get and give much better room rates and offers.  The hotel has complimentary pick up and drop to the gondola which is at the bottom of the small hill (its good in the evening when you are returning , we preferred to walk down).  Beware of the absolutely unreasonable MANDATORY dinner over Christmas eve priced at Rs 4725/- per head (just not worth it) which is not informed, billed to the guests and not informed by the travel agent or agoda website (the same kind of mandatory cover charge applies for even the new year eve).  Other than that the stay was wonderful -  if the weather had been good in terms of less cold, then the bar-be que option on the 1st floor would have been great.  The balcony rooms are good; however their bathroom / tub area (especially on the ground floor and below levels) is viewable from adjoining or the top floors if you keep the blind up (if you keep the blind down then the USP of seeing the snow clad mountain slopes while having a hot tub bath is of no use).  The hotel does not have a bar yet - so carry your own llquor.

reviews.author: SHIRAZ D
reviews.title: Thank God for Khyber .
reviews.text:
What a resort , it is just magnificent , fabulous , outstanding and brilliant in all aspects . one should salute the people who made such a resort at such a location , it's not easy to build and to run such a resort in Gulmarg . The rooms are beautiful , clean  , spacious . Room service is prompt and wonderful . The games room and the children play area is big  . The restaurants are nice and the restaurant staff is very helpful and courteous ( a special mention for Mr. Robin and Mr. Muzzaffar , who attended us well) . It has a heated indoor swimming pool so carry your costumes as it has an awesome view . 
The views from each and every part hotel are just awesome . I can go on and on writing good things about this one but even though it is a very expensive resort , you will never regret in staying at this one . 
Only one complaint  - the lifts were not working and we had to climb 3 floors everytime . Being a lift manufacturer myself , i know it is not the hotel's fault , but the company who has supplied the lifts . But guys get it done soon . 
Important note - if you have to rent boots and heavy jackets for the snow , take it from Tanmarg as the resort is a little away from the main market .
We loved walking in the heavy snowfall from the city to the hotel .

reviews.author: Venkatesh M

reviews.author: Karun A
reviews.title: World class luxury in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
This was a family holiday to Kashmir and my parents decided to book us into The Khyber Kimalayan Resort & Spa for our 3 night stay in Gulmarg after spending 2 nights in Srinagar and 3 nights in Pahalgam. I can honestly say we saved the best for last!

The Khyber was an amazingly refreshing experience from the very moment the car we were in approached the property. What was truly remarkable was the prime location and the amazing design aesthetic that is woven into every fibre of the 7 acre property. From the cobblestones in the drive way to the balanced wood and stone construction of the entire property and the grand chandelier and breathtaking views all around, that greet visitors upon arrival, you instantly feel you have arrived at a resort that would rival any of the worlds finest in more traditional but just as exotic resorts around the world from Aspen, Colorado, USA or Chamonix - Mont Blanc, France or Vermatt, Switzerland or Whistler, BC. This in itself, I think is some feat. Although a tremendous amount of credit for this goes to the surreal beauty of Gulmarg and Kashmir!

Everything about this resort makes it world class and you feel that as soon as you walk into a grand space where you are greeted by one of the managers personally who checks you in before showing you to the rooms. But first a warm cup of traditional 'Kawa' tea awaits to refresh and a warm or cold towel depending I imagine on what time of the year you arrive as a guest. 

We were surprised to learn that our rooms had been upgraded from Premier Mountain View Rooms to Luxury Balcony Rooms (albeit not with Mountain View). This in itself was a blessing as the Mountain View rooms get more direct sunlight and make it less easier to to actually sit in the balcony outside and enjoy the views with blinding sun in your eyes. Although in winter with the snow around, this may not be such a bad thing. In any case, the rooms themselves were spacious and truly luxurious with teakwood floors and walnut furniture complementing the heavily embroidered, rich darker shades of gold and maroon. Flatscreen TVs, a plush bed with amazing pillows and a wardrobe made the basic amenities excellent. And then you entered what has got to be one of the best designed and luxurious bathrooms around with a massive sunken tub with floor to ceiling windows looking out at the surrounding valleys - can't think of a better way to wash your troubles away and soak in the breathtaking views.

The locally spun carpets that adorn the rooms and bathrooms are very tasteful as well. Unfortunately the hotel was out of stock for the particular design we wanted to purchase which was unfortunate. 

The staff at the hotel were mostly excellent. Barring the gentleman who checked us in, whose name I can't remember, which says a lot for his quality. The one member of staff that truly made our stay exceptional was Mr Shyam - the F&B Manger/ Executive. For every meal at the hotel, which was fantastic (massive respect to the Chefs and team in the kitchen) across a variety of cuisines, Shyam went above and beyond his duties to ensure we only had the best at all times and were not just satisfied but were overwhelmed by his generosity and hospitality. The food itself, from a scrumptious breakfast buffet, to stupendous Chinese food (we had three meals of Chinese during our stay) and a plethora of cheese and dessert options, was exceptional and complemented by impeccable service. 

Unfortunately a few of the 'extras' at the resort including the pool, Spa and the outdoor grill/ barbecue area weren't yet operational when we went. But i can only imagine how much more these would add to the experience, especially in winter once they are. 

The views from the hotel itself are just stunning - with snow capped peaks and pine forests all around. The hotel also, is a 5 min walk to the Gondola which takes you up to the world's highest ski point. 

I can honestly say that the experience at Khyber can almost be an excuse to go to Kashmir if not for the beauty of this amazing state itself.

reviews.author: SnoberA

Best Wishes,

 .

Khyber is the best accommodation  in Gulmarg & one has to spent some extra to have luxury & facilities.The khyber is best luxury 5* resort made by human with combination of nature at its best....

reviews.author: Pradeep A

reviews.author: Kokila B

reviews.author: Ramesh Hemrajani
reviews.title: PATHETIC,DISASTROUS & A HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE
reviews.text:
I am a travel agent from Delhi who has been running the Travel agency for the past 14 years servicing high end customers and dealing with the best 5 star hotels. Luxury is our forte.
Here under is the description of the biggest mistake of booking a self proclaimed 5 star hotel called THE KHYBER GULMARG
 
We have been to the best 5 stars hotels and resorts worldwide and have an idea of the service standards, maintenance and the hospitality that a 5 star hotel should be. The Management and Staff at Khyber should really be ashamed of themselves, and we as travel agents need to make sure that we don’t sell such pathetic properties.
 
We arrived at Khyber Gulmarg on 16th October 2013 at around 1300 hours and then began series of disasters and the most disturbing experiences me and my family had. 
 
The hotel being a part of the SLH group, we had expected that it would atleast stand upto the standards of being a good basic 5 star, but by the time we checked out next day , we had realized that calling Khyber even a 3 star hotel would be an insult to the other 3 star hotels. 
 
The basic amenities like the swimming pool and gym were closed, and we were not advised of the same at the time of booking. All the lifts in the property were either shut or were under maintenance.  The kids room which they boast about so much of, was merely a joke ! It had nothing more than 2 incomplete sets of ludo and snakes and ladder and some pink wallpaper.
The main restaurant on the lobby level was closed. The entire arrangement thus had been shifted to the basement in the banquet hall , with typical wedding
type of décor. Upon checking on this , we were told that due to full occupancy , the hotel could not accommodate all the in house guests in the main restaurant.
 
Nevertheless keeping this aside here is what all happened with us at the hotel
 
Day 1:  we ordered a mutton dish in the restaurant for lunch and we were served some uncooked pieces of meat, that could be even impossible to chew
by animals.  At the same moment this was brought to the Restaurant Managers and chef’s notice both of them accepted that the meat was uncooked and Unedible... So much so for a SLH hotel claiming to be a 5 star.

This just does not end here, there were rusted nails in the balcony that pierced into one of our family member’s feet.  The level of maintenance was such that the shower holder along with a heavy rod  fell upon one of us during shower, causing a cut on left hand which was  bleeding. The para-medicos were summoned and the first aid was provided. As if this was not enough we even had a CFL that blasted in the room around early morning 2 am, and then there were pieces of glass lying all over on the floor.
The most seemingly unbelievable part is that all the above HAS happened in the duration of just 24 hrs, but that friends is the TRUTH !!!

Ramesh Hemrajani
Blue Ocean Travels Pvt Ltd.

reviews.author: TTT-789
reviews.title: Newly built (Jan 2013), amazing hotel!
reviews.text: This hotel was one of the best parts of our trip to Kashmir. We stayed 3 nights, and ate nearly all 3 meals everyday in the hotel. The restaurant manager took good care of our family of 5, plying us with free coffees and desserts with every meal. The rooms are large, spacious and have all the 21st century amenities including wi-fi. I'd definitely re-visit this hotel given the chance. It was about 200$ a night but well well worth it! Highly recommended, you won't regret it!

reviews.author: pk
reviews.title: Luxury in the snow
reviews.text: Extreme luxury in a small ski town! Lovely rooms with great views, beautiful bath area with a sunken tub. Eager to please staff. Good food. Hotel is still new , spa and pool not operational. Must-have kahwa in coffee lounge. Beware of pony and tourist vehicle lobbying , hotel car also not allowed to drop you! The gondola is best visited with a guide , he looks after your tickets and skips lines!

reviews.author: Jenny V
reviews.title: Breathtakingly Beautiful
reviews.text: We stayed at the Khyber for 2 nights and already planning to come back again. Excellent and courteous staff . Special mention of Mr. Maaroof and Mr. Manzoor at the reception who helped us at every stage of our stay to make it memorable. Thanks to Mr. Sameer { F & B ) for sharing the Kehwa receipe. The rooms and bathrooms are spacious and luxuriously designed. The balcony view rooms are amazing..... Hopefully when we visit next time, the swimming pool and the spa would be operational.  Special thanks to in house Doctor, who attended to our son .... who was not in the best of his health. Heartfelt thanks to him. Already recommended to our family and friends who want to visit in April. Thoroughly enjoyed the food and service at the restaurant.

reviews.author: Gautam Jain
reviews.title: An experience to Cherish !!
reviews.text:
As soon as you enter Khyber, you can feel the amazing ambiance of the resort. They welcomed us with a kahwa in there coffee shop with a magnificient view of the great himalayas. The snow capped mountains of Gulmarg look so beautiful that you don't want to get up from that place. The rooms are neatly done and the bathrooms are just too good. Ultimate luxury in the lap of nature. The staff is very cooperative and professional. The breakfast buffet was one of the best I ever had. If I had to point out one bad point, I'd say the mattress in the rooms are too soft (all the 3 couples felt that) and you feel stiff after sleeping on them for a while.
I really look forward to come again once there spa is operational

reviews.author: Tushar1983
reviews.title: Excellent stay at Khyber
reviews.text: It's a excellent property with great rooms and even better bathrooms (I stayed at the balcony room). The hotel is centrally heated so you can enjoy a cozy cuppa in the lobby area. The staff is extremely courteous and the room service very prompt. The day we were leaving for Pahalgam, Mr. Rajeev Chauhan packed a good amount of fruits and snacks for our 1yr old daughter. Mr. Yatinder arranged for a delicious birthday cake for my wife the day we had checked in. Keep up the good work guys and wish you all the very best !!!

reviews.author: Nishant
reviews.title: A great experience
reviews.text:
I stayed at at the Khyber, during a recent trip to Gulmarg.
Great Ambiance.A beautiful place.
However it was the staff, who were just great.Very courteous, and pleasant.Add on the great food and a complete 5 star experience.

reviews.author: RavishaK
reviews.title: Stunning hotel, in the stunning hills of Gulmarg
reviews.text:
The Khyber looks like a rich mountain retreat hotel when one reaches the entrance after driving uphill for some time. The warm and friendly staff helped us with our luggage. The checkin process was a little too slow due to some confusion. We had booked two rooms as we were two families holidaying together. However, only one room had the gorgeous view of the hills outside. So we requested them to give both the rooms with a good view and this process took some time. In the meanwhile, they had a special tea station which served us coffee/tea and some snacks in the lobby. This was quite nice and relaxing.

Our rooms were very comfortable and spacious with compact bathrooms with tubs and a good assortment of toiletries. The balconies were lovely with reclining chairs to enjoy the view outside. The rooms were nice and serene, and many families were staying in this hotel at that time. One disappointment was that the spa and pool were still under construction at that time. So we couldn't indulge into some massage after our journey from Srinagar. 

The restaurant in the lobby served delicious food and lovely breakfast spread. From south Indian dishes to North Indian specialities and even American spreads, it was excellent and filling. This hotel had advantages such as offering picturesque view, cool and beautiful location, surrounded by activities such as horse riding, clicking photos in Kashmiri dress, using the cable car to go and visit the snow peaks from where LOC is visible. We even took pictures with some Indian soldiers at the top of the peak. 

In totality, it was a lovely, calm and relaxing holiday that Khyber hotel offered us and gave us memories of a lifetime. I would strongly recommend this hotel to tourists going to Gulmarg. Especially, couples who are going for honeymoon as this place is very very romantic and stunning.

reviews.author: akeel_hashmi
reviews.title: Think of paradise and find it right here !
reviews.text:
No words can explain the exquisite nature has bestowed to this part of world called Kashmir,
It raised much above what we had heard read and seen in movies. And right in the midst
Of this charming and enthralling beauty is the hotel we were put in , close your eyes and think of
Paradise, wow!
Sumptuous food right at the helm of tall standing mountains and hot kehwa adds to what no
Thanks tripadvisor and Khyber hotels gulamarg for such a beautiful and ever lasting experience

reviews.author: OccTraveler2013
reviews.title: Breathtaking location and beautiful hotel
reviews.text:
The resort is situated at a breathtaking location, surrounded by the majestic Himalyas, close to the Gondolas and the golf course. The service is as wonderful as the resort architecture and amenities. The staff very warm and generally efficient. 
The breakfast was super but he restaurant food was not up to a standard of an Indian world-class hotel. The servers and their supervisors still seem to be on a learning path. I am sure that will get better but was a little disappointing.
One thing that was a pleasant surprise in a difficult health situation was that they have a resident doctor at the hotel. My sister had trouble related to her heart disease when we were there and I suffered from diarrhea when we came to the hotel. It was Dr. NAZIR AHMED who helped us. His expertise, including on-the-spot medications were very helpful and kept our overall trip experience extremely positive. Thank you to Khyber management for having such a thoughtful arrangement. 
A truly rejuvenating experience.

reviews.author: fassil123
reviews.title: Excellent Stat
reviews.text: Excellent Location, Amazing and tasty food with courteous staff around. It is a Pearl in Kashmir. I would say it exceeds expectations..... I along with my Family Loved the stay and we will come back to Khyber soon..

reviews.author: jt05
reviews.title: Amazingly charming hotel in a spectacular setting
reviews.text: This is an amazing charming hotel in a spectacular setting.  The rooms are fabulous and the views from the room and bathroom are stunning. The service is great and the staff is very friendly and welcoming. Probably one of the best hotels I have stayed in India.

reviews.author: Swati
reviews.title: Stopping by woods......
reviews.text: The Khyber Himalayan Resort is a very pleasent surprise.....a modern yet vintage, beautiful in wood, huge yet well guarded, probably the highest and with best views....all the good things that can be for a beauty loving traveller. We loved the Kahwah...which was extremely refreshing complete with the crunchy almonds. The rooms were fantastic, the bathrooms excellent, the views from the rooms breathtaking, staff well trained and courteous. The restaurant definitely demands special mention with an elaborate breakfast spread. The chef was prompt to serve the custom made continental dishes which were delicious as well. My 5 yrs old child also loved the food here. The lounge with various kinds of sitting arrangements leaves one in awe. This also houses a little area which all kids seemed to love. The evenings felt good at the lounge teaming with happy families relaxing here. Overall, such a superb stay in Gulmarg which does not even have a local residential area is amazing.

reviews.author: Indranil R
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text:
This is one of the best properties in Gulmarg. It is a very modern hotel with 5 star facilities. The view of the snow clad mountains is excellent from the rooms as well as from the lawns. 

The food is OK but not great.

The rooms are very clean with modern facilities, tea coffee makers, etc. 

The toilet is very elaborate and extremely modern. 

The hotel is located very strategically near the gondola station. 

However, since private transport is not allowed inside Gulmarg, one has to hire a pony to approach the hotel. 

This is an ideal hotel for honeymooners.

reviews.author: anu26
reviews.title: Relaxed holiday
reviews.text: Had an awesome experience at Kyber Resort,the check in was fast and delicious kahwa was offered upon arrival.The view from the rooms was breathtaking as we had informed the hotel we wanted good view rooms..Had read negative reviews for this property,but ours was amazing..It is a very hospitable propert where you raise your eyes and a person would come and ask if anything is required.. The buffet spread was lavish.i would specially thank Mr Mudassar( concierge) who made our stay a memorable one.. He had arranged our gondola passes too.The hotel provides an excellent free shuttle service to the dhabbas and shops nearby..A must try is their open air barbeque restaurant which serves excellent continental food..As we wanted to have lunch outside the hotel one day,we were told to have at Bakshi dhabi by the hotel,but I would recommend Vashnoo Dhaba which is just adjacent to Bakshi..it serves very good food.Gondola is very near to Kyber so very accessible..I would expect that they soon start their spa and more activities in the evenings..Movie theatre is very good in the resort but they charge a handsome money to book a show..Overall i give 10 upon 10

reviews.author: gopalmittal
reviews.title: Perfect holiday!
reviews.text:
Perfect holiday destination. never thought that a property like this is created in heaven!!
 just awesome.
Food is also very good. 
Only check in was delayed don't know why.
Never thought that something like this is created in Kashmir.

reviews.author: Stormsurgeon
reviews.title: Not so great Khyber Experience- it's a Tourist Trap!
reviews.text:
After a lovely stay at the Gurkha houseboats in Srinagar we headed to Gulmarg and checked into the Khyber and had reservations for 2 rooms - 5003 and 5005. The reservations were made a month in advance and Mr. Wajid was handling it for us. He also assured us that he would include one meal along with breakfast as part of our plan.  When we reached the hotel it was lunch time and we headed straight for the buffet area which is not in the restaurants but in a hall below with round tables that makes u feel that u are eating at someone's wedding reception. As soon as we picked up our plates (we were starving) we were told that ours was a CP plan and not an MAP as Wajid had promised us. We went to the Guest relations desk and spoke with Bilal and explained him the situation. He told us that Wajid had left the hotel for good and whatever commitment he had made could not be carried out by them. We asked him to clarify this with Wajid at his end, but he told us that he will get back to us. ( he never did - we had to call and ask him what was the update- which was negative) A commitment made by a hotel employee is the hotel's commitment as well. They should take responsibility and get things clarified at their end rather than make the Guest call the Reservations office and explain the whole scenario there and send mails etc of the communication. After all this they don't even have the courtesy of atleast informing us what the status is. The problem is a lunch / dinner buffet is a steep 1600 plus taxes. I feel it's extremely overpriced considering the limited buffet spread, ambience and service is concerned. For 6 of us it works out to be quite an amount ( especially when your mentally prepared that the deal includes breakfast and a meal) 
2. We asked the person who handled our check in if he could arrange our Gondola tickets ( he never got back to us ) - we met him the next day after we completed the ride and got only cold stares from him. 
3. The lifts do not work. Considering this is a 5 star property and a luxury hotel - this is the least that one can expect. I was with 2 kids and  I saw a lot of elderly guests having trouble climbing the innumerable stairs. 
4. We booked khyber with the hope that we could enjoy the spa and the indoor heated swimming pool. Their website prominently displays these facilities. However when we check in they tell us that the construction etc is complete but it will be commissioned in 15 days ( another disappointment )
5. The bars in both the rooms were empty - we called them to stock the bars - they never did. 
6. The flush in the toilet of 5005 didn't work - had to call them to rectify it. 
7. The drainage of the shower area was blocked and dirty, and water used to pool while taking a shower. (See pic) 
8. The shower apparatus was faulty and while taking a shower caused injury to my thumb. (See pic)
9. The fittings of the tub are so bad that they come out ( see pic ) 
10. The brown ball on the snooker table is missing - brought it to the notice - again - no response. ( it's not a big issue but I lost a close snooker game with another guest because of that ) 
11. Avoid the cold meats at the buffet - I had a glass particle in one of them and they look very stale and unappetizing. 

All in all, the khyber is the only 5 star in Gulmarg. So anyone who would like reasonable luxury and comfort would have no option but to book the khyber at its steep rates. However I feel that they need to improve on many aspects otherwise they would not do as well as they hope to do considering the poor service and customer feedback is concerned. On the plus side - the food is amazingly good and amazingly over priced as well. The steep climb to the property from the road below would make u struggle for breath no matter how fit u are and it would have been nice if there was a shuttle service ( I didn't ask them to provide me one - knowing the way they charge I would have had to pay more than a one way road trip to Srinagar !! 
Basically if u have the money to throw and can ignore the shortcomings - it's a good place to stay. Otherwise I hope that Koshy and his team buck up and improve otherwise a lot of prospective guests would be left disgruntled.

reviews.author: Devendra d
reviews.title: Super EXCELLENT
reviews.text:
just short of words to express the luxury that has gone behind making this resort, such great detailing in Interiors and with wonderful touch of Kashmiri tradition, there is nothing that you can look for or can regret.
Your visit/stay to Gulmarg would be incomplete without touching on this property.
Food Quality, Rooms all are just Superb.

reviews.author: Mohammed S
reviews.title: The best in Gulmarg-worth every penny
reviews.text:
Impeccable service,awesome location,good food,perfect for family.
Arguably the best hotel in town,stayed thee for 3 nights in a luxury balcony room.
It has to be a balcony room if one is staying at the Khyber!it's worth every penny!the rooms are very nice clean and classy service is top notch...and the food too is really good???be it alacarte or even the buffet breakfast ......
We celebrated my kids third birthday at the hotel and the hotel even made a cake for us on the house thank you so much for that.
We loved and stay there at the Khyber and will come back for sure to this place....if there is one place in kashmir we would come back and want to stay again it has to be Khyber.
all problems wee fixd in minutes...be it wifi connection..we had IT GUY COME OVER IN5 minutes and fix it .....be it the hot wart at the tub.".was fixed in 5 minutes...they sure have taken care to make sure the stay is top notch and without any hassles...thank you KHYBER for a perfect stay....
Yes the swimming pool was not in order..but could care less about it....and only problem I thought was due to some construction work...had few workers walking around abt...but was not much of a nuisance anyways....so not a concern."
WORTH EVERY PENNY...."..

reviews.author: John K
reviews.title: As breathtaking an experience as the Himalayas
reviews.text:
My wife, daughter and I stayed at The Khyber on our trip to Gulmarg in October.
The resort is situated in a breathtaking locale..surrounded by the majestic Himalyas, close to the Gondolas and the golf course.
The service is as 'wonderful' as the resort architecture and amenities.
Truly a King among resorts in the Himalayas.
The staff very warm and highly efficient.
One should trek down to the waterfall with a picnic hamper..I am told that the trek is truly worthwhile.
A horse ride to Khilanmarg and the Paper trees is a must.
A truly rejuvenating experience.
Thank you team Khyber.

reviews.author: Ayush Chauhan
reviews.title: If only luxury could buy you everything...
reviews.text:
Suffice to say this is easily the most grand and the largest hotel/ resort in Gulmarg. Great location (minutes away from the Gondola), fantastic views of the hills, grand architecture, lavishly done lobby, spacious rooms, plush interiors. We stayed in their premium rooms (with attached balcony) and it was a memorable stay (the rooms are a little small for the money charged - but not unmanageably so). This was my third trip to Gulmarg and I am amazed by the warmth and hospitality of the people there - Khyber was no different. Their service was prompt - and the brutal yardstick for that is warm milk at 7am for our 20 month old daughter. They didn't let us down once ! :) 

We were in Khyber late September 2013 and the spa / indoor swimming pool / gymnasium was still coming up. They took good care to ensure that the guests weren't bothered by it and I believe they were on track to have it up and running by this winter season. 
 
But like I said, if only luxury could buy you everything.. sigh ! And I must put a caveat here - that this part of the review is very personal and therefore not everyone would agree with it. For a place as charming as Gulmarg, its a pity that Khyber makes it slightly impersonal for you. And for a resort this size and lavish, it is not surprising. So the food was good but not great - infact just a few kms away is the oldest hotel in Gulmarg - Nedous - where we were served by two old, jovial butlers who have been with Nedous for the last 35 years. And the difference became evident - in the conversations that were missing, in the home-made mutton that was distinctly Kashmiri, in the charm that slightly rustic, undone exteriors have.

So in that sense, Khyber fails to provide the warmth and culture of Gulmarg. What works for it is the luxury and the dramatic surroundings. What doesn't is the intimacy, warmth and culture that should have been there - and only for that reason you also end up feeling that it is over-priced. I wouldn't be going back without trying some other places first.

reviews.author: Naresh23
reviews.title: Paradise at Gulmarg
reviews.text: Its a beautiful hotel, the food is absolutely delicious and the staff very helpful. The gondola is very close to the hotel. Recommend go both the phases. The sight is absolutely breathtaking. Even though there was no snow in september it was a great trip. Recommend October, jan to march and june july.

reviews.author: Pradeep024
reviews.title: Luxury in the lap of nature
reviews.text:
Hotel sits right in front mountain and view is amazing.
They have 2 category of rooms one without balcony and another with balcony. View is pretty amazing and you can stare at ranges for hours while enjoying your cupa tea. And it can literally take hours to explore all variety of tea Khyber has to offer. They have dedicated tea lounge which serves 24 variety of tea. A wide range menu and roof top barbeque just makes it perfect. 
Traveling with small kid is always challenging, our occasional special food request was always delivered with smile by chef. 
Swimming pool is under construction while gym was functional.
Only negative was air-conditioning which kept breaking down.

reviews.author: kkhan2013
reviews.title: mind blowing experience
reviews.text: I had lunch at the resort a few days back and trust me it was one of the best experiences.You can select from a wide menu ranging from Conti,Chinese,Indian and Kashmiri.the staff treats you specially and makes sure that the experience at khyber is unique.Would rate this as number 1 hotel in terms of infrastructure and trained staff

reviews.author: vishal0151
reviews.title: the best hotel in whole of kashmir
reviews.text: i know gulmarg is famous for gondola ride but i would rate this hotel above that. excellent infrastructure, delicious food, brilliant service, spacious rooms, and the whole staff was very responsive and helpful. i will only visit kashmir because of this very hotel.thank you khyber family.

reviews.author: Sabitamittal
reviews.title: One of the best one
reviews.text: The experience was out of this world. I am again going to be there in dec, 13. Location, placement and facade were marvellous. Typical Kashmir structure embodied in rich wood. Washroom were out of this word experience. Wooden flooring in washroom unseen before. Great food and more great kahwa.

reviews.author: Dhaval T
reviews.title: Memorable Stay !!!
reviews.text:
I stayed in Mountain View Room in the first week of Sep 2013. The view is just exotic. It was a One night stay where i felt i was in heaven. The food was outstanding and interiors of the hotels have been done traditionally and good. The rooms are spacious with wonderful set of people around. 

I would like ot visit one more time...

reviews.author: Dhruti2013
reviews.title: wonderful stay at khyber
reviews.text:
it was a memorable stay in Khyber.Amazing food,energetic set of employees around.
The location is amazing,I stayed in Himalayan view rom and the view from the room was  just lovely

Pony walas have spoiled Gulmarg

reviews.author: Milind P
reviews.title: Fantastic Property at a beautiful location
reviews.text:
The Khyber @ Gulmarg is a fantastic property, only recently built, at a beautiful location. As soon as you enter the hotel, you can see that it is a class apart in all respects. From the Furnishings to the paintings, to the rooms and the flooring, everything is tastefully chosen and done up. The Staff here is very courteous and polite. Food is lovely. However, there is no bar in the hotel, which may be noted. There is a kids area, comprising of a trampoline, swing and see-saw, which my daughter loved. Further, there are other entertainment options like the snooker, carom, etc, This area was under construction.

All in all, we had a fantastic experience at this hotel and would highly recommend it. I would even go so far to say this IS THE BEST HOTEL IN GULMARG.

reviews.author: Khalid A
reviews.title: Excellent location to stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
Excellent stay 

we booked through Akbar travels

it was great with family rooms were spacious with balcony 

weather was rainy and all over clouds 

we were lucky Gondola was open on the day we reached for both phases 

Beauty full place to visit 

No tension or disturbance was noted during entire stay in Kashmir 

problem reported outside were not present

Srignagar
