reviews.author: virender j
reviews.title: Good new hotel with average views
reviews.text: This is a good new hotel in gulmarg with very average views. The problem in gulmarg is that old hotel like highlands & nedous command the best views but are very average now as they have not upgraded their properties & new hotel like Khyber & vintage are no doubt mucg better but with very average views. Otherwise the food served in Khyber is good but exorbitantly priced where an average meal per pax without drinks is approx 2000/- per head. Do try this hotel in winters for the snow experience!

reviews.author: SwapTre
reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.text: This was a family vacation & we had booked 2 rooms. The check-in process was smooth & we were upgraded to adjacent balcony rooms with a great view. Our stay was for 3 nights & thoroughly enjoyable. The hotel lobby has a very cozy feel to it & the property is built was an eye for detail. The staff here is excellent & so is the food. We were offered complementary kahwa(local hot drink) at their tea-lounge with breathtaking views. The rooms are done up very well but the beds were too cushy to be comfortable. There is also some construction activity going on at present. We compliment the manager & the staff for this beautiful experience.

reviews.author: Darshikaajoomal
reviews.title: Awesome location
reviews.text:
Khyber was a beautiful stay for our whole family. The hotel had upgradedus to mountain view balcony rooms . Since we were travelling with three adults in the age group of above 70 years they were nice enough to give us the same category but on a lower level. We had 2 more rooms for us on the 1st level. Our rooms were fabulous and the children enjoyed the big bathrooms and bathtub.
There are lots of activities for children of all ages. The swimming pool and spa is to open in September 3013. They have a trampoline in the lawns and small baby area and. Children's area. 
But we managed to do lots of treks in and around our hotel. The locals were very glad to help us also. 
The gondola to go to level 1 and level 2 is just a two minute walk outside our hotel. It takes around 10 minutes to level 1 where there is nothing much to see. Level 2 is at 15000 feet above ground and we passed through clouds on our way up. It was cold . We had rent horses to then reach the top where you can see the Line of Control or if very fit you can trek up. It will take half hour. But the air is very thin so if not used to it might be difficult.
It is a half day trip .
You could ask the hotel to get you a local guide who can help with all the tickets and trekking. 
They will also help to organise other treks in the area . It is beautiful .
Food at the hotel is very expensive, but you have the option to go to local dhabas where the food is very fresh and clean also. There is no alcohol served in the hotel. But if you bring your own , they will serve it to you either in your rooms or even in the restaurant.
We had a wonderful last meal which was a barbecue on the terrace, with fresh sea food, meat, pastas and enough vegetarian options also.
Breakfast was very good with lots of options to choose from. Even though we were there for four nights we never got bored of the food. 
Service was very good. The housekeeping was always helpful.
But since we there in August and lucky or unluckily we got very hot weather in the day, and there are no AC in the rooms. So it can get stuffy to sleep. We would keep our balcony rooms open after lights out and had to call for table fans. They only have heating in the room, coy they have never experienced such hot weather.
Overall a very good trip and an excellent stay.

reviews.author: decorage
reviews.title: Fabulous stay!
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely fabulous stay at the hotel. The Manager welcomed us by our name - a small but thoughtful gesture. Makes a guest feel welcome to know that they are expecting you. 

Our rooms got upgraded to beautiful, valley facing rooms with balcony. You can spend the entire holiday just gazing at the breath-taking view.....

The hotel is well-priced and the luxurious setting can spoil you for your next destination. Taj at Shrinagar fell short of our expectation after experiencing The Khyber.

It is a definite recommend for everyone visiting Gulmarg. We would love to go again when it snows.

reviews.author: RekhaChoudhry
reviews.title: Good product, Fabulous locales!!
reviews.text:
My son had booked us here and I was a bit skeptical about staying here given that Gulmarg had seen the opening of this hotel only a very short while ago! Having said that, I was pleasantly surprised to see that this hotel was affiliated to the SLHW and thought to myself that the affiliation obviously held some merit to the hotel's services.
The product simply blows one away! Wafting smells of sweet saffron laced kahwa and the nuttiness of the walnut furniture are enough to create a mesmerising effect. The rooms are large and redolent with Afghan and Kashmiri influences. Large sunken baths overlooking the Affarwat mountains are sure to ease out any strain that one might have felt while coming to the hotel.
Our stay was however peppered with some unwanted faux pas. The toilet in the room backed up and nearly overflowed at around midnight. The complaint was however, attended to quite promptly.
The service at Cloves (the all-day dining restaurant) was pathetically slow and lacked attention and coordination. We received our drinks after we had finished our soups and appetisers. And this is despite us being the only three guests at the restaurant. This laxity was however, made up quite well by the food, which I must say was great, both in portions and taste.
Overall, I would say this was a great retreat and a must visit for people coming over to Gulmarg.

reviews.author: SantanuSyam
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth
reviews.text: We stayed in Khyber Resort at Gulmarg on 26th and 27th August 2013. No praise is enough for the quality of the hotel and services it offers. There is a warm hospitable team manning a fabulous property which is clearly the est in India in terms of value for money and customer focus. The location is on top of a hill with a fabulous view. The food is outstanding and the staff leaves nothing to chance to make your stay comfortable. If I were to rate this hotel based on my experience of holiday stays across the world, I would definitely rate this as my best experience.Look forward to enjoying many more holidays in this serene hotel which makes you feel on top of the world - literally!!!!

reviews.author: Leona M
reviews.title: Magical setting...
reviews.text:
Another property that I’m not sure where to begin...?

The views, the location, the hospitality, the food, the staff and the comfort of the rooms are all exceptional.  This property excel’s itself in every way possible.

The only disappointment for us was that the swimming pool and spa facilities were not open – they are expected to open in October – so a trip back is a must.

There is a peace and serenity about this property that you cannot describe.  I would return, especially in the winter to see the contrast with the snow and to be able to experience the skiing.

I cannot fault this property in any way except for the building noise and building staff constantly walking around.  The on-going building and noise ruins the tranquil surroundings as it starts around 8am and only finishes around 8pm which is disappointing.  We sat on our balcony every evening to appreciate the sunset and admire the views only to be disturbed with the constant drilling, talking and sawing from the building of the spa and chalets…guests should be made aware of this before arrive so to avoid disappointment as you can not appreciate a bath in privacy whilst looking out towards to views without looking at building staff.

I would however extend a big compliment to the assistant GM, Waseem for a compliment of staff that are friendly and offer a superior service and go beyond the call of duty for your guests.

This property comes highly recommended and as I mentioned before I would return in a heartbeat and cannot wait for my next trip to Gulmarg.

reviews.author: Sandeep Sharma
reviews.title: OUT OF THIS WORLD
reviews.text: We had stayed here for 2 nights in May 2013.The resort was fully enveloped by snow and the meadows of Gulmarg were covered by white blanket.The resort feels like heaven.There are no words to describe it.It is one of the best properties in Kashmir.The ambience is excellent and the food great.People usually cover Gulmarg in a day trip by enjoying the GONDOLA ride.Very few people actually stay here maybe because of the cost factor.But they dont realize what they are missing.This place is an absolute BLISS.

reviews.author: RahulC
reviews.title: Good property but Improvements needed!
reviews.text:
We were a group of 13 adults and 3 children. We stayed at this property for 2 nights (Check in 15th Aug and Check out 17th Aug). I searched for the best tariff for this hotel on online travel websites and my regular travel agent in Mumbai. But I got the best deal from Sawhney Tours and Travels, Srinagar.

We had booked 6 premier mountain view rooms for Rs 12,500 per room per night which included tax and breakfast. Out of the 6 rooms, 3 of our rooms were upgraded to Luxury Balcony rooms.

Before our stay, I did write to Mr Alex (G.M.) about looking forward to a great stay. He was prompt in his reply and assured us of a good stay. Even Mr Arun (Director of food and beverages) got in touch with me to enquire if we had any special dietary requirements. A good start!!
 
Our stay at this hotel could clearly be divided into two different experiences. To begin with we arrived at the hotel at 4.30pm.We were allotted 3 luxury balcony rooms (east wing) on the first floor and 3 premier mountain rooms on the minus one level (This was after requesting for all 6 rooms on the lobby level as we had senior citizens and children in our group and the hotel lift is still not operational). The premier mountain view rooms are around 386 sq. feet. The rooms were very modern, well maintained with flat screen television and tea/coffee warm kettle, centrally air conditioned, etc. Similarly the bathroom was fantastic with a nice shower section and a bath tub. But on close inspection the bath tub had brown dirt stains which was a downer. The phone and television was not working!!! I had to personally walk to the reception to inform about the problems and they said they would have it rectified. The view from the mountain view rooms was an absolute disappointment. On opening the curtains all we could see is trees and the parking complex!!! In the defense of the hotel management we faced cloudy and rainy weather during our stay in Gulmarg which had curtailed the views to an extent.

By dinner time, nobody had yet come to rectify the above issues. I,my wife and my 6 month old daughter went for dinner and this time we were clear about our disappointment. Fortunately, we ran into Mr Arun and Mr Deepak who understood our concerns and promptly changed our room to a luxury balcony room (east wing) on the lobby level. From then on, our stay only got better.

The luxury balcony rooms (568 sq. feet) are absolute luxury. Huge rooms and bathrooms with a wonderful balcony overlooking the valley. If there are no budget constraints I would definitely advice people to take balcony rooms but in the south wing. The east wing rooms have a good view but the view from the south wing is definitely better.

I happened to meet Mr Alex the next day. He explained that since the last 3 days it was raining heavily in Gulmarg hence they were facing issues with their telephone and televisions. He acknowledged the problem of the bath tub which he said was a problem in their system which he was going to completely overhaul! 

The breakfast spread in the hotel was great. South India, Pav Bhaji, cereals, milk shakes, juices, sausages, baked beans, cappuchino, kahva etc... Our first night dinner at Cloves restaurant was average. They have a buffet (Rs 1600 p.h.) but we opted for ala carte. Most of the dishes are priced in the range of Rs 600-700 plus tax. Our next days dinner at Nouf (open only for Dinner) was great. Its an open air grill restaurant and definitely pricier (Rs 800-Rs 1000 per dish plus tax) but the food was fantastic. At Nouf we can bring our own alcohol and they are happy to serve it to us. This restaurant has limited capacity and tends to go full. Hence prior reservations recommended.

Vodafone postpaid subscribers will not get network in the hotel except in the balcony of the luxury balcony rooms. There is full network when u exit the hotel. The hotel also has a cigar and sheesha lounge. The hotel does laundry for children clothes at 50 % of the normal laundry tariff. 

Gulmarg does not have wine shops. No hotel in Gulmarg serves alcohol.

The spa and swimming pool are not operational. They have a private theatre which unfortunately was booked during our stay. They have a small children's activity play area.

Mr Alex and his team have a great property. I am sure they will iron out the glitches faced by us. I would recommend a stay at this property when all their facilities are operational (January 2014 onwards).

reviews.author: JI009
reviews.title: Heaven on Earth !!!
reviews.text:
We stayed in Khyber for just 1 night ..wish we could have stayed longer. It is probably the best property in Kashmir. Awesome location, fantastic hospitality and service. The views from the hotel were just unbelievable. Rooms were very tastefully done, food was great and staff was very helpful. 
In all an awesome experience, if one goes to Gulmarg should definitely plan to stay in Khyber. Want to do it again in Winters !!!!

reviews.author: RCR1000
reviews.title: Family Holiday in Gulmarg
reviews.text:
We stayed 2 nights in this hotel. The staff were very friendly & helpful. 
The view from the upper floor was fantastic but the lower floor had no views. 
Unfortunately a number of facilities for children were not working - & we had a large group of
Young children. The pool was under repair!
The quality of food & selection were good. Overall,good experience. 
Recommend mountain view rooms on upper floor - worth the extra cost. 
Beds were too soft!

reviews.author: dpatel2013
reviews.title: EXCELLENT HOTEL
reviews.text: We stayed there for two days on 2nd and 3rd of  aug'13, Rooms are very nicely designed, Food is excellent and staff particularly Mr Rajiv Chauhan made our stay memorable.Only thing we miss in this hotel is bar, You have to carry your booze because there is no liquor shop in Gulmarg. Will definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Aali78
reviews.title: superb location, great view, great service.
reviews.text: superb staff, willing to help and guide, amazing views from the hotel. Rooms are very well designed and as its a new hotel its very nice. A young team going extra mile to please the guest...superb attitude. Good location. i am very keen on revisiting and staying here in winter.

reviews.author: Rahil R
reviews.title: Great property, but a work in progress
reviews.text:
Khyber seems to sit atop the rest of Gulmarg and commands beautiful views. The hotel is contemporary but with definite Kashmiri touches that help the hotel stand out from the rest of the luxury resorts that you might have stayed at. But the hotel is definitely a work in progress - the spa is not compete (odd since they have the word Spa in their name) and they haven't really worked out all their operational kinks yet. For example, they offer a helpful car pickup and drop off service to the town and back, but the number they gave me to call for the car pickup was either incorrect or no one picked up my call. Luckily I had the number of the driver who had dropped me the previous day and I was able to get a car to come pick me up, but had to wait in the rain for 10 mins. On our 2nd day there they didn't have a lunch buffet because there were too few guests (made me feel like I should have checked out with the other departing guests) and when I enquired about dining options at the time of check-in they forgot to mention that Nouf needed prior reservations. These all are fairly trivial in the big scheme of things, but they do add up especially when you're expecting luxury. 

The rooms though were beautiful and given how close the hotel is to the gondola's I think it would be a great place to stay for skiers. 

All in all, I'd probably stay here again because I think by the time of my next visit they would have worked out all these details.  

PS: The beds and pillows were terrible. They were so soft that I kept sinking in and the pillows barely gave my head any support. I actually napped on the couch in the room.

is really close to the Gondola's.

reviews.author: sunildua2013
reviews.title: heaven on the earth
reviews.text:
From the childhood I have listened that Kashmir is the heaven on earth .but I actually found that Gulmarg is the heaven of Kashmir and KHYBER RESORT is the heaven of Gulmarg this was my first trip to Kashmir .we have enjoyed lots in khyber resort  as khyber provide us all kind of entertainment and the food was also very  gooooooo .the staff of the khyber was  friendly .the interior and the exterior of the resort is woooooow   and u can enjoy the  stunning view from the bath tub . the room of the hotel were very spacious and well decorated .there amazing movie theater in the resort where u could enjoy with ur family and that's  complimentary .if u like hookah then there is very good hookah lounge where u can spent very goooo  time
and  my kids were pampered like in home and Khyber have great staff I rember three names one is abid  and shyam is hookah lounge manger and Deepak is also the manger and one of the best driver is shabbir there       . thanku Khyber to gave good memories to us
we defnatily come back in december or in January                and special  thanks to the owner of this resort for creating  this heaven

reviews.author: Arjun D
reviews.title: beyond expectations!!
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at the Khyber Resort for 4 nights with my family... it was indeed our first time at this hotel. I would like to simply say that this hotel and its entire team exceeded all our expectations... straight from being meeted and greeted by the Hotel GM to being served by some of the most hospitality staff I have ever come across. Everything was perfect;
the rooms were nice and modern and extremely spacious...(deluxe room with balcony); the food was extremely tasty and reflected authentic kashmiri cuisine. 

I would like to also compliment a particular member of the team in the restaurant " Deepak" who served us... he was courteous and very hospitable. well done to him and his team including tariq and everyone in the cloves restaurant. 

I would recommend this lovely hotel to anyone who thinks of going to gulmarg or be it even kashmir....do stay here, it is truly heaven on earth!!

reviews.author: Rahul W
reviews.title: Superb Experience in the hotel which is only few months old
reviews.text:
One of the best experience i ever had, while staying in this luxury hotel, which is very close to the Gondola. Everyone the beauty and the pleasant weather of this place greets you and you just cannot stop marveling at the nature from the balcony. when we reached there after a 4 hrs drive from Srinagar, we were warmly greeted by the staff of the hotel; who gave us Kava to drink as a welcome drink. All our stay along with breakfast was taken care off by our travel agent. As we were waiting to get to the rooms, we were told that we have been upgraded to Luxury Rooms which had balcony attached to it. we were really every happy.

The food at the hotel is quite good since you have a variety of food to choose from in the menu; but i suggest go and eat Kashmiri Food whether in Non veg or Veg.

The hotel arranged the sight seeing for us while negotiating with the local guide; who then got us the local transport which was in good condition and arranged the whole /half day sight seeing tour for us. 

We were there for 3 Nights/4 Days.

Will definitely go and stay at the same hotel during winters to experience snowfall.

reviews.author: Eesha k
reviews.title: great place to spend time !
reviews.text: Really a great place to be with family and friends. Had a good time. Excellent service, cooperative staff, nice rooms. Place well built to add in the beauty of kashmir !! A perfect destination for spending time with your closed ones. Good food. Scenic beauty to the best !!

reviews.author: supermehra
reviews.title: Excellent service & well appointed rooms
reviews.text:
Possibly the best hotel in Gulmarg, the Khyber is an excellent, brand new property. The hotel has the feel of a "wood cabin" with great views of the mountains & woods. 

Pros:
1. Located very close to the Gondola starting point & the golf course. 
2. Service is outstanding with eager to please staff.
3. Rooms are brand new and were the most comfortable in Kashmir. 
4. Food though limited in choice, was generally decent.
5. Chaikash their tea lounge is a great hang out and serves lovely kawa. Also decent cappuccino.  
6. The room we had, overlooked the hotel gardens which are perfect to relax in. Hotel also does bonfires on request for an additional charge. 
7. Kids have a cinema, trampoline, billiards table (poorly maintained), garden area to play in, all of which keeps them busy.  
8. We shared our suite with 2 kids, which worked out well. The room balcony was spectacular. 

Cons:
1. The hotel has some construction still underway. Can be noisy if you are nearer the construction. 
2. The approach to the hotel is cluttered with ponies which make a real mess. No real fault of the hotel, Gulmarg is just like that.  
3. The hotel restaurant was shut which meant that you had a choice between the buffet & an open air continental restaurant. The buffet tries hard, but isn't very good. It also gets boring if you are going to eat three meals times 3 days in the same room! Gulmarg has no other real options outside the hotel. 
4. The lack of authentic Kashmiri food was our greatest disappointment. When in Kashmir why would you want to eat continental? Perhaps for the europeans who come skiing in the winter!
5. NO ALCOHOL...... so BYOB!

Overall, I would highly recommend Khyber.

reviews.author: Amit K
reviews.title: Superb property with great views
reviews.text:
Newly built, superbly done up hotel. Hotel owner seems to have spent a fortune in building it (some parts still under construction). Spa is still to be operational. 

Stayed in a room with balcony - comparable to the best. 

Had the best Kahwa tea of my trip (which was offered while check-in was being done). However, food quality was generally not up to the mark, maybe its early days.

reviews.author: CHANDRAChandigarh
reviews.title: Good for Winter
reviews.text:
Stayed 4th & 5th June 2013

The check in was painfully slow, we were offered some kahwa and then totally forgotten about. The rooms are nice. However almost half of the rooms have balconies for which the hotel charges approx Rs 3000 extra.  Rooms with No balconies have a big glazed wall for a good view of the forest beyond, but then the glass was never cleaned.
 In this hotel we had to go down 2 floors to reach our room. Provision for lift is there which was not installed as yet.
The spa is also not functional yet. The business centre is also lacking in many aspects. No newspapers delivered to the rooms in the morning.
 Quality of food is good and the service in the restaurant is good. 
Housekeeping is poor. Hot water tap was delivering tepid water, while cold water tap was dry. After complaint  mechanics did come over to fix up, though the job done was not perfect.
The location is very good. 
This hotel has all the services under one roof, which is very important in winter when it is snowing outside.
My Nephew who was also with us on this trip and had stayed in Highland park hotel many times earlier had booked this hotel for a change. His was of the opinion that in Summer, Highland Park would be a better choice, while in winter this Khyber Resort  would be OK.

reviews.author: Gujjarwalprince
reviews.title: Great Grand Property at Great Grand Place.
reviews.text: Wonderful Hotel . newly built . Interiors are like a palace . Location is the negative point as it doesn't face the grasslands of Gulmarg but otherwise the rooms the staff the interiors the ambience is 7 star . One really wondwrs that such an iconic place excists in a place like Gulmarg . Hats off the the Owners of the hotel. They hav put in their heart in this property.

reviews.author: Azaddeepak
reviews.title: Heaven in Himalayas
reviews.text:
One of the greatest experience as guest in the hotel.
The property is ideally located having the views of snow capped mountains
The facilities at the hotel is 5 star plus
The rooms are with all the modern amenities and are better than many hotels in metro cities (a pleasant surprise )
A memorable stay

reviews.author: Aman_Rahi
reviews.title: Avoid having food as even our Guide fell sick
reviews.text: On 25 June, 2013 I along with my family and our Guide (Sahquat) went to have our lunch but to our shock and dismay the food quality was terrible and my daughter aged 4 years started puking the moment we reached tangmarg and my wife felt nausea and severe headache and our Guide(a Local from Tangmarg) suffered from diarrhea. Avoid having food.

reviews.author: M S B
reviews.title: Memorable Gulmarg trip
reviews.text: Wow!! A great view and equally well maintained décor. Excellent view of snow capped mountains and valley from the room. Would have loved to be there during snow fall. Looking forward to visit ' Khyber' again in October to feel the chilly weather>>>> Paisa Wasool stay..

reviews.author: Samit-Garg
reviews.title: Incredible Experience
reviews.text:
The place is exceptional. It surprises you with the kind of hotel experience that a place like Gulmarg can offer. 

Lavish rooms, great food, cultured hospitality and multiple terraces for chilling out - collectively make it a must do.

It is expensive, but I guess the huge costs of running the property in a place like Gulmarg, justifies their pricing.

Would love to be there again.

reviews.author: Rajesh G
reviews.title: Excellent property
reviews.text: the property is excellent in every thing. One can enjoy with family in the resort only. Earlier I thought Gulmarg is only for day trip only. But i never thought a resort of this kind can be made in gulmarg. I stayed there for 3 nights and everything was perfect.

reviews.author: Kalrak
reviews.title: Good Resort
reviews.text: We stayed for two nights at Khyber Gulmarg. It is a newly built property. Infrastructure is excellent but services need to pick up. Views are excellent. It is not value for money. the price charged is exorbitant as same quality of room can be had at much lesser price in other cities of the country.

reviews.author: Rakeshsony
reviews.title: Dream property
reviews.text:
One of the best hill station resort that I have been. Amazing setting, amazing facilities. Everything is out of the world. 
Food is excellent. You can't ask for more.
They should have some more games for kids.

reviews.author: agarwalmohit96
reviews.title: Excellent Place But Poor Service
reviews.text:
We stayed in Kyber Hotel for 2 nights. I must say the hotel is built in an excellent manner, however, they lack proper guest service. We took almost 2 hours to check in in spite of prior booking. We were received at the gate and made to seat in the tea lounge while our rooms were allotted, however after 35 minutes when I approached the helpdesk, they were not even aware of our waiting. We were then allotted rooms 2 floors below, with the elevators "YET TO START". We refused to take the rooms as my uncle is a heart patient and can't climb so many stairs. They upgraded our rooms (Which is a good thing) but took additional 1 hour to do so. Slightly disorganized. The food is gud but if you opt for ala carte than be prepared to be served cold food.

If I am to rate the hotel, than it would be 4.5 out of 5 but service would be 2.5 out of 5.0. They may not get repeated customers if they continue like this.

reviews.author: Avi_loves_travel
reviews.title: Exceptional in Winter
reviews.text:
Best luxury ski resort in Kashmir. Stayed here in winter , February 2013. The gondola to the ski slopes is just below the resort, walking distance which makes it very convenient for skiers.
 
The resort is very well made, offers multi cuisine restaurant and great views from the balcony views. The rooms are comfortable, and well heated for winter.

It offers large close areas for groups and most recommended.

reviews.author: SiddharthVasudevan
reviews.title: Excellent property, many improvements needed
reviews.text: The check in was painfully slow, we were offered some kahwa and then totally forgotten about. The rooms are nice and well appointed. As this hotel is still under construction, be prepared to hear a lot of drilling and hammering noises. The spa is also not functional yet. the business center is also lacking in many aspects. No newspapers delivered to the rooms in the morning. Quality of food is very good and the service in the restaurant is good. Housekeeping also did not attend to the room despite the make my room sign being on. The location is very good. The management really needs to pull up their socks to bring it to the level of other SLH hotels. Not many activities to keep you occupied through the day.

reviews.author: AMSAVANI
reviews.title: IN PRAISE OF KHYBER GULMURG AND ITS STAFF
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Khyber Hymlayan resort and spa at Gulmurg for 2 nights recently. I went with no expectations but the hotel turned out a big and pleasant surprise. One of the best hotels/resort i have been in. (have visited many all over the world).The service is impeccable. the food v delicious and varied. The terraced  garden and manicured lawns were a treat for sore eyes. The staff are more like hosts than hotel staff.The View from he balcony rooms is awesome and mind-blowing.near paradise.
 Mr. Mithun at the front desk was an epitome of courtesy and helpfulness. Wonderful experience. I cannot rate it more as there are no more dots above. wish you all the best and see you soon. Will come back

reviews.author: Maneet99
reviews.title: Good going.
reviews.text:
This is just less then 2 hours away from Srinagar Airport. The staff was welcoming & helpful. We had a premier room with a very modern bathroom. The hotel is yet to finish its pool, fitness & spa facilities. I would say to them, with such wonderful property & location, they should brace themselves to give some world-class services. The staff at front desk works fine, but still got to do more in terms of english language & most importantly to have a hold on the neighbour-gondola rides. Breakfast was not bad, they should change the menu on daily or alternate basis. I would definitely recommend to stay in this beautiful Hotel with family.
My request to the management of this hotel, to do their extra bit to make this a class hotel, rather then run-of-the-mill hotel. It deserves to be in a league of its own due to its location & architecture. You have won the first round but still long way to go.

reviews.author: raj
reviews.title: need to work hard
reviews.text: fanatastic location....well designed public and private spaces...good facilities.....good food but very heavily priced should stress on serving local cuisines also...rather than the regular punjabis cusine.........all staff appeared new thats way services and other managerial affairs not upto the mark.....housekeeping staff on floor was good and hard working.....staff response overall ok...but courteous staff....sometimes appeared confused and could not take decesions.....well dressed and mannnered staff at all levels........ good concept to have doctor inhouse but he charged us rs200 for his visit had no idea regarding this..................now are bad expirences.....in our two day stay our rooms mcb must have tripped at least ten times and the last one was at twelvepm at night...though th estaff was sincerely working on no issues regarding that but the issue is that with all the technicalities available they could not understand and control the sitituation....which was really very irritaating we had asked teh manager to change our rooms but they were not willing to do so and they continued our stay despite not resolvingthe problem fully that was a bad gesture on teh part of management...and also no compilimentaries were served to us in form of compensations................and no elevators were there.....no floor phones to connect to reception was available.........corridors were stinking whenever it was raining outside....informed teh managers and floor house keeping concerns...........wooden floor in toilets an d wet corridor was very slippery and would lead to major maintanance in future for teh hotel management.....the glass concept was a poor thought......and several minor issues related to planning an d maintenence must be seriously seen by the hotel managements.......

reviews.author: jyotigupta105
reviews.title: Best Hotel in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Situated in Gulmarg, Kashmir, this hotel was a 2.5 hour drive from Srinagar. The property is beautiful and a lot of wood has been used in its construction. The rooms facing the snow-covered mountains have a much better view so do specify in advance at the time of booking, else you might regret getting the other view. Although I was under the assumption, thanks to my travel agent, that there was a working spa, beauty salon and pool, I was a bit disappointed that these services have not yet begun and are still under construction and might start only from September 2013. I was looking forward to a relaxing time using the spa services and their indoor heated pool, but I guess that will have to wait for my next trip. Also, they can do a better job with the garden- there were hardly any flowers in bloom. The food is excellent- breakfast buffet, lunch and dinner, despite just one restaurant. The staff is very courteous, helpful and friendly. On reaching, we were served an excellent kashmiri kahwa. They have a small section in the lobby called 'chaikash' which is a station to serve all-day coffee, tea, snacks etc. and I enjoyed the lovely hot chocolate every day of my trip here. The hotel does not have a bar. Overall, a lovely hotel built in a beautiful region, surrounded by a view of snow-capped mountains. Away from the scorching 45 degrees heat of my hometown Delhi, it was a lovely change with perfect weather. Definitely recommend Khyber to all visiting Gulmarg

reviews.author: Nisha B
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: The hotel is situated inside Gulmarg and just 2 minutes from the popular Gondola ride. The property is big and is tastefully built. One can view the distant snow-capped peaks from the tea lounge, and beautiful pine trees and snow from the room/balcony. We received a warm welcome and the hotel upgraded us to luxury rooms for free which was a bonus. The rooms are spacious and truly luxurious. The service is prompt and up to the mark. Breakfast has good variety and can please most taste buds. The room tariff and the restaurant are both expensive, but I think that goes for most hotels in Kashmir. The hotel is a steep ride up and not comfortable to walk. One can ask for pick-ups and drops which is a wonderful addition to the service provided. A tip: To have outside cars inside Gulmarg, one needs to have hotel's booking voucher. Make sure you carry yours with you to avoid any hassle.

reviews.author: gvicky
reviews.title: "Fantasctic Hotel "
reviews.text:
I opted for Khyber Hotels in Gulmarg after reading favorable reviews by other travelers. I too was not disappointed. The staff was humble. The staff(from manager to cleanliness staff) will notice you and greet you even when you are roaming in the hotel gallery.
I stayed in Luxury Balcony Room. Though The Restaurant is not too spacious but the service staff maintained and manged the restaurant in a perfect way specially Rajeev & Deepak. We had a great time staying at the resort... The service was impeccable... 

The Food is bit expensive .
Room Tip: All the rooms have good view. This Hotel is in the middle of the valley.. so you will see great view.

reviews.author: ANAND Gulani
reviews.title: May 7th-May 9th, Luxury at its best !!!
reviews.text:
We started from Pahalgam towards Gulmarg and after having a hearty meal at Pine View Hotel Tangmarg, the climb of 13km to reach Gulmarg was just beautiful. Once we reached Gulmarg, we drove all the way in and up to reach the bestest property in Kashmir "Khyber Gulmarg", what a property. 

Check in welcome was so smooth and relaxing while sipping hot Kahwa and seeing the beautiful snowcap mountains was just fantastic
Gulmarg and Khyber really made me and my family feel really Euphoric, very very happy.
Location, food, service was simply fantastic and upto the mark

We loved this property so much even though the spa and pool were not yet operational, I can imagine what this will be once they are set rolling "Paradise in itself at Gulmarg"

We did both the levels by the Gondola and it was superb. We got a great guide Bilal arranged by the hotel and he really helped us a lot from the tickets to getting into the line to negotiating for the rides, taking to the best food at level 1, he was great. 

One can easily spend a week at this property by not stepping out, it has the needed expance, great location, breathtaking views and service.

Would like to really thank and mention Faheem Qureshi, Wasim Raja, Mithun Mandal, Suheel, Muddazar,Hamid and from the restaurant big thanks to Shyam, Deepak, Yatinder, Arun, Anu.
My cell phone was not working and I needed to make a couple of important calls and Mithun along with staff helped he there too which was much much much appreciated.

It was a pleasure to meet with mr Alex Koshy GM of the property and the owner Mr. Omar Tambroo and really thank them for their hospitality

ONLY +VES, NO -VES, THIS IS A DREAM HOTEL IN A DREAM LOCATION. IF YOU WANT THE BEST IN GULMARG, THERE IS ONLY ONE KHYBER THE SUPREME, YOU HAVE NO CHOICES AND YOU NEED NO CHOICES, IT IS KHYBER ALL THE WAY

reviews.author: Vinay290
reviews.title: not good experience.
reviews.text:
The hotel would have great potential they have Big beautiful rooms with stunning mountain view.

the hotel is near to Gondola but far from the market.

no bar, indoor pool, gym, spa are not in a working state & they are showing it on the internet, this was very disappointing and the room rates are high.

problem with the local people they are not allowing to take a cab to roam around which is disturbing & irritating because the hotel & Govt authorities seems to be doing nothing about it, they literally fought with us after we came back from gondola & spoiled our trip.

food is ok

Restaurant is overpriced.

service people seems to be confusing.

reviews.author: Aditya M
reviews.title: Khyber Resort - Beautiful Property and Best Option to Stay in Gulmarg
reviews.text: We stayed in Khyber in April 2013.....The one word which describes our stay is " Amazing" . All aspects are taken care of for a luxurious stay..... Once the other infrastructure like swimming pool, spa and children activity center becomes operational it will be the one of THE place in Kashmir Valley. Very well done up interiors and great service. Some teething issues are there but 'm sure that these aspects will be taken care of.

reviews.author: Vinay S
reviews.title: World Class facilities but still some rough edges
reviews.text:
Had prebooked this hotel a long time before the actual check in date. Started from Sonamarg early in the day, went directly to the Gondola and after a tiring day went to the resort looking for a hot bath. However found that the reservation desk had messed up my reservation and inspite of having paid the full amount in advance there was no room for me. The matter was sorted out after an irritatingly long wait and I was taken to my room.
The room is magnificient & luxurious by any standard. Decorated in the most elegant and aesthetic way, the balcony rooms were delightful. Everything, the decor, the presentation, the luxury, the service, the food was top notch. But inspite of all of this I did not carry back fond memories. The reasons are as under:
1) There was an argument at the entrance of Gulmarg with the people manning the barrier. Outside cars are not allowed inside Gulmarg unless the traveller has a booking for night stay. I was told that the mail of the reservation desk was not clear regarding booking.
2) As already mentioned my reservation was all messed up. I had modified my reservation dates and had obtained a confirmation from the hotel but it seemed that the changes were not made at the hotel database. Luckily I had carried print out of the entire emails and so was able to make my point. However precious time was lost in this.
3) At the time of check out I was presented with the bill with tarriff different from the promised one. Moreover my advance was also not being given credit. This again caused long delay and was sorted out after going through my emails. Surprisingly the hotel has till date not been able to trace out the payment inspite of me having providing the snap shot of all slips and bank account. This was however was not a good experience.
So once the sharp edges are softened Im sure it would be wonderful to go back.

reviews.author: NirajBVashi
reviews.title: Best Luxury Hotel in Kashmir
reviews.text: Khyber Himalayan Resort (spa is still coming up) is arguably the most luxurious hotel in Kashmir. Everything there is built for the luxury traveller (Spa, heated Swimming pool will be ready soon). Considering that Kashmir dont have many brand new hotels, Khyber is simply multiple notches above everyone else. Considering its started recently (Dec 2012), few things still need refinements (e.g. Electric blankets are missing, Wi-Fi is chargeable and Buffet meals are too expensive), its still is an experience that will leave lasting impression. It has closest Himalayan views, nice away from market and close to gondola location and also the only hotel in Gulmarg that offers complimentary transfers to Gondola and market.

reviews.author: Madhavi1976
reviews.title: Beautiful property surrounded with Snow capped Mountains
reviews.text: We stayed in Khyber Resorts Gulmarg from 5 - 7th April...... The resort is simply awesome and the way the resort has integrated the Kashmir effect in the lobby and all the areas....its simply amazing.... We had a great time staying at the resort... The service was impeccable... It has just started in Dec 2012, so there are some teething issues like over heating in rooms etc but 'm sure that in times to come this will be THE place in whole of Kashmir.... Thanks to Khyber Team for giving a perfect start to our Kashmir Holidays

reviews.author: Al-Mustabsher
reviews.title: The only 5* hotel in Gulmarg
reviews.text: It is a luxurious resort with a beautiful decoration and nice location.the rooms are clean and centrally heated. The security and staff at your service at anytime.You can spend a nice time in cafe had a beautiful view on the mountains

reviews.author: Vivek
reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed the hotel.nice rooms with terrific Himalayan view.
spa and other activities not yet started.Staffs are very cooperative and gentle. Food quality is good.Nice big bath tubs in Balcony deluxe rooms.

reviews.author: Tiwaskar
reviews.title: What a Place to Stay !!!
reviews.text: We stayed there for 2 night. The place is so beautiful that u feel as if ur in heaven. Great ambience, Fantastic Hospitality, Superb service, Lovely location, Fine dinning and amazing value for your money. Very New place - just inaugurated in December 2012.

reviews.author: Horizonseaker
reviews.title: Excellent property, fantastic location.
reviews.text: Khyber is located close to the Gondola at Gulmarg.  This is a tastefully decorated five star property.  The rooms offer great views, especially the ones facing the Aparwath mountain.  The beds very comfortable.  the rooms are spacious and clean.  The washrooms have a small walkin wardrobe and a nice tub.  The spa is yet to commence operations.  Liquor is currently not available at the property.  The restaurants offer very good food of different cuisines.  There's lot of snow in the backyard for kids to play during winters.  Each room has a balcony with a sit out, it's a present experience to sit on these in he mornings / evenings.  The hotel is new, they are still evolving the finer aspects of managing this magnificent property.  Gondola is at a walking distance, otherwise It's desirable to have your own transport to commute.

reviews.author: Aditi Thorat
reviews.title: i am in love with "KHYBER RESORT "
reviews.text: Amazing place. Its like nature embraces this place. n just beautiful ambience. The staff is sooo good, so efficient. they hv  human touch to their service. they make u feel at home n secure. Chef Vivek kapoors food is a delight. Centralised heating system is wonderful. Many of the well known hotels cant beat them at their standards. tthis is definitely one must visit place time n again.

reviews.author: Dilshad M
reviews.title: The 1st luxury resort in Gulmarg
reviews.text: Great place with an extremely professional staff. Only had lunch here but really an experience in class. Just what Gulmarg needed. I have been going to Gulmarg for skiing for the last 25 years and was happy to see the Khyber.

reviews.author: Dolly786
reviews.title: Excellent Property ....Must Visit
reviews.text:
Amazing Hotel and Spa. reviews.author: MayankMehtaMumbai
reviews.title: Mind Blowing Ski Resort Superb Khyber
reviews.text: This is exactly the place Gulmarg Kashmir needed, and finaly it has arrived. The hotel is excellent in par with any luxury ski resort abroad, rooms are a delight and very comfortable,service par excelence courteous warm and accommodating, the breakfast spread is amazing and the food quality is amazing, room service is good and so is the housekeeping scope of a little improvement ther but guess it has its initial teething problems but will surely be updated. We are regular skiers at Gulmarg since 1982 and such a place was always dreamed of and there it is, full marks to  Khyber. The rooms are so well done with fine detailing and catering to all specially the skiers, central heating is delight and very effective as promised, the bathrooms are so well planned with a hot tub perfect after a day of sking and the view of the mountains and the snow from the hot tub is just fantastic and a great experience. Traveling with our 4 year old grandchild was a bit of concern when we started our trip, but she was so comfortable in the minus temperatures and also took upto skiing and the snow very well now she wants to do this every year. The staff looked after us so well and promptly organised some great evenings specially for our family group of 12. This is one more of our memorable trips to Gulmarg for Skiing and for this time highlight was the Khyber hotel and its super staff. Congratulations and my best wishes to them. .......Mayank Mehta , Mumbai India

reviews.author: entdelhi
reviews.title: finally gulmarg gets what it deserves!
reviews.text:
at the outset i would like to confess that we did not stay here - came to check out the property because we were looking for an alternative to our hotel we were unhappy at.
it is located at a height, close to the gondola ski lift where the serious skiers would want to be.
since the property is very new, they do not have protocols set in place for skiers - people were entering with their ski boots and ski sticks - which must be murder on the flooring as well as carpeting! they need to set up a changing room/ lounge for skiers to change their footwear etc.
The central atrium is awesome with a high dome, wooden flooring, thick carpets and walls adorned with great paintings.
we sat in the tea lounge and ordered the kashmiri tea - ' kahwa' and it was delicious - flavoured with saffron and served with sliced almonds on the side.
had a chat with the hotel manager who was knowledgeable, pleasant, helpful and passionate about his role - the plan is to set up a spa as well as a year round swimming pool soon. he proudly announced that the property is already a member of the 'small luxury hotel' group - a great honour.
we dined at the coffee shop - the menu is extensive, compared to what was till now available at Gulmarg. The order got confused - they got us stuff we had not ordered, but were prompt to rectify.
a great property, very very new, hopefully with a great future!

reviews.author: Ashish R
reviews.title: 5 star luxury in the lap of himalaya
reviews.text: We reached Khyber Resort just a day after it was inaugurated. The quality of interior is be breathtaking. The rooms are very comfortable, with great view of the Gulmarg mountains clad with snow.. The food quality is excellent, though the helping could have been more generous.. The toilets also have a large window, through which you get an amazing view.

reviews.author: eltoxtli
reviews.title: Best hotel in Gulmarg but not up to the marks
reviews.text:
Likes
Nice hotel with great potential. Beautiful rooms with stunning mountain view. Nice coffee bar.
Friendly stuff.
Good location near to Gondola.
Disturbing
Hotel page at booking.com was showing bar, indoor pool, gym. Non of this is existing or working, this was very disapointing especially considering the fact that full room rate is charged. 
Breakfast buffet ok but some food items where looking like the had been placed the day before.
Restaurant completely overpriced.
Drop to Srinagar airport overpriced (6000INR).
Safety issues for small kids at the stairs.
No new years celebration.
I would have preferred to give all this comments directly to the hotel manager but there seem to be no interest to get direct feedback from international travellers. Despite the fact that we spent 4 nights here nobody was approaching us to get our opinion.
Check out procedure took 40 minutes!
